instructions_en: Position yourself on the hyperextension machine with your hips resting at the top of the pad and feet secured under the footrests.
Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
Lower your torso downward toward the floor by hinging at the hips.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, feeling the stretch in your lower back.
Raise your torso back to the starting position by contracting your lower back and glutes.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The 45-degree hyperextension machine is a back extension exercise targeting the lower back erectors and glutes. The angled pad supports the hips at 45 degrees, allowing a full range of motion for strengthening the posterior chain and improving spinal extension strength.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于45度山羊挺身器上，髋部置于垫子上方，双脚固定在脚垫下。
双臂交叉于胸前或置于脑后。
以髋部为轴，将躯干向下降低。
在最低点稍作停顿，感受下背部的拉伸。
收缩下背部和臀肌，将躯干抬回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent at 90 degrees, feet off the ground.
Extend your arms out to the sides for stability, palms facing down.
Keeping your knees together, slowly rotate your legs to one side until they are just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then rotate your legs back through center and to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The 90-90 rotation is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and obliques. It involves lying on your back with legs bent at 90 degrees and rotating them side to side, improving spinal rotation and core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，髋部和膝盖弯曲成90度，双脚离地。
双臂向两侧伸展以保持稳定，掌心朝下。
双膝并拢，缓慢将双腿向一侧旋转，直至接近地面。
稍作停顿，然后将双腿经中间转回并转向另一侧。
继续交替两侧，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and grip an ab wheel or barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Position the wheel directly beneath your shoulders with your arms fully extended.
Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body towards the ground while keeping your core tight.
Pause when your body is nearly parallel to the floor, then engage your abs to roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ab roll workout is a barbell or ab wheel exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, with secondary emphasis on the obliques, lower back, and shoulders. It involves rolling forward from a kneeling position to challenge core stability and strength.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手握住健腹轮或杠铃，与肩同宽。
将轮子置于肩膀正下方，双臂完全伸展。
缓慢向前滚动轮子，身体向地面延伸，同时保持核心收紧。
当身体接近与地面平行时暂停，然后收紧腹肌将轮子滚回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a plank position with your hands on sliders or a smooth surface, arms fully extended.
Slide one leg out to the side while simultaneously sliding your arms forward, extending your body.
Pause at the extended position, engaging your core and inner thighs.
Return to the starting plank position by pulling your arms and leg back in.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ab-to-adduction slide straight arms is a bodyweight exercise that combines core engagement with hip adductor activation. Performed on sliders, it challenges the abs and inner thighs through a controlled sliding motion with straight arms.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑姿势开始，双手放在滑盘或光滑表面上，双臂完全伸展。
将一条腿向侧面滑出，同时双臂向前滑动，身体延伸。
在伸展位置暂停，收紧核心和大腿内侧。
将双臂和腿收回，回到起始平板支撑姿势。
换另一侧重复，继续交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands directly under your shoulders.
Brace your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body toward the floor.
Extend as far as you can while maintaining a flat back and without letting your hips sag.
Pause briefly, then use your core to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ab wheel rollout is an ab wheel exercise targeting the abdominal muscles through an extended anti-extension movement. Rolling the body out against gravity demands significant core strength and is considered one of the most demanding ab exercises.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手握住健腹轮手柄，置于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，缓慢向前滚动轮子，身体向地面延伸。
尽可能向前伸展，保持背部平直，避免髋部下沉。
稍作停顿，然后用核心力量将轮子拉回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and grip an ab wheel with both hands directly below your shoulders.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body toward the ground.
Continue rolling until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor without touching it.
Pause briefly, then use your abs to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ab wheel rollout (kneeling) is a core strengthening exercise performed from a kneeling position using an ab wheel. It challenges the abs, lower back, and shoulders by requiring full-body tension during a controlled forward and backward rolling motion.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手握住健腹轮，置于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，缓慢向前滚动轮子，身体向地面延伸。
继续滚动直至躯干接近与地面平行但不接触地面。
稍作停顿，然后用腹肌将轮子拉回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands, positioning it directly beneath your shoulders.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body towards the ground.
Continue rolling out as far as you can while keeping your back flat and hips from sagging.
Pause briefly at full extension, then use your core to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ab wheel workout is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles while engaging the lower back and shoulders as stabilizers. It involves rolling out and back on an ab wheel from a kneeling position, demanding full core tension throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手握住健腹轮手柄，置于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，缓慢向前滚动轮子，身体向地面延伸。
尽可能向前滚动，保持背部平直，避免髋部下沉。
在完全伸展处稍作停顿，然后用核心力量将轮子拉回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet together and place one hand on a wall or support for balance.
Shift your weight onto your standing leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side in a controlled kicking motion.
Raise your leg as high as comfortable while keeping your hips level and torso upright.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions and switch sides.
description_en: The abduction kick is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hip abductors and outer glutes through a lateral leg kick. The controlled kicking motion activates the gluteus medius and improves hip stability and range of motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，一只手扶墙或支撑物以保持平衡。
将重心移到支撑腿上，以受控的踢腿动作将另一条腿向侧面抬起。
在舒适范围内尽量抬高腿部，保持髋部水平、躯干直立。
缓慢将腿放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换另一侧。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and keeping the other leg straight.
Lower your hips toward the bent knee side, feeling a stretch along the inner thigh of the straight leg.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, then shift to the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The adductor stretch forward is a bodyweight inner thigh stretch performed in a wide-stance position. By shifting the weight to one side, the adductors of the opposite straight leg are elongated, improving hip mobility and inner thigh flexibility.
instructions_zh: 双脚分开站立，间距宽于肩。
重心移向一侧，弯曲该侧膝盖，另一条腿保持伸直。
臀部向屈膝侧下沉，感受伸直腿大腿内侧的拉伸。
保持20–30秒，然后换另一侧。
每侧按目标次数重复。
xunji_candidate: 泡沫轴股内侧肌肉拉伸

instructions_en: Start in a frog position on hands and knees with your knees wide and feet turned out.
Shift your hips slowly to one side, lowering toward the floor.
Return to the center and shift to the opposite side.
Maintain a controlled, deliberate movement pace throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The advanced frog side-shift is a bodyweight hip mobility drill that uses lateral hip shifting from the frog position to stretch the adductors and hip joint. It is used to develop deep inner thigh flexibility and improve overall hip range of motion.
instructions_zh: 从青蛙式开始，双手双膝撑地，膝盖打开，双脚外旋。
臀部缓慢移向一侧，向地面下沉。
回到中间，再移向对侧。
全程保持受控、有意识的动作节奏。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a frog position on all fours with your knees wide and toes pointed outward.
Gently shift your hips toward one side, sinking closer to the floor on that side.
Hold the shifted position briefly before returning to center.
Shift to the opposite side and hold.
Continue alternating for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The advanced frog side-shift version 1 is a hip mobility variation of the frog side-shift that incorporates a brief hold at the end range of each lateral shift. The paused position allows the adductor and hip flexor muscles to relax into a deeper stretch.
instructions_zh: 从青蛙式开始，四点支撑，膝盖打开，脚尖外展。
臀部轻轻移向一侧，向该侧地面下沉。
在偏移位置短暂保持后回到中间。
换对侧移动并保持。
按目标次数持续交替。

instructions_en: Begin in a frog position on all fours with your knees spread wide and feet turned outward.
Shift your hips to one side and then rock back to center.
Move further to each side with each repetition to explore a greater range.
Keep your core engaged and your lower back from excessively arching.
Continue for the desired number of side shifts in each direction.
description_en: The advanced frog side-shift version 2 is a dynamic hip mobility exercise performed from the frog position. Side-shifting the hips opens the inner thighs and hip capsule progressively, improving adductor flexibility and deep hip range of motion.
instructions_zh: 从青蛙式开始，四点支撑，膝盖大幅打开，双脚外旋。
臀部移向一侧，再回到中间。
每次重复向两侧移动更远，以探索更大活动范围。
保持核心收紧，避免下背过度拱起。
每侧按目标次数持续侧移。

instructions_en: Begin in the frog position on all fours with knees wide and feet externally rotated.
Shift your hips in a controlled arc to the far left, hovering close to the floor.
Transition smoothly from left to right in a continuous rocking motion.
Increase the amplitude of the shift over successive repetitions.
Perform for the desired number of passes in each direction.
description_en: The advanced frog side-shift version 3 incorporates a continuous flowing transition from side to side in the frog position. The smooth arc of motion and progressive amplitude challenge the adductor mobility and hip joint control at a more dynamic level than the held variations.
instructions_zh: 从青蛙式开始，四点支撑，膝盖打开，双脚外旋。
臀部以受控弧线移向最左侧，贴近地面悬停。
从左到右平滑过渡，形成连续摇摆动作。
随重复次数增加侧移幅度。
每侧按目标次数完成。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and arms extended out to your sides.
Shift your weight onto one foot and slowly hinge forward at the hips, lifting the opposite leg behind you.
Extend your arms forward as your torso and raised leg come parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for the desired duration, keeping your core engaged and your body in a straight line.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The aeroplan balance is a bodyweight exercise that targets the core and challenges overall balance and stability. It involves hinging forward on one leg while extending the opposite leg and arms, mimicking an airplane shape. This movement develops proprioception, hip stability, and core control.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双脚与髋同宽，双臂向两侧伸展。
重心移到一只脚上，髋部缓慢前屈，同时另一条腿向后抬起。
双臂前伸，使躯干与抬起腿与地面平行。
保持目标时长，核心收紧，身体成一直线。
回到起始位置，换对侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright on one foot with your arms extended out to your sides.
Hinge forward at the hips while simultaneously lifting the opposite leg behind you until your torso and leg are parallel to the floor.
Reach your arms forward and hold the position for a longer duration than the standard version.
Engage your core and glutes throughout to maintain stability and control.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat on the other side for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The aeroplan balance advanced is a challenging bodyweight variation that increases the duration and difficulty of the standard aeroplan balance. It demands greater core stability, hip control, and proprioception, making it suitable for intermediate to advanced trainees.
instructions_zh: 单脚直立站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
髋部前屈，同时另一条腿向后抬起，直到躯干与腿平行于地面。
双臂前伸，保持时间比标准版更长。
全程收紧核心与臀肌，保持稳定与控制。
缓慢回到起始位置，换另一侧按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on one foot with your core engaged and your arms extended out to the sides.
Hinge forward at the hips, extending the free leg straight behind you.
Allow your torso to lower as your rear leg rises to maintain a horizontal line.
Hold the position for the desired duration, feeling the stretch in the hamstrings of the standing leg.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The aeroplan leg backward stretch is a bodyweight balance and flexibility exercise that combines a single-leg balance with a hamstring stretch. Hinging forward on one leg while extending the other back creates a deep stretch through the hamstrings of the planted leg.
instructions_zh: 单脚站立，核心收紧，双臂向两侧伸展。
髋部前屈，自由腿向后伸直。
躯干下沉、后腿抬起，保持水平线。
保持目标时长，感受支撑腿腘绳肌的拉伸。
回到站立，换另一侧重复。

name_en: agility ladder squat jump in out
instructions_en: Set up an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at one end of the ladder with your feet together.
Jump both feet into the first square, then jump them out to either side.
Immediately drop into a squat position, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Explode upward and move to the next square, repeating the in-out squat pattern down the length of the ladder.
Continue for the desired number of passes.
description_en: The agility ladder squat jump in out is a plyometric drill that targets the quadriceps and challenges coordination, speed, and lower body power. It combines ladder footwork with explosive squat jumps to improve agility and cardiovascular conditioning.
instructions_zh: 将敏捷梯平放在地面上。
双脚并拢站在梯子一端。
双脚跳入第一格，再向两侧跳出。
立即下蹲，保持胸部挺起，膝盖对准脚尖方向。
向上爆发跳起并移至下一格，沿梯子长度重复进出蹲跳模式。
持续完成目标次数。

name_en: air bike sit on hand support floor
instructions_en: Sit on the floor and place your hands flat on the ground behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor and begin pedaling your legs in a cycling motion.
Alternate bending and extending each knee in a smooth, controlled bicycle pattern.
Keep your core engaged and your chest upright throughout the movement.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration.
description_en: The air bike sit on hand support floor is a seated bodyweight exercise that simulates a cycling motion on the floor using hand support for stability. It targets the abs and hip flexors through the continuous pedaling action, serving as an accessible core and cardio drill.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双手平放在身后地面支撑。
双脚离地，开始以骑车动作蹬腿。
交替屈伸双膝，保持流畅可控的自行车动作。
全程收紧核心，保持胸部挺直。
持续蹬腿至目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit on the air bike and adjust the seat so your legs are slightly bent at full extension.
Grip the moving handles with both hands.
Begin pedaling and pumping the handles simultaneously at maximum effort.
Sprint at full intensity for the desired interval duration.
Slow down gradually and rest before repeating.
description_en: The air bike sprint is a high-intensity cardio exercise targeting the entire body. Using both the pedals and arm handles simultaneously, it elevates heart rate rapidly and burns a high number of calories, making it effective for conditioning and fat loss.
instructions_zh: 坐上风扇车，调整座椅使双腿在完全伸展时略微弯曲。
双手握住活动把手。
开始以最大努力同时蹬踏并拉动把手。
以全力冲刺目标间歇时长。
逐渐减速并休息后重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Engage your core and push your hips back as you bend your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The air squat is a foundational bodyweight lower body exercise targeting the quads, glutes, and hamstrings. It teaches proper squat mechanics and builds lower body strength, making it the basis for all squat progressions.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
收紧核心，屈膝同时将髋部向后推。
下蹲至大腿至少与地面平行。
保持胸部挺直，膝盖对准脚尖方向。
通过脚跟发力返回站立姿势。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head and your legs raised to a 90-degree angle.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor and rotate your torso, bringing your right elbow toward your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out.
Return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The air twisting crunch is a bodyweight core exercise that combines a crunch with a rotational twist and alternating leg extension. It targets the abs and obliques with added involvement of the hip flexors, making it an effective compound abdominal movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手置于头后，双腿抬起至90度角。
抬起肩胛骨离开地面并旋转躯干，将右肘朝左膝方向靠近。
同时将右腿伸直向外伸展。
回到中间位置并在另一侧重复。
持续交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs fully extended and raised slightly above the floor.
Simultaneously crunch upward and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee as you bend that knee in.
Extend the leg back out and return your torso toward center before immediately repeating on the other side.
Maintain a faster tempo than the standard version with the legs kept lower for increased difficulty.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The air twisting crunch advanced is an intensified version of the air twisting crunch performed with the legs held lower and at a faster tempo. The lower leg position increases the demand on the lower abs while the rotational component continues to target the obliques.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手置于头后，双腿完全伸直并略微抬离地面。
同时向上卷腹并旋转躯干，将一侧肘部朝对侧膝盖靠近，同时屈曲该膝盖。
将腿伸回并让躯干回到中间位置，然后立即在另一侧重复。
保持比标准版本更快的节奏，双腿保持较低位置以增加难度。
持续交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand tall with your feet together and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height.
Shift your weight onto your right foot and hinge forward at the hips, lifting your left leg straight behind you.
Continue tilting your torso forward until your body forms a straight line parallel to the floor.
Keep your arms extended wide and your gaze slightly forward to help with balance.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, then slowly return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Airplane pose is a standing balance posture that targets the lower back while engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and shoulders. It involves balancing on one leg while extending the torso and opposite leg parallel to the floor, improving stability and posterior chain strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站直，双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
将重心移至右脚，以髋部为轴前倾，同时将左腿向后方笔直抬起。
继续前倾躯干直至身体形成与地面平行的直线。
保持双臂大幅伸展，视线略微向前以帮助平衡。
保持该姿势20-30秒，然后缓慢回到站立并在另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended straight behind you.
Keeping your hips pressed to the ground, curl one leg upward by bending the knee toward your glutes.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstring.
Slowly lower your leg back to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite leg, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The alternate leg curl is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed lying face down. It involves curling one leg at a time toward the glutes, engaging the hamstrings and glutes while promoting unilateral leg strength.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫子上，双腿向后方笔直伸展。
保持髋部贴地，将一条腿向上弯曲，膝盖朝臀部方向屈曲。
在动作顶端停顿，挤压腘绳肌。
缓慢将腿放回起始位置。
在另一条腿上重复，交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms fully extended at your sides.
Keeping your elbow stationary, curl the right dumbbell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause at the top and squeeze your bicep, then slowly lower the weight.
Repeat the movement with your left arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The alternating dumbbell curl is a classic upper arm exercise targeting the biceps. By curling one arm at a time, it allows for focused contraction and better mind-muscle connection while also engaging the forearms as secondary stabilizers.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持哑铃，手臂自然下垂伸直。
保持肘部固定，将右哑铃向上弯举至肩部。
在顶端停顿并挤压肱二头肌，然后缓慢放下。
左臂重复该动作。
继续交替两侧至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your right side with your body in a straight line, supporting your head with your right hand.
Bend your right elbow and prop your head up, placing your right foot flat on the mat for stability.
Raise your left leg toward the ceiling, keeping it straight, and hold your left big toe with your left hand if possible.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the inner thigh and hamstring.
Slowly lower your leg, roll to the other side, and repeat.
description_en: Anantasana is a reclining yoga posture targeting the hamstrings and inner thighs while requiring core engagement for lateral balance. It involves lying on one side and extending one leg upward, promoting flexibility and stability.
instructions_zh: 右侧卧，身体呈一条直线，用右手支撑头部。
屈右肘撑起头部，右脚平放垫上以保持稳定。
将左腿伸直向上抬起，尽可能用左手抓住左脚大脚趾。
保持20-30秒，感受大腿内侧和腘绳肌的拉伸。
缓慢放下左腿，转向另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides at shoulder height.
Slowly rotate your arms in small circular motions, gradually increasing the size of the circles.
After the desired number of repetitions, reverse the direction of the circles.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions in each direction.
description_en: Angle mobility is a bodyweight exercise targeting the deltoids and improving shoulder joint range of motion. It involves controlled circular arm movements to increase flexibility, reduce stiffness, and warm up the shoulder muscles.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
双臂缓慢做小圆圈旋转，逐渐加大圆圈幅度。
完成目标次数后，反方向旋转。
每个方向继续至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine straight and shoulders relaxed.
Close your mouth and smile gently, then push the fleshy part of your cheeks upward toward your eyes using your facial muscles.
Hold the lifted position for 5 seconds, feeling the tension in your cheek muscles.
Slowly release and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The apple cheek lift is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the cheek muscles. It involves lifting the cheeks upward toward the eyes to tone and firm the mid-face region.
instructions_zh: 坐姿或站姿，脊柱挺直，肩膀放松。
闭嘴微笑，用面部肌肉将脸颊肉向上推向眼睛方向。
保持上提位置5秒，感受面颊肌肉紧张。
缓慢放松，恢复中性表情。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a wide push-up position with your hands significantly wider than shoulder-width.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body toward the bent arm, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The archer push up is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals by placing more load on one arm at a time. The extended arm provides balance and mild assistance, making it a powerful stepping stone toward single-arm push-up strength.
instructions_zh: 以宽距俯卧撑姿势开始，双手明显宽于肩宽。
将一侧手臂向侧面伸直，与地面平行。
身体向屈臂一侧下降，保持背部挺直、核心收紧。
推回起始位置。
换另一侧重复，伸直对侧手臂。
继续交替两侧至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the floor outside your left thigh.
Place your right hand behind you on the floor for support and wrap your left arm around your right knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and twist your torso to the right as far as comfortably possible.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then return to center and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: Ardha matsyendrasana, or the seated spinal twist, is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and spine. It involves rotating the torso from a seated position to improve spinal mobility and engage the core and obliques.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
屈右膝，将右脚平放在左大腿外侧的地面上。
右手放在身后地面支撑，左臂环抱右膝。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气将躯干向右扭转至舒适范围。
保持20-30秒，回到中间，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, palms facing down.
Slowly bring both arms forward and cross them in front of your chest in a butterfly motion.
Open the arms back out to the sides and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The arm butterfly with bottle stretch is a bodyweight exercise using bottles as light resistance. It targets the deltoids through a wide butterfly motion, warming up the shoulders and upper chest while improving range of motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一瓶水置于体侧。
双臂向两侧抬起至肩高，掌心向下。
双臂缓慢向前，在胸前以蝴蝶式交叉。
双臂向两侧打开，回到起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to your sides.
Begin making small circular motions with both arms, gradually increasing the size of the circles.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions, then reverse the direction of the circles.
Keep your core engaged and back straight throughout the movement.
description_en: Arm Circle Stretch 1 is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids. It involves rotating both arms in circular motions to warm up the shoulder joints, improve mobility, and increase blood flow to the upper body.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
双臂开始做小圆圈运动，逐渐加大圆圈幅度。
继续至目标次数，然后反方向旋转。
全程保持核心收紧、背部挺直。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Slowly raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height, palms facing down.
Hold the position for 2-3 seconds, feeling the stretch in your shoulders and chest.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Arm Raise Front Stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids and chest. It involves lifting both arms forward to shoulder height to improve shoulder flexibility and warm up the upper body.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。
缓慢将双臂向前伸直抬至肩高，掌心向下。
保持2-3秒，感受肩部和胸部的拉伸。
缓慢将双臂放回起始位置，重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back straight.
Slowly raise both arms out to your sides simultaneously.
Continue lifting until your arms are fully extended and parallel to the floor.
Reach outward through your fingertips, feeling a stretch across your chest and shoulders.
Hold this extended position for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly lower your arms back to your sides.
description_en: The arm stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the traps and upper arms. It is performed standing by pulling one arm across the chest to release tension and improve shoulder flexibility.
instructions_zh: 直立，双脚与肩同宽，背部挺直。
缓慢将双臂同时向两侧抬起。
继续抬起直至双臂完全伸直并与地面平行。
指尖向外延伸，感受胸部和肩部的拉伸。
保持此伸展姿势20-30秒。
缓慢将双臂放回身体两侧。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand reaches toward the opposite shoulder blade.
Use your opposite hand to gently press the raised elbow downward, deepening the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
Repeat on both sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Arm stretch version 1 is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary engagement of the deltoids and upper back. It involves an overhead elbow bend assisted by the opposite hand to maximize the stretch.
instructions_zh: 直立，双脚与肩同宽。
将一只手臂举过头顶，弯曲肘部使手伸向对侧肩胛骨。
用另一只手轻轻向下按压抬起的手肘，加深拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后换手臂。
两侧交替重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bring one arm straight across your chest at shoulder height.
Use the opposite hand or forearm to press the extended arm closer to your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling the pull in the shoulder.
Switch arms and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Arm stretch version 2 is a bodyweight stretching exercise that targets the deltoids. It involves a horizontal cross-body arm pull to increase shoulder flexibility and relieve tension in the upper arms and upper back.
instructions_zh: 直立，双脚与肩同宽。
将一只手臂在肩高处横过胸前伸直。
用对侧手或前臂将伸直的手臂向胸前按压。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受肩部的牵拉感。
换手臂，在另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Cross your arms over your chest, wrapping each hand around the opposite shoulder as if hugging yourself.
Gently pull your shoulders forward and hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat as desired.
description_en: Arm Stretching Hug Yourself is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lats and upper back. It involves wrapping the arms around the body to stretch the posterior shoulder and upper back muscles, improving flexibility and relieving tension.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。
双臂在胸前交叉，每只手环抱对侧肩膀，如同拥抱自己。
轻轻将肩膀向前拉，保持拉伸20-30秒。
放松，按需重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Raise both arms overhead as high as possible, stretching upward.
Slowly lower your arms back down to your sides in a controlled motion.
Repeat the up-and-down movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Arm Up Down Stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids and traps. It involves raising and lowering both arms in a controlled manner to improve shoulder mobility and warm up the upper body.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。
将双臂举过头顶尽量向上伸展。
以受控的动作缓慢将双臂放回身体两侧。
重复上下运动所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Engage your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Begin making small circles forward with both arms simultaneously.
Gradually increase the size of the circles over several repetitions.
Reverse the direction and perform circles backward.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions in each direction.
description_en: Arms circle is a bodyweight warm-up exercise targeting the deltoids and shoulder stabilizers. It involves rotating the arms in controlled circles at shoulder height, increasing blood flow to the shoulder joint, improving rotator cuff activation, and preparing the upper body for exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸直与肩同高。
收紧核心，保持肩膀放松。
双臂同时开始向前做小圆圈。
在数次重复中逐渐增大圆圈幅度。
反方向向后做圆圈。
每个方向持续所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and arms resting by your sides.
Engage your core and keep your spine in a neutral position.
Slowly raise both arms forward and overhead, keeping them straight and palms facing down.
Pause when your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Arms raise is a bodyweight warm-up exercise targeting the deltoid muscles. It involves a controlled forward raise of both arms to an overhead position, activating the shoulders and improving range of motion in preparation for a full-body Pilates session.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双臂垂于身体两侧。
收紧核心，保持脊柱中立位。
缓慢将双臂向前举过头顶，保持伸直，掌心向下。
双臂完全伸过头顶时稍作停顿。
缓慢将双臂放回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Begin pressing the dumbbells overhead while simultaneously rotating your palms away from you.
Fully extend your arms overhead with palms now facing forward at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, reversing the rotation so palms face you again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The arnold press is a dumbbell shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids through a combined pressing and rotation movement. Named after Arnold Schwarzenegger, it provides greater muscle activation across all three deltoid heads compared to a standard overhead press.
instructions_zh: 坐在有靠背支撑的训练凳上，双手各持一只哑铃置于肩部高度，掌心朝向自己。
开始将哑铃向上推举，同时将掌心向外旋转。
在动作顶端将手臂完全伸直过头，此时掌心朝前。
缓慢将哑铃降回起始位置，反向旋转使掌心再次朝向自己。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height, palms facing you.
Begin the press by rotating your palms to face forward as you push the dumbbells upward.
Continue pressing until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Reverse the motion, rotating your palms back to face you as you lower the dumbbells to chest height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The Arnold press is a dumbbell shoulder exercise targeting all three heads of the deltoid. The rotational component of the press engages the front, side, and rear delts throughout the movement, providing more complete shoulder development than a standard press.
instructions_zh: 坐在有靠背支撑的训练凳上，双手各持一只哑铃置于胸部高度，掌心朝向自己。
开始推举时将掌心旋转朝前，同时将哑铃向上推。
继续推举直至手臂完全伸直过头。
反向运动，在将哑铃降回胸部高度时把掌心旋转回朝向自己。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders.
Lower your knees, chest, and chin to the floor simultaneously, keeping your hips slightly elevated.
Ensure your palms, chin, chest, and knees are all touching the mat while your elbows stay close to your sides.
Hold this position briefly, pressing the tops of your feet into the mat.
Inhale and transition into cobra or upward-facing dog to continue the sun salutation sequence.
description_en: Ashtanga namaskar, or eight-limbed pose, is a yoga posture in which eight points of the body make contact with the floor. It targets the chest and engages the triceps, lower back, and abs, and is commonly used as a transitional pose in sun salutation sequences.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑姿势开始，双手位于肩部正下方。
同时将膝盖、胸部和下巴降向地面，保持髋部略微抬高。
确保手掌、下巴、胸部和膝盖都接触垫面，同时肘部贴近身体两侧。
短暂保持该姿势，将脚背压向垫面。
吸气并过渡到眼镜蛇式或上犬式，以继续拜日式序列。

instructions_en: Stand facing a pole, TRX strap, or doorframe and hold on with both hands for support.
Shift your weight onto one leg and extend the other leg straight out in front of you.
Using the support to assist you, lower your hips toward the floor on the standing leg.
Descend as low as possible, keeping your extended leg off the floor.
Drive through your heel to return to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions and switch legs.
description_en: The assisted pistol squat is a bodyweight unilateral squat targeting the quadriceps. Using external support to help balance and control the descent allows trainees to build the strength and mobility needed for the full pistol squat.
instructions_zh: 面向杆子、TRX带或门框站立，双手握住以提供支撑。
将重心移到一条腿上，另一条腿向前伸直。
利用支撑辅助，屈曲支撑腿将髋部向地面下放。
尽可能下蹲至最低位置，保持伸出的腿离地。
通过支撑腿脚跟发力回到起始位置。
完成目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Set the desired counterweight on the assisted pull-up machine and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body upward until your chin rises above the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower yourself back to the starting position with full arm extension.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The assisted pull up is a machine-based upper body exercise that targets the lats and involves secondary engagement of the biceps, rhomboids, and traps. The counterweight support makes it ideal for building pull-up strength progressively.
instructions_zh: 在辅助引体向上机器上设置好目标配重，跪或站在平台上。
以略宽于肩的正握握住横杆。
收紧核心，将身体向上拉，直到下巴超过横杆。
在顶端短暂停顿，夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢降回起始位置，手臂完全伸展。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position yourself on a hack squat machine with one foot flat on the platform and the other foot slightly behind it, resting on the toes only.
Ensure the majority of your weight is loaded through the front foot.
Disengage the safety and lower the sled by bending the front knee until your thigh is parallel to the footplate.
Drive through the heel of your front foot to extend back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions on one side before switching the foot position.
description_en: The b-stance squat on a hack squat machine is a unilateral variation that places the majority of the load on one leg at a time. The staggered foot position increases single-leg quad and glute demand while the machine provides stability, making it an effective progression toward single-leg training.
instructions_zh: 在哈克深蹲机上就位，一只脚平放在踏板上，另一只脚稍靠后，仅以脚尖支撑。
确保大部分体重加载在前脚上。
解除安全锁，屈曲前膝下放滑板，直到大腿与脚踏板平行。
通过前脚脚跟发力伸展回到起始位置。
在一侧完成目标次数后切换脚的位置。

instructions_en: Position yourself on a hyperextension bench with your hips at the edge of the pad and feet secured.
Cross your arms over your chest or extend them in front.
Round your upper back slightly and focus on driving through your glutes as you extend your hips.
Rise until your body forms a straight line or slightly above parallel.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The back extension with a glute focus is a machine-based exercise targeting the glutes. By rounding the upper back and consciously driving through the glutes during hip extension, the emphasis shifts from the lower back to the gluteal muscles.
instructions_zh: 在罗马椅/超伸展凳上就位，髋部位于垫子边缘，双脚固定。
双臂交叉于胸前或向前伸展。
上背部略微弓起，伸展髋部时专注于臀部发力。
上升至身体成一条直线或略高于平行位置。
缓慢降回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Set the Smith machine bar to approximately hip height and stand facing it.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward and lean back, allowing your body to hang at an angle with arms fully extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The back row smith machine is a compound pulling exercise performed on a Smith machine that targets the lats, rhomboids, and traps. It involves rowing the body upward toward a fixed bar, building upper back strength and muscle thickness.
instructions_zh: 将史密斯机横杆调至约髋部高度，面向横杆站立。
以略宽于肩的正握握住横杆。
双脚向前走并向后倾斜，使身体呈角度悬垂，手臂完全伸展。
通过肘部向后发力将胸部拉向横杆，夹紧肩胛骨。
在动作顶端停顿，然后缓慢降回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position a barbell on your upper traps and step back from the rack with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core, keep your chest up, and begin lowering your hips by bending your knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to or just below the floor, keeping your knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to press the floor away and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The back squat is a barbell compound exercise that primarily targets the quadriceps, with significant engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. It is one of the fundamental lower body strength movements used to build overall leg mass and functional strength.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于上斜方肌处，双脚与肩同宽，从深蹲架后退一步。
收紧核心，挺胸，屈膝开始下蹲。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或略低，膝盖与脚尖方向一致。
脚跟发力蹬地，返回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and reach both arms forward at shoulder height.
Round your upper back and gently press your arms forward, allowing your shoulder blades to spread apart.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling the tension across your upper back.
Release and return to an upright standing position.
Repeat as desired.
description_en: Back Stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lats and upper back. Reaching forward with rounded shoulders separates the shoulder blades and gently stretches the posterior upper body, relieving tension and improving thoracic mobility.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双臂前伸至肩高。
上背部拱起，双臂轻轻前推，让肩胛骨分开。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受上背部张力。
放松，恢复直立站姿。
按需重复。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your mouth closed.
Take a deep breath in through your nose and fill your cheeks with air as if inflating a balloon.
Hold the air in your puffed cheeks for 5–10 seconds.
Slowly release the air through a small opening in your lips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The balloon cheek is a bodyweight facial exercise that targets the cheek muscles by inflating the cheeks with air and holding the position. It helps tone and strengthen the muscles of the mid-face.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，闭嘴。
用鼻子深吸气，将空气充满双颊，如同吹气球。
保持鼓腮5-10秒。
通过嘴唇小口缓慢放气。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing a sturdy wall, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
As you rise from the squat, explosively throw the ball against the wall.
Catch the ball as it rebounds and immediately lower back into the squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The balls slam on wall squat is a dynamic compound exercise that combines a squat with an explosive wall throw, targeting the quadriceps while also engaging the shoulders and core. It builds lower body strength and upper body power simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 面向坚固墙壁站立，双手在胸前持药球。
下蹲，保持背部挺直、挺胸。
从深蹲起身时，爆发力将球砸向墙壁。
接住反弹的球，立即再次下蹲。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with both feet on the center of a resistance band, holding the ends at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward into a lunge position, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the ground until both knees are at approximately 90 degrees.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite leg and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Band lunges are a resistance band exercise targeting the quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings. The band adds accommodating resistance throughout the lunge movement, increasing difficulty at the top and improving lower body strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚踩在阻力带中央，双手在肩高处握住两端。
一脚向前迈出成弓步，保持躯干直立。
后膝下放至接近地面，双膝约呈90度。
前脚跟发力返回起始位置。
换另一腿重复，交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold each end in your hands, placing your palms flat on the floor.
Position yourself in a standard push-up stance with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position, working against the band resistance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Band push-ups are a resistance band exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. The band adds progressive resistance at the top of the push-up, increasing the challenge on the pressing muscles.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带绕过上背部，双手各握一端，手掌平放地面。
呈标准俯卧撑姿势，双手略宽于肩。
屈肘将胸部下放至接近地面，身体保持一条直线。
手掌发力伸臂返回起始位置，对抗阻力带阻力。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and stand facing the anchor point.
Grasp the band with both hands and step back to create tension.
Pull the band towards your torso in a rowing motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
At the end of the row, extend your arms back in a triceps kickback motion.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The band row to triceps is a resistance band exercise that combines a back row with a triceps extension, targeting the lats while also engaging the triceps and rear delts. This compound movement improves pulling strength and arm definition.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在胸高处，面向固定点站立。
双手握住阻力带，后退一步制造张力。
以划船动作将阻力带拉向躯干，夹紧肩胛骨。
划船末端，双臂向后伸展做三头肌后踢动作。
有控制地返回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at waist height and hold it for support with both hands.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front of you.
Slowly lower your body by bending the standing knee, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Descend until your thigh is parallel to the ground or as low as possible.
Drive through the heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The band single leg pistol squat uses a resistance band for assistance, targeting the quadriceps while building single-leg strength, balance, and hip stability. It is an effective progression toward the unassisted pistol squat.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在腰高处，双手握住以辅助支撑。
单腿站立，另一腿向前伸直。
屈站立腿膝盖缓慢下蹲，保持挺胸、背部挺直。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
脚跟发力返回起始位置。
按目标次数重复后换腿。

instructions_en: Place a resistance band just above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your knees outward against the band to activate your glutes.
Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking outward against the band resistance.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The band squat adds a resistance band around the knees to increase glute activation and correct knee cave during a standard squat pattern. It is effective for reinforcing proper squat mechanics and building lower body strength.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带置于膝盖上方，双脚与肩同宽站立。
双膝向外推撑阻力带以激活臀肌。
臀部后推、屈膝下蹲。
保持胸部挺直，膝盖对抗阻力带向外跟踪。
脚跟发力返回站立姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at chest height or sit on the floor with the band looped around your feet.
Grasp both ends of the band with an overhand grip, arms fully extended in front of you.
Sit or stand tall with a slight forward lean and a neutral spine.
Pull the band toward your torso by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at full contraction, then slowly release back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded back row is a resistance band exercise that targets the lats and upper back. By pulling the band toward the torso, it effectively engages the rhomboids, traps, and biceps, making it an accessible alternative to cable or machine rows.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在胸部高度，或坐在地上将阻力带套在双脚上。
正握阻力带两端，双臂在身前完全伸直。
坐直或站直，身体略微前倾，脊柱保持中立。
肘部向后驱动，肩胛骨夹紧，将阻力带拉向躯干。
完全收缩时停顿，然后缓慢还原至起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Loop a resistance band just above your knees and kneel with your hands on a bench for support.
Engage your core and keep your spine neutral throughout the movement.
Kick one leg back and upward, extending it fully while squeezing your glute at the top.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position without touching the knee to the ground.
Complete the desired repetitions on one side before switching to the other.
description_en: The banded bench kickback is a resistance band exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings. Performed with hands on a bench for support, the band adds resistance to the kickback motion, intensifying glute activation and promoting hip extension strength.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带套在膝盖上方，双手撑在长凳上跪姿支撑。
收紧核心，整个动作过程中保持脊柱中立。
一条腿向后上方踢出，完全伸展并在顶端夹紧臀肌。
缓慢将腿还原至起始位置，膝盖不触地。
一侧完成目标次数后换另一侧。

instructions_en: Stand with both feet on the center of a resistance band, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold one end of the band in each hand with a supinated grip, arms hanging at your sides.
Keeping your elbows tucked close to your torso, curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your hands back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded biceps curl is a resistance band exercise targeting the biceps. Standing on the band and curling upward mimics the motion of a dumbbell curl while providing accommodating resistance throughout the range of motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽踩在阻力带中央站立。
双手各握阻力带一端，掌心向上握法，双臂自然垂于体侧。
肘部紧贴躯干，双手向上弯举至肩部。
在动作顶端夹紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将双手还原至起始位置，按目标次数重复。

name_zh: 弹力带弯举接肩部上举
instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band, holding one end in each hand with a supinated grip.
Begin by performing a biceps curl, bringing your hands up toward your shoulders.
From the top of the curl, rotate your palms forward and press your arms overhead into a shoulder raise.
Slowly reverse the movement, lowering your arms back through the curl and returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded biceps to shoulder raise is a resistance band exercise that combines a biceps curl with an overhead shoulder raise. It targets the deltoids and biceps simultaneously, improving shoulder mobility and upper arm strength in one fluid movement.
name_zh_llm: 弹力带弯举接肩部上举
instructions_zh: 踩在阻力带中央站立，双手各握一端，掌心向上握法。
先做肱二头肌弯举，双手向上举至肩部。
在弯举顶端将掌心转向前方，双臂向上推举过头做肩部推举。
缓慢反向动作，经弯举路径将手臂还原至起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_zh: 弹力带弯举接高位划船
instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at a low point and stand facing the anchor, holding one end in each hand.
Begin by performing a biceps curl, bringing your hands toward your shoulders.
At the top of the curl, flare your elbows out and pull the band upward toward your chin in a high row.
Slowly reverse the movement, lowering back through the curl and returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Banded curls to high rows is a compound resistance band exercise that combines a biceps curl with an upright high row. It targets the lats, biceps, and upper traps, making it an efficient upper body pulling movement.
name_zh_llm: 弹力带弯举接高位划船
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定于低处，面向固定点站立，双手各握一端。
先做肱二头肌弯举，双手举向肩部。
在弯举顶端肘部向外展开，将阻力带向上拉向下巴做高位划船。
缓慢反向动作，经弯举路径还原至起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with both feet shoulder-width apart on the center of a resistance band.
Hold the ends of the band at shoulder height with your elbows raised forward.
Keeping your chest tall and core engaged, lower your hips into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded front squat is a resistance band exercise targeting the quadriceps and glutes. Holding the band at shoulder height mimics the front rack position of a barbell, encouraging an upright torso and deep squat mechanics.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽踩在阻力带中央站立。
双手握住阻力带两端置于肩部高度，肘部向前抬起。
保持胸部挺直、核心收紧，臀部下沉下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
脚跟发力返回站立姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Loop a resistance band around your ankles and get on all fours on a mat.
Keep your core engaged and spine neutral throughout the movement.
Kick one leg straight back, extending it fully until it is parallel to the ground.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The banded glute kick is a resistance band exercise performed on all fours, targeting the glutes and hamstrings. The band adds resistance to the kickback motion, intensifying glute activation and supporting hip extension development.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带套在脚踝处，在垫子上呈四点跪姿。
整个动作过程中保持核心收紧、脊柱中立。
一条腿向后伸直踢出，完全伸展至与地面平行。
在动作顶端夹紧臀肌。
缓慢还原至起始位置，按目标次数重复后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart with a resistance band looped under your heels and held at your sides.
Position your heels slightly elevated if needed to mimic the hack squat angle.
Keeping your torso upright and core tight, lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position, extending your hips and knees fully.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded hack squat is a resistance band exercise that targets the quadriceps with an emphasis on the lower quads. The band provides resistance through the full range of motion, simulating the mechanics of a hack squat machine.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，将阻力带绕在脚跟下方，双手在身体两侧握住阻力带。
如需模仿哈克深蹲角度，可将脚跟稍微垫高。
保持躯干直立、核心收紧，下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
通过脚跟发力回到站立位置，完全伸展髋部和膝盖。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band overhead at a fixed point and kneel or sit below the anchor.
Grasp the band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
With arms extended overhead, pull the band down toward your chest by driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly allow your arms to extend back overhead and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded lat pulldown is a resistance band exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi. Anchoring the band overhead and pulling it downward mimics the cable lat pulldown, effectively engaging the lats, biceps, and rhomboids.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在上方固定点，在固定点下方跪姿或坐姿。
双手握住阻力带，握距略宽于肩。
双臂向上伸展，通过将肘部拉向髋部，把阻力带下拉至胸前。
在动作底部收紧背阔肌。
缓慢让双臂回到上方伸展位置，并按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold one end of the band in each hand with arms at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded lateral raise is a resistance band shoulder exercise targeting the lateral deltoids. The band provides progressive resistance as the arms rise, offering a unique stimulus compared to dumbbells and making it an effective portable shoulder exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站在阻力带中央。
双手各握住阻力带一端，手臂放在身体两侧。
肘部微屈，将双臂向两侧抬起至肩高。
在顶部稍停，然后缓慢将双臂放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor one end of a resistance band at a low point and stand to the side facing the anchor.
Hold the other end of the band in one hand with your arm extended toward the anchor.
Brace your core and hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your hip by driving your elbow back, squeezing your lat at the top.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching arms.
description_en: The banded one arm row is a unilateral resistance band exercise targeting the lats and upper back. Performing one arm at a time allows for greater focus on muscle activation and helps address any strength imbalances between sides.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带一端固定在低处，侧身站在固定点旁并面向固定点。
一只手握住阻力带另一端，手臂朝固定点方向伸展。
收紧核心，背部保持平直，髋部略微铰链前倾。
通过将肘部向后拉，把阻力带拉向髋部，在顶部收紧背阔肌。
缓慢回到起始位置，按目标次数重复后换手臂。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height with palms facing forward and elbows bent.
Press the band overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your hands back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded overhead press is a shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids using resistance band tension for progressive resistance. It builds overhead pressing strength and shoulder stability while being gentle on the joints compared to barbell or dumbbell variations.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站在阻力带中央。
双手在肩高握住阻力带，掌心向前，肘部弯曲。
将阻力带向上推过头顶，直到双臂完全伸展。
在顶部稍停，然后缓慢将双手放回肩高。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and pull the band apart by moving your hands outward toward your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the fully extended position.
Slowly return your hands back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded pull-apart is a resistance band exercise targeting the rhomboids and rear deltoids. It improves shoulder health, posture, and upper back strength by training the scapular retractors through a horizontal pulling motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手在肩高握住阻力带，双臂向前伸展。
肘部保持微屈，双手向身体两侧向外移动，将阻力带拉开。
在完全拉开位置将肩胛骨向内收紧。
缓慢将双手回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。
xunji_candidate: 弹力带髋部拉动_拉力带穿越

instructions_en: Hold a resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, arms extended in front of you.
Maintain a shoulder-width grip and slight elbow bend.
Pull the band apart horizontally by moving both hands outward toward your sides.
Focus on squeezing your rear deltoids and shoulder blades at the end of the pull.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded pull-apart with a rear delt focus targets the posterior deltoids and rhomboids through a horizontal pulling motion. By consciously engaging the rear delts at the end range, it improves shoulder health, posture, and upper back strength.
instructions_zh: 双手在肩高握住阻力带，双臂向前伸展。
保持与肩同宽的握距，肘部微屈。
双手向身体两侧向外水平移动，将阻力带拉开。
在拉动末端重点收紧后三角肌和肩胛骨。
缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band to a fixed point at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step back to create tension in the band and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the peak contraction, then slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded row is a resistance band pulling exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi and mid-back. The band provides accommodating resistance and is an accessible alternative to cable or barbell rows for developing back thickness and scapular control.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在胸部高度的固定点，双手各握住一端。
后退以让阻力带产生张力，双脚与肩同宽站立。
将阻力带拉向躯干，肘部向后拉，并将肩胛骨向内收紧。
在收缩峰值稍停，然后缓慢将双臂伸回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair and place a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees.
Sit with feet flat on the floor and knees at 90 degrees.
Push both knees outward against the resistance of the band.
Pause at the widest position, contracting your outer glutes.
Slowly bring your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded seated abduction is a resistance band exercise targeting the glutes and hip abductors through a seated hip opening motion. It is a joint-friendly option for activating the outer glutes and is commonly used in warm-up and rehabilitation routines.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳或椅子边缘，将阻力带套在双膝上方的大腿处。
双脚平放地面，膝盖弯曲90度。
双膝向外推开，对抗阻力带的阻力。
在最宽位置停顿，收紧臀外侧。
缓慢将双膝回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a resistance band around your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, arms extended and back upright.
Pull the band toward your lower abdomen by driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded seated row is a resistance band back exercise targeting the lats and rhomboids through a horizontal pulling motion. With the band anchored to the feet, it replicates a cable row without requiring any equipment, making it ideal for home workouts.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿伸直，将阻力带绕过双脚。
双手握住阻力带，手臂伸直，背部挺直。
肘部向后拉，将阻力带拉向下腹部。
在收缩位置夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢伸直手臂回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band looped just above your knees.
Hold your hands in front of your chest for balance and push your knees out against the band.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, maintaining outward knee pressure against the band throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The banded squat is a resistance band exercise that targets the quads and glutes while activating the hip abductors. The band placed above the knees encourages proper knee tracking and adds an abductor challenge to the standard squat movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，将阻力带套在膝盖上方。
双手置于胸前保持平衡，双膝向外推开对抗阻力带。
保持胸部抬起、核心收紧，下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
脚跟发力站起，全程保持双膝向外对抗阻力带。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at ankle height and loop the other end around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with hands resting lightly on a stable surface for balance.
Keeping your leg straight and core engaged, kick the banded leg back as far as comfortable.
Squeeze your glute at the peak of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The banded straight leg kickback is a resistance band exercise that isolates the glutes through hip hyperextension. Keeping the leg straight throughout the movement increases the hamstring and glute demand, making it effective for posterior chain development.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带固定在脚踝高度，另一端套在一侧脚踝上。
面向固定点站立，双手轻扶稳定物体保持平衡。
保持腿部伸直、核心收紧，将套带腿向后踢至舒适范围。
在动作顶点收紧臀部。
缓慢回到起始位置，按目标次数重复后换腿。

instructions_en: Position a barbell on your upper traps and step back from the rack with feet shoulder-width apart.
Point your toes slightly outward and keep your chest up and core braced.
Descend by bending your knees and pushing your hips back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to extend your knees and hips and return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell back squat is the foundational lower body compound exercise targeting the quadriceps. With a barbell on the upper back, it trains the entire leg and builds functional strength, muscle mass, and athletic power.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于上斜方肌处，离开深蹲架，双脚与肩同宽。
脚尖略微向外，保持胸部抬起、核心收紧。
屈膝并向后推髋下蹲，直至大腿与地面平行。
脚跟发力伸展膝髋，回到站立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench and grip the barbell with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest by bending your elbows at approximately 45 degrees.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell flat bench press is the foundational compound chest exercise. Pressing a barbell from a flat bench activates the entire pectoral muscle, along with the triceps and front deltoids, making it a cornerstone of upper body strength development.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手略宽于肩握住杠铃。
取下杠铃，双臂完全伸直将杠铃保持在胸部正上方。
屈肘约45度，将杠铃下放至胸部中部。
伸直手臂将杠铃推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench and grasp the barbell with a grip wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell to your lower chest, keeping your elbows flared outward.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell bench wide grip press is a chest exercise that uses a wider-than-normal hand placement to increase the stretch on the pectorals. It targets the chest with secondary emphasis on the triceps and front delts, making it effective for building chest width.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，以宽于肩的握距握住杠铃。
取下杠铃，双臂完全伸直将杠铃保持在胸部正上方。
缓慢将杠铃下放至下胸部，肘部向外展开。
在底部短暂停顿，然后将杠铃推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge at the hips to lean your torso forward to approximately 45 degrees, keeping your back flat.
Let the barbell hang with your arms extended, then row it upward towards your lower chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell bent over row is a compound back exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi. Performed in a hinged position, it builds thickness in the upper and middle back while also developing grip and lower back endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以略宽于肩的正手握距握住杠铃。
屈髋向前俯身约45度，保持背部平直。
让杠铃自然下垂、手臂伸直，然后将其拉向下胸部。
在动作顶端夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position a barbell across your upper traps and stand in front of a box or bench.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Sit back and down onto the box in a controlled manner, keeping your chest up and weight in your heels.
Pause briefly on the box, then drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell box sit is a barbell lower body exercise targeting the glutes and quadriceps. Sitting fully onto the box eliminates the stretch reflex and trains the muscles to produce force from a dead stop, building starting strength.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于上斜方肌处，站在箱子或长凳前。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
控制身体向后向下坐至箱子上，保持胸部挺起，重心放在脚跟。
在箱子上稍作停顿，然后通过脚跟发力站起回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a bench and hold a barbell across your upper traps.
Extend one leg behind you and rest the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee, keeping your torso upright.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.
description_en: The barbell Bulgarian split squat is a unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. The elevated rear leg increases the range of motion and demands greater balance, making it an excellent movement for building leg strength and correcting imbalances.
instructions_zh: 站在长凳前，将杠铃置于上斜方肌处。
一条腿向后伸展，脚背搭在长凳上。
弯曲前膝，将后膝向地面下放，保持躯干直立。
下放至前侧大腿与地面平行。
通过前脚跟发力回到起始位置并重复，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench and grasp the barbell with a grip shoulder-width or slightly narrower apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly above your chest with arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell close grip bench press is a compound pressing exercise that shifts emphasis onto the triceps by using a narrower grip. It also engages the pectorals and front delts, making it a popular movement for building arm and upper body pressing strength.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，以与肩同宽或略窄的握距握住杠铃。
取下杠铃，双臂完全伸直将杠铃保持在胸部正上方。
缓慢将杠铃下放至下胸部，保持肘部贴近身体两侧。
在底部稍作停顿，然后将杠铃推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and the barbell over your mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar with an overhand or mixed grip just outside your legs.
Brace your core, set your back flat, and drive through the floor to lift the bar.
Keep the bar close to your body as you extend your hips and knees simultaneously.
Stand tall at the top with hips fully extended and shoulders back, then lower the bar back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell conventional deadlift is a fundamental barbell compound exercise targeting the lower back and entire posterior chain. It is one of the primary strength movements for building total body strength and developing the back, glutes, and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，杠铃位于脚中部上方。
以髋部铰链前倾，用正握或正反握在双腿外侧握住杠铃。
收紧核心，保持背部平直，通过蹬地发力提起杠铃。
杠铃贴近身体，同时伸展髋部和膝盖。
在顶部完全站直，髋部充分伸展、肩部后收，然后将杠铃控制下放回地面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a supinated grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of you with your elbows tucked close to your torso.
Curl the barbell upward toward your chest by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell curl is a fundamental upper arm exercise that targets the biceps brachii. Using a barbell allows for heavier loading compared to dumbbells, making it effective for building overall biceps size and strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以反握握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
让杠铃在身前自然下垂，手臂伸直，肘部贴近躯干。
弯曲肘部将杠铃向上弯举至胸前，保持上臂不动。
在动作顶部收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将杠铃下放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with a supinated grip narrower than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell with arms fully extended in front of your thighs.
Keeping your elbows tucked in, curl the barbell upward toward your chest.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell curl with a narrow grip targets the biceps with emphasis on the long head of the bicep. The close hand placement shifts focus to the outer portion of the biceps, helping to build peak and overall upper arm thickness.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以窄于肩宽的反握握住杠铃。
双臂完全伸直，将杠铃保持在身前大腿处。
保持肘部内收，将杠铃向上弯举至胸前。
在顶部停顿并收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将杠铃下放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Curl the barbell upward by contracting your biceps until the bar is at shoulder level.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The standard barbell curl is a fundamental upper arm exercise targeting the biceps. Performed standing with a barbell, it isolates the biceps through a full range of motion to build arm strength and muscle mass.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，以反握握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
保持肘部贴近躯干，上臂不动。
收缩肱二头肌将杠铃向上弯举，直至杠铃到达肩部高度。
在动作顶部停顿并收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将杠铃下放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart with a barbell resting over the middle of your feet.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs with an overhand or mixed grip.
Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and ensure your back is flat before initiating the lift.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees simultaneously to lift the bar.
Stand fully upright at the top, then hinge at the hips to lower the bar back to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell deadlift is a fundamental compound strength exercise targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and back. It involves lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to a standing position, engaging nearly every major muscle group and building total-body strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，杠铃位于双脚中部上方。
以髋部铰链前倾并屈膝，用正握或正反握在双腿外侧握住杠铃。
收紧核心，保持胸部挺起，确保背部平直后再开始提起。
通过脚跟发力，同时伸展髋部和膝盖提起杠铃。
在顶部完全站直，然后以髋部铰链控制下放杠铃回地面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart with a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, keeping your back flat.
Drive through your heels to stand upright, performing a deadlift.
At the top of the deadlift, curl the barbell up toward your chest by bending your elbows.
Lower the bar back down with control and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell deadlift to curl is a compound exercise that targets the hamstrings and posterior chain through a deadlift while adding a biceps curl at the top of the movement. It is an efficient exercise for building back, glute, and arm strength in one fluid motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，杠铃置于身前地面。
屈髋俯身，反握杠铃，保持背部平直。
脚跟发力站直，完成硬拉。
在硬拉顶端，屈肘将杠铃弯举至胸前。
有控制地将杠铃下放，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart with a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips and grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your back flat.
Drive through your heels to stand upright, performing a deadlift.
At the top, shrug the bar upward and transition into an overhead press, pushing the bar above your head.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell deadlift to press is a full-body compound exercise that combines a deadlift with an overhead press, targeting the traps and posterior chain while also developing shoulder strength. It is an efficient movement for building total-body power and coordination.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，杠铃置于身前地面。
屈髋俯身，正握杠铃，保持背部平直。
脚跟发力站直，完成硬拉。
在顶端耸肩将杠铃上提，过渡为过顶推举，将杠铃推过头顶。
有控制地将杠铃放回肩部，再放回地面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position a barbell on your upper back and stand with your heels elevated on plates or a wedge.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Keeping your chest up and back straight, lower your body by bending your knees.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Drive through your heels and midfoot to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell elevated back squat places the heels on an elevated surface to increase quad activation and allow for a more upright torso. It targets the quadriceps with secondary emphasis on the glutes and hamstrings, and is commonly used to improve squat depth and mechanics.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于上背部，脚跟垫在杠铃片或楔形板上站立。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
保持挺胸直背，屈膝下蹲。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或略低。
脚跟和脚掌中部发力，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position a barbell across the front of your shoulders with heels elevated on plates or a wedge.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and cross your arms to secure the bar or use a clean grip.
Keeping your elbows high and chest up, lower your body by bending your knees.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell elevated front squat combines heel elevation with a front rack position to maximize quadriceps engagement and encourage an upright torso. It targets the quads with secondary involvement of the glutes, core, and upper back for stabilization.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于肩前，脚跟垫在杠铃片或楔形板上。
双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂交叉固定杠铃或采用翻站握法。
保持肘部抬高、挺胸，屈膝下蹲。
下蹲至大腿至少与地面平行。
脚跟发力，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position a barbell in a front rack across the front of your shoulders with your elbows raised high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly pointed out.
Keeping your elbows high and torso upright, descend by bending your knees and hips.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor or below.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position and repeat.
description_en: The barbell front squat is a compound lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Holding the bar in a front rack position shifts the torso more upright, placing greater emphasis on the quads and core compared to the back squat.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于肩前架位，肘部抬高。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
保持肘部抬高、躯干直立，屈膝屈髋下蹲。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或更低。
脚跟发力，回到站立位置并重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with a barbell resting across your hips and your upper back against a bench.
Plant your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart, with knees bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Brace your core and drive through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Slowly lower your hips back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell glute bridge is a compound lower body exercise that targets the glutes and hamstrings. Loading a barbell across the hips while lying on the floor and pressing upward maximizes glute activation through hip extension.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面，杠铃置于髋部，上背部靠在长凳上。
双脚与髋同宽平踏地面，屈膝约90度。
收紧核心，脚跟发力将髋部向天花板方向顶起。
在顶端用力收紧臀肌，使身体从肩到膝呈一条直线。
缓慢将髋部放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

name_en: barbell good morning to behind neck shoulder press
name_zh: 杠铃早安式接颈后推举
instructions_en: Place a barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with a slight bend in the knees, lowering your torso toward the ground.
Keep your back flat and lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Return to an upright position, then press the barbell overhead from behind the neck.
Lower the bar back to your upper back and repeat the sequence.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell good morning to behind neck shoulder press is an advanced compound movement combining a posterior chain stretch with an overhead press. It targets the hamstrings and lower back through the good morning while also developing shoulder and trap strength through the press.
name_zh_llm: 杠铃早安式接颈后推举
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于上背部，双脚与肩同宽站立。
屈髋前倾，膝盖微屈，将躯干向地面下放。
保持背部平直，下放至腘绳肌有拉伸感。
回到直立位置，然后将杠铃从颈后推过头顶。
将杠铃放回上背部，重复该序列。
按目标次数持续进行。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart with knees bent.
Drive through your heels to thrust your hips upward until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower your hips back toward the floor in a controlled manner and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell hip thrust is a compound exercise targeting the gluteal muscles. Performed with the upper back elevated on a bench, it allows for a full range of hip extension under heavy load, making it the most effective exercise for glute development.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面，上背部靠在长凳上，带护垫的杠铃置于髋部。
双脚与髋同宽平踏地面，屈膝。
脚跟发力将髋部向上顶起，使身体从膝到肩呈一条直线。
在动作顶端收紧臀肌。
有控制地将髋部放回地面，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a loaded barbell at your sides with an overhand grip.
Allow your arms to hang straight down, fully extending your fingers around the bar.
Squeeze the bar as hard as possible and hold for the desired duration.
Focus on maintaining grip strength without bending your arms.
Set the bar down in a controlled manner and rest before repeating.
description_en: The barbell hold is a grip strength exercise targeting the forearms. Performed by holding a loaded barbell at the sides for time, it develops crushing grip strength and forearm endurance essential for many compound movements.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，正握杠铃置于身体两侧。
双臂自然下垂，手指完全伸展握住杠铃。
尽可能用力握紧杠铃，保持所需时间。
专注于维持握力，手臂不要弯曲。
控制杠铃放下，休息后重复。

instructions_en: Set an incline bench to 30-45 degrees and lie back, gripping the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it above your upper chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar to your upper chest in a controlled manner.
Press the bar back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The barbell incline bench press is a compound chest exercise targeting the upper pectoral muscles. The inclined angle shifts emphasis to the upper chest and front deltoids, making it a key movement for building a full and well-developed chest.
instructions_zh: 将上斜凳调至30-45度，仰卧，握距略宽于肩握住杠铃。
取下杠铃，双臂伸直将杠铃置于上胸上方。
控制杠铃下放至上胸。
伸直手臂将杠铃推回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Load a barbell in a landmine attachment or anchor it at one end against a stable surface.
Kneel on all fours and place one foot in the collar or sleeve of the barbell.
Engage your core and keep your spine neutral.
Drive your foot back and upward, extending your hip fully and squeezing your glute at the top.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The barbell kickback is a glute isolation exercise performed using a landmine or anchored barbell. Loading resistance onto the foot during a kickback motion increases glute and hamstring activation compared to bodyweight alternatives.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃装入地雷管附件或将一端固定在稳定物体上。
跪姿四肢着地，将一只脚放入杠铃套环或套筒中。
收紧核心，保持脊柱中立。
向后上方蹬腿，充分伸展髋部，在顶端收紧臀肌。
缓慢回到起始位置，重复所需次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with a barbell resting on your upper back in the squat rack position, feet hip-width apart.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground.
As you rise from the lunge, press the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the barbell back to your shoulders as you step back to the starting position.
Alternate legs with each repetition and continue for the desired number of repetitions.
