Maintain a flat back and engaged core throughout.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: Cross country is a dynamic core and cardio exercise performed in a plank position that mimics a cross-body running motion. It targets the cardiovascular system while engaging the core, hip flexors, and lower body for a challenging conditioning workout.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩下。
以横跨身体的动作将右膝朝左肘方向驱动。
回到起始位置，然后左膝朝右肘方向重复。
以连续、受控的跑动动作交替两侧。
全程保持背部平直并收紧核心。
继续至目标时长或次数。

instructions_en: Attach two single handles to high cable pulleys on opposite sides of a cable crossover machine.
Kneel or stand in the center and grasp the handles, one in each hand, with arms extended overhead.
Pull both handles down and toward your sides simultaneously, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the handles overhead and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The cross lat pulldown is a cable exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi by pulling from two opposing high cable pulleys. This bilateral variation increases the range of motion and lat stretch at the top, improving width and back muscle development.
instructions_zh: 在绳索交叉训练器两侧的高位滑轮上各连接一个单手把手。
跪或站在中间，双手各握一个把手，手臂向上伸直。
同时将两个把手向下拉向身体两侧，肘部朝髋部方向驱动。
在动作底部挤压背阔肌。
缓慢将把手送回头顶并重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms inward across your body simultaneously, crossing them in front of your chest.
Return your arms back out to the starting position with control.
Continue the swinging motion in a rhythmic pattern for the desired number of repetitions.
Keep your core engaged and your torso stable throughout the movement.
description_en: The crossbody arm swing is a dynamic bodyweight exercise targeting the deltoids and upper back. The rhythmic swinging motion improves shoulder mobility, increases blood flow to the shoulder joint, and serves as an effective warm-up or active recovery movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂在肩高向两侧伸展。
双臂同时向内横摆过身体，在胸前交叉。
有控制地将双臂回到起始位置。
以有节奏的摆动模式继续至目标次数。
全程保持核心收紧、躯干稳定。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to the sides.
Drive your right knee upward and across your body toward your left elbow simultaneously.
Return to the starting position and immediately drive your left knee toward your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides in a brisk, rhythmic motion.
Maintain an upright posture and keep your core engaged throughout.
description_en: Crossover high knee cardio is a bodyweight cardio exercise combining high knees with a crossbody rotation. It elevates heart rate while engaging the core and hip flexors through the diagonal knee-to-elbow pattern.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
同时将右膝向上并横过身体朝左肘方向驱动。
回到起始位置，随即左膝朝右肘方向驱动。
以轻快、有节奏的动作继续交替两侧。
全程保持身体直立并收紧核心。

instructions_en: Squat down and place your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, with fingers spread wide.
Bend your elbows slightly and place your knees on the backs of your upper arms, as high up as possible.
Lean your weight forward into your hands and slowly lift one foot off the floor, then the other.
Balance on your hands with your core engaged and your gaze slightly forward.
Hold the position for as long as possible, then slowly lower your feet back to the floor.
description_en: Crow pose is an advanced bodyweight balance exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the abs, upper arms, and lower arms. It involves balancing the body on bent arms with the knees resting on the triceps, demanding significant upper body strength and core stability.
instructions_zh: 下蹲，双手平放于地面，与肩同宽，手指充分张开。
微微弯曲手肘，将膝盖放在上臂后侧，尽量放高。
将重心前倾至双手，慢慢抬起一只脚，再抬起另一只脚。
收紧核心，目视前方，用双手保持平衡。
尽可能长时间保持该姿势，然后慢慢将双脚放回地面。

instructions_en: Squat down and place your palms flat on the floor about shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows and place your shins or inner knees against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands until your feet naturally lift off the ground.
Keep your gaze slightly forward and engage your core to hold the position.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then gently lower your feet to the floor.
description_en: Crow pose is an arm balance yoga posture closely related to crane pose, distinguished by a more bent-arm position. It targets the lower back and engages the core, triceps, and shoulders, building upper body and core strength for arm balancing.
instructions_zh: 下蹲，双掌平放于地面，约与肩同宽。
弯曲手肘，将小腿或膝盖内侧贴在上臂后侧。
将重心前移至双手，直到双脚自然离地。
目视前方，收紧核心以保持姿势。
保持10-20秒，然后轻轻将双脚放回地面。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Place your index fingers at the outer corners of each eye, applying very light pressure.
Slowly squint by gently bringing the lower eyelid upward without moving your forehead.
Hold the squint for 3 seconds, then slowly release.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The crow's feet smoother is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the muscles around the outer corners of the eyes. It involves controlled squinting to tone the orbicularis oculi and reduce the appearance of fine lines.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
将食指放在每只眼睛的外眼角处，施加非常轻的压力。
慢慢眯眼，轻轻将下眼睑向上抬，同时保持额头不动。
保持眯眼3秒，然后慢慢放松。
按所需次数重复该动作。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The crunch is a foundational bodyweight core exercise that targets the rectus abdominis. By lifting the shoulder blades off the floor with the knees bent, the movement isolates the abs through spinal flexion, forming the basis of most abdominal training routines.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
双手放在头后，手肘向外。
收紧腹肌，将肩胛骨抬离地面。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head and lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
As you crunch upward, bring your right elbow and left knee toward each other until they touch.
Lower back down and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The crunch elbow to knee touch is a rotational crunch variation that targets the abs and obliques by bringing the opposite elbow and knee together at the top of each crunch. The twisting motion increases oblique engagement compared to a standard crunch.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
双手放在头后，将肩胛骨抬离地面。
卷腹向上时，将右肘和左膝相互靠近直至触碰。
放下后换另一侧重复。
继续交替进行，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with one knee bent and the opposite leg extended straight.
Place your hands behind your head and crunch upward.
Simultaneously drive the bent knee toward your head while lifting your head toward the knee.
Touch or bring your head as close to your knee as possible.
Lower back down and repeat for the desired reps before switching legs.
description_en: The crunch head to knee touch is a bodyweight core exercise that combines a crunch with a knee drive to bring the head and knee toward each other. This movement intensifies the abdominal contraction and increases hip flexor involvement compared to a standard crunch.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，一侧膝盖弯曲，另一条腿伸直。
双手放在头后，卷腹向上。
同时将弯曲的膝盖向头部方向驱动，同时将头部抬向膝盖。
让头部触碰或尽可能靠近膝盖。
放下后按所需次数重复，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Wrap your arms around your knees, hugging them toward your chest.
Curl your upper body off the ground toward your knees, engaging your abs.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your core.
Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The crunch hug is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that combines a traditional crunch with a knee tuck. Wrapping the arms around the knees while crunching upward intensifies abdominal engagement and promotes core compression.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
双臂环抱膝盖，将膝盖抱向胸口。
收紧腹肌，将上半身卷离地面靠向膝盖。
在动作顶端停顿，挤压核心。
慢慢回到起始位置，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows wide.
Slowly lift your shoulder blades off the floor over a count of 3–4 seconds.
Pause at the top of the crunch for a moment.
Lower back down at a normal pace and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The crunch with slow upward is a tempo-based crunch variation that slows the concentric phase of the movement. Pausing the ascent increases time under tension for the rectus abdominis, promoting greater muscle activation and strength development compared to standard-speed crunches.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
双手放在头后，手肘向外张开。
用3-4秒的时间慢慢将肩胛骨抬离地面。
在卷腹顶端稍作停顿。
以正常速度放下，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Engaging your abs, curl your upper body off the ground toward your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Crunches are a foundational bodyweight exercise targeting the rectus abdominis. By curling the upper body off the ground, they isolate the abdominal muscles and build core strength and endurance.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
双手置于脑后，肘部向外。
收紧腹肌，将上身卷离地面向膝盖方向抬起。
在动作顶端稍作停顿，然后缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Step your right foot diagonally behind and to the left of your left foot.
Bend both knees and lower your right knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking over your front foot.
Press through your left heel to return to standing.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The curtsy lunge is a bodyweight lower body exercise targeting the glutes through a cross-behind stepping pattern. The diagonal step increases adductor involvement and glute medius activation compared to a standard lunge.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手叉腰。
右脚斜向后方迈步，置于左脚左后方。
双膝弯曲，右膝向地面下沉。
保持前膝对准前脚方向。
左脚跟发力蹬起，回到站立姿势。
换另一侧重复，并按目标次数交替进行。

instructions_en: Mount a stationary bike and adjust the seat height so your leg has a slight bend at full pedal extension.
Place your feet in the pedal straps and grip the handlebars.
Begin pedaling at a comfortable cadence, maintaining an upright or forward-leaning posture.
Adjust the resistance as needed to reach your target intensity level.
Continue for the desired duration, then gradually slow to a cool down pace.
description_en: Cycling is a low-impact cardio exercise targeting the quadriceps. Whether performed on a stationary bike or outdoors, it improves cardiovascular endurance and lower body muscular endurance while being gentle on the joints.
instructions_zh: 坐上固定自行车，调整座椅高度，使踏板完全伸展时腿部略微弯曲。
双脚放入踏板束带中，握住车把。
以舒适的踏频开始骑行，保持直立或前倾姿势。
根据需要调整阻力，达到目标强度。
持续目标时长，然后逐渐减速进入放松节奏。

instructions_en: Stand tall in mountain pose with your weight evenly distributed on both feet.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, lifting your right foot behind you.
Grasp your right ankle or foot with your right hand and begin to tilt your torso forward.
Extend your left arm straight forward and press your right foot into your hand to lift the leg higher.
Hold the balance for 20-30 seconds, then release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Dance pose is an advanced standing balance posture that stretches the chest, shoulders, and quadriceps while strengthening the lower back and improving balance. It involves standing on one leg and extending the opposite leg behind the body in a graceful backbend arc.
instructions_zh: 以山式站直，重心均匀分布在双脚上。
重心移到左脚，屈右膝，将右脚向后抬起。
右手抓住右脚踝或右脚，开始将躯干向前倾。
左臂向前伸直，右脚压向手掌以将腿抬得更高。
保持平衡20-30秒，然后松开并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand on your left foot and lift your right knee, clasping your hands beneath the right thigh.
Slowly extend your right leg forward until it is straight and parallel to the floor.
Flex your right foot and reach forward, holding the foot or ankle with both hands.
Keep your standing leg straight and your spine long as you fold toward your extended leg.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, then release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Dandayamana janu sirsasana is a standing head-to-knee yoga posture that targets the hamstrings and challenges balance and concentration. It involves extending one leg forward while standing, then folding the torso over the raised leg.
instructions_zh: 单脚站在左脚上，抬起右膝，双手在右大腿下方交扣。
缓慢将右腿向前伸直，直到与地面平行。
勾右脚，向前伸展，双手抓住脚或脚踝。
保持支撑腿伸直、脊柱延展，向伸出的腿方向折叠。
保持姿势20-30秒，然后松开并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
Engage your core, pressing your lower back firmly into the floor.
Slowly lower your right arm overhead and extend your left leg toward the floor simultaneously.
Pause just above the floor, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side, lowering your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dead bug is a bodyweight core stability exercise that targets the abs while teaching proper spinal bracing. By moving opposite limbs simultaneously, it challenges coordination and deep core control while minimizing lower back stress.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂伸直指向天花板，双膝弯曲90度位于髋部上方。
收紧核心，将下背部牢牢压向地面。
缓慢将右臂向头顶方向下放，同时将左腿向地面伸展。
在接近地面处稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。
换另一侧重复，放下左臂并伸展右腿。
按目标次数继续交替两侧。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended toward the ceiling and legs at a 90-degree tabletop position.
Simultaneously lower one leg toward the floor and reach the opposite arm overhead.
As the limbs extend, crunch your torso slightly upward to engage the abs more deeply.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dead bug crunch combines the dead bug movement pattern with an added crunch, increasing the demand on the rectus abdominis. The simultaneous limb extension and torso crunch require significant core coordination, anti-extension control, and abdominal strength.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂伸向天花板，双腿呈90度桌面姿势。
同时将一条腿向地面下放，并将对侧手臂伸向头顶。
四肢伸展时，将躯干略微向上卷起，以更深入收紧腹肌。
回到起始位置，并换另一侧重复。
按目标次数继续交替进行。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise your arms straight up toward the ceiling.
Lift your legs so your knees are bent at 90 degrees and your shins are parallel to the floor.
Slowly lower one leg toward the floor, extending it straight while keeping the opposite leg still.
Return the leg to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dead bug leg only is a core stability exercise that isolates the leg lowering component of the full dead bug. By alternating slow leg extensions from the tabletop position, the lower abs and hip flexors are challenged while the lower back remains pressed into the floor.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂向上伸直指向天花板。
抬起双腿，使膝盖弯曲90度，小腿与地面平行。
缓慢将一条腿向地面下放并伸直，同时保持另一条腿不动。
将腿回到起始位置，并换另一侧重复。
按目标次数继续交替双腿。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms flat by your sides and knees bent at 90 degrees, feet off the floor.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor and brace your core.
Slowly extend one leg toward the floor, keeping it just above the surface.
Return that leg to the bent position and extend the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dead bug legs only is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles by isolating the leg extension component of the classic dead bug. Removing the arm movement allows full focus on lower abdominal engagement and spinal stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂放在身体两侧，膝盖弯曲90度，双脚离地。
下背部紧压地面，收紧核心。
缓慢将一条腿向地面伸展，保持略高于地面。
将该腿收回弯曲位置，再伸展另一条腿。
继续交替双腿，完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Lower into a squat position while simultaneously bringing your arms forward to cross in front of you.
At the bottom of the squat, your arms should be crossed at chest height.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and open your arms out to the sides again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dead fly bodyweight squat combines a standard squat with an arm fly movement. As the hips lower, the arms cross forward like a reverse chest fly, and they open back outward on the ascent. This adds a dynamic shoulder and chest element to a lower body squat exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
下蹲的同时双臂向前在胸前交叉。
蹲至底部时，双臂应在胸前交叉。
脚跟发力站起，双臂再次向两侧打开。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and a loaded barbell over your mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the bar with hands just outside your legs.
Take a deep breath, brace your core, and keep your chest up with a flat back.
Drive through your heels to lift the barbell, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Stand tall at the top, then hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled manner.
description_en: The barbell deadlift is a compound exercise targeting the lower back, with significant engagement from the glutes, hamstrings, and traps. It is one of the most fundamental strength movements for building overall posterior chain power.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，杠铃置于脚中部上方。
屈髋屈膝，双手在腿外侧握杠。
深吸气，收紧核心，挺胸保持背部平直。
脚跟发力提起杠铃，同时伸展髋部和膝盖。
顶部站直，然后屈髋屈膝，控制杠铃放回地面。

instructions_en: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart with toes pointed outward, and a barbell over your mid-foot.
Grip the bar with hands inside your legs using an overhand or mixed grip.
Brace your core and keep your chest up, then push your knees out in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to lift the bar, extending your hips and knees at the same rate.
Stand fully upright at the top, then lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled manner.
description_en: The sumo barbell deadlift is a compound exercise targeting the lower back and glutes. The wide stance reduces the range of motion and places greater emphasis on the hips and inner thighs compared to a conventional deadlift.
instructions_zh: 双脚宽于肩站立，脚尖外展，杠铃置于脚中部上方。
双手在腿内侧握杠，采用正握或正反握。
收紧核心，挺胸，膝盖向外推与脚尖方向一致。
脚跟发力提杠，髋部和膝盖同步伸展。
顶部完全站直，然后控制杠铃放回地面。

instructions_en: Position yourself on a decline bench with your feet secured under the pads and hands placed behind your head.
Engage your core and curl your upper body upward toward your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, fully contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your torso back to the starting position without fully relaxing your core.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The decline bench crunch is a bodyweight abdominal exercise performed on a decline bench, which increases the range of motion and intensity compared to a standard crunch. It primarily targets the abs with secondary engagement of the obliques and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 仰卧于下斜凳上，双脚固定在垫下，双手置于头后。
收紧核心，将上身向上卷向膝盖。
在顶部停顿，充分收缩腹肌。
缓慢将躯干放回起始位置，核心不完全放松。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or chair and assume a push-up position with your hands close together under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows close to your sides.
Push back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Close Push Ups is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the triceps with secondary emphasis on the upper chest and shoulders. Elevating the feet shifts the load upward while the close grip increases tricep activation.
instructions_zh: 双脚放在长凳或椅子等高处，双手在胸下靠拢成俯卧撑姿势。
身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
肘部贴近身体两侧弯曲，胸部向地面下降。
推回起始位置，双臂完全伸展。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and position your feet on an elevated surface behind you.
From a decline elbow plank position, pike your hips upward toward the ceiling.
Hold the pike position briefly, squeezing your core.
Lower your hips back to the decline plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Pike Plank is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. Performed with feet elevated, the piking motion engages the deep core and hip flexors while the decline position increases overall difficulty.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在身后高处。
从下斜肘撑平板姿势开始，将髋部向上顶向天花板。
短暂保持折体姿势，收紧核心。
将髋部放回下斜平板位置。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and position your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench.
Align your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core fully.
Keep your hips level and avoid raising or dropping your lower back.
Hold this position for the desired duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The decline elbow plank is an advanced bodyweight core exercise that targets the abs by elevating the feet above the shoulders. The inclined position increases the demand on the abdominal muscles compared to a standard forearm plank.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在长凳等高处。
身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线，充分收紧核心。
保持髋部水平，避免下背部抬起或下沉。
保持该姿势至目标时间。
休息后重复完成目标组数。

name_zh: 下斜肘撑平板髋部下沉
instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface to form a decline elbow plank.
Keeping your core engaged, rotate your hips to one side, dipping them toward the floor.
Return to the center and dip to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Hip Dips is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the obliques. Performed in a decline elbow plank with feet elevated, the hip dipping motion increases rotational core activation and overall difficulty compared to the standard variation.
name_zh_llm: 下斜肘撑平板髋部下沉
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处，形成下斜肘撑平板。
保持核心收紧，将髋部向一侧旋转，向下沉髋。
回到中间，再向另一侧沉髋。
以受控方式继续左右交替。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: Decline Elbow Plank Knee Drive Leg on Table
name_zh: 下斜肘撑平板桌边提膝
instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface such as a table.
Engage your core and maintain a straight body line.
Drive one knee forward toward your chest in a controlled motion.
Return your foot to the elevated surface and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Knee Drive Leg on Table is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. Performed in a decline elbow plank with feet elevated, the knee drive adds dynamic core engagement to the static plank position.
name_zh_llm: 下斜肘撑平板桌边提膝
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在桌子等高处。
收紧核心，保持身体成一直线。
以受控动作将一侧膝盖向前驱向胸口。
将脚放回高处，换另一条腿重复。
继续左右交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface.
From the decline elbow plank position, bend both knees slightly and hover them just above the elevated surface.
Hold the knee hover position while maintaining a tight core and level hips.
Keep breathing steadily throughout the hold.
Return to the starting position and repeat as desired.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Knee Hover is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. The knee hover from a decline elbow plank position intensifies core and shoulder stability demands.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处。
从下斜肘撑平板姿势开始，双膝微屈，悬停在高处上方。
保持膝部悬停，核心收紧，髋部保持水平。
保持过程中持续稳定呼吸。
回到起始姿势，按需重复。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight diagonal line.
Lift one leg off the elevated surface, raising it as high as possible while keeping your hips level.
Hold briefly, then lower the leg back to the surface.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Leg Lift is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and glutes. The decline position and single-leg lift increase core stability demands and posterior chain engagement.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处。
收紧核心，保持身体成一条斜直线。
将一条腿抬离高处，尽量抬高，同时保持髋部水平。
短暂停顿，然后将腿放回高处。
左右交替，按目标次数重复。

name_zh: 下斜肘撑平板前后摇摆
instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface to form a decline elbow plank.
Shift your body forward by pushing onto your toes, moving your shoulders past your elbows.
Rock back to the starting position in a smooth, controlled motion.
Continue rocking forward and backward for the desired number of repetitions.
Maintain a flat back and tight core throughout.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Rocking is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and shoulders. The rocking motion from a decline plank position dynamically challenges core stability and anterior shoulder endurance.
name_zh_llm: 下斜肘撑平板前后摇摆
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处，形成下斜肘撑平板。
脚趾发力将身体向前移，使肩膀超过肘部。
以平滑受控的动作向后摇回起始位置。
继续前后摇摆，按目标次数重复。
全程保持背部平直、核心收紧。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface to form a decline elbow plank.
Step one foot out to the side, then step the other foot to meet it.
Step back in the opposite direction to return to center.
Maintain a tight core and level hips throughout the movement.
Continue stepping side to side for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Side Step-Out is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and obliques. Adding lateral foot movement to the decline elbow plank challenges core stability and introduces a dynamic element to the exercise.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处，形成下斜肘撑平板。
一只脚向侧方迈出，另一只脚跟上并拢。
向相反方向迈回中间。
全程保持核心收紧、髋部水平。
继续左右侧步，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your forearms on the floor and rest your feet on an elevated surface.
Hold a decline elbow plank with your core tight and hips level.
Reach one hand out to tap the floor to your side, then return it to the plank position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating with control.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Elbow Plank Side Touch is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and obliques. By reaching to the side from a decline plank position, this movement challenges core stability and anti-rotational strength.
instructions_zh: 前臂撑地，双脚放在高处。
保持下斜肘撑平板，核心收紧，髋部水平。
一只手向侧方伸出轻触地面，然后回到平板姿势。
换另一侧重复，受控交替。
继续按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface and walk your hands in so your hips are raised high, forming an inverted V shape.
Position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the ground, stopping at the bottom of the pike push-up.
Hold this lowered position for the desired duration.
Press back up to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: Decline Pike Push Up Hold is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the deltoids. By holding the lowered position of a decline pike push-up, this movement builds shoulder strength and stability under sustained tension.
instructions_zh: 双脚放在高处，双手向脚的方向走近，使髋部抬高，形成倒V形。
双手略宽于肩。
屈肘将头顶向地面下放，在折体俯卧撑底部停住。
在下方位置保持目标时长。
推回起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or step.
Place your hands on the floor directly under your shoulders.
Maintain a straight line from your heels to your head, engaging your core fully.
Hold the position without letting your hips sag or rise.
Breathe steadily and hold for the desired duration.
description_en: The decline plank hold is a bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the abs. Elevating the feet increases the angle and shifts greater load onto the upper abs and shoulders, making it a more challenging variation of the standard plank.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在长凳或台阶等较高的表面上。
双手放在地板上，位于肩膀正下方。
保持从脚跟到头部呈一条直线，充分收紧核心。
保持姿势，不要让髋部下沉或抬起。
保持稳定呼吸，维持所需时间。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench and position your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Align your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The decline push-up is a bodyweight chest exercise that targets the upper portion of the pectorals by elevating the feet above the hands. The inclined angle shifts the pressing emphasis to the upper chest and anterior deltoids.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在长凳等较高的表面上，双手放在地板上，略宽于肩宽。
身体从头到脚保持一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向地板方向下放。
在底部稍作停顿，然后推回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench or step and position your hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Ensure your body forms a straight line from head to heels with your core engaged.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at roughly a 45-degree angle to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom when your chest is just above the floor.
Press back up to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline push ups are a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper chest, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, upper arms, and abs. By elevating the feet, the angle shifts the emphasis onto the upper portion of the pectoral muscles and increases overall difficulty.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在长凳或台阶等较高的表面上，双手放在地板上，略宽于肩宽。
确保身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线，并收紧核心。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向地板方向下放，肘部与身体保持约45度角。
当胸部刚好高于地板时，在底部稍作停顿。
推回起始位置，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface and assume a push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
As you lower your chest toward the floor, bring one knee out to the side toward your elbow.
Press back up and return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating legs with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Spider Push Ups is an advanced bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectorals and obliques. Combining a decline push-up with a lateral knee drive engages the chest, core, and hip flexors simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在较高的表面上，呈俯卧撑姿势，双手略宽于肩宽。
当胸部向地板下放时，将一侧膝盖向侧面朝肘部方向抬起。
推起身体，将腿回到起始位置。
换另一侧重复，每次重复交替双腿。
按所需次数继续。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an elevated surface and assume a push-up position with your hands placed wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight diagonal line.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows outward.
Press through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Decline Wide Push Ups is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectorals. The combination of a decline angle and wide grip maximizes chest activation, particularly in the outer and upper pectoral region.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在较高的表面上，呈俯卧撑姿势，双手宽于肩宽。
保持身体呈一条斜直线。
弯曲肘部向外，将胸部向地板方向下放。
通过手掌发力推回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on top of a sturdy box or elevated platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step off the box and land with both feet simultaneously on the floor below.
Upon landing, immediately and explosively jump upward as high as possible with your arms swinging overhead.
Land softly with slightly bent knees to absorb the impact.
Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The depth jump is an advanced bodyweight plyometric exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and lower legs. It involves stepping off an elevated surface and immediately jumping upon landing, utilizing the stretch-shortening cycle to develop explosive lower body power.
instructions_zh: 站在稳固的箱子或高台上，双脚与髋同宽。
从箱子上走下，双脚同时落在下方地板上。
落地后立即爆发性向上跳起，尽量跳高，双臂向上摆动过头。
屈膝轻柔落地以缓冲冲击。
调整后按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing a desk or sturdy surface and place your hands on the edge closer than shoulder-width apart with fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels, with your core engaged.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the desk, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides throughout the movement.
Pause when your chest nearly touches the desk surface, then press back up to the starting position by fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk close grip push up is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the triceps, performed using a desk as an elevated surface. The close hand placement emphasizes the triceps over the pectoral muscles, making it an effective upper arm exercise suitable for office environments.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子或稳固表面站立，双手放在边缘，间距窄于肩宽，手指朝前。
双脚向后走，直到身体从头到脚跟呈一条斜直线，并收紧核心。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向桌子方向下放，整个动作中肘部紧贴身体两侧。
当胸部几乎接触桌面时稍作停顿，然后完全伸直手臂推回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

name_en: desk half bent with straight hands raise stretch
name_zh: 桌边半屈直臂上拉拉伸
instructions_en: Stand about one arm's length away from your desk with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, resting your hands lightly on the desk surface.
Keep your back flat, your arms straight, and your head in a neutral position aligned with your spine.
From this position, lift both hands slightly off the desk and raise your arms forward, maintaining straight arms.
Hold the raised position for 10-20 seconds, then lower your hands back to the desk. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk half bent with straight hands raise stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lower back, performed in a hinged position at a desk. It involves raising the arms from a bent-over stance to stretch the lower back, hamstrings, and shoulders simultaneously.
name_zh_llm: 桌边半屈直臂上拉拉伸
instructions_zh: 站在离桌子约一臂距离处，双脚与髋同宽。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，直到躯干大致与地面平行，双手轻放在桌面上。
保持背部平直、手臂伸直，头部保持中立并与脊柱对齐。
从这个位置，将双手稍微抬离桌面，保持手臂伸直向前抬起。
保持抬起姿势10-20秒，然后将双手放回桌面。按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing a desk and place both hands on the edge, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms a straight diagonal line from your head to your heels.
Engage your core, squeeze your glutes, and ensure your hips are aligned with your body, neither sagging nor raised.
Hold this incline plank position for the desired amount of time, breathing steadily throughout.
Walk your feet forward to return to the starting position. Rest and repeat as desired.
description_en: The desk incline plank hold is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, performed using a desk as an elevated surface. It involves maintaining a rigid plank position with the hands elevated to engage the core, shoulders, and lower back in a modified and accessible variation.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，双手与肩同宽放在桌边。
双脚向后走，直到身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线斜线。
收紧核心，夹紧臀部，确保髋部与身体对齐，既不下沉也不抬起。
保持这个斜板姿势所需时间，全程平稳呼吸。
双脚向前走回到起始位置。休息并按需重复。

instructions_en: Stand or sit in front of your desk and place both palms flat on the desk surface with your fingers pointing toward your body.
Gently lean your weight slightly forward, pressing your palms down and feeling the stretch across the inside of your forearms and wrists.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
To vary the stretch, rotate your hands so the fingers point outward and repeat the gentle lean.
Release and shake out your hands before repeating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk palm of hands stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the forearm muscles, performed at a desk. It involves pressing the palms flat against the desk surface and leaning gently forward to stretch the wrist flexors and forearm muscles, relieving tension from repetitive hand and typing movements.
instructions_zh: 站在或坐在桌前，双掌平放在桌面上，手指朝向身体。
身体轻轻前倾，手掌向下按压，感受前臂内侧和手腕的拉伸。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒，深呼吸。
要变换拉伸，将手旋转使手指朝外，重复轻轻前倾。
放松并甩甩手，然后按需重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing a desk and place your hands on the edge slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step your feet back to create a comfortable incline angle with your body straight from head to heels.
Engage your core and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the desk, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms fully.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk push up is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, performed using a desk as an inclined surface. It offers a beginner-friendly modification of the traditional push up, engaging the chest, triceps, and front deltoids while reducing the load compared to floor-based variations.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，双手放在桌边，略宽于肩。
双脚向后迈，形成舒适的倾斜角度，身体从头到脚跟保持笔直。
收紧核心，弯曲肘部将胸部向桌面下压，保持身体成一条直线。
伸直手臂完全推回起始位置。
按需重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing a desk and place both hands on the edge, shoulder-width apart with your fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet backward until your body forms a straight diagonal line from your head to your heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the desk in a controlled manner, keeping your core tight and your body straight.
Pause when your chest is close to the desk surface, then push back up by fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a straight body line throughout.
description_en: The desk push up standard is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, performed using a desk as an elevated surface. It involves the standard push up movement at a comfortable incline, engaging the chest, triceps, and deltoids while remaining accessible for all fitness levels.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，双手与肩同宽放在桌边，手指朝前。
双脚向后走，直到身体从头到脚跟形成一条直线斜线。
弯曲肘部，有控制地将胸部向桌面下压，保持核心收紧、身体笔直。
胸部接近桌面时暂停，然后完全伸直手臂推回。
按需重复所需次数，全程保持身体成直线。

instructions_en: Stand facing your desk with your feet hip-width apart and your arms extended at shoulder height.
Place both hands flat on the desk surface and step your feet backward until your arms are straight and your torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
Allow your head to drop between your arms and let gravity lengthen your spine, feeling a deep stretch through your back.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and relaxing further with each exhale.
Walk your feet forward and slowly roll back up to standing. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk standing back stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lower back, performed using a desk for support. It involves hinging at the hips with hands on the desk to create a deep spinal stretch, releasing tension in the lower back, trapezius, and shoulders.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，双脚与髋同宽，手臂与肩同高向前伸展。
双掌平放在桌面上，双脚向后走，直到手臂伸直、躯干大致与地面平行。
让头部垂在双臂之间，让重力拉长脊柱，感受背部的深度拉伸。
保持这个姿势20-30秒，深呼吸，每次呼气时进一步放松。
双脚向前走，慢慢卷起回到站立。按需重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing your desk and extend one leg, placing your heel on the desk surface with your leg straight.
Stand tall with your other foot flat on the floor and your hands resting on the desk for support.
Gently hinge forward at the hips toward the raised leg, keeping your back flat and your chest lifted.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling the pull along the back of the raised leg.
Carefully lower your leg and repeat on the other side. Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk standing leg stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed using a desk as an elevated surface. It involves placing one leg on the desk and hinging forward to stretch the hamstrings, glutes, and lower back, making it an effective standing flexibility exercise.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，一条腿伸直，脚跟放在桌面上。
站直，另一只脚平放在地面上，双手扶桌支撑。
从髋部轻轻向抬起的腿方向前倾，保持背部平直、胸部抬起。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受抬起腿后侧的拉伸。
小心放下腿，换另一侧重复。按需继续所需次数。

name_en: desk upper body and arms stretch
instructions_en: Stand facing your desk and reach both arms forward, placing your hands flat on the surface.
Walk your feet backward and lower your chest below the level of the desk, allowing your arms to stretch forward.
Round your upper back and actively pull your hips away from the desk, feeling a stretch through your upper back and arms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and letting your shoulders relax.
Walk your feet forward and return to standing. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The desk upper body and arms stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the rhomboids, performed using a desk as a prop. It involves reaching forward with both arms and drawing the upper body back to stretch the upper back, deltoids, and triceps simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子站立，双臂向前伸，双手平放在桌面上。
双脚向后走，将胸部降到桌面以下，让手臂向前拉伸。
拱起上背部，主动将髋部拉离桌子，感受上背部和手臂的拉伸。
保持20-30秒，深呼吸，让肩膀放松。
双脚向前走回到站立。按需重复所需次数。

name_en: desk upper body bent hands on desk
instructions_en: Stand about one arm's length away from your desk with your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips and place both hands flat on the desk, allowing your upper body to form approximately a 90-degree angle with your legs.
Keep your back flat, your arms straight, and your knees soft.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and allowing your lower back to decompress.
Slowly stand back up by engaging your core and returning to the upright position. Repeat as desired.
description_en: The desk upper body bent hands on desk is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lower back, performed using a desk for support. It involves hinging forward at the hips with hands on the desk to decompress and stretch the lumbar spine, hamstrings, and shoulder girdle.
instructions_zh: 站在离桌子约一臂远的地方，双脚与髋同宽。
从髋部前倾，双掌平放在桌面上，让上半身与双腿约成90度角。
保持背部平直、手臂伸直、膝盖微屈。
保持这个姿势20-30秒，深呼吸，让下背部减压。
收紧核心慢慢站起，回到直立位置。按需重复。

instructions_en: Stand or sit in front of your desk and extend one arm forward with your palm facing upward.
Use your other hand to gently pull back on the fingers of the extended hand, bending the wrist downward.
Hold the stretch for 15-20 seconds, feeling the tension along the underside of your forearm.
Flip your hand so the palm faces downward and gently press the fingers toward the ground for the opposite stretch.
Hold for 15-20 seconds, then switch to the other hand and repeat.
description_en: The desk wrist stretch is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the forearm muscles, performed at a desk. It involves bending the wrist in both flexion and extension directions to stretch the wrist flexors and extensors, providing relief from repetitive strain and improving wrist mobility.
instructions_zh: 站在或坐在桌前，向前伸直一只手臂，掌心朝上。
用另一只手轻轻将伸直手的手指往后拉，使手腕向下弯曲。
保持拉伸15-20秒，感受前臂下方的张力。
翻转手掌使掌心朝下，轻轻将手指压向地面做反向拉伸。
保持15-20秒，然后换另一只手重复。

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
At the bottom, lower your hips to the ground and extend your arms, arching your back into a cobra stretch.
Return your hips upward and bend your elbows to lower back into the bottom of the push-up.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The diamond cobra push up combines a close-grip diamond push-up with a cobra extension at the bottom of each rep. It targets the pectorals and triceps during the pressing phase while stretching the lower back and core through the cobra movement.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手在胸下形成菱形。
将胸部朝双手方向下压，肘部贴近身体两侧。
在底部将臀部降至地面并伸直手臂，弓背进入眼镜蛇式拉伸。
将臀部抬回上方，弯曲肘部回到俯卧撑底部位置。
推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a plank position and bring your hands together beneath your sternum, touching your thumbs and index fingers to form a diamond shape.
Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the movement and engage your core.
Lower your chest toward your hands in a controlled manner until it nearly touches the floor.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The diamond push up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the chest with strong emphasis on the triceps. The close diamond-shaped hand position shifts the workload to the inner chest and upper arms, making it one of the most effective bodyweight movements for triceps development.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑姿势开始，双手在胸骨下方合拢，拇指和食指相触形成菱形。
整个动作中肘部贴近身体，收紧核心。
有控制地将胸部朝双手方向下压，直到几乎触地。
在底部稍作停顿，然后推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position and bring your hands together under your chest, forming a diamond shape with your index fingers and thumbs.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lower your chest toward your hands.
Lower until your chest nearly touches your hands.
Press back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Diamond Push Ups is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the triceps. The diamond hand position places maximum emphasis on the triceps while the chest and shoulders serve as supporting muscles.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手在胸下合拢，食指和拇指形成菱形。
下压时肘部贴近身体，将胸部朝双手方向降低。
下压至胸部几乎触及双手。
推回起始位置，手臂完全伸直。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position and place your hands very close together, fingers nearly touching, directly under your chest.
Form a narrow diamond shape with your index fingers and thumbs.
Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping elbows pointing back.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Diamond Push Ups Close is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the triceps with a tighter hand position than standard diamond push-ups. This variation further isolates the triceps, increasing difficulty and range of motion demands.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手靠得很近，手指几乎相触，位于胸部正下方。
用食指和拇指形成窄菱形。
将胸部朝双手方向下压，肘部朝后。
推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Grip the parallel bars and support your body weight with arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows close to your body to focus the movement on the triceps.
Pause at the bottom of the movement.
Press yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dips are a bodyweight compound exercise primarily targeting the triceps, with significant secondary activation of the chest and shoulders. They are one of the most effective movements for building upper body pressing strength and overall arm development.
instructions_zh: 握住双杠，手臂完全伸直支撑体重。
收紧核心，弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
肘部贴近身体，将发力集中在肱三头肌。
在动作底部稍作停顿。
推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Grip the parallel bars of a dip station and lift yourself up to the starting position with arms extended.
Lean your torso forward at approximately 30-45 degrees and allow your elbows to flare slightly outward.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dips with a forward lean are a bodyweight exercise targeting the chest. By leaning the torso forward and allowing the elbows to flare, greater emphasis is placed on the pectoral muscles rather than the triceps, making it a highly effective chest builder.
instructions_zh: 握住双杠臂屈伸架的平行杠，手臂伸直将身体撑至起始位置。
躯干前倾约30-45度，肘部略微向外张开。
弯曲肘部下降身体，直到胸部感到拉伸。
通过手掌发力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders and forearms flat on the floor.
Engage your core, glutes, and legs to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Press your forearms firmly into the floor and keep your hips level, avoiding any sagging or piking.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Release by lowering your knees to the floor.
description_en: The dolphin plank hold is a bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the shoulders and lower back. It is performed in a forearm plank position, requiring sustained core and shoulder stability to maintain proper alignment throughout the hold.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑姿势开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方，前臂平贴地面。
收紧核心、臀部和腿部，保持从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
前臂用力压向地面，保持臀部水平，避免下塌或上翘。
保持该姿势至目标时间，同时平稳呼吸。
膝盖落地结束动作。

instructions_en: Begin on your hands and knees, then lower your forearms to the mat with elbows directly under your shoulders.
Interlace your fingers or keep your hands flat on the mat.
Tuck your toes under and lift your hips toward the ceiling, straightening your legs.
Press your forearms firmly into the mat and draw your shoulder blades together on your back.
Hold the inverted V-shape for 20-30 seconds, then lower your knees back to the mat.
description_en: Dolphin pose is a forearm-based inversion prep that targets the deltoids and upper back while stretching the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lifting the hips from a forearm plank position to form an inverted V-shape, building shoulder strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 从手膝跪姿开始，然后将前臂放低至垫上，肘部正对肩部下方。
十指交叉或手掌平放在垫上。
脚趾踩地，将臀部向天花板方向抬起，伸直双腿。
前臂用力压向垫面，将肩胛骨向背部中间收拢。
保持倒V形20-30秒，然后膝盖落回垫上。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep one knee bent at 90 degrees and press that foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Lower the knee back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching legs.
description_en: The donkey kick is a bodyweight glute exercise performed on all fours, targeting the glutes through hip extension. Pressing the bent leg upward against gravity activates the glute maximally at the top position, making it effective for isolated glute strengthening.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部下方，膝盖位于髋部下方。
保持一侧膝盖弯曲90度，将该脚向天花板方向推。
在动作顶端收紧臀肌。
有控制地将膝盖放回起始位置。
重复至目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Start on all fours with a neutral spine and core engaged.
Lift one bent leg upward as in a standard donkey kick, pressing the foot toward the ceiling.
At the peak, pause and pulse the leg two to three times before lowering.
Return the knee to the starting position and repeat.
Complete all reps on one side before switching legs.
description_en: Donkey kick 1 is a glute variation of the donkey kick that adds a pulsing motion at the top of each repetition. The pulses increase time under tension at peak glute contraction, enhancing muscle activation and building greater endurance in the glute muscles.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，保持脊柱中立、核心收紧。
像标准驴踢一样将一侧弯曲腿向上抬起，脚向天花板方向推。
在最高点停顿并小幅弹动两到三次后放下。
将膝盖回到起始位置并重复。
一侧完成所有次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your right knee bent at 90 degrees, lift your right foot toward the ceiling.
Drive your heel upward as high as possible while squeezing the glutes.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your knee back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching to the left leg.
description_en: The donkey kick bent is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes with secondary activation of the hamstrings and lower back. Performed on all fours with a bent knee, it isolates the glute muscles through hip extension.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部下方，膝盖位于髋部下方。
保持右膝弯曲90度，将右脚向天花板方向抬起。
脚跟向上尽量蹬高，同时收紧臀肌。
在顶端停顿，然后慢慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换左腿。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend your right leg straight back so it is parallel to the floor.
Lift your straight leg upward toward the ceiling, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower the leg back to the parallel position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching to the other leg.
description_en: The donkey kick leg straight is a bodyweight glute exercise performed on all fours with the leg fully extended. This variation increases the range of motion and the length-tension relationship of the glute muscles compared to the bent-knee version.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部下方，膝盖位于髋部下方。
将右腿向后伸直，使其与地面平行。
将伸直的腿向天花板方向抬起，在顶端收紧臀肌。
有控制地将腿放回平行位置。
重复至目标次数后换另一条腿。

instructions_en: Start on all fours in a tabletop position.
Lift one knee off the floor and extend the leg up and back simultaneously.
At the top, hold the position for 2 seconds, feeling the glute fully contracted.
Lower the leg back toward the floor without letting the knee touch down.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: Donkey kick leg up is a bodyweight glute isolation exercise that combines a straight-leg kickback with a sustained top hold. The upward direction and isometric pause maximize glute activation and posterior chain endurance.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿的桌面姿势开始。
将一侧膝盖抬离地面，同时将腿向上向后伸展。
在顶端保持姿势2秒，感受臀肌完全收缩。
将腿放回地面方向，但不要让膝盖触地。
一侧完成所有次数后换边。

instructions_en: Start on all fours with hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your right knee bent at 90 degrees and flex your right foot.
Push your right heel upward toward the ceiling while squeezing your glute.
Pause at the top of the movement, fully contracting your glute.
Lower your knee back toward the floor without touching it.
Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The donkey single leg kick is a bodyweight glute exercise performed on all fours. By kicking one heel upward with the knee bent, it isolates the gluteus maximus and is commonly used as a glute activation exercise in warm-up and lower body routines.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部下方，膝盖位于髋部下方。
保持右膝弯曲90度，勾起右脚。
将右脚跟向天花板方向推，同时收紧臀肌。
在动作顶端停顿，完全收缩臀肌。
将膝盖放回地面方向，但不要触地。
重复至目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and your legs raised to a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and press your lower back firmly into the mat.
Simultaneously lower both legs toward the ground in a controlled arc, stopping just above the mat.
Raise both legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a stable pelvis throughout.
description_en: The double leg scissor is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves lowering and raising both legs simultaneously while keeping the core engaged and the lower back pressed to the mat.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂过头伸展，双腿抬至90度。
收紧核心，将下背部牢牢压向垫面。
双腿同时沿弧线有控制地向地面放下，在接近垫面处停住。
有控制地将双腿抬回起始位置。
重复至目标次数，全程保持骨盆稳定。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs raised to a 90-degree angle.
Lift your head and shoulders off the mat and place your hands behind your head.
Engage your core and lower both legs toward the mat in a slow, controlled descent.
Stop when your lower back begins to lift, then raise both legs back to vertical.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a stable pelvis throughout.
description_en: The double straight leg stretch is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings and abdominal muscles. It involves lowering and raising both straight legs while in a curl-up position, challenging core control and hamstring flexibility simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿抬起至90度。
将头和肩抬离垫子，双手置于脑后。
收紧核心，双腿缓慢受控地向垫子下放。
当下背部开始抬起时停止，然后将双腿抬回垂直位置。
重复至目标次数，全程保持骨盆稳定。

instructions_en: Begin in a plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart and fingers spread wide.
Press through your palms and lift your hips toward the ceiling, straightening your legs and lowering your heels toward the floor.
Your body should form an inverted V-shape with your head positioned between your arms.
Engage your core and press your chest gently toward your thighs to deepen the shoulder stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily, then return to the starting position.
description_en: The downward dog hold is a bodyweight stretching and strengthening exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the lats, hamstrings, and lower back. It involves holding an inverted V-shape position to simultaneously stretch the posterior chain and build shoulder and core stability.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑开始，双手与肩同宽，手指大幅张开。
手掌发力，将臀部抬向天花板，伸直双腿，脚跟向地面下压。
身体呈倒V形，头部位于双臂之间。
收紧核心，胸口轻压向大腿以加深肩部拉伸。
保持20-30秒，平稳呼吸，然后回到起始位置。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours in a tabletop position.
Tuck your toes under and lift your hips upward and back to form an inverted V shape.
Press your hands firmly into the floor and push your chest toward your thighs.
Hold the stretch, focusing on lengthening the upper back for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: The downward dog upper back stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the upper back. The inverted V position allows gravity to decompress the thoracic spine while simultaneously stretching the hamstrings, calves, and deltoids.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿的桌面位开始。
脚趾扣地，将臀部向上向后抬起，形成倒V形。
双手用力压地，将胸口推向大腿。
保持拉伸，专注拉长上背部20-30秒。
缓慢回到起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Begin on your hands and knees in a tabletop position with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your toes under and exhale as you lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Straighten your arms and legs as much as possible, forming an inverted V-shape with your body.
Press your hands firmly into the mat, spread your fingers wide, and draw your shoulder blades down your back.
Hold the position for 30-60 seconds, pedaling your heels alternately to stretch your calves, then lower back to tabletop.
description_en: Downward-facing dog is a foundational yoga posture that targets the latissimus dorsi and stretches the hamstrings, shoulders, and lower back. It involves forming an inverted V-shape by pressing the hands and feet into the floor with hips lifted, serving as both a strength-builder and restorative stretch.
instructions_zh: 从双手双膝的桌面位开始，手腕位于肩下，膝盖位于髋下。
脚趾扣地，呼气时将臀部抬向天花板。
尽量伸直手臂和双腿，身体形成倒V形。
双手用力压垫，手指大幅张开，肩胛骨沿背部向下收。
保持30-60秒，交替踩脚跟以拉伸小腿，然后回到桌面位。

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bench behind your head with both hands.
Engage your core and lift your entire body off the bench, supported only by your upper back and shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to feet as you slowly lower toward the bench.
Stop just before your body touches the bench, then raise back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dragon flag is an advanced bodyweight core exercise that requires exceptional abdominal and full-body tension. It targets the abs by demanding that the entire body be held rigid while raising and lowering, also engaging the lower back, glutes, and shoulders for stabilization.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手在头后握住长凳。
收紧核心，将整个身体抬离长凳，仅由上背和肩部支撑。
保持肩到脚呈一条直线，缓慢向长凳下放。
在身体接触长凳前停止，然后抬回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back on the floor and reach behind your head to firmly grip a sturdy vertical pole with both hands.
Brace your core and lift your legs, hips, and lower back off the floor, keeping your body in a rigid, straight line.
Raise your body upward until your weight is supported entirely by your upper back and shoulders.
Slowly lower your body back toward the floor in a controlled manner, maintaining the stiff, straight-line position.
Stop just before your body touches the floor, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dragon flags core mastery is an advanced bodyweight exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the lower back, upper arms, and shoulders. It involves lowering and raising a rigid body from the shoulder pivot point, requiring exceptional total-body tension and core strength.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺在地面上，双手伸向头后紧握一根稳固的垂直杆。
绷紧核心，将双腿、髋部和下背部抬离地面，保持身体僵直成一条直线。
将身体向上抬起，直到重量完全由上背和肩部支撑。
以受控方式缓慢将身体下放回地面，保持僵直直线姿势。
在身体接触地面前停止，然后重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine straight.
Pucker your lips outward as far as possible, creating a 'duck face' expression.
Hold the puckered position for 5–10 seconds, engaging the muscles around your mouth.
Slowly release and return your lips to a neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The duck face hold is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oris and surrounding lip muscles. It involves extending the lips outward in a puckered position to tone and strengthen the mouth area.
instructions_zh: 坐姿或站姿，保持脊柱挺直。
将嘴唇尽量向外撅起，做出“鸭子嘴”表情。
保持撅嘴姿势5-10秒，收紧嘴部周围肌肉。
缓慢放松，嘴唇回到中性位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with elbows bent at 90 degrees and tucked close to your sides, forearms parallel to the floor.
Hold a light dumbbell in each hand with palms facing upward.
Keeping your elbows at your sides, externally rotate your shoulders to open your forearms outward.
Pause at the widest point, feeling the contraction in your rear delts.
Slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumb waiter dumbbell exercise targets the posterior deltoids and rotator cuff through an external rotation movement with arms fixed at the sides. It is highly effective for shoulder health and is commonly used for injury prevention and postural correction.
instructions_zh: 站立，肘部弯曲90度并贴近身体两侧，前臂与地面平行。
双手各持一只轻哑铃，掌心朝上。
保持肘部在体侧，肩部外旋，将前臂向外打开。
在最宽处停顿，感受后束三角肌收缩。
缓慢转回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, stepping one foot slightly back and placing only the ball of that foot on the floor.
The back foot serves as a kickstand for balance rather than bearing full weight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells along your front leg, keeping your back flat.
Once you feel a stretch in your front hamstring, drive through that heel to return to standing.
Complete the desired repetitions and switch legs.
description_en: The dumbbell b-stance deadlift is a dumbbell semi-unilateral hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings. The kickstand foot position increases loading on the lead leg while providing enough balance to handle heavier loads than a full single-leg deadlift.
instructions_zh: 双手各持哑铃站立，一只脚稍向后迈，仅前脚掌着地。
后脚仅作支撑保持平衡，不承担主要重量。
髋部铰链前倾，哑铃沿前腿下放，保持背部平直。
前腿腘绳肌有拉伸感后，通过前脚跟发力回到站立。
完成目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell resting on one hip.
Place your working foot flat on the floor with your knee bent, and position the other foot slightly forward as a kickstand.
Drive through the heel of your working foot to thrust your hips upward until your body is level.
Squeeze your working glute firmly at the top.
Slowly lower your hips back toward the floor and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: The dumbbell b-stance hip thrust is a dumbbell unilateral glute exercise performed with one foot as a stabilizing kickstand. This variation increases demand on the working glute while the dumbbell provides additional resistance for greater muscle activation.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，上背靠长凳，哑铃放在一侧髋部。
工作脚踩地屈膝，另一脚稍向前作为支撑。
通过工作脚脚跟发力将髋部向上顶起，直到身体成一直线。
在顶部收紧工作侧臀肌。
缓慢将髋部降回地面，重复目标次数后换边。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Plant your feet flat on the floor and arch your lower back slightly.
Press both dumbbells upward simultaneously until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to chest level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell bench press is a compound chest exercise targeting the pectorals, triceps, and anterior deltoids. Using dumbbells allows for a greater range of motion and independent arm movement compared to a barbell, improving chest development and correcting imbalances.
instructions_zh: 平躺长凳，双手各持哑铃于胸部高度，掌心向前。
双脚踩地，下背轻微拱起。
同时向上推举哑铃，直到手臂在胸部上方完全伸直。
顶部稍停，然后缓慢将哑铃降回胸部高度。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells back to chest level in a controlled arc, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell bench press is a compound chest exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. Using dumbbells allows for a greater range of motion and independent arm movement compared to a barbell, promoting balanced chest development.
instructions_zh: 平躺长凳，双手各持哑铃于胸部高度，掌心向前。
向上推举哑铃，直到手臂在胸部上方完全伸直。
以可控弧线将哑铃降回胸部高度，肘部保持微屈。
底部稍停，然后推回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured at the top and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Begin with the dumbbells at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The decline dumbbell bench press is a chest exercise targeting the lower pectoral muscles. The declined angle shifts emphasis to the lower chest fibers while reducing shoulder involvement, helping to build a complete and defined chest.
instructions_zh: 仰卧下斜长凳，双脚固定在顶端，双手各持哑铃。
起始时哑铃位于胸部高度，掌心向前。
向上推举哑铃，直到手臂完全伸直。
以可控方式将哑铃降回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to chest level in a controlled arc.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The incline dumbbell bench press is a compound exercise targeting the upper chest. The inclined angle emphasizes the upper pectoral fibers, and the use of dumbbells allows for a natural pressing path and greater range of motion.
instructions_zh: 仰卧调至30-45度的上斜长凳，双手各持哑铃于胸部高度。
向上并稍向内推举哑铃，直到手臂完全伸直。
以可控弧线将哑铃降回胸部高度。
底部稍停，然后推回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Hinge forward at your hips while keeping your back straight and a slight bend in your knees.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down toward the floor to begin.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your waist, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the weights back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell bent-over row is a compound strength exercise that primarily targets the latissimus dorsi and upper back muscles. By hinging at the hips and pulling the weights toward the torso, it builds back thickness and improves pulling strength while requiring core and lower back stabilization.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持哑铃，采用对握（掌心相对）。
髋部前倾，保持背部挺直、膝盖微屈。
让哑铃垂直下垂至地面开始。
将哑铃拉向腰部，肘部向后驱动，肩胛骨夹紧。
动作顶部稍停。
缓慢可控地将重量降回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows close to your torso, curl both dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell biceps curl is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the biceps. Curling the weight through the full range of motion with controlled tempo is one of the most fundamental movements for developing arm size and strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧，掌心向前。
肘部贴近躯干，将两个哑铃向上弯举至肩部。
动作顶部收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将哑铃降回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand holding dumbbells in both hands with palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Curl both dumbbells simultaneously upward toward your shoulders.
Keep your elbows stationary and close to your sides throughout the movement.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell biceps curl up is a standard bilateral biceps curl exercise targeting the biceps through simultaneous elbow flexion. It is effective for building bicep size and symmetry while also engaging the forearms for stability.
instructions_zh: 双手持哑铃站立，掌心朝前，手臂完全伸直。
同时将两个哑铃向上弯举至肩部。
整个动作过程中保持肘部固定并贴近身体两侧。
在顶部停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
控制哑铃缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Extend one leg back and rest the top of your foot on the bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Drive through your front heel to return to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.
description_en: The dumbbell Bulgarian split squat is a unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Holding dumbbells allows for a natural arm position while the elevated rear foot increases range of motion and unilateral leg strength.
instructions_zh: 站在长凳前，双手各持一个哑铃垂于体侧。
一条腿向后伸展，脚背放在长凳上。
弯曲前膝，将后膝向地面下放。
下蹲至前侧大腿与地面平行。
前脚跟发力回到起始位置并重复，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Position the balls of your feet on the edge of a raised surface if available.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing your calf muscles.
Slowly lower your heels back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell calf raise is a lower leg exercise targeting the gastrocnemius through loaded plantar flexion. Holding dumbbells adds resistance beyond body weight, making it effective for progressive calf development.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一个哑铃垂于体侧。
如有条件，将前脚掌置于抬高表面的边缘。
前脚掌发力，将脚跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿，挤压小腿肌肉。
缓慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Set an incline bench to approximately 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down.
Raise both arms forward to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause at the top, squeezing your anterior deltoids.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the hanging position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell chest support front raise is a shoulder isolation exercise performed lying face down on an incline bench. The chest-supported position eliminates momentum and body swing, placing strict tension on the anterior deltoids throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 将上斜凳调至约45度，面朝下趴下，胸部贴住靠垫。
双手各持一个哑铃，手臂垂直下垂。
双臂向前抬至肩部高度，肘部保持微屈。
在顶部停顿，挤压三角肌前束。
缓慢将哑铃放回下垂位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell with both hands.
Raise the dumbbell diagonally overhead to one side, rotating your torso slightly.
In a controlled chopping motion, bring the dumbbell diagonally down toward the opposite hip, rotating your torso.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, then return to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: The dumbbell chopper is a rotational core exercise that targets the abs and obliques through a diagonal chopping motion. It also engages the shoulders and legs, making it an effective full-body stabilization movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手持一个哑铃。
将哑铃斜向举过头顶至一侧，躯干略微旋转。
以可控的劈砍动作，将哑铃斜向向下拉至对侧髋部，同时旋转躯干。
在动作底部停顿，然后回到起始位置。
一侧完成目标次数后换边。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells together and hold them touching throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells toward your chest while maintaining constant inward pressure.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, keeping them in contact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell close chest press is a chest exercise performed by keeping both dumbbells pressed together throughout the movement. This creates continuous adduction tension on the pectorals, making it an effective movement for building inner chest strength and definition.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一个哑铃置于胸部高度。
将哑铃并拢，整个动作过程中保持接触。
保持持续向内施压，将哑铃下放至胸部。
将哑铃推回起始位置，保持接触。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand directly over your chest with palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells together and lower them toward your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Lower until your elbows reach a 90-degree angle.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell close grip bench press is a dumbbell pressing exercise targeting the triceps with secondary involvement of the pectorals. Pressing with a neutral grip and elbows tucked shifts emphasis from the chest to the triceps for effective arm development.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一个哑铃位于胸部正上方，掌心相对。
将哑铃并拢，下放至下胸部，肘部紧贴身体两侧。
下放至肘部呈90度角。
将哑铃推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder, focusing on squeezing your bicep at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions, then switch arms.
description_en: The dumbbell concentration bicep curl is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the biceps. Bracing the arm against the inner thigh eliminates swinging and maximizes bicep isolation for focused muscle development.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放地面，一手持哑铃。
将上臂后侧靠在大腿内侧。
将哑铃向上弯举至肩部，顶部专注挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换臂。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder, focusing on squeezing your bicep at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions and switch arms.
description_en: The dumbbell concentration biceps curl is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the biceps. Bracing the arm against the inner thigh eliminates body swinging and maximizes bicep isolation for peak contraction and focused muscle development.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放地面，一手持哑铃。
将上臂后侧贴靠大腿内侧。
向上弯举哑铃至肩部，在顶端集中挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换另一侧手臂。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging by your sides and palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells upward by contracting your biceps until they reach shoulder level.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell curl is a fundamental upper arm exercise targeting the biceps. Using dumbbells allows for independent arm movement and a natural wrist rotation, promoting balanced bicep development and strength.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧，掌心朝前。
保持上臂固定并贴近躯干。
收缩肱二头肌向上弯举哑铃至肩部高度。
在顶端停顿并挤压肱二头肌，然后缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot behind and across your body, as if performing a curtsy.
Lower your back knee toward the ground while keeping your chest tall and core engaged.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Alternate legs with each repetition and continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell curtsy lunges are a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, particularly the gluteus medius, along with the quads and hip abductors. The crossover stepping pattern adds a rotational demand that increases glute activation compared to standard lunges.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向后交叉迈步，如同行屈膝礼。
后膝向地面下压，保持胸部挺直、核心收紧。
前脚跟发力蹬回起始位置。
每次重复交替双腿，持续完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells toward the floor, keeping your back flat.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, performing a deadlift.
At the top, curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell deadlift to biceps curl is a compound exercise that pairs a posterior chain deadlift with a biceps curl. It targets the hamstrings, glutes, and lower back while adding an arm strengthening component to create an efficient full-body movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃。
髋部铰链前倾，将哑铃向地面下放，保持背部平直。
脚跟发力站起，完成硬拉动作。
在顶端屈肘将哑铃弯举至肩部。
将哑铃放下并回到起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with a dumbbell placed outside your right hand.
Engage your core and keep your hips level throughout the movement.
Reach under your body with your left hand and drag the dumbbell to the left side.
Return your left hand to the plank position and stabilize.
Repeat in the opposite direction, dragging the dumbbell back with your right hand.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell drag is a plank-based core exercise that targets the abs through anti-rotation resistance. By dragging a dumbbell beneath the body, it challenges core stability and shoulder strength simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑姿势开始，将哑铃放在右手外侧。
收紧核心，整个动作中保持髋部水平。
左手从身体下方伸过，将哑铃拖至左侧。
左手回到平板支撑位置并稳定。
反方向重复，用右手将哑铃拖回。
持续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and diagonally to the outside, lowering into a reverse diagonal lunge.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell drop step is a unilateral lower body exercise that involves stepping back diagonally to challenge the quads and glutes from a different angle. It improves single-leg strength, balance, and hip stability while also engaging the core.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向后外侧斜向迈步，下蹲成反向斜弓步。
保持前膝对准脚尖方向，躯干直立。
前脚发力蹬回起始位置。
另一侧重复，交替双腿完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your heels elevated on plates or a wedge, holding a single dumbbell vertically at your chest in a goblet grip.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointed slightly outward.
Keeping your chest up and elbows pointing down, lower your body by bending your knees.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the ground.
Drive through your heels and midfoot to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell elevated goblet squat uses heel elevation to increase quadriceps activation while the goblet grip encourages an upright torso and core engagement. It is an effective variation for building quad and glute strength with improved squat mechanics.
instructions_zh: 脚跟垫高在杠片或楔形板上站立，双手以高脚杯握法在胸前竖握一只哑铃。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
保持胸部上挺、肘部朝下，屈膝下蹲。
下蹲至大腿至少与地面平行。
脚跟和脚掌中部发力蹬回站立位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with heels elevated on plates or a wedge, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Perform a squat by lowering your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Return to the standing position, then step one foot forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the ground, then push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs with each lunge repetition and continue for the desired number of sets.
