description_en: The dumbbell elevated squat front lunge combines an elevated squat with a forward lunge to target the quadriceps and glutes through two complementary movement patterns. The heel elevation increases quad recruitment during the squat phase, while the lunge challenges single-leg strength and balance.
instructions_zh: 脚跟垫高在杠片或楔形板上站立，双手各持哑铃。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
回到站立位置，然后一只脚向前迈步成弓步。
后膝向地面下压，然后前脚发力蹬回。
每次弓步重复交替双腿，持续完成目标组数。

instructions_en: Stand with a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides, arms fully extended.
Brace your core, retract your shoulder blades, and stand tall.
Walk forward in a straight line at a controlled pace, maintaining an upright posture.
Keep your grip firm and your steps deliberate throughout the carry.
Walk for the desired distance or duration, then set the dumbbells down carefully.
description_en: The dumbbell farmer carry is a functional strength exercise that targets the forearms and grip while also challenging the traps, core, and lower body. Carrying heavy loads for distance builds full-body stability, endurance, and practical carrying strength.
instructions_zh: 双手各持一只重哑铃垂于体侧，手臂完全伸直站立。
收紧核心，肩胛骨后收，挺胸站直。
以可控速度沿直线向前行走，保持身体直立。
整个行走过程中握紧哑铃，步伐稳健。
行走至目标距离或时间后，小心放下哑铃。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a heavy dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Brace your core and descend into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining your grip on the dumbbells.
description_en: The dumbbell farmer carry squat is a dumbbell compound exercise targeting the quadriceps while also challenging grip strength and core stability. Holding heavy dumbbells at the sides increases spinal loading compared to a goblet squat.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只重哑铃垂于体侧。
收紧核心，屈膝并向后推髋下蹲。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行，保持胸部挺起。
脚跟发力站回起始位置。
保持握紧哑铃，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended directly above your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue lowering until you feel a deep stretch across your chest.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up in the same arcing path until they meet above your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell flat flys are an isolation chest exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. The wide arcing motion stretches and contracts the chest through a large range of motion, making it effective for developing chest width and muscle definition.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂伸直于胸部正上方。
肘部微屈，将哑铃沿宽弧线向两侧下放。
继续下放直至胸部有明显拉伸感。
沿相同弧线将哑铃回到胸部上方合拢。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells outward in a wide arc.
Continue lowering until you feel a deep stretch in your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back up in the same arcing motion to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Incline dumbbell flys are an isolation exercise targeting the upper chest. The inclined angle directs the stretch and contraction toward the upper pectoral fibers, complementing pressing exercises to build a fuller upper chest.
instructions_zh: 躺在调至30-45度的上斜凳上，双手各持一只哑铃于胸部上方。
肘部微屈，将哑铃沿宽弧线向外下放。
继续下放直至上胸部有明显拉伸感。
沿相同弧线将哑铃回到起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms facing upward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your wrists just beyond your knees.
Curl the dumbbells upward by flexing your wrists.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your forearm muscles.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell forearms curl is a wrist flexion exercise targeting the forearm muscles. Performed seated with forearms braced on the thighs, it effectively isolates the wrist flexors to build forearm strength and grip endurance.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳边缘，前臂放在大腿上，掌心朝上。
双手各持一只哑铃，手腕超出膝盖。
屈腕将哑铃向上弯举。
在动作顶端停顿，收缩前臂肌肉。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing down.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise one or both arms forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell front raise is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the anterior deltoid. Lifting the arms forward against gravity develops frontal shoulder strength and is commonly used in shoulder conditioning routines.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于大腿前方，掌心朝下。
肘部微屈，将一只或双臂向前抬至肩高。
在动作顶端停顿。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Press through your feet to lift your hips into a glute bridge position.
While holding the bridge, press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to your chest while maintaining the bridge.
Repeat the press for the desired repetitions, then lower your hips.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The dumbbell glute bridge chest press is a compound exercise that simultaneously targets the pectorals and glutes. Pressing from the bridge position requires hip stability throughout the movement, adding a functional lower body element to a standard chest press.
instructions_zh: 仰卧屈膝，双手各持一只哑铃于胸部高度。
双脚踩地发力，将髋部抬起至臀桥位置。
保持臀桥姿势，将哑铃向上推至手臂完全伸直。
保持臀桥姿势，将哑铃放回胸部。
重复推举至目标次数，然后放下髋部。
休息后重复至目标组数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell vertically at chest level with both hands cupping the top end.
Keep your elbows tucked in and your chest up.
Descend into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell goblet squat is a lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Holding the dumbbell at chest height encourages an upright torso and proper squat mechanics, making it an excellent teaching tool and effective quad builder.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手捧住一只哑铃顶端，竖直置于胸前。
肘部内收，胸部挺起。
屈膝并向后推髋下蹲，直至大腿与地面平行。
脚跟发力回到站立位置。
重复至目标次数。

name_en: dumbbell goblet squat to reverse lunge
name_zh: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲接后撤弓步
instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest in a goblet grip, standing with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a goblet squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Return to standing, then step one foot back into a reverse lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the ground, then return to standing.
Alternate legs with each lunge and continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell goblet squat to reverse lunge is a compound lower body exercise that pairs a goblet squat with a reverse lunge. It targets the quadriceps and glutes while improving unilateral strength, balance, and core stability throughout both movements.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃高脚杯深蹲接后撤弓步
instructions_zh: 双手以高脚杯握法将哑铃竖直握于胸前，双脚与肩同宽站立。
下蹲至高脚杯深蹲姿势，直至大腿与地面平行。
起身站立，然后单脚后撤做反向弓步。
后膝向地面下压，然后起身站立。
每次弓步交替双腿，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Curl the dumbbells upward while maintaining the neutral grip, bringing them to shoulder level.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps and forearms.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell hammer curl is an upper arm exercise targeting the biceps with a neutral grip. This grip variation places greater emphasis on the brachialis and brachioradialis muscles, contributing to overall arm thickness and strength.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法，掌心朝向躯干。
肘部贴近身体两侧，上臂保持不动。
保持中立握法将哑铃向上弯举至肩部高度。
在顶端稍作停顿，收紧肱二头肌和前臂。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Hold the dumbbells at chest level with your elbows at approximately a 45-degree angle from your torso.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell hammer press is a chest pressing exercise performed with a neutral grip to reduce shoulder stress and increase triceps involvement. It targets the pectorals with secondary emphasis on the triceps and front delts, and is a joint-friendly alternative to traditional dumbbell bench press.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法，掌心相对。
将哑铃置于胸部高度，肘部与躯干约呈45度角。
将哑铃向上推举，直至手臂完全伸直。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
Curl the dumbbells upward with palms facing each other, performing a hammer curl.
At the top of the hammer curl, rotate your palms to face upward and continue into a standard biceps curl.
Squeeze your biceps at the peak, then reverse the rotation and lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell hammer to biceps curl is a combination curl exercise that works both the brachioradialis and biceps brachii. By transitioning from a neutral to a supinated grip within each repetition, it targets multiple heads of the bicep for complete development.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法。
掌心相对将哑铃向上弯举，做锤式弯举。
在锤式弯举顶端将掌心旋转朝上，继续做标准肱二头肌弯举。
在最高点收紧肱二头肌，然后反向旋转并放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your knees and your back flat throughout the movement.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as you lower your torso toward the floor.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell hip hinge is a fundamental movement pattern exercise targeting the hamstrings and posterior chain. It teaches proper hip hinge mechanics, which are foundational for movements like the deadlift and Romanian deadlift.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
整个动作过程中膝盖保持微屈，背部保持平直。
以髋部为轴向后推髋，同时将躯干向地面下放。
下放至腘绳肌有拉伸感，然后向前顶髋回到站立姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Set a bench to a 30-45 degree incline and lie back holding dumbbells pressed together at your chest.
Maintain constant inward pressure on the dumbbells throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells toward your upper chest while keeping them in contact.
Press back up to the starting position without allowing the dumbbells to separate.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell incline close chest press combines an incline angle with the constant inward pressing of a close chest press. It targets the upper portion of the pectorals while the adduction tension engages the inner chest, making it effective for upper chest development.
instructions_zh: 将长凳调至30-45度上斜，仰卧，双手持哑铃在胸前并拢。
整个动作过程中保持哑铃持续向内挤压。
将哑铃下放至上胸位置，保持两者接触。
向上推回起始位置，不要让哑铃分开。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place a dumbbell on the floor in each hand position and assume a push-up stance gripping the dumbbell handles.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels with core engaged.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Push through the dumbbells to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell incline push up is a dumbbell bodyweight hybrid exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. Gripping the dumbbells during the push-up increases the range of motion by allowing the chest to descend deeper, enhancing muscle stretch and activation.
instructions_zh: 在地面放置两只哑铃，双手握住哑铃手柄呈俯卧撑姿势。
身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线，核心收紧。
肘部呈45度角弯曲，将胸部向地面下放。
通过哑铃发力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Perform a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back to thigh-parallel depth.
Explosively drive through your heels to jump off the ground as high as possible.
Land softly with bent knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately descend into the next squat and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell jump squat is a plyometric exercise targeting the quadriceps and developing lower body explosive power. Adding light dumbbell resistance increases the training stimulus while the jumping motion improves athleticism and conditioning.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只轻哑铃置于身体两侧。
屈膝并向后推髋做深蹲，下蹲至大腿平行深度。
通过脚跟爆发发力，尽可能高地跳离地面。
屈膝柔和落地以缓冲冲击。
立即下蹲进入下一次深蹲，按目标次数重复。

name_en: dumbbell kneeling hammer curl to hammer press
name_zh: 哑铃跪姿锤式弯举接锤式推举
instructions_en: Kneel on both knees on a mat with a dumbbell in each hand using a neutral grip.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders in a hammer curl motion.
From the top of the curl, press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height, then lower further to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell kneeling hammer curl to hammer press is a compound arm exercise performed in a kneeling position, eliminating lower body momentum. It targets the biceps through the curl and the shoulders through the press, while the kneeling position engages the core for stability.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃跪姿锤式弯举接锤式推举
instructions_zh: 双膝跪在垫子上，双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法。
以锤式弯举动作将哑铃向上弯举至肩部。
从弯举顶端将哑铃向上推举，直到手臂完全伸直。
将哑铃放回肩部高度，然后继续下放至起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause at the top and avoid shrugging your shoulders.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell lateral raise is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the lateral head of the deltoids. Raising the arms out to the sides against gravity effectively develops shoulder width and definition.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
肘部微屈，将双臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
在顶端稍停，避免耸肩。
缓慢将哑铃下放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: dumbbell lateral raise to front raise
instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides in a lateral raise until they are parallel to the ground.
Lower the dumbbells back down, then raise both arms straight in front of you in a front raise.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Continue alternating between lateral and front raises for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell lateral raise to front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets all heads of the deltoid by combining lateral raises with front raises. Alternating between the two movements provides comprehensive shoulder development and improved muscular endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
做侧平举，将双臂向两侧抬起，直到与地面平行。
将哑铃下放，然后做前平举，将双臂向正前方抬起。
将哑铃下放回起始位置。
继续交替进行侧平举和前平举，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a flat bench, positioning a dumbbell between your feet by squeezing it with your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed into the bench and grip the bench for stability.
Curl your legs upward by bending your knees, bringing the dumbbell toward your glutes.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell leg curl is a hamstring isolation exercise performed lying face down on a bench, using a dumbbell held between the feet. It effectively mimics the motion of a lying leg curl machine, targeting the hamstrings and calves.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在平凳上，用脚踝夹住一只哑铃置于双脚之间。
保持髋部贴紧凳面，抓住凳子以保持稳定。
屈膝将双腿向上弯起，把哑铃带向臀部。
在动作顶端稍停，收紧腘绳肌。
缓慢将哑铃下放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Engage your core and maintain an upright posture.
Lift your right knee upward toward your hip level.
Lower it and immediately lift your left knee.
Continue alternating in a controlled marching cadence.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell march is a loaded hip flexion exercise targeting the glutes and hip flexors while adding core stability challenge through the added weight. It is effective for developing hip strength and single-leg balance simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
收紧核心，保持身体直立。
将右膝向上抬至髋部高度。
放下后立即抬起左膝。
以受控的踏步节奏继续交替进行。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Keep your feet flat on the floor and your back pressed against the pad.
Press the dumbbells upward and slightly inward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell overhead press version 1 is a seated shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids. Pressing dumbbells overhead from shoulder height builds shoulder strength and size, with secondary activation of the triceps and traps.
instructions_zh: 坐在有靠背的凳子上，双手各持一只哑铃置于肩部高度，掌心朝前。
双脚平放地面，背部贴紧靠垫。
将哑铃向上并略微向内推举，直到手臂在头顶完全伸直。
在顶端稍停，然后缓慢将哑铃下放回肩部高度。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and maintain an upright posture.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The standard dumbbell overhead press is a compound shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids. Pressing dumbbells overhead while standing builds shoulder strength and stability, with core engagement required to maintain an upright posture under load.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于肩部高度，掌心朝前。
收紧核心，保持身体直立。
将哑铃向上推举，直到手臂在头顶完全伸直。
在顶端稍停，然后缓慢将哑铃下放回肩部高度。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a single dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead.
With a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbell in a wide arc behind your head toward the floor.
Feel the stretch in your lats and chest at the bottom of the movement.
Pull the dumbbell back up in the same arc to the starting position over your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell pullover is a dumbbell exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi through an overhead arc motion. It uniquely trains both the chest and lats simultaneously and is used to develop upper body width and thoracic mobility.
instructions_zh: 平躺在凳子上，双手共持一只哑铃，手臂伸直置于头顶。
肘部微屈，以宽弧线将哑铃向头后下放至接近地面。
在动作底部感受背阔肌和胸部的拉伸。
沿相同弧线将哑铃拉回胸部上方的起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot straight back and lower your hips until both knees are bent at approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee directly above your front ankle and your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other leg, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell reverse lunges are a dumbbell lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps, with engagement of the glutes and hamstrings. Stepping backward rather than forward reduces knee stress and challenges balance and unilateral leg strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向正后方迈步，屈髋下蹲至双膝约呈90度。
前膝保持在前脚踝正上方，躯干保持直立。
前脚发力蹬地回到起始位置。
换另一条腿重复，交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing a low step or platform holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step backward onto the platform with one foot, then bring the other foot up.
Step back down one foot at a time, returning to the starting position.
Repeat, leading with the opposite foot and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell reverse step is a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes by stepping backward onto an elevated platform. It develops unilateral leg strength and improves balance and coordination with the added resistance of dumbbells.
instructions_zh: 面向低台阶或平台站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向后踏上平台，另一只脚随后跟上。
双脚依次向后下踏，回到起始位置。
换另一只脚领先重复，继续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and hinge forward, lowering the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep your back flat and lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell romanian deadlift targets the hamstrings through a hip hinge movement with dumbbells. It is a highly effective exercise for building hamstring length and strength while also engaging the glutes and lower back.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃置于大腿前方。
髋部后推，屈髋前倾，哑铃沿腿部向下放。
保持背部平直，下放哑铃至腘绳肌有拉伸感。
髋部前推回到站立位置。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Avoid locking out your elbows at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell shoulder press is a compound overhead exercise targeting the deltoids and building overall shoulder strength. Using dumbbells allows for a natural pressing path and unilateral correction, making it a versatile alternative to barbell pressing.
instructions_zh: 坐姿或站姿，双手各持哑铃置于肩高，掌心朝前。
收紧核心，将哑铃向上推举至手臂完全伸直。
动作顶端避免肘关节锁死。
缓慢将哑铃下放回肩高。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip.
Allow your arms to hang straight down with your shoulders relaxed.
Elevate your shoulders as high as possible towards your ears in a controlled shrugging motion.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your trapezius muscles.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell shrug is a back exercise targeting the trapezius muscles. Holding dumbbells at the sides allows for a natural arm path and equal loading on both sides, making it effective for building upper trap strength and thickness.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧，采用中立握法。
手臂自然下垂，双肩放松。
以可控的耸肩动作将双肩尽可能向耳朵方向抬高。
顶端短暂停顿，挤压斜方肌。
缓慢将双肩下放回起始位置，重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Let your arms hang naturally and keep your chest tall and core engaged.
Shrug your shoulders straight upward toward your ears as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your traps.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell shrugs are an isolation exercise that targets the upper trapezius muscles. The upward shrugging motion against loaded dumbbells builds trap size and thickness, improving shoulder and neck aesthetics and upper body stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
手臂自然下垂，挺胸并收紧核心。
双肩向耳朵方向尽可能垂直耸起。
顶端短暂停顿，挤压斜方肌。
缓慢将双肩下放回起始位置，重复完成目标次数。

name_en: dumbbell single leg & arm deadlift to upright row
name_zh: 哑铃单腿单臂硬拉接直立划船
instructions_en: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell toward the floor, extending the free leg behind you.
Return to upright, then pull the dumbbell up along your body toward your chin.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching legs.
description_en: The dumbbell single leg and arm deadlift to upright row is a unilateral compound exercise combining a single-leg hinge with a contralateral upright row. It targets the hamstrings and posterior chain while also building trap and shoulder strength, requiring balance and core stability throughout.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃单腿单臂硬拉接直立划船
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，对侧手持哑铃。
屈髋前倾，将哑铃向地面下放，同时自由腿向后伸展。
回到直立后，将哑铃沿身体向上拉至下巴方向。
控制哑铃下放回起始位置。
一侧完成全部次数后再换腿。

name_en: dumbbell single leg & arm squat press
name_zh: 哑铃单腿单臂深蹲推举
instructions_en: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand at shoulder height.
Lower into a single-leg squat by bending the standing knee, keeping your chest upright.
As you rise from the squat, press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height as you return to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: The dumbbell single leg and arm squat press is a unilateral exercise that challenges balance and coordination by pairing a single-leg squat with a contralateral overhead press. It targets the quads and glutes while also developing shoulder strength and core stability.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃单腿单臂深蹲推举
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，对侧手持哑铃置于肩高。
屈曲支撑腿下蹲成单腿蹲，保持胸部直立。
从下蹲起身时，将哑铃向上推举至手臂完全伸直。
将哑铃下放回肩高，同时回到起始位置。
完成目标次数后换边。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand, letting your arm hang straight down.
Shift your weight onto the leg on the same side as the dumbbell (or opposite, depending on your preferred balance), keeping a slight bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward at your hips, extending your free leg straight out behind you while lowering the dumbbell toward the floor.
Extend your free arm out to the side to help maintain your balance.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, ensuring your back remains flat.
Drive through the heel of your standing foot and push your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch the dumbbell to your other hand and repeat on the opposite leg.
description_en: The dumbbell single leg deadlift is a unilateral strength and balance exercise targeting the hamstrings and glutes. Adding a dumbbell increases the resistance on the posterior chain, making it highly effective for building muscle, improving hip stability, and correcting strength imbalances between legs.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，一手持哑铃，手臂自然下垂。
将重心移到持哑铃同侧的腿上（或对侧，取决于你的平衡偏好），支撑腿膝盖微屈。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，非支撑腿向后伸直，同时将哑铃向地面下放。
非持铃手臂向侧方伸出以帮助保持平衡。
继续下放躯干直至几乎与地面平行，保持背部平直。
通过支撑脚脚跟发力，髋部向前推，回到直立的起始位置。
完成目标次数后，将哑铃换到另一只手，在另一条腿上重复。

name_en: dumbbell single leg deadlift to upright row
name_zh: 哑铃单腿硬拉接直立划船
instructions_en: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells toward the floor, extending the free leg behind you.
Return to upright, then pull the dumbbells up along your body toward your chin in an upright row.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching legs.
description_en: The dumbbell single leg deadlift to upright row combines a single-leg Romanian deadlift with an upright row. It targets the hamstrings and glutes through the hinge while adding trap and shoulder engagement through the row, also requiring significant core and balance stability.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃单腿硬拉接直立划船
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于大腿前方。
以髋部为轴俯身，将哑铃向地面下放，非支撑腿向后伸直。
回到直立位置，然后将哑铃沿身体向上拉至下巴处做直立划船。
将哑铃放回起始位置并重复。
在一侧完成所有次数后再换腿。

name_zh: 哑铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions_en: Stand on one foot and hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells toward the floor while extending the free leg behind you.
Keep your back flat and your hips square as you descend.
Once you feel a strong stretch in your hamstring, drive your hips forward to return to standing.
Complete the desired repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The dumbbell single-leg romanian deadlift is a dumbbell unilateral hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings and glutes. The single-leg stance demands significant balance and core stability in addition to posterior chain strength.
name_zh_llm: 哑铃单腿罗马尼亚硬拉
instructions_zh: 单脚站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于大腿前方。
以髋部为轴俯身，将哑铃向地面下放，同时非支撑腿向后伸直。
下放过程中保持背部平直、髋部正对前方。
感到腘绳肌有明显拉伸感后，髋部向前发力回到站立位置。
完成目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot flat on the box.
Drive through the heel of your elevated foot to step up, bringing your other foot onto the box.
Step back down with the trailing foot first.
Repeat on the same leg for the desired number of repetitions, then switch.
description_en: The dumbbell single leg step up is a dumbbell unilateral exercise targeting the quadriceps. The added load of the dumbbells increases lower body strength demand and helps develop balanced muscular strength between legs.
instructions_zh: 站在箱子或长凳前，双手各持一只哑铃。
将一只脚平放在箱子上。
通过抬起脚脚跟发力踏上箱子，将另一只脚也带到箱子上。
后脚先落下，退回地面。
在同一侧腿完成目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended directly above your chest.
Keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward your temples.
Pause just above your head, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Keep your elbows pointed at the ceiling throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell skull crusher is a triceps isolation exercise performed lying on a bench. By lowering the dumbbells toward the temples with controlled elbow flexion, it provides a deep stretch and full contraction of the triceps, making it highly effective for arm development.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂伸直于胸部正上方。
保持上臂垂直于地面，弯曲肘部将哑铃下放至头部两侧。
在头部上方稍作停顿，然后伸直手臂回到起始位置。
整个动作过程中保持肘部朝向天花板。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended straight above your chest.
Keep your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Pause just before the dumbbells touch your temples, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell skullcrusher is a triceps isolation exercise performed lying on a bench. Lowering dumbbells toward the sides of the head while keeping the upper arms fixed places maximum tension on the triceps brachii.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一只哑铃，手臂伸直于胸部正上方。
保持上臂固定并垂直于地面。
缓慢弯曲肘部，将哑铃下放至头部两侧。
在哑铃接近太阳穴前稍作停顿，然后伸直手臂回到起始位置。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Set an incline bench to approximately 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms hanging straight down and palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells upward by contracting your biceps, keeping your upper arms perpendicular to the floor.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell spider curl is an upper arm exercise targeting the biceps. Performed face-down on an incline bench, this variation eliminates body movement and keeps constant tension on the biceps throughout the entire range of motion.
instructions_zh: 将上斜凳调至约45度，面朝下趴下，胸部贴紧靠垫。
双手各持一只哑铃，手臂自然下垂，掌心朝前。
收缩肱二头肌将哑铃向上弯举，保持上臂垂直于地面。
在动作顶端停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置，重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a sturdy box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot onto the box and drive through that heel to lift your body up.
Bring the other foot onto the box to stand fully upright.
Step back down one foot at a time to return to the starting position.
Repeat, leading with the opposite foot and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell step up box is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes by stepping up onto an elevated platform with added dumbbell resistance. It builds single-leg strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_zh: 站在稳固的箱子或长凳前，双手各持一只哑铃。
一只脚踩上箱子，通过该脚脚跟发力将身体抬起。
将另一只脚也带到箱子上，完全站直。
一只脚一只脚地退回地面，回到起始位置。
换另一只脚领先重复，继续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
With a slight bend in your knees, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells along your legs.
Keep your back flat and lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell stiff deadlifts are a dumbbell hip hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings. Maintaining nearly straight legs during the hinge maximizes the stretch and contraction of the hamstrings, building posterior chain strength and flexibility.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于大腿前侧。
膝盖微屈，以髋部为轴向前俯身，让哑铃沿腿部向下放。
保持背部平直，下放至腘绳肌有明显拉伸感。
收紧臀肌，髋部向前发力回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointed outward, holding a single dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower the dumbbell toward the floor.
Keep your back flat and chest tall throughout the movement.
Press through your heels and inner feet to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell sumo deadlift uses a wide stance to target the quads and adductors through a vertical pulling pattern. Holding a single dumbbell between the legs provides a comfortable range of motion and is accessible for all training levels.
instructions_zh: 双脚宽距站立，脚尖向外，双手在双腿之间握住一只哑铃。
以髋部为轴俯身并屈膝，将哑铃向地面下放。
整个动作过程中保持背部平直、胸部挺起。
通过脚跟和脚内侧发力回到站立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Perform a full squat, lowering until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
As you drive upward from the squat, press the dumbbells overhead.
Fully extend your legs and arms at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height as you descend into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell thruster is a full-body compound exercise combining a squat and overhead press into one fluid movement. It targets the quads, glutes, and shoulders simultaneously, making it highly efficient for building strength and cardiovascular conditioning.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于肩部高度。
完成一次深蹲，下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
从深蹲向上发力时，将哑铃推举过头顶。
在动作顶端完全伸直双腿和手臂。
下蹲时让哑铃回到肩部高度，进入下一次深蹲。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot diagonally behind you in a transverse or curtsy lunge pattern.
Lower your back knee toward the ground while keeping your front knee stable.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell transverse lunges involve stepping at an angle across the body, targeting the quadriceps and glutes while engaging the hip abductors and adductors. This multi-planar movement improves lower body strength, mobility, and dynamic stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
一只脚向斜后方迈出，做横向或屈膝礼弓步。
后膝向地面下放，同时保持前膝稳定。
通过前脚发力回到起始位置。
换另一侧重复，双腿交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Brace your right elbow against your side with the upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your forearm back and upward until your arm is fully straight.
Pause at the top, squeezing your tricep.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: The dumbbell triceps kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps through elbow extension in a hinged position. By keeping the upper arm stationary and fixed, it forces the triceps to perform the full range of motion without assistance.
instructions_zh: 右手持哑铃，以髋部为轴向前俯身，直到躯干几乎与地面平行。
右肘贴紧身体侧面，上臂与地面平行。
向后上方伸直前臂，直到手臂完全伸直。
在顶端停顿，收紧肱三头肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换侧。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip in front of your thighs.
Pull the dumbbells upward along your body by raising your elbows above the level of your hands.
Continue pulling until the dumbbells reach chest height and your elbows are at shoulder level.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell upright row is a shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids and trapezius. Using dumbbells allows for a more natural wrist path compared to a barbell, reducing shoulder joint stress while effectively building upper shoulder width.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手各持一只哑铃，采用中立握法置于大腿前侧。
将哑铃沿身体向上提拉，使肘部高于手部。
继续上提至哑铃到达胸部高度，肘部与肩同高。
在顶端停顿，然后缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding one dumbbell with both hands, cupping the upper weight plate with palms facing upward.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your chin by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell waiter curl is a biceps exercise in which both hands hold a single dumbbell in a waiter-carry position. The supinated grip and fixed wrist angle intensify the squeeze at the top and increase long head biceps activation.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手托住一只哑铃的上方配重片，掌心朝上。
肘部紧贴身体两侧。
屈肘将哑铃向上弯举至下巴方向。
在顶端停顿，收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one foot and lower your back knee toward the ground.
Ensure both knees are at approximately 90 degrees at the bottom of the lunge.
Push through your front heel and step the rear foot forward into the next lunge.
Continue walking forward in a lunge pattern for the desired number of steps.
description_en: Dumbbell walking lunges are a dynamic lower body exercise targeting the quads, glutes, and hamstrings. Moving continuously forward with dumbbells adds load and increases the demand on the core and lower body compared to stationary lunges.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于身体两侧。
一只脚向前迈出，后膝向地面下放。
在弓步底部确保双膝约呈90度。
通过前脚跟发力，后脚向前迈出进入下一次弓步。
以弓步方式持续向前行走目标步数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms extended at your sides.
Raise your arms to shoulder height and make small circular motions forward.
Gradually increase the size of the circles over several repetitions.
Reverse the direction and perform the same number of circles backward.
Lower your arms and rest before repeating.
description_en: Dumbbell weighted arm circles are a shoulder endurance and mobility exercise targeting the deltoids through circular rotational motion. Adding light dumbbells increases the challenge on the shoulder stabilizers and rotator cuff, improving joint health and muscular endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，每只手握一只轻哑铃，双臂自然垂于体侧。
将双臂抬至肩高，向前做小幅绕环动作。
在数次重复中逐渐加大绕环幅度。
反方向做同样次数的向后绕环。
放下双臂休息后重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand pressed overhead.
Keep your eyes on the raised dumbbell and push your hip out to the side opposite the dumbbell.
Slowly bend at the waist and lower your free hand down your inner leg toward the ground.
Keep the dumbbell arm straight and perpendicular to the ground throughout the movement.
Return to the upright position by contracting your obliques and glutes.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: The dumbbell windmill is a functional exercise that targets the obliques and core by rotating through the torso while maintaining an overhead dumbbell. It also stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes, making it an excellent movement for mobility and rotational strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚略宽于肩站立，一只手将哑铃举过头顶。
眼睛注视举起的哑铃，将对侧髋部向外推出。
缓慢屈髋，自由手沿内侧腿向下伸向地面。
整个动作过程中持哑铃的手臂保持伸直并垂直于地面。
收缩腹斜肌和臀肌回到直立位置。
一侧完成所有次数后再换边。

instructions_en: Lie prone on an incline bench set to approximately 45 degrees, holding light dumbbells in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down toward the floor.
Raise both arms upward and outward at a diagonal, forming a Y shape with your body.
Pause at the top, squeezing your upper back and rear delts.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dumbbell y-raise is a shoulder health exercise targeting the lower trapezius and posterior deltoids through an inclined overhead Y-pattern raise. It improves scapular stability and shoulder girdle strength, making it valuable for injury prevention.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在约45度的斜板上，每只手握一只轻哑铃。
双臂自然垂直下垂朝向地面。
双臂向上向外斜向抬起，与身体形成Y形。
在顶端停顿，挤压上背部和后三角肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。
xunji_candidate: 上斜凳俯卧哑铃Y字上举

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms resting by your sides.
Engage your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly raise both arms out to your sides simultaneously.
Continue lifting until your arms are fully extended and parallel to the floor, keeping your palms facing down.
Pause and hold this extended position briefly.
Slowly lower your arms back to your sides and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dynamic arms stretch is a bodyweight warm-up and mobility exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the traps, chest, and upper arms. It involves performing controlled arm circles in both directions to increase shoulder joint mobility and blood flow to the upper body.
instructions_zh: 直立，双脚与肩同宽，双臂垂于体侧。
收紧核心，保持肩部放松。
同时缓慢将双臂向两侧抬起。
继续抬起至双臂完全伸直并与地面平行，掌心朝下。
短暂停顿并保持伸展位置。
缓慢将双臂放回体侧，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height.
Swing both arms forward, crossing them in front of your chest in a controlled motion.
Immediately swing your arms back and out to the sides, opening the chest as wide as possible.
Continue the swinging motion rhythmically without pausing at either end.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dynamic chest stretch is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. The rhythmic swinging motion warms up the chest and anterior deltoids by moving the shoulder joints through their full range of motion.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂在肩高向两侧伸展。
双臂向前摆动，在胸前交叉，动作受控。
立即将双臂向后向外摆回，尽量打开胸腔。
有节奏地连续摆动，两端均不停顿。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Raise both arms overhead, keeping your elbows slightly bent so your hands frame your head.
Engage your core and slowly bend your torso to one side, keeping your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly when you feel a stretch along the side of your body.
Slowly return to the upright center position.
Bend to the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The dynamic upper body stretch is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the chest, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, traps, and lats. It involves sweeping the arms in a wide arc to open the chest and loosen the upper body, making it an effective warm-up or cool-down movement.
instructions_zh: 直立，双脚宽于肩。
双臂举过头顶，肘部微屈，双手框住头部。
收紧核心，缓慢将躯干向一侧弯曲，胸部保持朝前。
身体侧面感到拉伸时短暂停顿。
缓慢回到直立中间位置。
向另一侧弯曲，交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Extend your right leg straight back and bend your knee, lifting your right foot toward the ceiling.
Reach your left hand back to grasp the right foot, creating a backbend.
Maintain balance on your right arm and left knee while opening your chest upward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: Eka hasta vyagrasana, or one-handed tiger pose, is a kneeling balance and backbend posture targeting the lower back and glutes. It involves extending one leg back while grasping the foot with the opposite hand, requiring core stability and hip flexibility.
instructions_zh: 从手膝着地的桌面姿势开始。
右腿向后伸直并屈膝，将右脚抬向天花板。
左手向后伸抓住右脚，形成后弯。
用右臂和左膝保持平衡，同时向上打开胸腔。
保持20-30秒，然后放开并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Begin standing and shift your weight to your left foot, bringing your right ankle to rest on your left thigh.
Bend your left knee and hinge forward, placing your hands on the mat.
Hook your right shin on the backs of your upper arms and shift your weight onto your hands.
Lean forward and lift your left foot off the floor, balancing entirely on your hands.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then slowly lower and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Eka pada galavasana is an advanced arm balance yoga posture that targets the hip flexors and glutes of the crossed leg while requiring significant core and upper body strength. It involves hooking one shin on the upper arms and extending the opposite leg backward while balancing on the hands.
instructions_zh: 站立开始，重心移到左脚，将右脚踝放在左大腿上。
屈左膝并向前屈髋，双手放在垫子上。
将右小腿勾在上臂后侧，重心移到双手上。
身体前倾，左脚离地，完全靠双手平衡。
保持10-20秒，然后缓慢放下并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your body in a straight line.
Place your elbow directly beneath your shoulder and press your forearm into the floor.
Lift your hips off the ground so your body forms a straight diagonal line.
Hold the position with your core engaged and hips level.
Maintain the hold for the desired duration before switching sides.
description_en: The elbow hold side plank is a bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the obliques. Supporting the body on one forearm and foot challenges lateral core stability and strengthens the entire side of the trunk.
instructions_zh: 侧卧，双腿并拢，身体成一条直线。
将肘部置于肩部正下方，前臂压向地面。
将髋部抬离地面，使身体形成一条斜直线。
收紧核心，保持髋部水平，维持姿势。
保持至目标时长后换另一侧。

name_en: elbow hold side plank with half hand raise
instructions_en: Set up in a side plank position on your forearm with your body in a straight line.
Raise your top arm straight toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower the raised arm halfway down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Raise the arm back to the vertical position and repeat.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching to the other side.
description_en: The elbow hold side plank with half hand raise is a bodyweight side plank variation that adds an arm raise to increase the demand on the obliques and shoulder stabilizers. The partial hold intensifies muscle engagement along the lateral core.
instructions_zh: 以前臂支撑进入侧平板姿势，身体成一条直线。
将上方手臂向天花板方向伸直抬起。
缓慢将抬起的手臂下放至一半位置，保持2-3秒。
将手臂抬回垂直位置并重复。
完成目标次数后换另一侧。

name_en: elbow plank hold with hips dip
instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows under shoulders and body in a straight line.
Keeping your feet in place, slowly rotate your hips and lower them to one side toward the floor.
Stop just before your hip touches the ground, then rotate and lower to the other side.
Continue alternating dips in a controlled, rhythmic manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The elbow plank hold with hips dip is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the obliques. The lateral hip dip motion from a forearm plank position adds dynamic oblique engagement on top of the static core stability demand.
instructions_zh: 以前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩部下方，身体成一条直线。
双脚保持不动，缓慢旋转髋部并向一侧下放至接近地面。
在髋部触地前停住，然后旋转并向另一侧下放。
以受控、有节奏的方式持续交替下沉。
重复至目标次数。

name_en: elbow plank hold with hips up
instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Keeping your legs straight, raise your hips upward toward the ceiling into an inverted V shape.
Hold the elevated hip position for 2-3 seconds.
Lower your hips back to the straight plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The elbow plank hold with hips up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abs. It transitions from a flat forearm plank to a pike position, increasing spinal flexion demand on the abdominals and challenging shoulder stability.
instructions_zh: 以前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩部正下方。
保持双腿伸直，将髋部向天花板方向上抬成倒V形。
保持髋部抬高位置2-3秒。
将髋部放回直线平板位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a forearm plank position with elbows on the floor directly under your shoulders.
Press up onto your right hand, then your left hand, rising into a high plank position.
Perform one full push-up in the high plank position.
Lower back down to your right forearm, then your left forearm, returning to the elbow plank.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Elbow plank to push ups is a bodyweight compound exercise targeting the chest and core. It combines the stability demand of an elbow plank with the upper body strength challenge of a push-up, creating a dynamic full upper-body movement.
instructions_zh: 以前臂平板支撑开始，肘部撑地位于肩部正下方。
先撑起右手，再撑起左手，进入高位平板支撑。
在高位平板支撑中完成一次完整俯卧撑。
先下放至右前臂，再下放至左前臂，回到肘部平板支撑。
每次重复交替领先手臂，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms against it at shoulder height, elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Step your feet back until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, keeping your hips level.
Avoid letting your lower back sag or your hips rise.
Hold for the desired duration.
description_en: The elbow wall plank is a bodyweight isometric exercise that targets the abdominal muscles in a modified upright position. It is commonly used as a beginner-friendly alternative to the floor plank, building core endurance and stability.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，将前臂贴墙置于肩部高度，肘部弯曲90度。
双脚后撤，直到身体从头到脚跟形成一条斜直线。
收紧核心并夹紧臀肌，保持髋部水平。
避免下背部下沉或髋部上抬。
保持至目标时长。

instructions_en: Place a kettlebell on elevated plates or a low platform and stand over it with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grasp the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Keeping your back flat and chest up, drive through your heels to stand upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower the kettlebell back to the elevated surface with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The elevated kettlebell deadlift uses an elevated surface to increase the range of motion compared to a standard kettlebell deadlift. It targets the hamstrings and glutes while also engaging the lower back and core, making it effective for posterior chain development and hip hinge mechanics.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在加高的杠铃片或低平台上，双脚与髋同宽站在其上方。
以髋部为轴俯身，双手握住壶铃把手。
保持背部平直、胸部抬起，脚跟发力站直。
在动作顶端夹紧臀肌。
控制壶铃放回加高表面。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Place a kettlebell on elevated plates or a low platform and stand over it in a wide sumo stance.
Turn your feet outward at approximately 45 degrees and hinge at the hips to grasp the kettlebell.
Keep your chest up, back flat, and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand upright.
Lower the kettlebell back to the elevated surface with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The elevated kettlebell sumo deadlift uses a wide stance and elevated surface to increase range of motion and target the glutes and inner thighs. It builds posterior chain strength with an emphasis on the glutes, adductors, and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在加高的杠铃片或低平台上，以宽距相扑站姿站在其上方。
双脚向外转约45度，以髋部为轴俯身握住壶铃。
保持胸部抬起、背部平直，膝盖对准脚尖方向。
脚跟发力并夹紧臀肌站直。
控制壶铃放回加高表面。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Place your feet on a bench and walk your hands toward the bench so your hips are elevated and your body forms an inverted V.
Position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the top of your head toward the floor by bending your elbows outward.
Pause when your head is near the floor.
Press back up to the inverted V starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The elevated pike push-up is an advanced bodyweight shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids through a vertical pressing movement. Elevating the feet increases the body angle to be more vertical, placing greater demand on the shoulders compared to a standard pike push-up.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在长凳上，双手向长凳方向移动，使髋部抬高、身体呈倒V形。
双手间距略宽于肩宽。
屈肘向外，将头顶向地面下放。
头部接近地面时稍作停顿。
推回至倒V形起始姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench, box, or step.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels.
Engage your core, glutes, and shoulders to maintain the plank position.
Keep your hips level without sagging or raising them.
Hold the position for the desired duration.
description_en: The elevated plank is a modified bodyweight plank exercise where the hands are placed on an elevated surface. This reduces the load on the core compared to a standard plank, making it suitable for beginners or those recovering from injury.
instructions_zh: 将双手放在长凳、箱子或台阶等抬高平面上。
双脚向后走，直到身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线斜线。
收紧核心、臀部和肩部以保持平板支撑姿势。
保持髋部水平，不要下沉或抬高。
保持该姿势至目标时长。

name_en: elevated skii jumps with booty bands
instructions_en: Loop a resistance band just above your knees and stand with one foot on a low elevated surface.
Push your knees outward against the band and hinge slightly at the hips.
Explosively jump laterally from one side of the elevated surface to the other, landing softly.
Maintain a slight bend in your knees upon landing and immediately jump back to the other side.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions, keeping the band tension consistent throughout.
description_en: Elevated ski jumps with booty bands are a plyometric resistance band exercise targeting the glutes, quads, and hamstrings. Incorporating a band above the knees increases hip abductor and glute activation during the lateral jumping movement.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带套在膝盖上方，一只脚站在低矮的抬高平面上。
膝盖向外撑开阻力带，髋部略微屈曲。
爆发性地从抬高平面一侧横向跳向另一侧，轻柔落地。
落地时保持膝盖微屈，并立即跳回另一侧。
按目标次数持续进行，全程保持阻力带张力一致。

instructions_en: Step onto the elliptical machine and grip the moving handles.
Set a high resistance level appropriate for interval training.
Push and pull the handles while driving through the pedals at maximum effort for the work interval.
Reduce your pace to a slow recovery stride for the rest interval.
Continue alternating between work and rest intervals for the desired duration.
description_en: Elliptical HIIT is a low-impact cardio machine workout targeting the quadriceps and full body. Alternating between high-intensity and recovery intervals maximizes caloric expenditure and cardiovascular conditioning with minimal joint stress.
instructions_zh: 踏上椭圆机并握住活动手柄。
设置适合间歇训练的高阻力档位。
在工作区间内以最大努力推拉手柄并驱动踏板。
在休息区间内降低速度，进行缓慢恢复性踩踏。
按目标时长持续交替进行工作和休息区间。

instructions_en: Step onto the elliptical machine and grip the handles firmly.
Begin pedaling in a smooth, elliptical motion, pushing and pulling the handles in coordination with your legs.
Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean and keep your core engaged.
Adjust the resistance and incline as needed to reach your desired intensity.
Continue for the desired duration, maintaining a consistent pace.
description_en: The elliptical trainer is a low-impact cardio machine exercise that targets the cardiovascular system. It simulates running and stair climbing while minimizing joint stress, making it suitable for endurance training and active recovery.
instructions_zh: 踏上椭圆机并握紧手柄。
开始以平滑的椭圆轨迹踩踏，双腿协调地推拉手柄。
保持身体直立、略微前倾，并收紧核心。
根据需要调整阻力和坡度以达到目标强度。
按目标时长持续进行，保持稳定节奏。

instructions_en: Sit on an exercise ball and walk your feet forward until your upper back is resting on the ball.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest level with your feet flat on the ground.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, maintaining your hips in a raised bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise ball chest press is performed on an unstable surface to increase core activation alongside traditional chest pressing. It targets the pectorals while requiring the abs and lower back to stabilize the body, making it an effective functional strength exercise.
instructions_zh: 坐在健身球上，双脚向前走，直到上背部靠在球上。
双手各持一只哑铃置于胸部高度，双脚平放在地面。
将哑铃向上推起，直到手臂完全伸直。
缓慢将哑铃下放回起始位置，保持髋部处于抬起的桥式位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: exercise ball dumbbell press glute bridge
instructions_en: Sit on an exercise ball and walk forward until your upper back rests on the ball.
Raise your hips into a glute bridge position and hold a dumbbell in each hand at chest height.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Maintain the glute bridge throughout the entire set.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise ball dumbbell press glute bridge combines a chest press with an isometric glute bridge on an exercise ball. It targets the pectorals and glutes simultaneously while also engaging the hamstrings and core for overall body stability and strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在健身球上，向前走，直到上背部靠在球上。
将髋部抬起至臀桥位置，双手各持一只哑铃置于胸部高度。
将哑铃向上推起，直到手臂完全伸直。
缓慢将哑铃下放回起始位置。
整个组次中保持臀桥姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place your feet on an exercise ball and your hands on the ground in a push-up position.
Walk your hands back toward the ball so your upper body is at an incline angle.
Lower your chest toward the ground by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position while keeping your core tight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise ball incline chest press uses the instability of an exercise ball to create an incline push-up angle that targets the upper pectorals. It also engages the core for balance and challenges the front delts and triceps as secondary muscles.
instructions_zh: 将双脚放在健身球上，双手撑地呈俯卧撑姿势。
双手向球的方向后移，使上半身呈倾斜角度。
屈肘将胸部向地面下放。
保持核心收紧，推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down with your hips on an exercise ball and your feet anchored against a wall or floor.
Place your hands behind your head or extend your arms in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, lift your upper body and extend your back until your body is in a straight line.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise ball reverse superman targets the lower back and posterior chain by performing a back extension over an exercise ball. The unstable surface increases core activation, while the exercise primarily develops lower back strength and spinal erector endurance.
instructions_zh: 俯卧，将髋部置于健身球上，双脚抵住墙壁或地面固定。
双手置于脑后或向前伸直。
保持核心收紧，抬起上半身并伸展背部，直至身体呈一条直线。
在顶端保持片刻，然后缓慢回到起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides and an exercise ball held between your feet.
Lift your legs to a 90-degree angle, squeezing the ball between your feet.
Slowly lower your legs to one side toward the ground, rotating at the hips.
Return to the center and lower to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise ball windmill is a rotational core exercise that targets the obliques by lowering the legs side to side while holding an exercise ball. The added weight and instability increase the demand on the obliques, lower back, and deep core stabilizers.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双臂向两侧伸展，双脚之间夹住健身球。
将双腿抬至90度，双脚夹紧健身球。
以髋部为轴旋转，缓慢将双腿向一侧下放至接近地面。
回到中间位置，再向另一侧下放。
继续交替两侧，按所需次数重复。

name_en: exercise oblique rotation exercise ball kettlebell
instructions_en: Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the ground and hold a kettlebell with both hands at chest height.
Lean back slightly to engage your core and maintain a stable position on the ball.
Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the kettlebell toward your hip.
Return to center and rotate to the other side in a controlled manner.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The exercise oblique rotation with exercise ball and kettlebell is a seated rotational exercise that targets the obliques and core. Performed on an unstable ball with a kettlebell for resistance, it develops rotational strength and spinal stability simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 坐在健身球上，双脚平放地面，双手在胸前握住壶铃。
身体稍向后倾以收紧核心，在球上保持稳定。
将躯干向一侧旋转，使壶铃靠近髋部。
回到中间位置，再以受控的方式向另一侧旋转。
继续交替两侧，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your right foot out 90 degrees, aligning your right heel with your left arch.
Bend your right knee to a 90-degree angle, keeping it directly over your ankle.
Lower your right forearm to rest on your right thigh or place your right hand on the mat beside your right foot.
Extend your left arm overhead with the palm facing down, forming a long diagonal line from left heel to left fingertips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then press through your right heel to return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Extended side angle is a standing yoga posture that targets the hip flexors and obliques while stretching the entire side body. It involves a wide-legged stance with one knee bent and the torso extending laterally, promoting hip opening and lateral body flexibility.
instructions_zh: 双脚大幅分开站立，右脚向外转90度，使右脚跟与左脚足弓对齐。
右膝弯曲至90度，保持膝盖正对脚踝上方。
将右前臂放低置于右大腿上，或右手放在右脚旁的垫子上。
左臂向上伸展，掌心向下，从左脚跟到左手指尖形成一条长斜线。
保持20-30秒，然后通过右脚跟发力回到站立，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend one knee and rotate it outward, placing the sole of the foot against the inner thigh of the extended leg.
Sit tall and gently press the bent knee toward the floor.
Hold for 20–30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side.
description_en: The external thigh out seated floor is a seated bodyweight exercise targeting the adductors and hip external rotators. By rotating one bent knee outward and pressing it toward the floor, the inner thigh and deep hip muscles are gently stretched.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲一侧膝盖并向外旋转，将脚底贴在伸直腿的大腿内侧。
坐直，轻轻将弯曲的膝盖压向地面。
换另一侧重复。

name_en: external thigh out- seated floor version i
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both knees bent and feet flat.
Allow one knee to fall outward to the floor while keeping the other upright.
Gently press the dropped knee further toward the floor with your hand.
Hold for 20–30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
description_en: External thigh out seated floor version I is a variation of the seated external thigh stretch with both knees bent and one knee allowed to fall outward. The hand pressure deepens the adductor and hip rotator stretch in this seated position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双膝弯曲，双脚平放。
让一侧膝盖向外倒向地面，另一侧保持直立。
用手轻轻将倒下的膝盖进一步压向地面。
换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit comfortably with your back straight and face relaxed.
Place the tips of your index fingers on the inner corners of your eyebrows.
Apply gentle circular pressure, moving along the brow bone toward the outer corners of the eyes.
Continue the circular massage under the eyes along the lower orbital bone back toward the nose.
Repeat the full circuit for 30–60 seconds.
description_en: The eye socket massage is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the muscles and tissue around the eye area. It involves applying gentle circular pressure along the orbital bone to relieve tension and improve circulation around the eyes.
instructions_zh: 舒适坐好，背部挺直，面部放松。
将食指指尖放在眉毛内侧。
以轻柔的圆周压力沿眉骨向外眼角方向移动。
继续在眼睛下方沿眶下骨向鼻子的方向做圆周按摩。
重复整个循环30-60秒。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the ez bar at the inner angled grips with a supinated grip.
Let the bar hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ez bar biceps curl is a classic upper arm exercise that targets the biceps using an angled bar to reduce wrist and elbow strain. The ergonomic grip allows for a more comfortable curl pattern while maintaining effective bicep activation.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以反握握住EZ杆内侧的斜握位。
让杆以手臂长度垂在大腿前方。
保持肘部不动，将杆向上弯举至肩部。
在动作顶端停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将杆放回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding an ez bar with a shoulder-width semi-supinated grip.
Allow the bar to hang at arm's length in front of your hips.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Pause at the top, contracting your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the fully extended position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The ez bar curl is a biceps exercise using the angled ez bar for a neutral wrist-friendly grip. It builds bicep mass and strength while reducing stress on the wrists compared to a straight barbell curl.
instructions_zh: 直立，双手以肩宽半旋前握距握住曲杆。
让曲杆在髋部前方自然下垂，手臂伸直。
保持肘部贴近躯干，将曲杆弯举向肩部。
在顶端停顿，收缩肱二头肌。
缓慢将曲杆下放回完全伸直的位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Lower into a slight squat position and begin rapidly shuffling your feet in place.
Keep your steps short and quick, staying on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet to maintain speed and coordination.
Continue for the desired duration at maximum speed.
description_en: The fast feet run is a high-intensity cardio drill that involves rapid, short steps in place to elevate the heart rate and improve foot speed. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system while engaging the upper and lower leg muscles throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，膝盖微屈。
下蹲至轻微屈膝姿势，开始原地快速碎步跑。
保持步幅短而快，以前脚掌着地。
双臂与双脚节奏一致摆动，保持速度和协调。
以最大速度持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Stand in a low athletic stance with your knees slightly bent, feet hip-width apart, and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Lower your hips slightly as if in a quarter squat, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Begin rapidly alternating your feet in short, quick steps while maintaining the low stance.
Pump your arms quickly to drive the pace of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration, keeping the tempo as fast as possible throughout.
description_en: Fast feet sprint in low stance is a bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the hamstrings, glutes, and lower legs. It involves rapid foot shuffles from a low athletic position to develop speed, agility, and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_zh: 以低位运动姿势站立，膝盖微屈，双脚与髋同宽，重心在前脚掌。
髋部略微下沉如四分之一蹲，保持胸部抬起、背部挺直。
保持低位姿势，开始双脚快速短促交替踏步。
快速摆臂带动双脚节奏。
持续目标时间，全程保持尽可能快的节奏。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hands raised in a guard position near your face.
Rapidly alternate punching forward with each hand, rotating your wrists so palms face down at extension.
Keep your core tight and shoulders relaxed as you maintain a fast punching pace.
Breathe rhythmically and stay light on your feet.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions or time.
description_en: Fast Punches is a bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the triceps and shoulders. This shadow boxing variation involves rapidly alternating punches to elevate heart rate, improve upper body endurance, and develop punching speed and coordination.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手抬至脸旁防守位置。
双手快速交替向前出拳，出拳时旋转手腕使掌心朝下。
保持核心收紧、肩部放松，维持快速出拳节奏。
有节奏地呼吸，脚步保持轻盈。
按目标次数或时间持续进行。

instructions_en: Stand in a boxing stance with your hands raised and knees slightly bent.
Begin rapidly alternating punches while simultaneously moving your feet, stepping forward, backward, and laterally.
Incorporate combinations of jabs, crosses, and hooks at maximum speed.
Engage your core and rotate your hips into each punch.
Continue for the desired duration or number of rounds.
description_en: Fast Punches Advanced is an advanced bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the triceps and shoulders. This shadow boxing variation adds footwork and combination punching to the standard fast punches, increasing cardiovascular demand and full-body coordination.
instructions_zh: 以拳击站姿站立，双手抬起，膝盖微屈。
开始快速交替出拳，同时移动脚步，向前、向后和侧向踏步。
以最大速度组合刺拳、直拳和勾拳。
收紧核心，每次出拳时旋转髋部。
持续目标时间或回合数。

instructions_en: Begin in a standard push-up position but support your weight on your fingertips instead of your palms.
Spread your fingers wide for maximum stability.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The fingers push-up is an advanced bodyweight variation of the standard push-up that shifts weight onto the fingertips. This modification dramatically increases forearm and grip strength demands while maintaining the chest and triceps activation of a standard push-up.
instructions_zh: 从标准俯卧撑姿势开始，但用指尖而非手掌支撑体重。
手指尽量张开以获得最大稳定性。
弯曲肘部，将胸部下放至地面。
在底部停顿，然后推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keep your right knee bent at 90 degrees and lift it out to the side.
Raise your knee as high as your hip level while keeping your back flat.
Pause at the top, squeezing your outer glute.
Slowly lower your knee back to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: The fire hydrant is a bodyweight glute exercise performed on all fours that targets the glute medius and outer glutes through a lateral hip abduction movement. It is widely used for glute activation, hip mobility, and rehabilitation purposes.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部正下方，膝盖位于髋部正下方。
保持右膝弯曲90度，向侧方抬起。
将膝盖抬至与髋部同高，保持背部平直。
在顶端停顿，收缩臀外侧。
缓慢将膝盖放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换边。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side as high as comfortable.
Pause at the top and squeeze the glute of the raised leg.
Lower the leg back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching to the other leg.
description_en: The fire hydrant is a bodyweight glute exercise performed on all fours that targets the glute medius through a lateral leg raise. The movement improves hip abductor strength, hip joint mobility, and pelvic stability, and is commonly used in warm-up and rehabilitation routines.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩部正下方，膝盖位于髋部正下方。
保持膝盖弯曲90度，将一条腿向侧方抬至舒适的最高位置。
在顶端停顿，收缩抬起腿的臀肌。
控制动作将腿放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复后换另一条腿。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours with a neutral spine and core engaged.
Lift one bent leg out to the side in the fire hydrant position.
From the raised position, extend the leg straight outward.
Return the leg to the bent raised position, then lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching sides.
description_en: Fire hydrate 1 is a bodyweight glute and hip abductor exercise that combines the fire hydrant with a leg extension at the top. This addition engages the glutes and hamstrings through a greater range of motion, increasing the difficulty and muscle activation compared to the standard fire hydrant.
instructions_zh: 四点跪姿开始，保持脊柱中立，核心收紧。
将一条屈膝腿向侧方抬起，呈消防栓姿势。
从抬起位置将腿向外伸直。
将腿收回屈膝抬起位置，再放回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换边重复。

instructions_en: Squat with feet slightly wider than hip-width, then slide your upper arms behind your calves as low as possible.
Plant your palms flat on the floor slightly behind your heels.
Lean your weight forward onto your hands and begin to straighten your legs out to the sides.
Lift your hips to approximately arm height and extend both legs straight, parallel to the floor.
Hold the position for 10-20 seconds, engaging your core and keeping your gaze forward, then lower with control.
description_en: Firefly pose is an advanced arm balance that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors while demanding significant upper body strength. It involves balancing on the hands with the legs extended horizontally to the sides, requiring core engagement and tricep stability.
instructions_zh: 下蹲，双脚略宽于髋部，将上臂尽量低地滑入小腿后方。
手掌平放于地面，位于脚跟稍后方。
重心前移至双手，开始将双腿向两侧伸直。
抬起髋部至约手臂高度，双腿伸直并与地面平行。
保持10-20秒，核心收紧，目视前方，然后有控制地放下。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine straight.
Suck your cheeks inward and purse your lips to create a fish-like expression.
Try to smile while maintaining the sucked-in cheek position.
Hold the expression for 5 seconds, feeling the tension in your cheek muscles.
Relax and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The fish face is a bodyweight facial exercise that targets the cheek and lip muscles. It involves sucking the cheeks inward while smiling to tone and strengthen the mid-face region.
instructions_zh: 坐姿或站姿，保持脊柱挺直。
将脸颊向内吸，嘴唇收拢，做出鱼脸表情。
保持吸颊姿势的同时尝试微笑。
保持表情5秒，感受面颊肌肉的紧张感。
放松，恢复自然表情。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms by your sides.
Slide your hands under your glutes with palms facing down.
Press your forearms and elbows into the mat and lift your chest toward the ceiling, arching your upper back.
Gently tilt your head back and lower the crown of your head lightly to the floor.
Hold the pose for 20-30 seconds, then lift your head, release your hands, and lower your back to the mat.
description_en: Fish pose is a supine backbend yoga posture that targets the lower back and opens the chest and throat. It involves arching the upper back and placing the crown of the head on the floor, promoting thoracic spine extension and chest flexibility.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放于身体两侧。
双手滑入臀部下方，掌心朝下。
前臂和肘部压向垫面，将胸部抬向天花板，上背部拱起。
轻轻后仰头部，将头顶轻放于地面。
保持20-30秒，然后抬起头，松开双手，将背部放回垫面。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest height with palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to chest level, elbows flaring slightly outward.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The flat dumbbell bench press is a foundational chest exercise targeting the pectorals through a horizontal pressing motion. Dumbbells allow for a greater range of motion than a barbell and require independent stabilization of each arm, improving muscular balance.
instructions_zh: 平躺于长凳上，双手各持哑铃于胸部高度，掌心朝前。
将哑铃向上推起，直至双臂在胸部上方完全伸直。
缓慢将哑铃降回胸部高度，肘部略微向外展开。
在底部稍作停顿，然后再次推起。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Lift both legs off the ground approximately six inches and engage your core.
Alternately raise and lower each leg in a small, rapid flutter kick motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your core braced throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: The flutter kick is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors. Performing rapid alternating leg kicks while hovering above the ground challenges core stability and endurance.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放于下背部下方支撑。
将双腿抬离地面约六英寸，核心收紧。
双腿交替上下做小而快速的扑动踢腿动作。
整个动作过程中保持下背部下压，核心绷紧。
持续目标时间或次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, engaging your core.
Alternately raise and lower each leg in a small, controlled fluttering motion.
Keep your lower back pressed toward the floor throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: The flutter kick is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors through continuous alternating leg movements. Performed lying on the back, it builds lower abdominal endurance and overall core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放于下背部下方支撑。
将双腿抬离地面几英寸，核心收紧。
双腿交替上下做小而受控的扑动动作。
整个动作过程中保持下背部压向地面。
持续目标时间或次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands under your glutes for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor and brace your core.
Alternate raising and lowering each leg in small, rapid kicks.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: Flutter kicks are a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. The rapid alternating leg movement in a supine position creates sustained core tension, making it effective for lower ab endurance.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放于臀部下方支撑。
将双腿抬离地面几英寸，核心绷紧。
双腿交替上下做小而快速的踢腿动作。
整个动作过程中保持下背部压向地面。
持续目标时间或次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right ankle over your left thigh just above the knee.
Flex your right foot to protect the knee joint.
Hinge forward from the hips, folding your torso over both legs until you feel a deep stretch in your right glute.
Hold the stretch for 30-60 seconds, breathing deeply into the hip, then slowly return to seated and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Fold piriformis relief is a seated forward fold variation that targets the glutes and piriformis muscle to release deep hip tension. It combines a figure-four position with a forward fold, intensifying the external hip rotation stretch compared to the supine version.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲右膝，将右脚踝交叉放在左大腿膝盖上方。
勾起右脚以保护膝关节。
从髋部向前折叠，躯干压向双腿，直到右侧臀部感到深度拉伸。
保持拉伸30-60秒，深呼吸感受髋部，然后缓慢回到坐姿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your hips backward while keeping your back flat and chest lifted.
Lower your torso until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, then allow your torso to round gently into a full forward fold.
Hold the folded position for 2-3 seconds, then re-engage your core and hinge back up to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Fold with hinge is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes and lower back. It combines a controlled hip hinge with a forward fold to dynamically stretch the posterior chain and improve hip mobility.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，膝盖微屈。
从髋部向前折叠，臀部向后推，保持背部平直、胸部抬起。
降低躯干直到腘绳肌感到深度拉伸，然后让躯干自然弯曲进入完全前屈。
保持折叠姿势2-3秒，然后收紧核心，从髋部回到站立。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor or a chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Place a small rolled towel or ball under the arch of one foot.
Squeeze your foot downward to grip the object with your arch.
Hold the contraction for 3–5 seconds, then release.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching feet.
description_en: The foot arch squeeze is a rehabilitation and mobility exercise targeting the intrinsic muscles of the foot and the calf. Squeezing the arch activates the plantar foot muscles and calves, helping to strengthen the foot arch and prevent or address flat foot-related issues.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板或椅子上，双脚平放在地面。
将一小块卷起的毛巾或小球放在一只脚的足弓下方。
足弓向下挤压，抓住物体。
保持收缩3-5秒，然后放松。
按目标次数重复后换脚。

instructions_en: Stand or sit with one foot crossed over the opposite knee.
Gently pull your toes back toward your shin with your hand.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, feeling it along the bottom of your foot and calf.
Release and repeat on the other foot.
Perform for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The foot arch stretch is a gentle bodyweight stretch targeting the plantar fascia, calves, and ankle stabilizers. Pulling the toes back toward the shin elongates the arch of the foot and the calf muscles, helping to relieve foot tension and improve ankle flexibility.
instructions_zh: 站立或坐着，将一只脚交叉放在对侧膝盖上。
用手轻轻将脚趾向小腿方向拉回。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受脚底和小腿的拉伸。
放松后换另一只脚重复。
每侧按目标次数进行。
