description_en: The kettlebell pullover to glute raise combines a lat-focused pullover with a glute bridge to target both the upper back and posterior chain in a single floor exercise. It develops lat flexibility and strength while also building glute and hamstring power.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝双脚踩地，双手持壶铃置于胸部上方。
以拉举动作将壶铃向头后方下放，感受背阔肌拉伸。
将壶铃回到胸部上方，同时将髋部抬离地面做臀桥。
将髋部放回地面，然后重复拉举动作。
持续至目标次数。

name_en: kettlebell reverse lunge alternating between leg
instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower your back knee toward the ground in a reverse lunge.
Keep your front knee directly over your ankle and your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kettlebell reverse lunge alternating between legs is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes. Alternating legs with each rep challenges balance and coordination while building single-leg strength with the added resistance of kettlebells.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只壶铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向后迈步，后膝下沉做后弓步。
前膝保持对准脚踝上方，躯干保持直立。
前脚发力回到起始位置。
换另一条腿交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot directly back and lower your hips until both knees are at approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee aligned over your front ankle and your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to the standing position.
Repeat on the opposite leg, alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Kettlebell reverse lunges are a kettlebell unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. The added kettlebell load increases overall demand on the legs and core, while the reverse step reduces anterior knee stress compared to a forward lunge.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只壶铃垂于体侧。
一只脚正后方迈步，下沉髋部至双膝约呈90度。
前膝保持对准前脚踝上方，躯干保持直立。
前脚发力推回站立位置。
换对侧腿交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell at chest level with both hands.
Engage your core and perform a full sit-up, rising to an upright seated position.
At the top of the sit-up, press the kettlebell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the kettlebell back to your chest and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Kettlebell sit-ups to press is a compound exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, combining a full sit-up with an overhead press. This movement engages the core, hip flexors, and shoulders, providing both strength and conditioning benefits.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝双脚踩地，双手将壶铃持于胸前。
收紧核心完成完整仰卧起坐，起身至坐姿。
在仰卧起坐顶部将壶铃向上推举至手臂完全伸直。
将壶铃放回胸前，缓慢回到起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

name_zh: 壶铃分腿站姿直腿硬拉
instructions_en: Stand in a staggered stance with one foot slightly ahead of the other, holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Keeping most of your weight on the front foot, hinge at the hips and lower the kettlebells toward the ground.
Keep your back flat and a slight bend in the front knee throughout.
Drive through the front heel to return to the starting position, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching the staggered stance.
description_en: The kettlebell staggered stance stiff deadlift targets the hamstrings and glutes with a unilateral emphasis by splitting the stance to shift the load to the front leg. It builds posterior chain strength, improves hip hinge mechanics, and challenges core stability.
name_zh_llm: 壶铃分腿站姿直腿硬拉
instructions_zh: 前后错步站立，一只脚略在前，双手各持一只壶铃。
重心主要放在前脚，屈髋将壶铃向地面下放。
全程保持背部平直，前膝微屈。
前脚跟发力回到起始位置，顶部收紧臀部。
一侧完成全部次数后换错步方向。

instructions_en: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at the hips to grip the kettlebell with both hands and hike it back between your legs.
Explosively drive your hips forward to propel the kettlebell upward to chest or shoulder height.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down and hike it back between your legs, hinging at the hips.
Repeat the swing in a fluid, continuous motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kettlebell swing is a dynamic hip hinge exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings. The explosive hip extension develops posterior chain power and conditioning, making it one of the most effective full-body conditioning movements.
instructions_zh: 双脚略宽于肩站立，壶铃放在身前地面上。
屈髋俯身，双手握住壶铃，将其向后甩至双腿之间。
爆发力向前顶髋，将壶铃向上摆至胸部或肩部高度。
让壶铃自然下摆，再次屈髋将其甩回双腿之间。
以流畅连续的动作重复摆动至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a kettlebell at your chest in a goblet grip.
Step one foot out wide and lower into a lateral squat by shifting your weight over that foot.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat on the ground.
Drive through the squatting leg to return to standing, then bring your feet together.
Repeat the lateral squat to the same side for the desired reps, then switch sides.
description_en: The kettlebell walking lateral squat is a lateral lower body exercise that targets the quads and glutes while emphasizing the hip abductors and inner thighs. It improves frontal plane movement, lateral strength, and mobility in the hips and ankles.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手以高脚杯握法将壶铃抱于胸前。
一只脚向侧方大步迈出，重心移至该脚，下蹲成侧弓步。
另一条腿保持伸直，双脚全程踩实地面。
通过下蹲腿发力站起，然后将双脚并拢。
向同一侧重复侧弓步至目标次数，然后换边。

instructions_en: Stand in a fighting stance with one foot slightly forward and hands raised to guard position.
Throw a series of punches including jabs, crosses, hooks, and uppercuts.
Alternate with front kicks, side kicks, and roundhouse kicks.
Maintain footwork and movement throughout the combination.
Continue for rounds of the desired duration.
description_en: Kickboxing is a high-intensity cardio workout that combines boxing punches and martial arts kicks. It develops cardiovascular fitness, coordination, agility, and total body conditioning through fast-paced offensive and defensive combinations.
instructions_zh: 以格斗站姿站立，一只脚稍向前，双手抬起至防守位置。
打出一系列拳法，包括刺拳、直拳、勾拳和上勾拳。
交替进行前踢、侧踢和回旋踢。
整个组合动作中保持步法和移动。
持续进行至目标时长的回合。

instructions_en: Begin in pigeon pose with your right shin forward and left leg extended back.
Bend your left knee and reach your left hand back to grasp your left foot.
Raise your right arm overhead and reach it back to clasp your left foot as well.
Open your chest to the ceiling and gently deepen the backbend by pressing your foot toward your head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release the foot carefully and repeat on the other side.
description_en: King pigeon pose is an advanced yoga backbend that targets the lower back and opens the chest and hip flexors simultaneously. It involves a deep spinal extension combined with hip opening, requiring considerable flexibility in the spine, shoulders, and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 从鸽子式开始，右小腿向前，左腿向后伸展。
弯曲左膝，左手向后伸抓住左脚。
右臂举过头顶，也向后伸抓住左脚。
胸口向上打开，脚向头部方向轻压，缓慢加深后弯。
保持20-30秒，然后小心松开脚，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands behind your head.
Lift your right knee toward your chest while simultaneously crunching your left elbow toward the rising knee.
Lower your leg and return to the upright position.
Repeat on the opposite side, lifting your left knee and crunching your right elbow toward it.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The knee lift crunch is a standing bodyweight exercise that targets the abs and obliques. Alternating knee lifts combined with rotational crunches create a dynamic core movement that also engages the hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双脚与髋同宽，双手放在脑后。
右膝抬向胸口，同时左肘向抬起的膝盖方向卷腹。
放下腿，回到直立位置。
换对侧重复，抬起左膝，右肘向其卷腹。
继续交替两侧至目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin on all fours and lower your forearms to the floor or keep your arms extended.
Lower your knees to the floor and align your body from knees to shoulders in a straight line.
Engage your core and avoid letting your hips sag.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Rest and repeat as needed.
description_en: Knee Plank Hold is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. The knee variation reduces load compared to a full plank, making it an effective entry point for building core endurance and learning proper plank alignment.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，前臂放至地面或保持手臂伸直。
膝盖落地，身体从膝盖到肩膀保持一条直线。
收紧核心，避免髋部下沉。
保持该姿势至目标时长，同时稳定呼吸。
休息后按需重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width in front of you.
Lower your knees to the floor and maintain a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press through your palms to push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Knee Push Up is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectorals. Performing the push-up from the knees reduces the load, making it ideal for beginners developing chest, tricep, and shoulder pushing strength.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手放在身前，略宽于肩。
膝盖落地，保持从膝盖到肩膀一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸口向地面下放。
通过手掌发力推回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your hips so your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Knee push-ups are a beginner bodyweight exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. By supporting the body on the knees rather than the toes, the movement reduces difficulty and allows those building upper body strength to practice proper push-up mechanics.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，双手略宽于肩放置。
放下髋部，使身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将胸口向地面下放。
推回起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms by your sides.
Exhale and draw both knees toward your chest, wrapping your arms around your shins.
Gently hug your knees in and rock lightly side to side to massage the lower back.
Keep your head flat on the mat and your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the position for 30-60 seconds, then slowly release your legs back to the mat.
description_en: Knee to chest pose is a gentle restorative yoga posture that targets the lower back and hip flexors through a supine compression stretch. It involves drawing both knees to the chest while lying on the back, releasing tension in the lumbar spine and glutes.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。
呼气，双膝拉向胸部，双臂环抱小腿。
轻轻抱住膝盖，左右轻摇以按摩下背部。
头部保持贴垫，双肩放松。
保持30-60秒，然后慢慢将双腿放回垫上。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Swing your arms down and bend your knees to prepare for the jump.
Explosively jump upward, driving both knees toward your chest at the peak of the jump.
Quickly extend your legs to land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Immediately transition into the next repetition and continue for the desired number of jumps.
description_en: The knee tuck jump is a plyometric cardio exercise that combines an explosive vertical jump with a double knee tuck at the peak. It develops lower body power, cardiovascular endurance, and core control while engaging the hip flexors and leg muscles dynamically.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，膝盖微屈。
双臂下摆，屈膝为跳跃做准备。
爆发性向上跳起，在最高点将双膝拉向胸部。
迅速伸腿，以前脚掌轻柔落地，膝盖微屈。
立即衔接下一次重复，按目标次数继续跳跃。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat and drive back up to standing.
At the top of the movement, drive one knee upward toward your chest.
Lower the leg and immediately descend into the next squat.
Alternate the knee tuck each repetition for the desired count.
description_en: The knee tuck squat combines a standard bodyweight squat with an alternating knee tuck at the top of each repetition. The knee drive engages the hip flexors and abs at the peak while the squat builds lower body strength, creating a combined leg and core exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立。
下蹲后发力站起。
在动作顶端将一侧膝盖拉向胸部。
放下腿，立即进入下一次深蹲。
每次重复交替提膝，按目标次数完成。

instructions_en: Kneel on both knees on a mat with your hips stacked over your knees.
Hold a medicine ball or slam ball with both hands overhead.
Engage your core and forcefully slam the ball straight down in front of you.
Retrieve the ball and raise it back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kneeling ball slam is an upper body power exercise performed from a kneeling position, removing lower body involvement to isolate the shoulders, core, and lats. It develops explosive pressing strength and core stability with each slam.
instructions_zh: 双膝跪在垫上，髋部位于膝盖正上方。
双手将药球或砸球举过头顶。
收紧核心，用力将球向正前方地面砸下。
取回球并重新举过头顶。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope behind your neck with both hands and position your hips back over your heels.
Engage your core and crunch downward, bringing your elbows toward the floor.
Pause at the fully contracted position, isolating the abs.
Slowly return to the upright starting position while maintaining tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kneeling cable crunch with a rope attachment behind the neck is a weighted abdominal exercise that provides constant resistance throughout the movement. It targets the abs through a loaded flexion pattern, helping to develop strength and muscle definition in the core.
instructions_zh: 将绳索连接至绳索器械高位滑轮，面朝器械跪姿。
双手将绳索置于颈后，髋部后坐至脚跟上方。
收紧核心向下卷腹，将肘部拉向地面。
在完全收缩位置停顿，集中刺激腹肌。
保持绳索张力，缓慢回到直立起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: kneeling hammer curl to hammer shoulder press
name_zh: 跪姿锤式弯举接锤式肩推
instructions_en: Kneel on both knees with a dumbbell in each hand using a neutral grip, arms extended at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up to shoulder height in a hammer curl motion.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height, then lower to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kneeling hammer curl to hammer shoulder press is a compound arm and shoulder exercise that eliminates lower body momentum by removing the option to stand. It targets the biceps through the curl and the shoulders through the press, with core engagement required throughout.
name_zh_llm: 跪姿锤式弯举接锤式肩推
instructions_zh: 双膝跪地，双手各持哑铃，采用中立握法，双臂垂于体侧。
以锤式弯举动作将哑铃弯举至肩高。
将哑铃推举过头顶直至双臂完全伸直。
将哑铃放回肩高，再降至起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on both knees holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands.
Begin passing the kettlebell around your body in a circular motion, transferring it from hand to hand.
Keep your core braced and avoid rotating your torso as the kettlebell moves.
Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Maintain upright posture throughout the movement.
description_en: The kneeling kettlebell around the world is a shoulder and core stability exercise that involves circling a kettlebell around the body while kneeling. It targets the deltoids and challenges the core to resist rotation with each pass, developing shoulder endurance and stability.
instructions_zh: 双膝跪地，双手握住壶铃把手。
开始将壶铃绕身体做圆周运动，双手交替传递。
保持核心收紧，壶铃移动时避免躯干旋转。
向一个方向完成目标圈数后反向进行。
整个动作过程中保持身体直立。

instructions_en: Kneel in front of a landmine apparatus holding the barbell end with both hands at chest height.
Brace your core and rotate your torso to one side, lowering the bar toward the ground.
Return to the center and rotate to the opposite side in a controlled arc.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
Keep your hips square and only rotate through the thoracic spine and shoulders.
description_en: The kneeling landmine oblique twist is a rotational core exercise that uses the arc of the landmine bar to challenge the obliques through a full range of motion. Performing the exercise kneeling eliminates lower body compensation and increases core activation.
instructions_zh: 跪在地雷管器械前，双手在胸高处握住杠铃端。
收紧核心，将躯干转向一侧，将杠铃端向地面降低。
回到中间，以受控弧线转向对侧。
继续交替两侧，按目标次数完成。
保持髋部正对前方，仅通过胸椎和肩部旋转。

instructions_en: Kneel on one knee and anchor a resistance band beneath the planted knee.
Hold the other end of the band with both hands and raise your arms overhead.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, bend your elbows to lower your hands behind your head.
Extend your arms fully overhead to return to the starting position, squeezing your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kneeling overhead tricep extension with a resistance band targets the triceps brachii in the fully stretched position. Kneeling provides a stable base while anchoring the band beneath the knee, allowing for effective overhead tricep loading without equipment.
name_zh_llm: 跪姿弹力带颈后臂屈伸
instructions_zh: 单膝跪地，将阻力带固定在着地膝盖下方。
双手握住阻力带另一端，将手臂举过头顶。
保持上臂不动，弯曲肘部将双手降至头后。
完全伸直手臂举过头顶回到起始位置，收紧三头肌。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on both knees on a mat with your body upright.
Slowly lean back by extending at the knee joint, lowering your torso toward the ground.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from head to knees.
Hold for a moment at the lowest comfortable point, then contract your quads to return to upright.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The kneeling quad extension is an advanced bodyweight exercise that eccentrically loads the quadriceps by leaning backward from a kneeling position. It builds significant quad strength and is used as a progression toward exercises requiring knee flexion control.
instructions_zh: 双膝跪在垫子上，身体保持直立。
通过伸展膝关节缓慢后仰，将躯干向地面降低。
保持髋部前推，身体从头到膝呈一条直线。
在舒适的最低点稍作停留，然后收缩股四头肌回到直立。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and place one hand on the floor beside you at shoulder height.
Lean your body toward the hand on the floor, bending that elbow to lower your shoulder.
Feel the stretch across the chest of the opposite side.
Slowly push back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: The kneeling side push-up stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the chest. Performed in a kneeling position, the lateral lean creates a unilateral chest and shoulder stretch while the push-up element adds mild strength engagement.
instructions_zh: 跪在地板上，将一只手放在身体旁与肩同高的位置。
身体向地板上的手倾斜，弯曲该肘部降低肩膀。
感受对侧胸部的拉伸。
缓慢推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复后换边。

name_en: kneeling single arm arnold shoulder press
instructions_en: Kneel on one knee with a dumbbell in the hand on the side of the raised knee.
Hold the dumbbell in front of your shoulder with your palm facing you and elbow bent.
Press the dumbbell upward while rotating your palm outward.
Fully extend your arm overhead with your palm facing forward.
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: The kneeling single arm arnold shoulder press is a unilateral shoulder exercise that incorporates the rotational movement of the arnold press to target all three deltoid heads. Performing it kneeling removes lower body stability and increases core engagement.
instructions_zh: 单膝跪地，哑铃握在抬起膝盖同侧的手中。
将哑铃握在肩前，掌心朝向自己，肘部弯曲。
向上推举哑铃的同时将掌心向外旋转。
手臂完全伸直举过头顶，掌心朝前。
反向动作回到起始位置。
一侧完成所有次数后换边。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position but make fists with both hands and place your knuckles on the floor, aligned under your shoulders.
Keep your wrists neutral and straight throughout the movement.
Lower your chest toward the floor in a controlled manner, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Knuckle push ups are a bodyweight exercise targeting the chest, with secondary engagement of the upper arms, shoulders, and lower arms. Performing push ups on the knuckles maintains neutral wrist alignment, reduces wrist strain, and increases the range of motion during the descent.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手握拳，将指关节撑在地面上，对齐肩膀下方。
整个动作过程中保持手腕中立伸直。
控制身体将胸部向地面降低，肘部与身体约呈45度角。
在底部稍作停顿，然后推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hands placed beside your hips.
Press through your hands to lift your hips off the floor into an L-sit position.
From the L-sit, reach one hand toward your toes while maintaining the lift.
Return the hand and lower your hips before repeating on the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The L-sit hip lift toe touch variation is a challenging bodyweight exercise combining an L-sit hold with an alternating toe touch. It targets the abs and hip flexors through the sustained L-sit while adding a dynamic reaching element that challenges balance and core stability.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿伸直，双手放在髋部两侧。
双手发力将髋部抬离地面进入L坐姿势。
从L坐姿势，一只手伸向脚尖，同时保持抬起。
收回手并降低髋部，然后换另一侧重复。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Place your hands flat on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms to lift your entire body off the floor, keeping your legs straight and parallel to the ground.
Hold the L-shape position for as long as possible, engaging your abs and keeping your back straight.
Slowly lower back down to the floor and rest before repeating.
description_en: The L-sit hold is an advanced bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the hip flexors, upper arms, and shoulders. It involves suspending the body off the floor in an L-shape by pressing through the hands, requiring tremendous core compression and upper body pressing strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿向前伸直。
双手平放在髋部两侧的地面上，手指朝前。
手掌发力将整个身体抬离地面，保持双腿伸直并与地面平行。
保持L形姿势尽可能长时间，收紧腹肌并保持背部挺直。
缓慢降回地面休息后重复。

name_en: l sit hold with leg bent close
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs bent and feet close to your hips.
Place your hands flat on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and engage your core to lift your hips and feet off the ground.
Hold the suspended position with your bent knees close to your chest.
Maintain the hold for the desired duration, keeping your arms straight.
description_en: The L sit hold with leg bent close is a bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. Lifting the hips and bent legs off the floor requires significant core and upper body strength to sustain the hold.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿弯曲，双脚靠近髋部。
双手平放在髋部两侧的地面上，手指朝前。
双手发力并收紧核心，将髋部和双脚抬离地面。
保持悬空姿势，弯曲的膝盖靠近胸部。
保持目标时长，手臂伸直。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you.
Place your hands beside your hips on the floor for support.
Sit tall and flex your feet, pulling your toes toward you.
Gently hinge forward from the hips to increase the hamstring stretch.
Hold for 30–60 seconds.
description_en: The L-sit leg on floor stretch is a seated hamstring and lower back flexibility exercise performed in the classic L-sit position with legs extended flat. Sitting upright with feet flexed and leaning forward gradually deepens the hamstring stretch through the posterior leg chain.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
双手放在臀部两侧的地面上支撑。
坐直并勾脚尖，将脚趾拉向自己。
从髋部轻轻前倾，加深腘绳肌拉伸。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
Simultaneously raise both straight legs and your torso toward each other.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top, forming an L or V shape.
Hold the peak position for a moment, then slowly lower both your legs and torso.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: L sit ups are a bodyweight abdominal exercise that involves simultaneously lifting the torso and straight legs to meet in the middle. This challenging movement maximizes rectus abdominis contraction and hip flexor strength.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂举过头顶。
同时抬起伸直的双眼和躯干，使两者相互靠近。
在顶端双手伸向双脚，形成L形或V形。
在最高点稍作停留，然后缓慢放下双腿和躯干。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Insert one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment and load the free end with plates.
Stand facing the loaded end with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grip the bar.
Brace your core, flatten your back, and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Hinge back at the hips to lower the bar with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine barbell deadlift is a hip hinge exercise performed with a barbell anchored in a landmine attachment. The angled bar path places a unique stimulus on the glutes and lower back while reducing shear forces on the spine compared to a conventional deadlift.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端插入地雷架附件，另一端加载杠铃片。
面向加载端站立，双脚与肩同宽，屈髋握杠。
收紧核心，保持背部平直，肩胛骨向下向后收。
脚跟发力站起，同时伸展髋部和膝盖。
屈髋控制下放杠铃，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place a barbell in a landmine sleeve and kneel in front of it with the bar end positioned at your hips.
Sit back on your heels in a tall kneeling position with the bar resting at hip level.
Drive your hips forward explosively, pressing the bar upward through hip extension.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine kneeling hip thrust is a glute-focused exercise that uses the landmine to add resistance to a hip thrust performed from a kneeling position. It isolates the glutes and hamstrings while reducing lower back strain compared to a standard hip thrust.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放入地雷架套筒，跪在杠铃前方，杠铃端位于髋部位置。
坐回脚跟呈高跪姿，杠铃置于髋部高度。
爆发性向前顶髋，通过髋伸将杠铃向上推。
在动作顶端收紧臀肌。
控制回到起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Secure one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment or wedge it into a corner.
Stand facing the barbell and grasp the free end with one hand at shoulder height.
Stagger your stance for balance and keep your core braced.
Press the barbell upward and forward in an arcing motion until your arm is fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position and repeat, then switch arms.
description_en: The single arm landmine press is a barbell exercise targeting the shoulders, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and chest. The angled pressing path of the landmine reduces shoulder joint stress while building unilateral pressing strength.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端固定在地雷架附件中或楔入墙角。
面向杠铃站立，单手在肩部高度握住自由端。
前后错步站立以保持平衡，收紧核心。
以弧形轨迹向上向前推杠铃，直至手臂完全伸直。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置并重复，然后换臂。

name_zh: 杠铃地雷管后撤弓步转体
instructions_en: Stand holding the end of a landmine barbell with both hands at chest height.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground.
At the bottom of the lunge, rotate your torso toward the front knee, bringing the bar to that side.
Return to center and drive through the front foot to stand.
Repeat on the other leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine reverse lunges twist combines a reverse lunge with a rotational core movement, targeting the quadriceps and glutes while adding oblique engagement. The landmine provides a guided arc for the twist, making it a functional movement for lower body and rotational strength.
name_zh_llm: 杠铃地雷管后撤弓步转体
instructions_zh: 站立，双手在胸部高度握住地雷杠铃末端。
一只脚向后迈步做后弓步，后膝向地面下降。
在弓步底部，躯干向前膝方向旋转，将杠铃带到该侧。
回到中间位置，前脚发力站起。
换另一腿重复，两侧交替按目标次数进行。

instructions_en: Place a barbell in a landmine sleeve and stand holding the end of the bar in front of you.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and use the bar for balance.
Lean back slightly and bend your knees, allowing your body to lower toward the ground.
Keep your hips forward and back straight as you descend.
Return to the starting position by contracting your quadriceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine sissy squat uses the landmine bar for balance assistance while targeting the quadriceps through a deep knee flexion squat pattern. It provides a controlled progression for developing quad strength and knee joint resilience.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃放入地雷架套筒，站立并在身前握住杠铃末端。
双脚与肩同宽站立，用杠铃辅助平衡。
身体稍向后仰并屈膝，使身体向地面下降。
下降时保持髋部向前、背部挺直。
收缩股四头肌回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine attachment and lie on the floor facing the free end.
Hold the sleeve of the barbell with both hands, arms extended toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and perform a full sit-up, keeping the bar raised overhead throughout.
At the top, press the barbell slightly forward before lowering back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine sit-up is a barbell core exercise targeting the abdominal muscles using a landmine attachment for resistance. Holding the barbell overhead during the sit-up adds load to the movement while also engaging the shoulders and demanding greater core stability.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端固定在地雷架附件中，面向自由端仰卧在地面上。
双手握住杠铃套筒，双臂伸向天花板。
收紧核心完成完整仰卧起坐，全程保持杠铃举过头顶。
在顶端将杠铃稍向前推，然后放回。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a barbell in a landmine sleeve and sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands and extend your arms forward at chest level.
Lower your torso toward the ground in a slow and controlled manner.
Return to the upright position by engaging your abs, pressing the bar forward.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Landmine sit ups are a core exercise that uses the resistance of a landmine barbell to increase difficulty during the sit-up movement. They target the abdominals with secondary engagement of the hip flexors and shoulders throughout the controlled lowering and rising phases.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端固定在地雷管套中，屈膝坐在地面上，双脚平放。
双手握住杠铃末端，双臂在胸前高度向前伸直。
以缓慢可控的方式将躯干向地面下放。
收紧腹肌，将杠铃向前推，回到直立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine attachment and hold the free end with both hands at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned outward.
Keeping your chest up and the bar at chest level, descend into a squat by bending your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine squat is a barbell squat variation targeting the quadriceps using a landmine attachment. The angled barbell promotes an upright torso and reduces spinal compression, making it a joint-friendly alternative to traditional barbell squats.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端固定在地雷附件中，双手在胸前高度握住自由端。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
保持胸部抬起、杠铃在胸前高度，屈膝下蹲。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
脚跟发力回到站立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding the end of a landmine barbell with both hands at chest height.
Perform a squat by lowering your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
As you drive upward from the squat, press the bar overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the bar back to chest height as you return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine squat to press is a compound exercise that combines a squat with an overhead press using a landmine barbell. It targets the quadriceps and glutes while developing shoulder strength and core stability throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 双手在胸前高度握住地雷杠铃末端站立。
下蹲，降低髋部直至大腿与地面平行。
从下蹲向上发力时，将杠铃推举过头顶直至双臂完全伸直。
回到站立位置时，将杠铃放回胸前高度。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a barbell in a landmine sleeve and stand facing away from the anchor with feet hip-width apart.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands behind you or from the side.
Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, lowering the bar toward the ground.
Keep your back flat and core engaged throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine stiff stance deadlift is a hip hinge exercise that uses the guided arc of a landmine barbell to target the hamstrings and posterior chain. The fixed range of motion makes it an accessible option for developing hip hinge mechanics and lower back strength.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃固定在地雷管套中，背对固定点站立，双脚与髋同宽。
双手在身后或体侧握住杠铃末端。
屈髋并略微屈膝，将杠铃向地面下放。
整个动作过程中保持背部平直、核心收紧。
脚跟发力回到站立，在顶部收紧臀肌。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Insert one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment and stand with the loaded end between your legs.
Grip the bar at hip height with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your chest up and core tight, lower into a squat by bending your knees and hips.
Drive through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The landmine V squat uses a barbell anchored in a landmine attachment to create a guided squat path. The angled bar encourages an upright torso and is particularly effective for targeting the quads while reducing lower back strain.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端插入地雷附件，站立时让负重端位于双腿之间。
双手在髋部高度握住杠铃，双脚与肩同宽。
保持胸部抬起、核心收紧，屈膝屈髋下蹲。
脚跟发力回到站立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and grip the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width apart.
Adjust the knee pad to secure your legs and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar downward towards your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-grip lat pulldown is a cable machine exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi. The wider grip increases lat stretch at the top and places greater emphasis on the outer back, helping to build a wider back appearance.
instructions_zh: 坐在高位下拉器上，以宽于肩的正握握住横杆。
调整膝垫固定双腿，身体略微后仰。
肘部向下向后发力，将横杆拉向上胸。
在动作底部收紧背阔肌。
缓慢让横杆回到起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit at a lat pulldown machine and adjust the thigh pad to secure your legs.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lat pulldown is a cable machine exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi and upper back. Pulling a weighted bar from overhead down toward the chest mimics the pulling pattern of a pull-up, making it effective for developing back width.
instructions_zh: 坐在高位下拉器上，调整大腿垫固定双腿。
以略宽于肩的正握握住横杆。
身体略微后仰，将横杆拉向上胸，肘部向髋部方向发力。
在动作底部收紧背阔肌。
缓慢可控地让横杆回到起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start in a bear hold position on all fours with knees hovering just above the ground.
Brace your core and move laterally by stepping your right hand and right foot out simultaneously.
Follow with your left hand and left foot to maintain your width.
Continue crawling sideways for the desired distance, then switch directions.
Keep your hips low and back flat throughout the movement.
description_en: The lateral bear crawl is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats and shoulder stabilizers through sideways movement in a hovering all-fours position. It develops coordination, core stability, and shoulder endurance.
instructions_zh: 从熊撑姿势开始，四点支撑，膝盖悬停在地面上方。
收紧核心，右手和右脚同时向外迈步侧向移动。
左手和左脚跟随，保持身体宽度。
继续侧向爬行至目标距离，然后换方向。
整个动作过程中保持髋部低、背部平直。

instructions_en: Stand beside a plyo box in a wide stance.
Place your hands on top of the box and jump your feet back into a plank position.
Perform a push-up, then jump your feet up and over the box to land on the other side.
Immediately place your hands on the box again and repeat the burpee in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lateral burpee box step over is a high-intensity conditioning exercise that combines a burpee with a lateral movement over a plyo box. It targets the quadriceps and glutes while also challenging chest, shoulder, and core strength through the push-up component.
instructions_zh: 站在跳箱旁，双脚宽距站立。
双手放在跳箱上，双脚向后跳成平板支撑姿势。
做一个俯卧撑，然后双脚跳起越过跳箱落到另一侧。
立即再次将双手放在跳箱上，向反方向重复波比跳。
继续左右交替，完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet together and hands on your hips.
Take a wide step out to your right side and bend your right knee as you lower your body.
Keep your left leg straight and your right knee tracking over your right foot.
Lower until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side and continue alternating for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The lateral lunge is a bodyweight lower body exercise targeting the quads through a sideways stepping and squatting motion. It also stretches the adductors and strengthens the glutes, making it effective for developing frontal plane movement and hip mobility.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，双手放在髋部。
向右侧迈出一大步，屈右膝下蹲。
保持左腿伸直，右膝对准右脚方向。
下蹲至右大腿与地面平行。
蹬右脚回到起始姿势。
在左侧重复，继续左右交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand on the platform of the lateral raise machine and position your upper arms against the pads.
Keep your chest up, core engaged, and maintain a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the pads outward by abducting your shoulders until your upper arms are approximately parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your lateral deltoids.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position under control and repeat.
description_en: The lateral raise machine is an isolation exercise that targets the lateral (middle) deltoids to build shoulder width. The machine provides a fixed movement path and consistent resistance, making it easier to maintain proper form while minimizing momentum.
instructions_zh: 站在侧平举机的踏板上，将上臂贴住垫臂。
挺胸、收紧核心，肘部保持微屈。
肩部外展将垫臂向外抬起，直到上臂约与地面平行。
在顶端稍作停顿，挤压侧三角肌。
缓慢控制下放回到起始位置，重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with a neutral grip.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your core engaged.
Raise both dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your medial delts.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Dumbbell lateral raises are the primary isolation exercise targeting the medial deltoid. By raising the arms out to the side, it directly develops shoulder width and contributes to the characteristic rounded shoulder appearance.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手各持一只哑铃置于体侧，采用中立握法。
肘部保持微屈，收紧核心。
将两只哑铃沿宽弧线向两侧抬起，直到手臂与地面平行。
在顶端稍作停顿，挤压中束三角肌。
缓慢将哑铃下放回起始位置，重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a low athletic stance with your knees bent and feet shoulder-width apart.
Push off your inside foot and shuffle laterally to one side.
Land softly and immediately push back the other direction.
Maintain a quick, continuous shuffling pace throughout.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The lateral shuffle is a bodyweight cardio drill performed by rapidly shuffling side to side in a low athletic stance. It develops lateral quickness, cardiovascular fitness, and lower body agility while engaging the glutes and leg muscles throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 从低重心运动姿势开始，屈膝，双脚与肩同宽。
蹬内侧脚，向一侧横向滑步。
轻柔落地并立即向另一方向蹬回。
全程保持快速、连续的滑步节奏。
持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Stand in an athletic stance with your knees slightly bent and feet shoulder-width apart.
Take two to three quick shuffle steps to one side, staying low.
Plant the outside foot and immediately shuffle the same number of steps in the opposite direction.
Keep your hips low and your weight on the balls of your feet throughout.
Continue shuffling side to side for the desired duration.
description_en: Lateral shuffle 1 is a side-to-side agility drill that elevates the heart rate and trains lateral movement patterns. It targets the cardiovascular system while engaging the glutes and upper legs, commonly used in athletic conditioning and warm-up routines.
instructions_zh: 以运动姿势站立，膝盖微屈，双脚与肩同宽。
向一侧快速做两到三步滑步，保持低重心。
外侧脚蹬地，立即向反方向滑同样步数。
全程保持髋部低位，重心放在前脚掌。
继续左右滑步，持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Stand in an athletic stance holding one end of a battle rope in each hand.
Begin alternating rope waves while simultaneously shuffling laterally in one direction.
After several steps, shuffle back in the opposite direction while continuing the rope waves.
Maintain a low athletic stance throughout the movement.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The lateral shuffle battle rope is a full-body conditioning exercise that combines lateral agility with upper body battle rope work. It targets the biceps and shoulders through the rope movement while engaging the quads and glutes for lateral locomotion and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_zh: 以运动姿势站立，双手各握战绳一端。
开始交替甩绳，同时向一侧横向滑步。
滑几步后，继续甩绳并向反方向滑回。
全程保持低重心运动姿势。
持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Stand in a low athletic stance with your knees slightly bent and your weight on the balls of your feet.
Push off your inside foot and shuffle laterally in one direction by stepping and bringing your feet together repeatedly.
Keep your hips low and your chest up throughout the movement.
After the desired distance, plant your outside foot and shuffle back in the opposite direction.
Continue shuffling back and forth for the desired duration.
description_en: Lateral sprint shuffles are a bodyweight cardio and agility exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and lower legs. They involve rapid side-to-side shuffling in a low athletic stance to develop lateral speed, footwork, and cardiovascular conditioning.
instructions_zh: 以低重心运动姿势站立，膝盖微屈，重心放在前脚掌。
蹬内侧脚向一侧滑步，反复迈步并拢双脚。
全程保持髋部低位、胸部抬起。
达到目标距离后，外侧脚蹬地，向反方向滑回。
继续来回滑步，持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Stand with feet together and hands on your hips or extended in front.
Step one foot out wide to the side and lower into a lateral lunge by shifting your weight over that foot.
Keep the opposite leg straight and both feet flat on the ground.
Push off the bent leg to bring your feet back together.
Repeat in the same direction for the desired steps, then switch sides.
description_en: Lateral walking lunges are a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes through a side-to-side lunge pattern. They improve frontal plane strength, hip abductor activation, and dynamic balance.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，双手叉腰或向前伸直。
一只脚向侧面迈出一大步，重心移到该脚上，下蹲成侧弓步。
另一条腿保持伸直，双脚平贴地面。
蹬弯曲的腿将双脚收回并拢。
沿同一方向重复至目标步数，然后换边。

instructions_en: Sit on a hip abduction machine and lean your torso forward slightly, resting your chest on your thighs.
Adjust the pads to rest against the outside of your knees.
Push your legs outward against the pads in a controlled motion.
Pause at the widest point and squeeze your outer glutes.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lean forward hip abduction is a variation of the machine hip abduction that shifts emphasis toward the gluteus maximus by leaning the torso forward. This positional change alters the angle of hip abduction and increases glute engagement.
instructions_zh: 坐在髋部外展机上，躯干微微前倾，胸部贴在大腿上。
调整护垫使其贴靠在膝盖外侧。
以受控的动作将双腿向外推压护垫。
在最宽处停顿并收紧臀外侧。
缓慢将双腿回到起始位置，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with one leg extended on the mat and the other raised toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and stabilize your hips against the mat.
Draw a large circle with your raised leg, moving it across your body, down, out, and back up.
Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The leg circle is a foundational Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hip flexors and stabilizing the core. It involves drawing controlled circles with one leg while keeping the pelvis and spine completely still, developing hip mobility and core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在垫子上，一条腿伸直放在垫上，另一条腿抬向天花板。
收紧核心，将髋部稳定压在垫子上。
用抬起的腿画一个大圆，依次横过身体、向下、向外、再回到上方。
沿一个方向完成目标圈数，然后反向。
换腿，在另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit in a leg extension machine with your back flat against the pad and knees aligned with the machine's pivot point.
Hook your ankles under the roller pad and grip the handles on the sides.
Extend your legs upward until they are fully straight, squeezing your quads at the top.
Slowly lower the weight back to the starting position, stopping just before it touches the stack.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg extension is a machine-based isolation exercise that targets the quadriceps. Extending the knee against resistance from the seated position provides direct stimulation to the quad muscles, commonly used for hypertrophy and rehabilitation.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿屈伸机上，背部平贴靠垫，膝盖与机器转轴对齐。
将脚踝勾在滚垫下方，握住两侧把手。
向上伸直双腿至完全伸展，在顶端收紧股四头肌。
缓慢将重量放回起始位置，在触及配重片前停住。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the leg extension machine and adjust the back pad so your knees align with the machine's pivot point.
Place your shins behind the padded lever and grip the handles at your sides.
Extend your legs upward by straightening your knees until your legs are parallel to the floor.
Pause at the top and squeeze your quadriceps.
Slowly lower the lever back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg extension machine is an isolation exercise targeting the quadriceps. By extending the knee against resistance, it directly strengthens the quads without engaging the posterior chain, making it ideal for targeted quad development.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿屈伸机上，调整靠背垫使膝盖与机器转轴对齐。
将小腿放在护垫杆后方，握住两侧把手。
伸直膝盖向上抬起双腿，直到双腿与地面平行。
在顶端停顿并收紧股四头肌。
缓慢将杆放回起始位置，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Set up in a bound headstand position on the floor, positioned in front of a sturdy chair.
Lift your hips and place one foot onto the seat of the chair for support, extending your other leg straight up.
Engage your core and slowly lift the foot off the chair, bringing it up to meet your extended leg in a full headstand.
Pause briefly at the top, maintaining balance and a tight core.
Slowly lower one leg back down to rest on the chair with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg lift progression for headstand preparation is a bodyweight balance exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the hip flexors and shoulders. It involves controlled single-leg lifts in an inverted position to build the core strength and body awareness needed for a full headstand.
instructions_zh: 在稳固椅子前方，在地面上摆好头倒立准备姿势。
抬起髋部，将一只脚放在椅面上支撑，另一条腿向上伸直。
收紧核心，缓慢将脚从椅子上抬起，与伸直的腿并拢成完整头倒立。
在顶端短暂停顿，保持平衡并收紧核心。
缓慢将一条腿有控制地放回椅子上。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor and open your legs as wide as comfortable.
Place your hands on the floor between or in front of you.
Gently hinge forward from your hips, lowering your torso toward the floor.
Hold the stretch for 30–60 seconds.
Slowly return to upright and repeat as desired.
description_en: The leg open stretch is a seated bodyweight exercise that targets the adductors and hamstrings through a wide-leg forward fold. Spreading the legs wide and folding forward improves inner thigh flexibility and hip mobility, commonly used in cooldown and flexibility routines.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿尽可能宽地打开。
双手放在双腿之间或前方的地面上。
从髋部轻轻向前折叠，将躯干向地面下压。
保持拉伸30–60秒。
缓慢回到直立姿势，按需重复。

name_en: leg open with hand on chest cross stretch
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide apart.
Cross your arms over your chest and hinge forward from the hips.
Lower your torso toward the floor between your legs.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds.
Return to upright and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The leg open with hand on chest cross stretch is a seated wide-leg forward fold performed with arms crossed over the chest. The arm position removes shoulder engagement and shifts focus entirely to the forward fold, deepening the adductor and hamstring stretch.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿大幅分开。
双臂交叉放在胸前，从髋部向前折叠。
将躯干向双腿之间的地面下压。
保持拉伸20–30秒。
回到直立姿势，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit in the leg press machine with your back flat against the pad and feet hip-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop when your knees are at approximately a 90-degree angle, keeping your lower back pressed to the pad.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels to fully extend your legs without locking your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg press is a machine-based compound exercise targeting the quadriceps, with significant engagement of the glutes and hamstrings. It allows for heavy loading of the lower body in a controlled, supported position.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，背部平贴靠垫，双脚与髋同宽踩在踏板上。
松开安全把手，屈膝将踏板向胸部方向下放。
当膝盖约呈90度角时停止，保持下背部紧贴靠垫。
通过脚跟发力将踏板推离，充分伸展双腿但不要锁死膝盖。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a leg press machine and position your feet wide and high on the platform, toes pointed outward.
Lower the weight by bending your knees and allowing them to track outward toward your elbows.
Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position without locking your knees.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg press frog stance is a leg press variation with a wide, high, and externally rotated foot placement that targets the glutes and hip adductors. This position shifts emphasis away from the quads and onto the posterior and inner thigh muscles.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，双脚宽距且较高地踩在踏板上，脚尖朝外。
屈膝下放重量，让膝盖向外朝肘部方向移动。
通过脚跟发力伸展双腿回到起始位置，不要锁死膝盖。
在顶端稍作停顿，收紧臀肌。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the leg press machine and place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Stop when your knees reach approximately 90 degrees or your lower back begins to lift off the seat.
Drive through your heels to extend your knees and push the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg press machine is a compound lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. The machine allows for heavy loading with back support, making it effective for building quad strength and muscle mass as a supplement to free weight squatting.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，双脚与肩同宽踩在踏板上。
松开安全把手，屈膝将踏板向胸部方向下放。
当膝盖约达90度或下背部开始离开座椅时停止。
通过脚跟发力伸展膝盖，将踏板推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a leg press machine and place your feet close together at the center of the platform.
Ensure your feet are directly below or slightly above center with toes pointed forward.
Lower the weight by bending your knees to approximately 90 degrees.
Press through the balls of your feet to extend your legs and return to the starting position without locking your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The leg press narrow stance is a leg press variation that places the feet close together on the platform, increasing the emphasis on the quadriceps. This foot positioning recruits the outer quad more than a wider stance.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，双脚并拢放在踏板中央。
确保双脚位于中心正下方或稍上方，脚尖朝前。
屈膝下放重量至约90度。
通过前脚掌发力伸展双腿回到起始位置，不要锁死膝盖。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright next to a wall or support for balance.
Raise one leg in front of you to hip height, keeping it straight.
Hold the raised leg position for 2-3 seconds, feeling the stretch in the quads and hip flexors.
Lower the leg slowly and switch sides.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each leg.
description_en: Leg raise thigh stretch is a bodyweight standing exercise targeting the quads and hip flexors. Holding the raised straight leg challenges balance while providing a dynamic stretch along the front of the thigh.
instructions_zh: 站在墙边或支撑物旁保持平衡。
将一条腿向前抬至髋部高度，保持伸直。
保持抬腿姿势2-3秒，感受股四头肌和髋屈肌的拉伸。
缓慢放下腿并换边。
每条腿按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head and lift your head and shoulders off the mat.
Lower one leg toward the ground in a controlled motion while keeping the other raised.
Switch legs in a scissoring motion, alternating smoothly.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your core engaged and lower back pressed to the mat.
description_en: The leg scissor is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves alternating leg lowering movements performed with the head and shoulders lifted, challenging core control and lower body coordination.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿向上伸直朝向天花板。
双手放在脑后，将头和肩膀抬离垫面。
控制一条腿向下放低，另一条腿保持抬起。
双腿交替做剪刀式动作，流畅轮换。
保持核心收紧、下背部贴垫，按目标次数持续交替。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet close together and place your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight slightly onto one leg to balance.
Keeping your opposite leg straight, lift it slightly forward off the floor.
Point your toes downward toward the floor as you lift.
Lower your foot back to the starting position.
Alternate legs and continue the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Leg stretch with hands on hips is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes and lower back. It involves hinging forward from a wide-stance position with hands on hips to deepen the hamstring stretch while maintaining an upright postural awareness.
instructions_zh: 站直，双脚并拢，双手放在髋部。
将重心稍移到一条腿上保持平衡。
保持另一条腿伸直，将其稍向前抬离地面。
抬起时脚尖向下指向地面。
将脚放回起始位置。
交替双腿，按目标次数持续动作。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one leg, keeping a slight bend in the knee for stability.
Lift your opposite foot slightly and swing it horizontally across the front of your standing leg.
Swing the same leg back in the opposite direction, bringing it out wide to the side.
Continue swinging the leg side to side in a controlled pendulum motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then switch legs and repeat.
description_en: The leg swing is a bodyweight dynamic stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes and hip flexors. It involves swinging one leg forward and backward in a controlled pendulum motion to mobilize the hip joint and warm up the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 站直，双脚与髋同宽，双手放在髋部。
将重心移到一条腿上，膝盖微屈以保持稳定。
将另一只脚稍抬起，水平摆过支撑腿前方。
同一条腿向反方向摆回，向外侧摆宽。
以可控的钟摆动作持续左右摆腿。
完成目标次数后换腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with your hand on a wall or support for balance.
Engage your core and swing the free leg forward to hip height, then smoothly swing it behind you as far as comfortably possible.
Keep the movement controlled and use momentum to gradually increase your range of motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then switch legs and repeat.
description_en: Leg swing front to back is a bodyweight dynamic stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes and hip flexors. It involves rhythmically swinging one leg forward and backward to warm up the hip joint and improve sagittal plane mobility.
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，手扶墙或支撑物保持平衡。
收紧核心，将自由腿向前摆至髋部高度，然后顺畅地向后摆至舒适的最大幅度。
保持动作受控，利用惯性逐渐增加活动范围。
完成目标次数后换腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or support for balance.
Lift the opposite leg slightly off the floor and begin tracing large, controlled circles with that leg.
Move the leg forward, out to the side, behind you, and back to the start in a full circular motion.
Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Leg swing in circle is a bodyweight dynamic stretching exercise targeting the glutes and hip joint, with secondary engagement of the hip flexors and hamstrings. It involves tracing full circular paths with the leg to lubricate the hip joint and improve multi-directional mobility.
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，扶墙或支撑物保持平衡。
将另一条腿稍微抬离地面，开始用该腿画大而受控的圆圈。
腿向前、向外侧、向后、再回到起始位置，完成完整的圆周运动。
完成目标次数的单方向画圈后，反向进行。
换腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand sideways next to a wall or support and place one hand on it for balance.
Engage your core and swing the free leg across your body to the opposite side, then swing it outward as far as comfortably possible.
Keep the swinging motion controlled and allow momentum to gradually open the range of motion.
Complete the desired number of swings, then turn around and repeat on the other leg.
description_en: Leg swing side to side is a bodyweight dynamic stretching exercise targeting the glutes and hip abductors, with secondary engagement of the hip flexors and lower back. It involves swinging one leg laterally across and away from the body to improve frontal plane hip mobility.
instructions_zh: 侧身站在墙或支撑物旁，一只手扶住保持平衡。
收紧核心，将自由腿向身体对侧摆动，然后向外侧摆至舒适的最大幅度。
保持摆动受控，利用惯性逐渐打开活动范围。
完成目标次数后转身换另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Engage your core and press your lower back into the mat.
Lift both legs a few inches off the mat.
Alternately raise and lower each leg in small, rapid flutter kicks.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions or duration, breathing steadily.
description_en: Legs flutter is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hip flexors and abdominal muscles. It involves lying on the back and performing rapid, alternating flutter kicks with the legs held low to the ground, challenging core endurance and lower body coordination.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧。
收紧核心，将下背部压向垫面。
将双腿抬离垫面几英寸。
双腿交替上下做小而快速的摆动踢腿。
持续目标次数或时间，保持稳定呼吸。

instructions_en: Sit sideways next to a wall and swing your legs up as you lower your back to the floor.
Scoot your glutes as close to the wall as comfortable and extend your legs straight up the wall.
Rest your arms out to the sides with palms facing up.
Relax your entire body and allow your lower back to soften into the floor.
Hold the position for 5-10 minutes, breathing deeply, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come out.
description_en: Legs up the wall is a restorative inverted yoga posture that gently stretches the hamstrings and lower back while promoting circulation and relaxation. It involves lying on the back with legs extended vertically against a wall, offering a passive and calming inversion.
instructions_zh: 侧身坐在墙边，双腿上摆的同时将背部放低到地面。
将臀部尽量靠近墙壁，双腿沿墙伸直向上。
双臂向两侧展开，掌心朝上。
放松全身，让下背部自然沉向地面。
保持5-10分钟，深呼吸，然后屈膝转向一侧退出。

instructions_en: Sit in a comfortable kneeling or cross-legged position with your hands on your knees.
Inhale deeply through your nose, spreading your fingers wide and sitting tall.
Open your mouth wide and exhale forcefully, extending your tongue down toward your chin.
Simultaneously open your eyes wide and direct your gaze upward between your eyebrows.
Repeat the breath 3-5 times, then return to normal breathing.
description_en: Lion's breath is a pranayama and yoga posture targeting the muscles of the face, neck, and throat. It involves a forceful exhalation with tongue extended and eyes wide, releasing tension in the face and neck while stimulating the throat region.
instructions_zh: 以舒适的跪姿或盘腿坐姿坐好，双手放在膝盖上。
用鼻子深吸气，手指张开，坐直身体。
张大嘴巴用力呼气，舌头向下伸向下巴。
同时睁大眼睛，目光向上看向眉心之间。
重复呼吸3-5次，然后恢复正常呼吸。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face in a neutral, relaxed position.
Place your index fingers at the outer corners of your mouth.
Using your facial muscles, lift the corners of your mouth upward into a gentle smile.
Hold the lifted position for 5 seconds.
Slowly release and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lip corner lift is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the zygomaticus and orbicularis oris muscles. It involves lifting the corners of the mouth upward to tone and firm the lower cheek and lip area.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部保持中立放松。
将食指放在嘴角外侧。
用面部肌肉将嘴角向上提成轻柔的微笑。
保持上提姿势5秒。
缓慢放松，恢复中立表情。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Press your lips firmly together without clenching your teeth.
Hold the pressed position for 5 seconds, engaging the muscles around the mouth.
Slowly release the tension and relax your lips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lip press is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oris muscle. It involves pressing the lips firmly together to tone and strengthen the muscles surrounding the mouth.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
双唇用力闭合，但不要咬紧牙齿。
保持紧闭姿势5秒，收紧嘴部周围肌肉。
缓慢释放紧张，放松双唇。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine straight.
Close your mouth and pucker your lips outward as if preparing to give a kiss.
Hold the puckered position for 5 seconds, squeezing the lip muscles firmly.
Release and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lip pucker (kiss face) is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oris muscle. It involves puckering the lips outward to strengthen and tone the muscles around the mouth.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，保持脊柱挺直。
闭上嘴，将嘴唇向外撅起，如同准备亲吻。
保持撅嘴姿势5秒，用力收紧唇部肌肉。
放松，恢复自然表情。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Smile as wide as possible while keeping your lips closed together.
Hold the wide smile for 5 seconds, feeling the stretch across your lips and cheeks.
Slowly relax and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lip stretch smile is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the lip and zygomaticus muscles. It involves holding a wide, closed-lip smile to stretch and tone the muscles across the lower face.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
双唇闭合，尽可能宽地微笑。
保持宽笑5秒，感受嘴唇和面颊的拉伸。
慢慢放松，恢复自然表情。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face in a relaxed, neutral position.
Open your mouth slightly and stretch your lips outward as wide as possible, as if saying 'eee'.
Hold the stretched position for 5 seconds.
Slowly relax and return to a neutral expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lips stretch is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oris and surrounding lip muscles. It involves stretching the lips outward to increase flexibility and tone the muscles around the mouth.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部保持放松自然。
微微张嘴，将嘴唇尽可能向两侧拉伸，如同发“eee”音。
保持拉伸姿势5秒。
慢慢放松，恢复自然表情。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on your mat with your legs extended and arms alongside your body, palms facing up.
Rest your forehead gently on the mat.
Inhale and simultaneously lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the floor.
Keep your gaze forward and downward, draw your shoulder blades together, and squeeze your glutes.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, then exhale and slowly lower everything back to the mat.
description_en: Locust pose is a prone yoga posture that targets the lower back by lifting the chest and legs simultaneously off the floor. It strengthens the posterior chain including the glutes, hamstrings, and spinal extensors, and is a foundational backbend for building back body strength.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫子上，双腿伸直，双臂放在身体两侧，掌心朝上。
额头轻轻放在垫子上。
吸气，同时将头、胸、手臂和双腿抬离地面。
目光向前下方看，肩胛骨向内收拢，收紧臀部。
保持20-30秒，然后呼气，慢慢将身体放回垫子上。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended by your sides, palms facing down.
Raise both legs to a 90-degree angle directly above your hips.
Engage your core and press your lower back into the mat.
Slowly lower both legs toward the mat without letting your lower back arch.
Raise them back to vertical and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Lower body lifted is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. It involves raising and lowering both legs from a supine position, requiring deep core engagement and spinal stability to control the movement safely and effectively.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
将双腿抬至臀部正上方90度。
收紧核心，将下背部压向垫子。
慢慢将双腿向垫子放下，同时避免下背部拱起。
将双腿抬回垂直位置，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed and eyes open.
Look straight ahead and keep your upper eyelids still.
Slowly raise your lower eyelids upward toward the iris, as if squinting from below.
Hold the position for 3 seconds.
Slowly release and return to a relaxed expression.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lower eyelid tightener is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oculi muscle. It involves raising only the lower eyelid upward to strengthen and tone the under-eye area.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松，眼睛睁开。
直视前方，保持上眼睑不动。
慢慢将下眼睑向上抬向虹膜，如同从下方眯眼。
保持该姿势3秒。
慢慢放松，恢复自然表情。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Keeping your upper lip still, push your lower lip upward as far as possible toward your upper lip.
Hold the raised position for 5 seconds, engaging the chin and lower lip muscles.
Slowly return your lower lip to the resting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lower lip lift is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the mentalis and orbicularis oris muscles. It involves raising the lower lip upward to tone and strengthen the muscles around the lower mouth and chin.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
保持上唇不动，将下唇尽可能向上推向上唇。
保持上抬姿势5秒，收紧下巴和下唇肌肉。
慢慢将下唇恢复到休息位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground.
As you lower into the lunge, curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Drive through the front foot to return to standing and lower the dumbbells.
Repeat on the other leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Lunges alternate biceps curl combines an alternating forward lunge with a simultaneous biceps curl to train the lower body and arms together. It targets the biceps while also developing quad, glute, and hamstring strength for an efficient compound exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持一只哑铃放在身体两侧。
一只脚向前迈出成弓步，后膝向地面降低。
下蹲成弓步时，将两只哑铃弯举向肩部。
前脚发力回到站立姿势，同时放下哑铃。
换另一条腿重复，两侧交替，按所需次数进行。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet together.
Step forward with one foot into a lunge position.
As you lower, allow the front knee to travel forward over the toes for a knee dive.
Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push back to standing and repeat on the opposite leg.
description_en: The lunge knee dive is a forward lunge variation where the front knee is intentionally allowed to travel past the toes during the descent. This increases ankle and knee range of motion, engaging the quads and calf muscles more deeply in a controlled manner.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢直立。
一只脚向前迈出成弓步。
下蹲时前膝向前超过脚尖。
下蹲至后膝接近地面。
推回站立，换另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground.
Push off your front foot to bring your feet together and stand upright.
From standing, lower into a hack squat by hinging at the hips and bending the knees with the torso leaning slightly back.
Return to standing and repeat the lunge on the opposite leg, continuing in an alternating sequence.
description_en: Lunges to hack squat is a compound bodyweight sequence that combines a forward lunge with a hack squat to target the quads, glutes, and hamstrings. The movement transitions between two complementary exercises to maximize lower body engagement.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手垂于体侧。
向前迈步成弓步，后膝向地面下压。
前脚发力蹬起，双脚并拢直立。
从站立姿势屈髋屈膝下蹲成哈克深蹲，躯干略向后倾。
回到站立，换另一条腿做弓步，交替进行。

name_zh: 仰卧内收肌拉伸-脚抬高
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back near a wall and rest your feet on the wall with knees slightly bent.
Allow your knees to fall outward to the sides.
Let gravity gently open the hips and stretch the inner thighs.
Hold for 30–60 seconds.
Bring the knees back together and repeat.
description_en: The lying adductor stretch with feet elevated positions the feet on a wall to provide support while gravity opens the hips and stretches the adductors. The wall support allows for a more relaxed and sustained inner thigh stretch compared to the standard supine variation.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧内收肌拉伸-脚抬高
instructions_zh: 仰卧在墙边，双脚搭在墙上，膝盖微屈。
让双膝向外侧打开。
让重力自然打开髋部，拉伸大腿内侧。
双膝收回并拢，重复。

name_en: lying adductor stretch – feet elevated version 1
name_zh: 仰卧内收肌拉伸-脚抬高变式1
instructions_en: Lie on your back with your hips near a wall and feet resting on the wall.
Slowly slide your feet apart along the wall, letting gravity open the hips.
Allow the inner thigh to elongate as the legs spread.
Hold the widest comfortable position for 30–60 seconds.
Slide your feet back together and repeat.
description_en: The lying adductor stretch feet elevated version 1 uses the wall as a surface to slide the feet apart progressively, allowing gravity to deepen the adductor stretch. The sliding motion lets practitioners ease into the stretch at their own pace.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧内收肌拉伸-脚抬高变式1
instructions_zh: 仰卧，臀部靠近墙壁，双脚搭在墙上。
双脚沿墙面缓慢分开，让重力打开髋部。
双腿分开时让大腿内侧拉长。
在最宽且舒适的位置保持30–60秒。
双脚沿墙收回并拢，重复。

name_en: lying adductor stretch (supine inner thigh stretch)
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Allow one or both knees to fall outward toward the floor.
Rest in the open position and breathe steadily.
Hold for 30–60 seconds.
Slowly bring the knees back together and repeat.
description_en: The lying adductor stretch is a supine bodyweight exercise that stretches the inner thigh muscles by allowing the knees to fall outward while lying on the back. The relaxed position allows gravity to provide a gentle, sustained adductor stretch.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
让一侧或双侧膝盖向外侧倒向地面。
在打开的位置放松，保持平稳呼吸。
缓慢收回双膝并拢，重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with legs extended.
Draw both knees to your chest and wrap your arms around them.
Gently pull your knees closer to your chest, feeling the stretch in your lower back and hips.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Release and slowly lower your legs back to the floor.
description_en: The lying back and hips stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lower back and hips. Pulling both knees to the chest from a supine position gently decompresses the lumbar spine and releases tension in the glutes and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直。
双膝抱向胸前，双臂环抱膝盖。
轻轻将膝盖拉向胸口，感受下背部和髋部的拉伸。
保持20–30秒，深呼吸。
放松，缓慢将双腿放回地面。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides.
Lift both legs off the floor with knees slightly bent.
Open your legs apart in a wide scissor position.
Close them back together, crossing one over the other.
Alternate which leg crosses on top with each repetition.
description_en: The lying bent leg scissor is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the abs and adductors by opening and crossing the legs while lying on the back with knees slightly bent. The movement engages the hip adductors on the closing phase and the core throughout.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双臂放在身体两侧。
双腿抬离地面，膝盖微屈。
双腿向两侧大幅打开成剪刀位。
双腿收回并拢，一条腿交叉在另一条腿上。
每次重复交替哪条腿在上交叉。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed lightly behind your head.
Lift both feet off the ground and bend your knees to a 90-degree angle.
Begin a slow pedaling motion, drawing one knee toward your chest while extending the opposite leg.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and your core engaged throughout the movement.
Continue alternating legs in a controlled cycling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying bike bent knee is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. Performed on the back, it mimics a slow cycling motion with bent knees to engage the abs and hip flexors while minimizing strain on the lower back.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双手轻放在头后。
双脚抬离地面，屈膝成90度。
开始缓慢蹬车动作，一侧膝盖拉向胸口，另一条腿伸直。
整个动作中下背部贴紧地面，核心收紧。
双腿交替做可控的蹬车动作至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the mat, hip-width apart.
Engage your core and press your feet firmly into the mat.
Lift both feet off the mat, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your feet back to the mat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Lying double leg bent is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings. It involves lifting both bent legs from a supine position and drawing the knees toward the chest, developing lower body awareness and core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双膝弯曲，双脚平放于垫上，与髋同宽。
收紧核心，双脚用力压向垫面。
双脚离地，双膝向胸部靠拢。
保持片刻，然后缓慢将双脚放回垫面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your hips for support.
Raise your legs a few inches off the floor.
Begin rapidly alternating small up and down kicks with each leg.
Keep the legs straight and the movement controlled.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The lying flutter kick is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the lower abs and hip flexors through rapid alternating leg kicks while lying on the back. Keeping the legs low and straight increases the mechanical demand on the lower abdominal region.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手置于臀下支撑。
双腿抬离地面数英寸。
开始快速交替上下小幅踢腿。
保持双腿伸直，动作受控。
持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your hips.
Raise your legs just above the floor and begin flutter kicking at maximum speed.
Keep the kicks small and the legs as straight as possible.
Sustain the rapid pace for the desired duration.
Lower your legs to rest before repeating.
description_en: The lying flutter kick fast is a high-intensity version of the lying flutter kick performed at maximum speed. The rapid pace elevates the cardiovascular demand and increases time under tension in the lower abs, making it effective for both core training and metabolic conditioning.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手置于臀下。
双腿抬至略高于地面，以最快速度开始交替踢腿。
保持踢腿幅度小，双腿尽量伸直。
维持快速节奏至目标时长。
放下双腿休息后重复。

name_en: lying leg bent hold back stretch
name_zh: 仰卧屈腿抱膝背部拉伸
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Draw both knees toward your chest and wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold the knees close to the chest and gently rock side to side if comfortable.
Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds.
Release and repeat.
description_en: The lying leg bent hold back stretch is a supine lower back stretch that gently decompresses the lumbar spine by drawing both knees toward the chest. It relieves lower back tension and stretches the glutes, making it a staple of post-exercise recovery routines.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧屈腿抱膝背部拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲，双脚平放于地面。
双膝向胸部靠拢，双臂环抱小腿。
双膝贴近胸部保持，如舒适可轻轻左右摇摆。
保持拉伸姿势20–30秒。
放松后重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent and feet flat.
Grasp one knee with both hands and draw it toward your chest.
Slowly extend that leg upward while keeping it held with your hands.
Hold the extended position for 20–30 seconds.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The lying leg bent stretch is a supine hamstring flexibility exercise that draws one bent knee to the chest and then extends it upward for a sustained stretch. The progressive extension allows a controlled deepening of the hamstring stretch from a supported lying position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲，双脚平放。
双手抓住一侧膝盖，向胸部拉近。
双手保持抓握，缓慢将该腿向上伸直。
保持伸直姿势20–30秒。
放下该腿，换另一侧重复。

name_en: lying leg bent with hand raise straight stretch
name_zh: 仰卧屈腿举手直臂拉伸
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent.
Raise one arm straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend the same-side leg straight out, hovering above the floor.
Hold the extended arm and leg position for 20–30 seconds.
Return and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The lying leg bent with hand raise straight stretch combines an arm raise with a leg extension from a supine position. The paired limb extension creates a diagonal stretch through the core and hip flexors, improving total body coordination and flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧屈腿举手直臂拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲。
一侧手臂向天花板方向伸直上举。
同侧腿伸直，悬于地面上方。
保持手臂和腿伸直姿势20–30秒。
还原后换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a leg curl machine and position the pad just above your ankles.
Grip the handles for stability and press your hips firmly into the pad.
Curl your legs upward toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying leg curl is a machine-based isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings. By curling the legs toward the glutes against resistance, it effectively develops hamstring strength and size.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于腿弯举器械上，将垫置于脚踝上方。
握住把手稳定身体，髋部紧压垫面。
屈膝将双腿向上卷向臀部。
动作顶端停顿，挤压腘绳肌。
缓慢将双腿放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on the leg curl machine and position the pad just above your heels.
Grip the handles beneath the bench for stability.
Curl your heels toward your glutes by bending your knees as far as the machine allows.
Pause at the top and squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying leg curl machine is an isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings. Performed face-down, it curls the lower leg toward the glutes against resistance, directly strengthening the hamstrings and improving knee flexion strength.
instructions_zh: 俯卧于腿弯举器械上，将垫置于脚跟上方。
握住凳下把手稳定身体。
屈膝将脚跟向臀部卷起，至器械允许的最大幅度。
顶端停顿并挤压腘绳肌。
缓慢将双腿放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed beneath your hips for support.
Lift both legs off the mat and draw one knee in toward your chest.
Extend that leg out while drawing the opposite knee in, creating a smooth cycling motion.
Continue pedaling in a forward direction for the desired number of repetitions.
Reverse the direction and repeat.
description_en: The lying leg cycle is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hip flexors and quadriceps. Performed on the back, it simulates a cycling motion with both legs, building hip mobility, core endurance, and lower body coordination.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手放在臀部下方支撑。
双腿抬离垫子，一侧膝盖向胸部收拢。
将该腿伸出，同时另一侧膝盖收拢，形成流畅的蹬车动作。
按目标次数持续向前蹬车。
反向重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and hands beneath your lower back or flat on the floor.
Keep your legs together and raise them upward until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Pause at the top, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your legs back toward the floor without fully touching it.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying leg lift up is a bodyweight ab and hip flexor exercise targeting the lower abdominals through a vertical leg raise. It builds lower core strength and hip flexor endurance while requiring the upper abs to stabilize the spine.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放在下背部下方或平放于地面。
双腿并拢向上抬起，直至与地面垂直。
在顶部停顿，收紧腹肌。
缓慢将双腿放回地面，但不要完全触碰。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back.
Raise both legs off the ground until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower your legs toward the floor, stopping a few inches above it.
Pause, then raise your legs again for the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying leg raise is a foundational lower abdominal exercise performed on the floor. By controlling the lowering phase, it maintains constant tension on the abs and hip flexors throughout the full range of motion.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放在下背部下方。
双腿抬离地面，直至与地面垂直。
缓慢将双腿放向地面，在离地几英寸处停住。
停顿，然后再次抬腿进行下一次重复。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your hands placed beneath your lower back or flat at your sides.
Bend your knees to approximately 90 degrees and lift your feet slightly off the ground.
Raise your bent legs upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top, engaging your abs.
Slowly lower your feet back toward the ground without fully resting them and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
