description_en: The lying leg raise with bent knees is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the lower abs and hip flexors. Bending the knees reduces the lever arm compared to a straight-leg raise, making it more accessible while still effectively loading the abdominal muscles.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放在下背部下方或平放于身体两侧。
屈膝约90度，双脚稍微抬离地面。
向上抬起屈曲的双腿，将膝盖拉向胸部。
在顶部停顿，收紧腹肌。
缓慢将双脚放回地面但不完全落地，按目标次数重复。

name_en: lying leg raise straight flutter kick
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your hips.
Raise both legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Begin performing small, rapid flutter kicks with the legs in the raised position.
Keep the kicks controlled and the legs straight.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The lying leg raise straight flutter kick performs the flutter kick from a high-leg position with legs raised toward vertical. The elevated starting position changes the resistance angle and shifts the work toward the upper abs and hip flexors compared to lower-leg variations.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手放在臀部下方。
双腿伸直向上抬向天花板。
在抬腿姿势下开始做小而快速的交替打水动作。
保持打水受控，双腿伸直。
持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended.
Raise one leg straight up toward the ceiling.
Grasp the back of the thigh or calf and gently pull the leg toward you.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, feeling the elongation through the hamstring.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The lying leg raise up stretch is a supine bodyweight hamstring exercise that uses a leg raise to the ceiling followed by a gentle assisted pull. It targets the hamstrings through a straight-leg stretch and is a standard flexibility exercise for improving posterior leg range of motion.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直。
一条腿伸直向上抬向天花板。
抓住大腿后侧或小腿，轻轻将腿拉向自己。
保持拉伸20–30秒，感受大腿后侧的延展。
放下腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your glutes for support and knees slightly bent.
Keeping your lower back pressed into the floor, raise your legs toward the ceiling.
Stop when your legs are perpendicular to the floor or when you feel your lower back lift.
Slowly lower your legs back toward the floor without touching it.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Lying leg raises with bent knees are a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. The bent knee position reduces the lever arm and decreases demand on the hip flexors compared to straight-leg raises, making it more accessible.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手放在臀肌下方支撑，膝盖微屈。
保持下背部压向地面，将双腿抬向天花板。
当双腿与地面垂直或感觉下背部抬起时停止。
缓慢将双腿放回地面但不触碰。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides.
Begin alternately lifting your knees toward your chest in a marching pattern.
Coordinate your arm swings with the opposite leg movements.
Maintain a steady, controlled pace.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: Lying on floor marching is a supine cardio and core exercise that simulates marching from a back-lying position. It targets the hip flexors and abs through alternating knee drives, offering a low-impact cardiovascular and core activation option for those with mobility limitations.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂放在身体两侧。
开始以行军模式交替将膝盖抬向胸部。
手臂摆动与对侧腿部动作协调配合。
保持稳定、受控的节奏。
持续目标时间。

instructions_en: Lie face down on the floor with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Reach back with the same-side hand and grasp the ankle.
Gently pull the ankle toward the glute to increase the quad stretch.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, then repeat on the other leg.
description_en: Lying quads stretch II is a prone bodyweight stretch targeting the quadriceps and hip flexors. Bending one knee and pulling the heel toward the glute while face down provides a deep stretch through the front of the thigh in a supported, stable position.
instructions_zh: 俯卧地面，双腿伸直。
弯曲一侧膝盖，脚跟拉向臀部。
同侧手向后抓住脚踝。
轻轻将脚踝拉向臀部，加深股四头肌拉伸。
保持20–30秒，然后换另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs to a 90-degree tabletop position.
Begin pedaling your legs backward in a reverse cycling motion.
Alternate extending one leg behind while the other bends toward the chest.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor throughout.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The lying reverse bike is a bodyweight core exercise that performs a cycling motion in the reverse direction while lying on the back. Reversing the standard cycling pattern challenges the abs and hip flexors differently, engaging the muscles through an altered range of motion.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿抬至90度桌面位置。
开始向后做反向蹬车动作。
一腿向后伸展，另一腿屈膝靠向胸部，交替进行。
全程保持下背部贴地。
持续至目标时长。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your hands under your hips.
Raise both legs off the floor to about 45 degrees.
Open your legs wide apart, then cross them over each other alternately.
Keep the movements slow and controlled.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying scissor leg is a bodyweight core exercise that alternately opens and crosses the legs while lying on the back. The movement targets the lower abs and hip adductors, requiring sustained core engagement to keep the legs elevated throughout the exercise.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双手放在臀部下方。
双腿抬离地面约45度。
双腿大幅分开，然后交替交叉。
动作缓慢可控。
持续至目标次数。

name_en: lying single bent knee hold stretch
name_zh: 仰卧单腿屈膝抱膝拉伸
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended.
Bend one knee and draw it toward your chest, holding it with both hands.
Gently pull the knee closer until you feel a stretch in your glute and outer hip.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The lying single bent knee hold stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise targeting the glutes and hip flexors. The single-leg pull toward the chest isolates the stretch to one side at a time, allowing greater control and depth.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧单腿屈膝抱膝拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直。
弯曲一侧膝盖拉向胸部，双手抱住。
轻轻将膝盖拉近，直到臀部和外侧髋部有拉伸感。
保持拉伸20–30秒。
放松后换另一侧重复。

name_en: lying straight leg up hold stretch
name_zh: 仰卧直腿上举保持拉伸
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended on the floor.
Raise one straight leg toward the ceiling, keeping the knee locked.
Hold the leg at the point of comfortable tension for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly lower the leg back to the floor.
Repeat on the other side for the desired number of holds.
description_en: Lying straight leg up hold stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings. Raising a straight leg while lying on your back provides a passive hamstring stretch that improves posterior chain flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧直腿上举保持拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直贴地。
一条直腿抬向天花板，膝盖保持伸直。
在舒适拉伸感处保持20–30秒。
缓慢将腿放回地面。
换另一侧重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Allow both knees to fall open to the sides as far as comfortable.
Breathe steadily and let gravity deepen the inner thigh stretch.
Hold for 30–60 seconds.
Bring the knees back together and repeat.
description_en: The lying stretch wide leg bent is a supine adductor stretch performed with bent knees falling open to the sides. The bent-knee version is more accessible than the straight-leg variation and provides a gentle inner thigh and hip stretch in a fully supported lying position.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
双膝向两侧自然打开至舒适范围。
保持平稳呼吸，让重力加深大腿内侧拉伸。
双膝合拢后重复。

name_zh: 仰卧垂直卷腹（双腿伸直向上）
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise both legs straight up toward the ceiling, perpendicular to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross your arms over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying vertical crunch with legs straight up is a bodyweight core exercise that performs the crunch with the legs extended vertically. The raised leg position increases the difficulty of the crunch by removing hip flexor assistance and demanding greater rectus abdominis activation.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧垂直卷腹（双腿伸直向上）
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直向上抬起，垂直于地面。
双手放在头后或交叉于胸前。
收紧腹肌，肩胛骨抬离地面，双手伸向双脚。
顶部稍停，然后缓慢放下上半身。
重复至目标次数。

name_en: lying vertical crunches (legs straight up) advance
name_zh: 仰卧垂直卷腹（双腿伸直向上）进阶
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise both legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Place your hands behind your head.
Crunch upward explosively, bringing your chest as close to your knees as possible.
Hold the top position for a moment, squeezing the abs hard.
Lower with control and repeat at a challenging pace for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The lying vertical crunches advance is an intensified version of the vertical crunch that incorporates an explosive concentric phase and an extended hold at the top. The combination of speed and peak contraction maximizes abs activation and builds greater abdominal power.
name_zh_llm: 仰卧垂直卷腹（双腿伸直向上）进阶
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿伸直向上抬起。
双手放在头后。
爆发式向上卷腹，胸部尽量靠近膝盖。
顶部稍停，用力收紧腹肌。
控制下放，以有挑战性的节奏重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Extend both legs straight up toward the ceiling, then slowly open them out to the sides as wide as comfortable.
Allow gravity to gently pull your legs toward the ground, feeling a stretch along your inner thighs.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and relaxing into the stretch.
Slowly bring your legs back together and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The lying wide-leg adductor stretch is a bodyweight floor exercise targeting the adductor muscles of the inner thigh. Performed on the back with legs extended and spread wide, it uses gravity to deepen the stretch and improve hip flexibility and groin mobility.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂自然放松置于身体两侧。
双腿伸直向上抬起朝向天花板，然后缓慢向两侧打开至舒适的最大幅度。
让重力轻轻将双腿拉向地面，感受大腿内侧的拉伸。
保持姿势20-30秒，深呼吸并放松进入拉伸。
缓慢将双腿并拢，重复所需组数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise both legs up toward the ceiling.
Open your legs wide apart toward each side.
Use your hands on the inner thighs to gently press them further apart if needed.
Hold the wide position for 20–30 seconds.
Close your legs and repeat.
description_en: The lying wide leg stretch targets the adductors by spreading the legs wide from a supine position with legs raised. Gravity assists the deepening of the stretch, and the lying position removes lower back loading, making it accessible for those with limited flexibility.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿向上抬起朝向天花板。
将双腿向两侧大幅打开。
如有需要，用双手按住大腿内侧轻轻向下压以进一步打开。
保持打开姿势20-30秒。
并拢双腿后重复。

name_en: lying with holding her straight raise leg
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs extended and arms resting by your sides.
Keeping your leg straight, slowly raise one leg toward the ceiling until you feel a stretch in the back of your thigh.
Grasp the raised leg with both hands just below the knee to hold it in place.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the hamstring.
Slowly lower the leg back to the floor and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The lying with holding her straight raise leg is a bodyweight stretch targeting the hamstrings. Performed lying on the back, one leg is raised straight and held in place with the hands to deepen the hamstring stretch and improve posterior leg flexibility.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂置于身体两侧。
保持腿部伸直，缓慢将一条腿抬向天花板，直到感觉大腿后侧有拉伸感。
双手握住抬起腿的膝盖下方以固定位置。
保持姿势20-30秒，感受腘绳肌的拉伸。
缓慢将腿放回地面，换另一侧重复。
继续交替两侧至所需次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Keeping both legs straight, raise them together to a 90-degree angle with the floor.
Slowly lower your legs back down without letting them touch the floor.
Pause just above the ground, then raise them again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Lying with leg raise straight is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. Raising and lowering both straight legs simultaneously creates constant abdominal tension and builds lower core strength.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手置于下背部下方提供支撑。
保持双腿伸直，同时抬起至与地面呈90度角。
缓慢放下双腿，但不要触地。
在接近地面处停顿，然后再次抬起。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit at the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Grasp the handles with elbows slightly bent and upper arms parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your pectorals and bring your arms toward each other in a hugging motion.
Pause at the fully contracted position, holding the contraction briefly.
Slowly allow your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The machine pec deck fly is a chest isolation exercise targeting the pectorals through a controlled adduction movement. The guided machine path allows beginners to safely overload the chest while reducing shoulder joint stress compared to free weight flyes.
instructions_zh: 坐在蝴蝶机上调好座椅，使把手与肩同高。
握住把手，肘部微屈，上臂与地面平行。
收紧胸肌，以环抱动作将双臂向中间合拢。
在完全收缩位置停顿，短暂保持收缩。
缓慢让双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit at the seated row machine with your feet on the footpads and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with a neutral or overhand grip and sit upright.
Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the fully contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The machine seated row is a back exercise targeting the lats and rhomboids using a cable or plate-loaded row machine. The seated position allows for controlled loading and consistent tension, making it effective for developing mid-back thickness and strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在坐姿划船机上，双脚踩在踏板上，膝盖微屈。
以对握或正握握住把手，坐直身体。
将把手拉向躯干，肘部向后驱动，肩胛骨收紧。
在完全收缩位置停顿。
缓慢伸直双臂回到起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the floor close to your right hip.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and twist your torso to the right.
Bring your left elbow to the outside of your right knee and place your right hand on the floor behind you.
Hold the twist for 20-30 seconds, then release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Marichyasana is a seated spinal twist yoga posture that targets the abdominal muscles and obliques while stretching the lower back and hamstrings. It involves twisting the torso with one knee bent, encouraging thoracic rotation and core activation.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲右膝，将右脚平放在靠近右髋的地面上。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气将躯干向右扭转。
将左肘置于右膝外侧，右手放在身后地面上。
保持扭转20-30秒，然后松开换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Place your hands beneath the natural curve of your lower back for support.
Gently lift your head and shoulders off the floor without flattening your lower back.
Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching the leg position.
description_en: McGill Curl Up is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the abs. Based on spine research, this low-load curl minimizes spinal compression while effectively activating the abdominal muscles, making it ideal for core rehabilitation and injury prevention.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，一条腿伸直，另一条腿屈膝，脚掌平放地面。
双手置于下背部自然弧度下方提供支撑。
轻轻将头和肩膀抬离地面，不要压平下背部。
在顶部短暂停顿，然后缓慢放下。
重复所需次数后换腿位置。

instructions_en: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment or corner of the room.
Stand perpendicular to the bar and grip the end of the barbell with one hand using an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips to a roughly 45-degree torso angle with a slight bend in the knees.
Pull the end of the bar upward toward your hip, driving your elbow back.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lat and upper back.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position and repeat before switching sides.
description_en: The meadows row is a unilateral landmine exercise that targets the lats through a single-arm rowing movement. The angled pulling direction allows for a greater range of motion and stretch on the lat at the bottom of the movement compared to traditional rows.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃固定在杠铃地雷架或房间角落。
侧身站在杠铃旁，单手正握杠铃末端。
髋部铰链前倾至约45度，膝盖微屈。
将杠铃末端向上拉向髋部，肘部向后驱动。
在顶部停顿，收紧背阔肌和上背部。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置，重复后换边。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Engage your core and perform a full sit-up, raising your torso all the way up.
At the top of the movement, extend your arms and press the ball overhead or toward the ceiling.
Lower back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The med ball sit-up is a medicine ball exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. Adding a weighted ball increases the resistance of a standard sit-up and can be combined with an overhead press at the top for additional shoulder engagement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面，双手将药球抱于胸前。
收紧核心，完成完整仰卧起坐，将躯干完全抬起。
在动作顶部，伸直手臂将球推过头顶或推向天花板。
有控制地回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding a medicine ball with both hands overhead.
Slam the ball forcefully down to the ground, then immediately drop into a burpee.
Place your hands on the ground, jump your feet back, and perform a push-up.
Jump your feet forward, pick up the ball, and stand back up.
Raise the ball overhead and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The med ball slam burpee combines an explosive medicine ball slam with a full burpee to create a demanding full-body conditioning exercise. It targets the quads and glutes through the burpee squat pattern while also developing shoulder power and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手将药球举过头顶。
用力将球砸向地面，然后立即下蹲做波比跳。
双手撑地，双脚向后跳，做一个俯卧撑。
双脚向前跳，捡起球，站起。
将球举过头顶，按目标次数重复。

name_en: med ball slam on floor in lunges
instructions_en: Stand in a lunge stance with one foot forward, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lower into the lunge and simultaneously slam the medicine ball down to the ground.
Pick the ball up and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The med ball slam on floor in lunges combines a stationary lunge with an explosive medicine ball slam to challenge lower body strength and upper body power simultaneously. It targets the quadriceps and glutes through the lunge while developing shoulder explosiveness.
instructions_zh: 呈弓步姿势站立，一只脚在前，双手将药球举过头顶。
下蹲成弓步，同时将药球向下砸向地面。
捡起球，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball in both hands at your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side and bring the ball beside your hip.
Explosively throw the ball back and over that shoulder toward a wall or partner.
Catch the ball on rebound or retrieve it and return to the starting position.
Repeat on the same side for the desired reps, then switch sides.
description_en: The med ball throw behind shoulder is a rotational power exercise that targets the deltoids and traps through an explosive overhead throwing movement. It builds shoulder and upper back power while engaging the core for rotational strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手将药球抱于胸前。
躯干转向一侧，将球带到髋部旁。
爆发性地将球向后越过该侧肩膀掷向墙壁或搭档。
接住反弹的球或捡回球，回到起始位置。
在同一侧按目标次数重复，然后换边。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a medicine ball with both hands against your chest.
Engaging your abs, curl your upper body off the ground, bringing the ball toward your knees.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball abs crunch is a weighted abdominal exercise that targets the rectus abdominis. Holding a medicine ball against the chest adds load to the standard crunch, increasing the difficulty and muscle engagement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
双手将药球抱于胸前。
收紧腹肌，将上半身卷离地面，将球带向膝盖。
在动作顶部停顿，然后缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Lift your shoulders off the ground and extend your legs slightly.
Bring one knee toward your chest while simultaneously bringing the medicine ball toward that knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball elbow to knee is a weighted core exercise that targets the abs and obliques. Combining a knee tuck with a weighted crunch provides rotational and flexion demand across the entire core.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双手持药球。
将肩膀抬离地面，双腿略微伸直。
将一侧膝盖拉向胸前，同时将药球带向该膝盖。
回到起始位置，换另一侧重复。
继续交替进行，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a plank position with your hands on a medicine ball, arms fully extended.
Engage your core and maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Drive one knee toward your chest as quickly as possible, then return it to the starting position.
Immediately repeat with the opposite knee in a running motion.
Continue alternating legs at a rapid pace for the desired duration or repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball mountain climber is a dynamic core exercise that targets the abs and hip flexors while also challenging shoulder stability. Placing the hands on a medicine ball increases instability, amplifying core and stabilizer recruitment.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑姿势开始，双手撑在药球上，手臂完全伸直。
收紧核心，保持从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
尽快将一侧膝盖驱向胸前，然后回到起始位置。
立即换另一侧膝盖，以跑步动作重复。
快速交替双腿，按目标时间或次数持续进行。

instructions_en: Place a medicine ball on the floor and position your hands on top of it, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back to assume a plank position with your body forming a straight line.
Engage your core and stabilize your upper body on the rounded surface of the ball.
Keep your hips level and hold the position without letting the ball shift.
Hold for the desired duration.
description_en: The medicine ball plank is a core stability exercise that increases the challenge of a standard plank by placing the hands on an unstable spherical surface. The instability demands greater shoulder and core muscle activation to maintain a neutral position.
instructions_zh: 将药球放在地板上，双手放在球上，与肩同宽。
双脚向后走成平板支撑姿势，身体保持一条直线。
收紧核心，在球的圆弧面上稳定上半身。
保持髋部水平，维持姿势，不让球移动。
保持至目标时长。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Raise the ball overhead, extending your body fully.
Explosively slam the ball into the floor as hard as possible.
Catch the ball as it rebounds or pick it up from the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball slam is a high-intensity power exercise targeting the full body through an explosive overhead throwing motion. It builds power, cardiovascular conditioning, and core strength while serving as an effective stress-relief workout.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手持药球。
将球举过头顶，身体充分伸展。
爆发力将球用力砸向地面。
接住反弹的球或从地面捡起。
回到起始姿势，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Explosively stand up and throw the ball vertically as high as possible.
Catch the ball on its way down and immediately lower into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball squat throw is a plyometric exercise combining a squat with an explosive vertical throw to develop lower body power and shoulder strength. It targets the quadriceps and glutes through the squat phase while the throw challenges the shoulders and engages the core.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手持药球于胸前。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
爆发力站起，将球垂直向上抛至最高。
在下落时接住球，立即下蹲进入下一次。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a medicine ball with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Curl your upper body off the ground, reaching the ball straight up toward the ceiling.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball straight crunch is a weighted abdominal exercise performed with arms extended overhead holding a medicine ball. Reaching the ball upward during the crunch increases the lever arm, intensifying the demand on the rectus abdominis.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
双手持药球，双臂伸直举于胸前上方。
卷起上半身离地，将球垂直向上伸向天花板。
在顶端停顿并收紧腹肌。
缓慢回到起始姿势，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and place a medicine ball between your feet, gripping it with your ankles.
Extend your legs upward to hold the ball above your hips.
Curl your upper body off the ground and reach your hands toward the ball.
Tap the ball with your fingertips at the top of the crunch.
Lower back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball toe tap is an abdominal exercise that targets the upper and lower abs simultaneously. By holding a medicine ball between the feet and reaching to tap it at the top of the crunch, it creates a full-range core contraction.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双脚夹住药球，用脚踝固定。
双腿向上伸直，将球举于髋部上方。
卷起上半身离地，双手伸向球。
在卷腹顶端用指尖触碰球。
有控制地回到起始姿势，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet together holding a medicine ball at chest height with arms extended.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the ground.
At the bottom of the lunge, rotate your torso and the ball toward the front knee.
Return to center and step the back foot forward, entering the next lunge.
Continue walking forward, twisting at each lunge for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine ball walking lunge twist combines forward lunges with a rotational core movement to target the quadriceps, glutes, and obliques. It builds functional lower body strength and rotational core power in a dynamic walking pattern.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，双臂前伸，双手持药球于胸前。
一只脚向前迈成弓步，后膝向地面下压。
在弓步底部，将躯干和球转向前膝方向。
回到中间，后脚向前迈，进入下一次弓步。
持续向前行走，每次弓步时扭转，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a plank position with your hands on a medicine ball.
Maintain a straight body line and brace your core.
Lift one hand off the ball and reach it toward the opposite foot, rotating slightly through your torso.
Return your hand to the ball and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The medicine plank to toe tap combines a medicine ball plank with a rotational reach, targeting the abs and obliques. The movement challenges core stability and introduces a rotational element that increases the demand on the entire core.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑开始，双手放在药球上。
保持身体一条直线，收紧核心。
一只手离开球，伸向对侧脚，躯干略微旋转。
手回到球上，换另一侧重复。
持续交替，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both legs folded to one side, knees stacked and feet pointing behind you.
Place the hand closest to your feet on the floor for support.
Extend the opposite arm up and overhead, reaching toward the opposite side to create a lateral arc through the torso.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Return to the starting position, switch your leg position to the other side, and repeat the stretch.
description_en: The mermaid stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the obliques and lateral torso. Performed in a side-seated position with one arm reaching overhead, it creates a deep lateral stretch through the waist, lats, and hip flexors, improving spinal mobility and flexibility.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿折向一侧，膝盖叠放，双脚朝后。
靠近脚的手放在地板上支撑。
另一只手臂向上举过头顶，伸向对侧，使躯干形成侧向弧线。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒，平稳呼吸。
回到起始姿势，换另一侧腿的位置，重复拉伸。

instructions_en: Set a bench inside a smith machine and adjust the bar to shoulder height.
Sit on the bench and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and hold it at the front of your shoulders.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated military press on the smith machine is a shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids. The guided bar path of the smith machine allows for strict pressing form and heavy loading, building shoulder strength with additional safety.
instructions_zh: 在史密斯机内放置一张训练凳，将杠铃杆调至肩部高度。
坐在训练凳上，以略宽于肩的正握握住杠铃杆。
将杠铃杆从架上取下，保持在肩前位置。
向上推举杠铃杆，直至双臂完全伸展过头。
缓慢将杠铃杆降回起始位置，重复至目标次数。

name_zh: 改良超人式保持（腿贴地）
instructions_en: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended and your arms stretched overhead.
Keep your legs flat on the ground and focus on lifting only your chest and arms off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and engage your lower back muscles as you lift.
Hold the raised position for the desired duration.
Slowly lower your chest and arms back to the floor and repeat.
description_en: The modified superman hold with legs grounded is a beginner-friendly back strengthening exercise. By keeping the legs flat on the floor, the focus shifts entirely to the upper back and lower back extensors, reducing difficulty while still effectively targeting the posterior chain.
name_zh_llm: 改良超人式保持（腿贴地）
instructions_zh: 俯卧于地面，双腿伸直，双臂向前伸展过头。
保持双腿平贴地面，专注于仅将胸部和手臂抬离地面。
抬起时收紧臀肌并激活下背部肌肉。
在抬起位置保持目标时长。
缓慢将胸部和手臂降回地面，重复动作。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and drive your right knee toward your chest.
Quickly return your right foot to the starting position and simultaneously drive your left knee toward your chest.
Continue alternating legs at a fast, running-like pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: The mountain climber is a bodyweight cardio and core exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, quads, and hip flexors. It involves rapidly alternating knee drives in a plank position to challenge core stability, cardiovascular endurance, and overall conditioning.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑姿势开始，双手位于肩部正下方，身体呈一条直线。
收紧核心，将右膝向胸部方向驱动。
迅速将右脚回到起始位置，同时将左膝向胸部方向驱动。
以快速跑步般的节奏持续交替双腿。
重复至目标时长或次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders.
Drive your right knee toward your chest and hold it in the tucked position.
Keep your hips level and your core engaged throughout the hold.
Hold for the desired duration, then return the leg to the start and repeat on the left side.
Alternate legs as directed, focusing on maintaining a rigid plank position.
description_en: The mountain climber hold is an isometric variation of the mountain climber that involves holding the knee-to-chest position rather than alternating rapidly. This modification increases the time under tension for the abs and hip flexors while reinforcing plank stability.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑姿势开始，双手位于肩部正下方。
将右膝向胸部方向驱动，并保持在收膝位置。
在整个保持过程中保持髋部水平、核心收紧。
保持目标时长，然后将腿回到起始位置，换左侧重复。
按指示交替双腿，专注于保持稳固的平板支撑姿势。

instructions_en: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at shoulder height, arms fully extended.
Step your feet back until your body is in a slight incline, similar to a standing plank.
Drive one knee upward toward your chest while keeping the other foot planted.
Quickly alternate legs in a running motion against the wall.
Continue for the desired duration while keeping your core tight.
description_en: Mountain climber vertical is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abs in a standing incline position against a wall. The vertical variation reduces wrist pressure while maintaining the hip flexor and core engagement of the traditional mountain climber.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，双手放在墙上与肩同高，双臂完全伸展。
双脚向后迈步，使身体呈轻微倾斜，类似站立平板支撑。
将一侧膝盖向胸部方向驱动，另一只脚保持踩地。
靠墙以跑步动作快速交替双腿。
保持核心收紧，持续至目标时长。

instructions_en: Stand tall in mountain pose with your feet together, arms by your sides, and weight evenly distributed.
Inhale and raise your arms overhead, lengthening your spine.
Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, sweeping your arms down as you fold toward the floor.
Allow your hands to reach toward the floor or rest on your shins, keeping a slight bend in your knees if needed.
Inhale to rise back up to mountain pose with arms overhead and repeat the flow for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Mountain pose to forward fold flow is a bodyweight yoga movement targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the abs, lower back, and glutes. It transitions between a tall standing posture and a forward fold in coordination with the breath, promoting spinal mobility and posterior chain flexibility.
instructions_zh: 以山式站直，双脚并拢，双臂垂于体侧，重心均匀分布。
吸气，双臂举过头顶，拉长脊柱。
呼气，从髋部向前折叠，双臂向下扫过，向地面折叠。
双手伸向地面或放在小腿上，如有需要可保持膝盖微屈。
吸气回到山式，双臂过头，重复该流动动作至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart and arms resting at your sides.
Distribute your weight evenly across both feet and all four corners of each foot.
Engage your thighs slightly, lift your kneecaps, and lengthen your tailbone toward the floor.
Lift your chest, roll your shoulders back and down, and extend the crown of your head toward the ceiling.
Hold the pose for 30-60 seconds, breathing steadily, focusing on full-body alignment and awareness.
description_en: Mountain pose is the foundational standing yoga posture from which all other standing poses are built. It targets whole-body alignment and postural awareness, engaging the legs, core, and back to promote upright stability and grounding.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢或与髋同宽站立，双臂自然垂于体侧。
将重心均匀分布在双脚及每只脚的四个角上。
轻微收紧大腿，上提膝盖骨，尾骨向地面方向延伸。
上提胸腔，肩部向后向下卷，头顶向天花板方向延伸。
保持该姿势30-60秒，平稳呼吸，专注于全身对齐与觉察。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your spine straight and shoulders relaxed.
Open your mouth slightly and begin moving your jaw from side to side in a rapid, controlled motion.
Keep the movements small but quick, engaging the jaw muscles with each repetition.
Continue for 20–30 seconds.
Rest briefly, then repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: Move jaw fastly is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the masseter and temporalis muscles. It involves rapid lateral jaw movements to dynamically engage and strengthen the jaw muscles.
instructions_zh: 坐直，脊柱挺直，肩部放松。
微微张开嘴，开始以快速、可控的动作左右移动下颌。
保持动作幅度小而快速，每次重复都激活下颌肌肉。
短暂休息，然后重复至目标组数。

instructions_en: Position yourself on a hack squat machine with a narrow foot stance, feet together or close.
Toes should face forward or slightly outward.
Disengage the safety and lower the sled by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the footplate.
Drive through your heels to extend your legs back to the starting position without locking your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The narrow grip hack squat is a machine squat variation performed with feet close together, placing greater emphasis on the outer quadriceps. The restricted stance increases the VMO and lateral quad activation compared to a standard wide stance hack squat.
instructions_zh: 站在哈克深蹲机上，双脚窄距，并拢或靠近。
脚尖朝前或略微外展。
解除安全锁，屈膝下放踏板，直到大腿与踏板平行。
脚跟发力伸腿回到起始位置，膝盖不要锁死。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently roll your head in a full circular motion, moving to the right shoulder, then back, then left shoulder, then back to the chest.
Keep the movements slow and controlled throughout the full circle.
Repeat the circle in the opposite direction.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The neck circle is a bodyweight exercise targeting the neck muscles and sternocleidomastoid. It involves slow, controlled circular head rotations to improve neck mobility and release tension.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，肩膀放松。
慢慢低头，下巴靠近胸口。
轻柔地做头部全圈环绕，依次转向右肩、后方、左肩，再回到胸前。
整个环绕过程保持缓慢可控。
反方向重复环绕。
按目标次数继续。

instructions_en: Sit or stand with your spine tall and your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly drop your chin toward your chest.
Gently roll your head in a half arc from one shoulder toward the other, passing through the center.
Pause briefly on each side when your ear approaches your shoulder, feeling the stretch in your neck.
Return to center and repeat in the other direction for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Neck half circle is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the neck muscles, with secondary engagement of the traps. It involves rolling the head in a controlled half-circle motion to release tension along the cervical spine and improve neck mobility.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，脊柱挺直，肩膀放松。
慢慢低头，下巴靠近胸口。
轻柔地做头部半弧环绕，从一侧肩膀经过中间转向另一侧。
每侧耳朵靠近肩膀时稍作停顿，感受颈部拉伸。
回到中间，反方向重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Gently push your lower jaw forward and slightly upward to feel a stretch on the left side of the neck and jaw.
Hold the stretch for 10–15 seconds.
Return to the neutral position and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The neck jaw stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the neck and jaw muscles. It combines a lateral head tilt with a jaw protrusion to stretch the sternocleidomastoid and surrounding neck musculature.
instructions_zh: 坐直，背部挺直，肩膀放松。
头向右侧倾斜，右耳靠近右肩。
轻轻将下颌向前并略微向上推，感受左侧颈部和下颌的拉伸。
保持拉伸10–15秒。
回到中立位，换另一侧重复。
交替两侧至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended.
Place your arms flat at your sides.
Slowly raise your head off the mat, bringing your chin toward your chest.
Hold the lifted position for 5 seconds, engaging the neck muscles.
Slowly lower your head back to the mat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The neck lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the sternocleidomastoid and anterior neck muscles. It involves lifting the head while lying down to strengthen the muscles at the front of the neck.
instructions_zh: 仰卧在垫子上，双腿伸直。
双臂平放在身体两侧。
慢慢将头抬离垫子，下巴靠近胸口。
保持抬起姿势5秒，收紧颈部肌肉。
慢慢将头放回垫子。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: neck press hands on behind head
instructions_en: Sit or stand with your spine neutral and core engaged.
Place both hands behind your head, interlacing your fingers.
Press your head backward against your hands while your hands provide resistance.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5–10 seconds.
Release and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The neck press with hands behind the head is an isometric neck strengthening exercise targeting the posterior neck muscles. By pressing the head backward against the resisting hands, the neck extensors and upper trapezius are strengthened through an isometric contraction.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，脊柱中立，核心收紧。
双手放在脑后，手指交叉。
头向后压双手，双手提供阻力。
保持等长收缩5–10秒。
放松后按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine neutral.
Place one hand on the side of your head above the ear.
Press your head laterally against your hand while your hand resists.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5–10 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The neck press with hands is an isometric lateral neck strengthening exercise using hand resistance applied to the side of the head. Pressing the head sideways against resistance activates the lateral neck flexors and upper trapezius, improving cervical lateral strength.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，脊柱中立。
一只手放在头侧，耳朵上方。
头向手的方向侧压，手提供阻力。
保持等长收缩5–10秒。
放松后换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit or stand upright with your spine in a neutral position.
Place one hand against your forehead or temple.
Press your head in the direction of the hand while the hand provides resistance.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5–10 seconds.
Release, switch directions, and repeat.
description_en: The neck press with one hand is a unilateral isometric neck exercise using a single hand to provide resistance. Pressing the neck against one hand targets the neck muscles on the corresponding side, allowing focused strengthening of specific cervical muscle groups.
instructions_zh: 坐直或站直，脊柱保持中立。
一只手放在额头或太阳穴处。
头向手的方向按压，手提供阻力。
保持等长收缩5–10秒。
放松后换方向重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands placed behind your head, elbows wide.
Engage your core and slowly curl your head, neck, and upper body off the mat.
Continue rolling up until you are sitting upright, then hinge slightly forward from the hips.
Round your spine and slowly roll back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The neck pull is an advanced Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves a full roll-up from a supine position with hands clasped behind the head, demanding significant core strength, spinal articulation, and hamstring flexibility.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手置于脑后，肘部向外打开。
收紧核心，缓慢将头、颈和上背部卷离垫面。
继续向上卷起至坐姿，然后从髋部微微前倾。
弓起脊柱，有控制地缓慢滚回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
Place your palm flat against your forehead.
Press your head forward into your palm while resisting the movement with your hand.
Hold the isometric contraction for 5–10 seconds.
Release and repeat, alternating the hand placement to the back of the head and each side.
Perform the desired number of repetitions in each direction.
description_en: The neck resistance press is a bodyweight exercise targeting the neck muscles using isometric contraction. It involves pressing the head against the resistance of the hand in multiple directions to strengthen the neck.
instructions_zh: 坐直，背部挺直，肩膀放松。
将手掌平放在额头上。
头部向前压向手掌，同时用手抵抗该动作。
保持等长收缩5–10秒。
放松后重复，交替将手放在后脑勺和两侧。
每个方向按目标次数完成。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your back straight.
Tilt your head back until you are looking at the ceiling.
Open and close your mouth in a chewing motion while in this position, engaging the neck and chin muscles.
Continue for 20–30 seconds.
Return your head to the neutral position and rest briefly.
Repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The neck tightener is a bodyweight exercise targeting the platysma and neck muscles. It combines a head tilt with a chewing motion to tighten and tone the muscles along the front of the neck.
instructions_zh: 坐直，背部挺直。
将头向后仰，直到看向天花板。
在该位置做张嘴闭嘴的咀嚼动作，收紧颈部和下巴肌肉。
将头回到中立位置，短暂休息。
按目标组数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your shoulders relaxed and spine straight.
Slowly tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Hold the tilted position for 15–20 seconds, feeling the stretch on the left side of the neck.
Slowly return to the neutral position.
Repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The neck tilt hold is a bodyweight exercise targeting the neck and trapezius muscles. It involves holding a lateral neck tilt to stretch and lengthen the muscles on the side of the neck.
instructions_zh: 坐直，肩膀放松，脊柱挺直。
缓慢将头向右侧倾斜，使右耳靠近右肩。
保持倾斜姿势15–20秒，感受颈部左侧的拉伸。
缓慢回到中立位置。
在另一侧重复。
继续交替进行，按目标次数完成。

instructions_en: Use a box or jump to reach the top position of a pull-up, with your chin above the bar and arms bent.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly lower your body toward the starting hang position, taking 3-5 seconds to descend.
Maintain tension in your lats and arms throughout the descent, resisting gravity as much as possible.
Once fully extended, jump or step back to the top and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The negative pull up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, with secondary engagement of the biceps, traps, and rhomboids. It focuses on the eccentric lowering phase of the pull-up to build the back and arm strength required for a full pull-up.
instructions_zh: 使用箱子或跳跃到达引体向上的顶部位置，下巴高于横杆，手臂弯曲。
以正手握距、与肩同宽握住横杆。
缓慢将身体下放至起始悬垂位置，下降过程用3-5秒。
在整个下降过程中保持背阔肌和手臂的张力，尽可能抵抗重力。
完全伸展后，跳起或踩回顶部，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on a padded surface and secure your ankles under a fixed bar or have a partner hold them.
With your torso upright and arms crossed over your chest, slowly lower your body toward the floor by extending your knees.
Control the descent using your hamstrings as long as possible.
When you can no longer hold yourself, lower to the ground and use your hands to push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The nordic curl is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the hamstrings eccentrically. It is considered one of the most effective movements for hamstring strength and injury prevention, requiring significant eccentric control.
instructions_zh: 跪在软垫上，将脚踝固定在固定横杆下，或由同伴按住。
躯干保持直立，双臂交叉于胸前，通过伸展膝关节缓慢将身体向地面下放。
尽可能长时间用腘绳肌控制下降。
无法继续支撑时，下落到地面，用手撑回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Place your index finger on the tip of your nose, applying very light upward pressure.
Flex your nose downward using the muscles above the upper lip, working against your finger.
Hold the contracted position for 3–5 seconds.
Release and return to a neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Nose shortening is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the nasalis and muscles surrounding the nose. It involves pressing the nose tip upward with a finger while contracting the muscles downward to tone the nasal area.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
将食指放在鼻尖上，施加非常轻微向上的压力。
用上唇上方的肌肉将鼻子向下皱起，对抗手指。
保持收缩姿势3–5秒。
放松并回到中立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed and breathing normally.
Focus on the muscles around your nostrils and attempt to flare them outward.
Hold the flared position for 3–5 seconds.
Slowly contract the nostrils back inward as much as possible.
Hold the contracted position for 3–5 seconds.
Repeat the flare and contract cycle for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Nostril flare control is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the nasalis muscle. It involves alternating between flaring and contracting the nostrils to improve muscular control and tone the nose area.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松，正常呼吸。
专注于鼻孔周围的肌肉，尝试将鼻孔向外扩张。
保持扩张姿势3–5秒。
缓慢将鼻孔尽可能向内收缩。
保持收缩姿势3–5秒。
按目标次数重复扩张和收缩循环。

instructions_en: Begin in a wide push-up stance with one hand placed in the center of your chest and the other placed behind your back.
Engage your core tightly and keep your body in a rigid plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending the working arm, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press explosively back up to the starting position.
Complete the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description_en: One arm push ups are an advanced bodyweight exercise targeting the chest, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, upper arms, and abs. Performing the push-up on a single arm demands maximum chest and triceps strength, along with exceptional core stability to prevent rotation.
instructions_zh: 以宽距俯卧撑姿势开始，一只手放在胸口中央，另一只手放在背后。
收紧核心，保持身体呈刚性平板姿势。
弯曲工作臂，将胸口向地面下压，肘部贴近身体。
在底部稍作停顿，然后爆发性推回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换臂。

instructions_en: Stand or sit with a dumbbell in one hand, raised to shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Brace your core to stabilize your torso against the unilateral load.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height.
Complete the desired repetitions on one side before switching arms.
description_en: The one arm shoulder press is a unilateral dumbbell exercise targeting the deltoids and triceps. Pressing with one arm at a time requires significant core stabilization to resist lateral lean, making it effective for addressing shoulder strength imbalances.
instructions_zh: 站立或坐姿，一只手握哑铃举至肩高，掌心朝前。
收紧核心以稳定躯干，对抗单侧负重。
将哑铃垂直向上推举至手臂完全伸直。
在顶部停顿，然后缓慢将哑铃降回肩高。
一侧完成目标次数后换臂。

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position and widen your feet for extra stability.
Place one hand on the floor beneath your shoulder and place the other hand behind your back.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your working elbow.
Keep your body as square as possible throughout the movement.
Press back up to the starting position.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.
description_en: The one hand push-up is an elite bodyweight exercise targeting the pectorals and triceps with maximum load on a single arm. It requires exceptional upper body strength, core stability, and balance to perform with proper form.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双脚分开以增加稳定性。
一只手放在肩部正下方的地面上，另一只手放在背后。
弯曲工作肘部，将胸口向地面下压。
整个动作过程中尽量保持身体方正。
推回起始位置。
完成目标次数后换臂。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position and place one hand behind your back, balancing on the other hand with feet spread wide.
Engage your core and keep your hips square to the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending the working elbow.
Press back up to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: One Hand Push Ups is an advanced bodyweight strength exercise targeting the pectorals. Performing a push-up on a single arm demands exceptional unilateral chest and shoulder strength, core stability, and body control.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，一只手放在背后，靠另一只手支撑，双脚大幅分开。
收紧核心，保持髋部与地面平行。
弯曲工作肘部，将胸口向地面下压。
推回起始位置。
一侧完成所有次数后换边。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet together.
Shift your weight onto one foot and slowly lift the opposite foot off the ground.
Balance on the standing leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hold the balance position for 20-30 seconds, keeping your core engaged.
Lower the raised foot and repeat on the other side.
description_en: One leg balance is a bodyweight exercise targeting the calves and lower leg stabilizers. Balancing on a single leg challenges proprioception, ankle stability, and neuromuscular coordination throughout the leg and core.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢直立站立。
将重心移到一只脚上，缓慢抬起另一只脚离开地面。
用支撑腿保持平衡，膝盖微屈。
保持平衡姿势20-30秒，核心持续收紧。
放下抬起的脚，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Set the Smith machine bar to hip height and stand facing it on one leg.
Grip the bar with both hands and hinge forward at the hip, extending the lifted leg behind you.
Lower the bar by hinging until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground.
Drive through your planted heel to return to the standing position.
Complete the desired repetitions on one leg before switching sides.
description_en: The one leg deadlift on a Smith machine is a single-leg hip hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings and glutes. The fixed bar path of the Smith machine provides stability, making this exercise accessible for developing unilateral posterior chain strength.
instructions_zh: 将史密斯机杠铃调至髋部高度，单腿面向杠铃站立。
双手握住杠铃，以髋部为轴前倾，同时将抬起腿向后伸展。
继续以髋部为轴下放杠铃，直到躯干接近与地面平行。
通过支撑脚脚跟发力回到站立位置。
一条腿完成目标次数后换边。

instructions_en: Set up on a leg press machine with only your upper back supported and one foot on the lower portion of the platform.
Extend the non-working leg out or rest it on the platform.
Drive through the heel of the working foot to thrust your hips upward.
Squeeze your glute at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your hips and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching legs.
description_en: The one leg hip thrust on a leg press is a unilateral glute exercise that adapts the hip thrust to a leg press machine. Performing the movement with a single leg increases the glute load and helps address strength imbalances between sides.
instructions_zh: 在腿举机上设置好，仅上背部有支撑，一只脚踩在踏板下部分。
非工作腿伸直或搁在踏板上。
通过工作脚脚跟发力，将髋部向上推。
在动作顶部收紧臀肌。
缓慢下放髋部，重复目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended slightly in front of you.
Bend the standing knee and lower your hips toward the floor.
Keep your chest upright and your core engaged throughout.
Lower as far as your strength and mobility allow.
Drive through the standing heel to return to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: The one leg squat is a demanding unilateral bodyweight exercise that targets the quads, glutes, and hamstrings on a single leg. It requires significant leg strength, core stability, and balance, and is a key exercise for identifying and addressing lower body strength imbalances.
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，另一条腿略微向前伸展。
弯曲支撑膝，将髋部向地面下压。
全程保持胸部挺直、核心收紧。
在力量和灵活性允许的范围内尽量下蹲。
通过支撑脚脚跟发力回到起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wide apart, approximately three to four feet, and turn your right foot out 90 degrees.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Hinge laterally over your front leg, lowering your right hand toward your right shin or the floor.
Extend your left arm toward the ceiling and rotate your gaze upward to open your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Open chest triangle pose detail is a bodyweight yoga exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary engagement of the hamstrings, obliques, and lower back. It involves a lateral bend over an extended leg while rotating the chest open, improving hamstring flexibility, lateral stability, and thoracic rotation.
instructions_zh: 双脚大幅分开站立，约三到四英尺，右脚向外转90度。
双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
向侧方屈髋越过前腿，右手向下伸向右小腿或地面。
左臂向天花板伸展，目光向上转动以打开胸腔。
保持20-30秒，然后回到站立姿势，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and your head resting on your bottom arm.
Engage your core and keep your hips stacked.
Slowly raise your top leg as high as comfortable without rotating your hip.
Pause at the top, then lower your leg with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description_en: The outer thigh lift is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hip abductors and glutes. Performed side-lying, it involves lifting the top leg to work the outer thigh and lateral hip, improving hip stability and lower body alignment.
instructions_zh: 侧卧，身体呈一条直线，头枕在下方手臂上。
收紧核心，保持髋部叠放。
慢慢将上方腿抬至舒适的最高位置，不要旋转髋部。
在顶部停顿，然后有控制地放下腿。
重复所需次数，然后换另一侧。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor with your torso upright and your core engaged.
Place one hand behind your head and the opposite hand behind your lower back.
Simultaneously extend both arms outward to your sides, straightening your elbows.
Sweep your arms to reverse the position, placing the opposite hand behind your head and the other behind your lower back.
Continue alternating this over-and-under motion smoothly for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The over under is a bodyweight agility and core exercise targeting the obliques through lateral bending and rotation. Ducking alternately to each side challenges lateral core strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_zh: 跪在地面上，躯干直立，收紧核心。
一只手放在脑后，另一只手放在下背部。
同时将双臂向两侧伸展，伸直肘部。
双臂扫动交换位置，将另一只手放在脑后，另一只手放在下背部。
继续流畅地交替此上下动作，完成所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand or sit upright and hold a single dumbbell with both hands, gripping the top plate.
Raise the dumbbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head and elbows pointing forward, lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Pause at the bottom, then extend your arms back to the starting position by contracting your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The overhead dumbbell triceps extension is an upper arm exercise targeting the triceps. Performed with a single dumbbell held overhead, it stretches the long head of the tricep for maximum engagement and builds arm extension strength.
instructions_zh: 直立站立或坐姿，双手握住一只哑铃，握住上端配重片。
将哑铃举过头顶，直至双臂完全伸直。
保持上臂靠近头部、肘部朝前，将哑铃降至头后。
在底部停顿，然后收缩肱三头肌将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell or plate overhead with both arms fully extended.
Stand with feet together and brace your core.
Step forward with one foot and lower your hips until both knees are at 90 degrees.
Drive through your front heel to take the next step forward, lunging continuously.
Maintain the overhead lockout position throughout all repetitions.
description_en: Overhead walking lunges are a dumbbell unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Holding weight overhead increases core stability demand and challenges shoulder endurance alongside lower body strength through continuous movement.
instructions_zh: 双臂完全伸直，将哑铃或杠片举过头顶。
双脚并拢站立，收紧核心。
一只脚向前迈步，降低髋部直至双膝均呈90度。
前脚跟发力迈出下一步，连续进行弓步。
在所有重复中保持过顶锁定位置。

instructions_en: Set up parallettes on the floor and assume a push-up position gripping the handles.
Keep your body in a straight line and engage your core.
Lower your chest below the level of the handles by bending your elbows.
Pause at the bottom with a deep range of motion.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The parallettes push-up is an advanced bodyweight chest exercise using raised handles that allow the chest to descend below the floor level. The increased range of motion creates a deeper stretch of the pectorals and greater muscle activation than a standard push-up.
instructions_zh: 在地面上放置双杠架，握住把手呈俯卧撑姿势。
保持身体呈一条直线，收紧核心。
弯曲肘部，将胸部降至把手水平以下。
在底部停顿，保持大幅活动范围。
推回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so your arms are parallel to the floor.
Place your forearms against the arm pads or grip the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Press the arm pads together in front of your chest by contracting your pectoral muscles.
Pause at the peak of the contraction and squeeze your chest.
Slowly allow the arm pads to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pec deck machine fly is a machine exercise targeting the chest. The guided range of motion isolates the pectoral muscles and maintains constant tension throughout, making it effective for chest development with reduced risk of shoulder strain.
instructions_zh: 坐在蝴蝶机上调好座椅，使手臂与地面平行。
将前臂贴在臂垫上，或握住把手使肘部弯曲90度。
收缩胸肌，将臂垫在胸前合拢。
在收缩顶峰停顿并挤压胸部。
缓慢让臂垫回到起始位置，重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the mat, hip-width apart.
Engage your core and gently press your lower back into the mat.
Exhale and peel your spine off the mat one vertebra at a time, beginning with your tailbone.
Continue lifting until your hips are fully elevated and your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Slowly roll back down through your spine, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pelvic curl, also known as the glute bridge, is a fundamental Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the gluteal muscles and hamstrings. It involves peeling the spine off the mat with articulation, strengthening the posterior chain while developing spinal mobility and core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放在垫子上，与髋同宽。
收紧核心，轻轻将下背部压向垫子。
呼气，从尾骨开始逐节将脊柱卷离垫子。
继续抬起直至髋部完全抬高，身体从肩到膝呈一条直线。
缓慢沿脊柱逐节滚回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Flatten your lower back against the floor by tightening your abdominal muscles and tilting your pelvis slightly upward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, keeping your glutes relaxed.
Release and allow your lower back to return to its natural arch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pelvic tilt is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and lower back. This gentle movement is commonly used to reduce lower back pain, improve lumbopelvic stability, and develop core awareness.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
收紧腹部肌肉，骨盆微微向上倾，使下背部贴平地面。
保持该姿势数秒，臀部保持放松。
放松，让下背部恢复自然弧度。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand over a barbell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge forward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip at shoulder-width with arms fully extended.
From a dead stop, explosively row the barbell to your lower chest.
Lower the barbell completely back to the floor between each repetition.
Reset your position, then pull again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pendlay row is a strict barbell row variation where the bar returns to the floor between each repetition, eliminating momentum. This dead-stop technique demands greater power and full lat engagement on each pull, making it highly effective for back strength development.
instructions_zh: 站在杠铃上方，双脚与肩同宽，屈髋前倾至躯干与地面平行。
以正握、与肩同宽的握距握住杠铃，双臂完全伸直。
从完全静止开始，爆发性地将杠铃拉向下胸部。
每次重复之间将杠铃完全放回地面。
重新调整姿势，再次上拉。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Step into the pendulum squat machine and position your shoulders under the pads.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart on the platform and release the safety.
Descend by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, lowering through a full range of motion.
Drive through your heels to push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pendulum squat is a machine-based exercise targeting the quadriceps through a swinging arc motion. The pendulum mechanism reduces spinal compression while allowing a deep range of motion, making it effective for quad development.
instructions_zh: 踏入钟摆深蹲机，将肩膀置于垫下方。
双脚与肩同宽站在踏板上，解除安全锁。
屈膝并向后推髋下蹲，完成全幅度下放。
通过脚跟发力，推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position and bring one knee forward, placing it behind your wrist.
Allow the shin to rest at an angle across the mat and extend the opposite leg straight back.
Lower your hips toward the floor and sink into the stretch.
Hold for 30–60 seconds, feeling the stretch deep in the glute of the front leg.
Return to plank and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The pigeon pose hips stretch version is a yoga-inspired bodyweight exercise that delivers a deep stretch to the glutes and external hip rotators. By crossing one leg forward and sinking the hips toward the floor, the piriformis and glute complex are targeted for improved hip flexibility.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板支撑开始，将一侧膝盖向前移至手腕后方。
让小腿斜放在垫上，另一条腿向后伸直。
将髋部向地面下沉，进入拉伸。
保持30–60秒，感受前侧腿臀部的深度拉伸。
回到平板支撑，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet in toward your hands, raising your hips high to form an inverted V shape.
Keep your arms straight and press through your palms.
Hold the pike position for the desired duration.
Walk your feet back to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: Pike Plank Hold is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the deltoids. Holding the inverted V position places sustained load on the shoulders and upper back, making it an effective movement for building shoulder endurance and preparing for handstand training.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手与肩同宽。
双脚向双手方向走近，抬高髋部形成倒V形。
保持手臂伸直，通过手掌发力。
保持折体姿势至目标时长。
双脚走回起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Start in a downward dog position with your hips raised high and body forming an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push back up to the starting downward dog position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pike push-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the deltoids in a vertical pressing pattern. The elevated hip position shifts the load away from the chest and onto the shoulders, making it an effective progression toward handstand push-ups.
instructions_zh: 从下犬式开始，髋部抬高，身体形成倒V形。
屈肘，将头顶向地面下放。
推回起始下犬式位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a downward dog position with your hands shoulder-width apart and hips raised toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and keep your legs straight throughout the movement.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Pike push ups are a bodyweight exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the upper arms, traps, and chest. Performed in an inverted V-position, the angled pressing motion places the primary load on the shoulders, making this an effective progression toward the handstand push-up.
instructions_zh: 从下犬式开始，双手与肩同宽，髋部向天花板抬高。
收紧核心，整个动作过程中保持双腿伸直。
屈肘，将头顶向双手之间的地面下放。
在底部稍作停顿，然后通过手掌发力回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a pilates or stability ball with feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Walk your feet forward and lean back until your lower back is supported by the ball.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows pointed out.
Engage your core and curl your upper body off the ball into a crunch or full sit-up.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pilates ball sit up is a medicine ball core exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. Performing the sit-up on an unstable ball surface increases core activation and also develops balance and spinal stabilizer engagement.
instructions_zh: 坐在普拉提球或稳定球上，双脚平放于地面，与髋同宽。
双脚向前走，身体后仰，直到下背部由球支撑。
双手置于头后，肘部向外。
收紧核心，将上身卷离球做卷腹或完整仰卧起坐。
缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the mat.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, creating a figure-four shape.
Flex your right foot to protect the knee.
Gently press your right knee away from your body, or draw both legs toward your chest.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling the release in the outer hip and glute.
Switch sides and repeat.
description_en: The piriformis stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deep gluteal muscles, particularly the piriformis. Performed supine in a figure-four position, it releases tension in the outer hip, reducing tightness that can contribute to sciatic discomfort.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双膝弯曲，双脚平放于垫上。
将右脚踝交叉放在左膝上，形成4字形。
勾起右脚以保护膝盖。
轻轻将右膝向外侧压，或将双腿拉向胸口。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受外侧髋部和臀部的放松。
换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left thigh, flexing your right foot.
Lift your left foot off the floor and draw both legs toward your chest.
Interlace your hands behind your left thigh and gently pull your legs closer to your torso.
Hold the stretch for 30-60 seconds, then release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Piriformis relief is a supine yoga and rehabilitation posture that targets the glutes and piriformis muscle to alleviate tension and sciatic discomfort. It involves the figure-four position while drawing the legs toward the chest to create a deep external hip rotation stretch.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲，双脚平放于地面。
将右脚踝交叉放在左大腿上，勾起右脚。
将左脚抬离地面，双腿拉向胸口。
双手交叉放在左大腿后方，轻轻将双腿拉向躯干。
保持拉伸30-60秒，然后放松并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended straight out in front of you.
Extend your arms forward for counterbalance.
Slowly lower your body toward the floor by bending your standing knee, keeping your extended leg off the ground.
Descend as deep as possible while maintaining control, ideally until your standing thigh is parallel to or below the floor.
Drive through your heel to return to the starting position and repeat, then switch legs.
description_en: The pistol squat is an advanced bodyweight exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and abs. It is a single-leg squat performed to full depth while the opposite leg is held straight out, demanding exceptional unilateral strength, balance, and ankle flexibility.
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，另一条腿向前伸直。
双臂前伸以保持平衡。
弯曲支撑腿，缓慢下蹲，保持伸出的腿离地。
在保持控制的情况下尽可能下蹲，理想情况下支撑腿大腿与地面平行或低于地面。
通过脚跟发力回到起始位置并重复，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a pole, doorframe, or TRX strap with one hand gripping it for support.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you and shift your weight onto the opposite leg.
Slowly lower into a single-leg squat, using the pole to assist balance and reduce load as needed.
Descend until your thigh is parallel to or below the floor, then drive through your heel to rise.
Complete the desired number of repetitions and switch legs.
description_en: Pistol squats with poll support are a bodyweight exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and abs. Using a support for balance allows the athlete to practice the full pistol squat range of motion while progressively building the strength and coordination needed for the unsupported version.
instructions_zh: 站在柱子、门框或TRX带前，一只手抓住以提供支撑。
一条腿向前伸直，将重心移到另一条腿上。
缓慢下蹲成单腿深蹲，根据需要借助柱子辅助平衡并减轻负荷。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或低于地面，然后通过脚跟发力起身。
完成目标次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Begin jogging in place by alternating lifting each foot off the ground.
Maintain a light, bouncy rhythm on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms naturally to match your leg movement.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: Place jogging is a simple cardio exercise performed in a stationary position. It elevates the heart rate and warms up the lower body by simulating the movement pattern of running without requiring space or equipment.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立。
开始原地慢跑，交替将每只脚抬离地面。
以前脚掌保持轻盈有弹性的节奏。
自然摆臂，与腿部动作配合。
持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides.
Begin jogging in place at a comfortable pace, lifting your feet a few inches off the floor with each stride.
Pump your arms naturally in coordination with your legs.
Maintain an upright posture with your core lightly engaged and eyes forward.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: Place jog cardio is a bodyweight cardiovascular exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the hamstrings, glutes, and lower legs. It involves jogging in place as a low-impact way to elevate heart rate, warm up the lower body, or maintain active recovery.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双臂自然垂于体侧。
以舒适的速度开始原地慢跑，每一步将脚抬离地面几英寸。
自然摆臂，与腿部协调配合。
保持上身直立，核心轻微收紧，目视前方。
持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Begin face down on the floor and prop yourself up on your forearms with elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Lift your hips off the floor so your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your hips level throughout.
Hold the position while breathing steadily for the desired duration.
Lower your knees to the floor to release.
description_en: The plank is a foundational bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, lower back, and glutes. It involves maintaining a rigid straight-body position on the forearms to build core endurance, spinal stability, and full-body tension.
instructions_zh: 面朝下趴在地面上，用前臂撑起身体，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
将臀部抬离地面，使身体从头到脚跟呈一条直线。
收紧核心，夹紧臀部，全程保持臀部水平。
保持姿势并平稳呼吸，持续目标时长。
膝盖着地以退出动作。

instructions_en: Start in a plank position with your hands on the ground and a medicine ball placed just outside one hand.
Reach one hand across your body and tap or slap the ball, then return to the plank.
Alternate hands, tapping the ball from each side while maintaining a rigid plank position.
Avoid rotating your hips as you reach across.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank ball slap is a core anti-rotation exercise that challenges the abdominals and obliques by requiring you to maintain a stable plank while reaching across the body to tap a medicine ball. It develops core stability, shoulder strength, and coordination.
instructions_zh: 从平板支撑姿势开始，双手撑地，一只手的旁边放置一个药球。
一只手伸向身体对侧拍击药球，然后回到平板支撑。
双手交替，从两侧拍击药球，同时保持平板支撑稳定。
伸手时避免臀部旋转。
持续目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with hands beneath your shoulders.
Push your hips upward and back to transition into a downward dog position.
Hold the downward dog for 2-3 seconds, pressing your chest toward your thighs.
Return your hips back down to the high plank position.
Repeat the transition for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank downward dog is a bodyweight exercise that alternates between a high plank and a downward dog. It targets the core in the plank phase and stretches the posterior chain in the downward dog phase, building both strength and mobility.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀正下方。
将臀部向上向后推，过渡到下犬式姿势。
保持下犬式2-3秒，胸部向大腿方向压。
将臀部放回高平板支撑位置。
按目标次数重复该过渡动作。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with a dumbbell on the ground just outside one hand.
Reach the opposite hand under your torso and drag the dumbbell to the other side.
Return to the plank position and repeat with the other hand dragging the dumbbell back.
Maintain a rigid, level plank throughout the movement and avoid swaying your hips.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank dumbbell drag is a core stability exercise that challenges the abs and obliques to resist rotation while pulling a dumbbell from side to side. It develops anti-rotation strength, shoulder stability, and full core engagement.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，一只手的侧前方地面放一个哑铃。
对侧手伸到躯干下方，将哑铃拖到另一侧。
回到平板支撑位置，换另一只手将哑铃拖回。
整个动作保持平板支撑稳定水平，避免臀部晃动。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows beneath your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your hips to the right, dipping toward the floor.
Return to the center plank position before dipping your hips to the left.
Continue alternating sides in a smooth, controlled motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
description_en: The plank hip dip is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the abs and obliques through controlled lateral hip rotation. Performed from the forearm plank position, it adds rotational challenge to standard plank stability, increasing oblique activation.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方，身体成一条直线。
收紧核心，缓慢将臀部向右侧旋转，向地面下沉。
回到中间平板支撑位置，再将臀部向左侧下沉。
以平稳可控的动作继续左右交替。
按目标次数或时间重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down and lift your body onto your forearms and toes, keeping your elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Engage your core and maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your hips level and avoid letting them sag or pike upward.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Rest and repeat as needed.
description_en: Plank Hold on Elbow is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. The forearm plank distributes load across the core and reduces wrist strain compared to a high plank, making it a foundational core endurance exercise.
instructions_zh: 俯卧，将身体撑在前臂和脚尖上，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，保持从头到脚跟成一条直线。
保持臀部水平，避免下塌或上翘。
保持该姿势至目标时间，同时平稳呼吸。
休息后按需重复。

instructions_en: Place a weight plate on your upper back and assume a forearm plank position with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, engaging your core and glutes.
Maintain a neutral spine and avoid letting your hips sag or rise.
Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily.
Carefully remove the weight and rest before repeating.
description_en: The weighted plank hold is a bodyweight-based core exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, with secondary engagement of the lower back, shoulders, and glutes. Adding weight increases the demand on the core, making it an advanced progression of the standard plank.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃片放在上背部，进入前臂平板支撑，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
保持从头到脚跟成一条直线，收紧核心和臀肌。
保持脊柱中立，避免臀部下塌或抬起。
保持该姿势至目标时间，同时平稳呼吸。
小心取下负重，休息后重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a full push-up plank position with arms extended and hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and maintain a straight body line.
Bring both hands together beneath your chest, touching palms or fingertips.
Hold briefly, then return your hands to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Hold With Hand Join is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. The brief hand-joining motion challenges shoulder stability and core anti-rotation strength while maintaining the plank position.
instructions_zh: 从完整俯卧撑平板支撑开始，手臂伸直，双手与肩同宽。
收紧核心，保持身体成一条直线。
将双手在胸下合拢，掌心或指尖相触。
短暂保持，然后将双手回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows directly under your shoulders.
Keeping your shoulders square, rotate your hips and lower them to one side toward the floor.
Stop before your hip touches the ground, then rotate to the opposite side.
Continue alternating twists in a controlled and rhythmic manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank hold with hips twist is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the obliques. The lateral hip rotation from a forearm plank challenges rotational core strength while maintaining overall plank stability.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
保持肩膀方正，旋转臀部并向一侧下沉至地面方向。
在臀部触地前停住，然后旋转到另一侧。
以可控且有节奏的方式继续交替扭转。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: Plank Hold With One Hand and Leg Lift
name_zh: 平板支撑单手单腿抬起
instructions_en: Begin in a full plank position with arms extended.
Simultaneously lift one arm off the ground and the opposite leg, extending both straight.
Hold the extended position briefly while keeping your hips level.
Lower back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Hold With One Hand and Leg Lift is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and glutes. The simultaneous arm and opposite leg lift significantly challenges core anti-rotation stability and posterior chain engagement.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑单手单腿抬起
instructions_zh: 从完整平板支撑开始，手臂伸直。
同时抬起一只手臂和对侧腿，两者均伸直。
短暂保持伸展姿势，同时保持臀部水平。
回到起始位置，换对侧重复。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a forearm or high plank position with your core engaged and body in a straight line.
Jump both feet outward to a wide stance, then jump them back to the starting position.
Maintain a stable plank with your hips level throughout the movement.
Move at a consistent pace for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
description_en: The plank in out is a dynamic core exercise that adds a jumping component to a standard plank by moving the feet in and out. It targets the abdominals and hip flexors while elevating the heart rate and improving core stability under movement.
instructions_zh: 从前臂或高位平板支撑开始，收紧核心，身体保持一条直线。
双脚同时向外跳开至宽站距，然后跳回起始位置。
整个动作过程中保持平板支撑稳定，髋部保持水平。
以稳定的节奏完成目标次数或时长。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm or high plank position with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and keep your hips stable throughout.
Jump both feet out to the sides simultaneously, landing wider than hip-width apart.
Immediately jump both feet back together to the starting position.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions at a controlled pace.
description_en: The plank jack is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, glutes, and lower legs. It combines the stability demands of a plank with a lateral jumping motion of the feet to add a cardiovascular component while training core endurance.
instructions_zh: 从前臂或高位平板支撑开始，身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
收紧核心，全程保持髋部稳定。
双脚同时向两侧跳开，落地时宽于髋部。
立即双脚跳回并拢至起始位置。
以可控节奏持续完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and keep your hips level throughout the movement.
Explosively jump both feet outward wider than hip-width apart, then jump them back together.
Perform the movement at maximum speed while maintaining a stable plank position.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
description_en: Plank jack advanced is a bodyweight cardio and core exercise targeting the abs, with secondary engagement of the shoulders, glutes, and lower legs. It involves rapidly jumping the feet in and out while holding a plank position, increasing the intensity and cardiovascular demand of the standard plank jack.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手位于肩部正下方，身体保持一条直线。
收紧核心，整个动作过程中保持髋部水平。
爆发性双脚向外跳开至宽于髋部，然后跳回并拢。
在保持平板支撑稳定的同时以最快速度完成动作。
持续完成目标次数或时长。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and jump both feet out wider than hip-width.
Immediately jump your feet back together.
Continue the in-and-out jumping motion at a controlled pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
