description_en: The plank jack modification is a cardio and core exercise that combines the stability demands of a plank with the heart rate elevation of a jumping jack. By keeping the upper body fixed, it targets the shoulders and abs while conditioning the lower body.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手位于肩部下方，身体保持一条直线。
收紧核心，双脚向外跳开至宽于髋部。
立即双脚跳回并拢。
以可控节奏持续进行开合跳动作。
重复完成目标次数或时长。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and body forming a straight line.
Keeping your core braced, jump both feet out wide simultaneously.
Jump your feet back together.
Continue the jumping jack motion with your legs while maintaining the plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
description_en: Plank jacks are a bodyweight exercise that combines the core stability demand of a plank with the cardiovascular challenge of a jumping jack. This movement targets the abdominal muscles while elevating heart rate.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板支撑开始，双手位于肩部下方，身体保持一条直线。
保持核心收紧，双脚同时向外跳开。
双脚跳回并拢。
保持平板支撑姿势，双腿持续进行开合跳动作。
重复完成目标次数或时长。

instructions_en: Begin in a full plank position with arms extended and hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and draw one knee toward your chest in a controlled motion.
Hold briefly, then extend the leg back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Knee To Chest is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. The slow, controlled knee drive from the plank position dynamically engages the core while maintaining upper body stability.
instructions_zh: 从完整平板支撑开始，手臂伸直，双手与肩同宽。
收紧核心，以可控动作将一侧膝盖拉向胸部。
短暂保持，然后将腿伸回起始位置。
换另一条腿重复。
持续交替双腿完成目标次数。

name_en: Plank Knee To Elbow Hip Up
name_zh: 平板支撑提膝至肘髋上顶
instructions_en: Begin in a full plank position with arms extended.
Simultaneously raise your hips slightly and drive one knee diagonally toward the same-side elbow.
Hold briefly, engaging your obliques.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Knee To Elbow Hip Up is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the obliques. The combination of a hip rise and same-side knee drive from the plank position intensely engages the lateral core and requires dynamic stability.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑提膝至肘髋上顶
instructions_zh: 从完整平板支撑开始，手臂伸直。
同时略微抬高髋部，将对侧膝盖斜向拉向同侧手肘。
短暂保持，收紧腹斜肌。
返回起始位置，换另一侧重复。
持续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line.
Engage your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one leg off the mat and open it out to the side as far as comfortable.
Hold for a moment, then return the leg to the starting position.
Repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank leg open is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and glutes. Performed from a forearm plank, it involves lifting and opening each leg to the side, challenging core stability and hip abductor strength.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑开始，手肘位于肩部下方，身体保持一条直线。
收紧核心，保持髋部水平。
将一条腿抬离垫面，尽可能舒适地向侧方打开。
短暂保持，然后将腿返回起始位置。
换对侧重复。
持续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin on your hands and knees, then walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Place your hands directly under your shoulders with fingers spread wide.
Engage your core by drawing your navel toward your spine and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by gazing at the floor slightly in front of your hands.
Hold the position for 30-60 seconds, breathing steadily, then lower your knees to the mat.
description_en: Plank pose is a foundational yoga and fitness posture that isometrically targets the abdominal muscles and core stabilizers. It involves holding a push-up position with a straight body line, building strength and endurance in the core, shoulders, and glutes.
instructions_zh: 从手膝跪姿开始，双脚向后走，直到身体从头到脚跟成一条直线。
双手置于肩膀正下方，手指张开。
收紧核心，肚脐向脊柱方向收，同时夹紧臀部。
保持颈部中立，目光看向双手前方地面。
保持30-60秒，平稳呼吸，然后膝盖落回垫上。

name_en: plank pose sliding around the kettlebell
instructions_en: Place a kettlebell on the floor and start in a high plank position with the kettlebell to one side.
Move your body in a circular pattern around the kettlebell by stepping your hands and feet alternately.
Complete a full circle around the kettlebell while maintaining a plank.
Reverse direction and circle back to the starting position.
Continue for the desired number of circles.
description_en: The plank pose sliding around the kettlebell is a dynamic core challenge that requires moving the entire body in a plank around a stationary kettlebell. It targets the abs and obliques while demanding significant shoulder stability and full-body coordination.
instructions_zh: 将壶铃放在地上，从高平板姿势开始，壶铃位于身体一侧。
双手和双脚交替移动，围绕壶铃做圆周运动。
在保持平板姿势的同时绕壶铃完成一整圈。
反方向绕回起始位置。
继续完成目标圈数。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows beneath your shoulders.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, transitioning to a full push-up plank.
Lower back down to one forearm, then the other, returning to the elbow plank.
Alternate the leading arm with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Push Up Elbow is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs and shoulders. Transitioning between the forearm and full plank positions builds core stability, shoulder strength, and muscular endurance.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板姿势开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
先撑起一只手，再撑起另一只手，过渡到完整俯卧撑平板。
先放下一侧前臂，再放下另一侧，回到肘撑平板。
每次重复交替领先手臂。
继续完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a full plank position with arms extended.
While keeping your hips level, slowly extend one arm directly in front of you at shoulder height.
Hold the reached position briefly, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank Reach is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. The single-arm extension from the plank position challenges core anti-rotation stability and shoulder girdle control.
instructions_zh: 从完整平板姿势开始，双臂伸直。
保持髋部水平，慢慢将一只手臂向前伸直至肩高。
在伸展位置短暂保持，然后回到起始位置。
换另一侧重复。
继续交替手臂完成目标次数。

name_zh: 平板支撑单臂哑铃臂屈伸
instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with one hand on a dumbbell and the other flat on the ground.
From the plank, perform a triceps kickback by bending the elbow of the dumbbell arm to 90 degrees.
Extend the dumbbell back by straightening your elbow until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Slowly return the dumbbell to the bent position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching arms.
description_en: The plank single arm dumbbell triceps exercise combines a plank hold with a one-arm triceps kickback, targeting the triceps while requiring the core and shoulders to stabilize the plank position. It is an effective way to train the triceps with added core challenge.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑单臂哑铃臂屈伸
instructions_zh: 从高平板姿势开始，一只手撑在哑铃上，另一只手平放地面。
从平板姿势做三头肌后踢，将持哑铃手臂的肘部弯曲至90度。
伸直肘部将哑铃向后伸展，直到手臂与地面平行。
慢慢将哑铃回到弯曲位置。
一侧完成所有次数后换手。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift one hand off the ground and rotate your torso, opening your chest toward the ceiling.
Extend the raised arm straight up so your body forms a T shape.
Hold for a moment, then return to the plank and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank T twist is a rotational core exercise that targets the obliques by rotating from a plank position into a side plank T shape. It challenges spinal rotation, shoulder stability, and full core strength with each alternating twist.
instructions_zh: 从高平板姿势开始，双手与肩同宽。
抬起一只手离开地面，旋转躯干，胸部朝向天花板打开。
将抬起的手臂笔直向上伸，使身体呈T形。
短暂保持，然后回到平板姿势，换另一侧重复。
继续交替两侧完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Push your hips up and back into a downward dog position, forming an inverted V shape.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen through your spine.
Pause at the top, feeling the stretch through your back and hamstrings.
Return to the plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank to downward dog is a bodyweight mobility and strength exercise that transitions between a plank and an inverted V position. It stretches the lower back and hamstrings while strengthening the shoulders and core through the transition.
instructions_zh: 从高平板姿势开始，双手位于肩膀下方，身体成一条直线。
将髋部向上向后推，进入下犬式，形成倒V形。
脚跟向地面压，拉长脊柱。
在顶部停顿，感受背部和腘绳肌的拉伸。
回到平板姿势。
重复目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank with elbows directly under your shoulders.
Press up with one hand, then the other, to transition into a full push-up position.
Perform one push-up, then lower back down to one forearm, then the other, returning to the elbow plank.
Alternate the leading arm each round.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank To Push-Ups is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs, chest, and shoulders. This dynamic movement combines the core endurance of a plank with a full push-up, building both upper body strength and core stability.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
先撑起一只手，再撑起另一只手，过渡到完整俯卧撑姿势。
做一个俯卧撑，然后先放下一侧前臂，再放下另一侧，回到肘撑平板。
每轮交替领先手臂。
继续完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with your elbows beneath your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Engage your core and rotate your hips to one side, lowering them toward the ground.
Pause just before touching the floor, then rotate to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled, rhythmic motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank twist is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the obliques through rotational hip movement from a plank position. It challenges core stability while adding a dynamic element that specifically engages the lateral core muscles.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方，身体保持一条直线。
收紧核心，将髋部向一侧旋转，向地面下压。
在触地前停顿，然后向另一侧旋转。
以受控、有节奏的动作继续左右交替。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: plank with hand and leg lift
name_zh: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders.
Simultaneously raise your right hand forward and your left leg straight back.
Hold the extended position for 2 seconds, keeping your hips level.
Lower and repeat on the opposite side, raising your left hand and right leg.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank with hand and leg lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abs and lower back. Extending opposite limbs from a high plank demands anti-rotational core stability and challenges balance and coordination.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀正下方。
同时将右手向前抬起、左腿向后伸直抬起。
保持伸展姿势2秒，髋部保持水平。
放下后换对侧重复，抬起左手和右腿。
继续交替，按目标次数重复。

name_en: plank with hand and leg up
name_zh: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Raise your right arm straight up toward the ceiling while simultaneously raising your right leg.
Hold the position briefly with your arm and same-side leg elevated.
Return to the plank and repeat on the left side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank with hand and leg up is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs. Raising the same-side arm and leg simultaneously challenges lateral stability and demands greater balance and core control than standard plank variations.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀下方。
将右臂向天花板方向伸直抬起，同时抬起右腿。
手臂与同侧腿抬起时短暂保持姿势。
回到平板支撑，换左侧重复。
继续交替，按目标次数重复。

name_en: Plank With Hips Lift on Elbow
instructions_en: Begin in a forearm plank position with elbows directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and slowly lift your hips toward the ceiling into a pike position.
Hold briefly at the top, feeling the tension in your abs.
Lower your hips back to the straight plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank With Hips Lift on Elbow is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the abs. The hip lift from the elbow plank dynamically engages the core and challenges the transition between the plank and pike positions.
instructions_zh: 从前臂平板支撑开始，肘部位于肩膀正下方。
收紧核心，慢慢将髋部向天花板抬起成屈体姿势。
在顶部短暂保持，感受腹部发力。
将髋部放回直线平板支撑姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders and body straight.
Rotate your hips to the right, dropping your right hip toward the floor.
Return to the center plank position and rotate to the left.
Continue alternating sides in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank with hips twist is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the obliques. Performed from a high plank, the alternating hip rotations add dynamic oblique engagement while maintaining upper body stability.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀下方，身体保持直线。
将髋部向右旋转，右髋向地面下压。
回到中间平板支撑位置，再向左旋转。
以受控方式继续左右交替。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and lift your right hand off the ground.
Hold the single-arm plank position for 2-3 seconds while keeping your hips level.
Place the right hand back down and repeat on the left side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank with one hand lift is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs and obliques. Removing one hand from the ground forces the core to resist rotation and maintain spinal alignment with greater anti-rotational strength.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀正下方。
将重心移到左手，抬起右手离地。
保持单臂平板支撑2-3秒，髋部保持水平。
放下右手，换左侧重复。
继续交替，按目标次数重复。

name_en: plank with opposite hand leg lift
name_zh: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with hands beneath your shoulders.
Lift your right hand forward and your left leg back simultaneously, keeping both aligned with your torso.
Hold for 2 seconds, then return both limbs to the floor.
Repeat on the opposite side, lifting your left hand and right leg.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plank with opposite hand leg lift is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs. Extending diagonally opposite limbs from a high plank challenges anti-rotational stability and strengthens the entire posterior chain and core.
name_zh_llm: 平板支撑对侧手脚抬起
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀下方。
同时向前抬起右手、向后抬起左腿，并与躯干保持对齐。
保持2秒，然后将两侧肢体放回地面。
换对侧重复，抬起左手和右腿。
继续交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders and body forming a straight line.
Brace your core and slowly lift one arm off the ground, extending it directly in front of you.
Hold briefly while maintaining a stable plank position with minimal hip rotation.
Return your hand to the floor and repeat on the other arm.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plank with reach is a bodyweight exercise that adds dynamic challenge to the standard plank by requiring alternating arm extensions. This movement demands strong anti-rotation core stability and shoulder control.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀下方，身体成一条直线。
收紧核心，慢慢将一只手臂抬离地面，向前伸直。
短暂保持，维持稳定平板支撑，尽量减少髋部旋转。
将手放回地面，换另一只手臂重复。
继续交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate with both hands at the bottom, arms extended downward.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise the plate forward and upward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the plate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plate front raise is a plate isolation exercise targeting the anterior deltoids. Holding the plate with both hands in a fixed position maintains shoulder-width tension and builds frontal shoulder strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手握住杠铃片底部，手臂向下伸直。
保持肘部微屈，将杠铃片向前上方举至肩部高度。
在动作顶端稍作停顿。
缓慢将杠铃片放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your spine straight and shoulders pulled back.
Tilt your head back slightly and pull the corners of your mouth downward and outward.
Tense the muscles along the front of your neck so the platysma bands become visible.
Hold the tension for 5 seconds.
Slowly release and return to a neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The platysma lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the platysma muscle along the front of the neck. It involves tensing and lifting the platysma bands to tone and firm the neck and lower face.
instructions_zh: 坐直，脊柱挺直，肩膀向后收。
头部稍微后仰，嘴角向下向外拉。
收紧颈部前侧肌肉，使颈阔肌条带显现。
保持紧张5秒。
缓慢放松并回到中立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms alongside your body and palms pressing into the floor.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the floor, bringing your legs overhead.
Lower your toes toward the floor behind your head, keeping your legs straight.
Interlace your fingers on the mat beneath your back for additional support.
Hold the pose for 20-30 seconds, then slowly roll your spine back down to the mat vertebra by vertebra.
description_en: Plough pose is an inverted yoga posture that targets the lower back and stretches the hamstrings, shoulders, and entire posterior chain. It involves bringing the legs overhead until the toes touch the floor behind the head, creating deep spinal flexion and shoulder opening.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂放在身体两侧，手掌压地。
收紧核心，将臀部抬离地面，双腿举过头顶。
双腿伸直，脚趾向头后方的地面下放。
在背后垫子上十指交叉以增加支撑。
保持姿势20-30秒，然后脊柱逐节缓慢卷回垫上。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a sturdy plyo box or bench.
Step one foot onto the box and explosively drive through that heel to jump upward.
Switch feet in the air so the opposite foot lands on the box.
Immediately step or jump back down and repeat, alternating the leading foot.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The plyo step up is a plyometric lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps and glutes through explosive step-up movements on an elevated platform. It develops unilateral leg power, coordination, and cardiovascular conditioning.
instructions_zh: 站在稳固的跳箱或长凳前。
一只脚踩上箱子，爆发性蹬伸该脚跟向上跳起。
在空中换脚，使另一只脚落在箱子上。
立即踏下或跳下并重复，交替领先脚。
按目标次数持续进行。

instructions_en: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest toward the ground, then explosively push yourself upward.
Generate enough force to lift your hands off the ground at the top of the movement.
Land with soft elbows and immediately lower into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Plyometric push-ups are an explosive variation of the standard push-up that develops upper body power by requiring the hands to leave the ground. They target the pectorals with secondary emphasis on the triceps, front delts, and core through the explosive pressing motion.
instructions_zh: 从标准俯卧撑姿势开始，双手与肩同宽。
胸部向地面下放，然后爆发性向上推起。
在动作顶端产生足够力量使双手离地。
以微屈肘部落地，并立即下放进入下一次重复。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and bring your palms together in a prayer position in front of your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat as you lower your torso toward the ground.
Allow your arms to extend forward or rest in front of you as you deepen the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Slowly rise back to standing and repeat as desired.
description_en: Prayer Forward Fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lats and lower back. Folding forward with hands in prayer position gently lengthens the posterior chain and opens the upper back.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手在胸前合十呈祈祷姿势。
以髋部为轴前屈，保持背部平直，将躯干向地面下放。
双臂可向前伸展或放在身前以加深拉伸。
保持20-30秒，深呼吸。
缓慢起身回到站立，按需重复。

instructions_en: Bring both palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position.
Slowly lower your hands toward your waist while keeping your palms pressed together.
Hold the stretch when you feel tension in your forearms and wrists.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat as desired.
description_en: Prayer Stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the forearms and wrists. Pressing the palms together and lowering the hands gently stretches the flexor muscles of the forearms, helping to relieve tension from repetitive gripping or typing.
instructions_zh: 双手在胸前合十呈祈祷姿势。
保持手掌相压，缓慢将双手向腰部下移。
当感觉前臂和手腕有张力时保持拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后放松。
按需重复。

instructions_en: Sit at a preacher curl bench and place the back of your upper arms flat against the angled pad.
Grip an ez curl bar with an underhand grip using the inner angled handles.
Starting with your arms nearly fully extended, curl the bar upward by contracting your biceps.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar back to the near-extended starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The preacher curl with an ez bar is a bicep isolation exercise performed on a preacher bench. The angled pad locks the upper arms in place, eliminating momentum and placing maximum tension on the biceps for focused growth.
instructions_zh: 坐在牧师凳上，上臂后侧平贴斜垫。
用内侧斜握手柄以反握握住曲杆。
从手臂接近完全伸直开始，收缩肱二头肌将杆向上弯举。
在动作顶端稍作停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将杆放回接近伸直的起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit at the preacher curl machine and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the angled pad.
Grasp the handles with a supinated grip and arms fully extended.
Curl the handles upward toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the handles back to the fully extended starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The preacher curl machine is a biceps isolation exercise that uses a preacher pad to eliminate shoulder involvement. The fixed arm position maximizes bicep contraction throughout the movement and is particularly effective for developing lower bicep fullness.
instructions_zh: 坐在牧师椅弯举机上，调整座椅使上臂平放在斜垫上。
以旋后握法握住把手，手臂完全伸直。
屈肘将把手向上弯举至肩部方向。
在顶部停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将把手放回完全伸直的起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright and place both hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Begin lifting your knees alternately toward your chest in a rapid high-knee jogging pattern.
Keep your chest up and your elbows back throughout the movement.
Pump your legs continuously at a brisk pace.
Continue for the desired duration while maintaining the prisoner hand position.
description_en: The prisoner high knee cardio is a bodyweight cardio exercise that combines the high knee drill with the prisoner arm position. Placing the hands behind the head eliminates arm momentum and increases core and upper body engagement while sustaining cardiovascular demand.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
开始以快速高抬腿跑的模式交替将膝盖抬向胸部。
整个动作过程中保持胸部抬起、肘部后展。
以轻快节奏持续交替蹬腿。
保持囚徒手位，持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot forward, in a lunge position.
Place your hands behind your head in a prisoner position with elbows wide.
Drive your hips forward to feel the stretch in your right hip flexor.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso upright.
Switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The prisoner hip stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hip flexors. The kneeling lunge position combined with hands behind the head and upright torso promotes full hip flexor elongation and thoracic extension.
instructions_zh: 右膝跪地，左脚在前，呈弓步姿势。
双手放在脑后呈囚徒手位，肘部打开。
髋部向前推，感受右侧髋屈肌的拉伸。
保持躯干直立，拉伸20-30秒。
换腿，在另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand on one leg with your hands clasped behind your head in a prisoner position.
Slowly rotate your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow back.
Hold the rotated position for 2 seconds, then rotate to the left.
Continue alternating twists while maintaining your balance on one leg.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching the standing leg.
description_en: Prisoner one leg twist is a bodyweight balance and core exercise targeting the obliques. Combining a single-leg stance with rotational trunk movements challenges balance, spinal rotation, and lateral core strength.
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，双手在脑后交扣呈囚徒手位。
缓慢将躯干向右旋转，右肘向后带。
保持旋转姿势2秒，然后向左旋转。
单腿保持平衡的同时继续交替旋转。
完成目标次数后换站立腿。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place both hands behind your head, fingers interlaced.
Hinge forward at the hips, lowering your torso until it is roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and elbows wide.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your upper back and lats.
Return to standing and repeat.
description_en: Prisoner Standing Upper Body Bent is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lats and upper back. Folding forward from a prisoner hand position opens the thoracic spine and stretches the back extensors in a controlled, accessible manner.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手放在脑后，手指交叉。
髋部铰链前屈，降低躯干至大致与地面平行。
保持背部平直，肘部打开。
保持姿势20-30秒，感受上背部和背阔肌的拉伸。
回到站立姿势并重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended straight back and arms extended directly in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lower back to lift your chest, arms, and legs slightly off the floor. Keep your neck neutral.
Maintain this elevated body position and slowly sweep your straight arms out to the sides and down toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as your hands reach your sides.
Slowly reverse the motion, sweeping your arms back forward to the starting position.
Repeat the arm sweep for the desired number of repetitions while keeping your body lifted.
description_en: The prone back extension is a foundational bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back erectors through a spinal extension movement. Performed lying face down, it is commonly used in rehabilitation and warm-up routines to strengthen the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫子上，双腿向后伸直，双臂向前伸直。
收紧臀部和下背部，将胸部、手臂和双腿稍微抬离地面。保持颈部中立。
保持抬起的身体姿势，缓慢将伸直的手臂向两侧扫开并向下扫向髋部。
双手到达身体两侧时，挤压肩胛骨。
缓慢反向运动，将手臂向前扫回起始位置。
保持身体抬起，按目标次数重复手臂扫动。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your mouth closed.
Inhale deeply through your nose and fill both cheeks with air.
Hold the air in your puffed cheeks for 10 seconds without releasing.
Transfer the air from one cheek to the other by pressing one cheek inward.
Hold on each side for 3 seconds before releasing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The puffy cheeks hold is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the cheek and buccinator muscles. It involves holding air in the puffed cheeks and transferring it side to side to tone and strengthen the mid-face muscles.
instructions_zh: 坐直，闭上嘴。
用鼻子深吸气，将双颊充满空气。
保持鼓起的脸颊含气10秒，不要漏气。
按压一侧脸颊向内，将空气从一侧脸颊转移到另一侧。
每侧保持3秒后释放。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and avoid swinging your body.
Pull yourself upward by driving your elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar.
Pause at the top and squeeze your lats.
Slowly lower yourself back to the full hanging position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The pull-up is a foundational bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi. Using an overhand grip, it builds upper body pulling strength across the back, biceps, and shoulders, and is a key measure of relative body strength.
instructions_zh: 以略宽于肩的正握悬垂在引体向上杆上。
收紧核心，避免身体摆动。
通过将肘部向下向后驱动将身体向上拉，直到下巴超过杆。
在顶部停顿并挤压背阔肌。
缓慢下降到完全悬垂位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and depress your shoulder blades.
Pull your body upward by driving your elbows toward your hips until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the hanging position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Pull-ups are a bodyweight compound exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi and is one of the most effective movements for developing upper body pulling strength. The movement requires significant coordination of the back, biceps, and core.
instructions_zh: 正握单杠，双手略宽于肩，悬垂。
收紧核心，肩胛骨下沉。
肘部向髋部发力，将身体向上拉，直到下巴过杠。
顶部稍作停顿，然后缓慢下放回悬垂位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes pointed outward.
Lower into a deep sumo squat position.
From the bottom, perform small pulsing movements up and down without fully rising.
Continue pulsing for the desired number of reps or duration.
Stand fully to complete the set.
description_en: The pulse sumo squat is a bodyweight inner thigh and quad exercise that holds the bottom of the sumo squat and performs small pulsing contractions. The constant tension at the bottom of the movement builds endurance and strength through the adductors and quads.
instructions_zh: 双脚宽于肩站立，脚尖向外。
下蹲至深相扑蹲位置。
在底部做小幅上下脉冲动作，不完全起身。
按目标次数或时间持续脉冲。
完全站起完成本组。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest to the ground and perform a push-up.
As you push back up, transition into a downward-dog position by raising your hips.
Lift one hand and reach toward the opposite foot, touching or reaching toward your toe.
Return to the push-up position and repeat on the opposite side, continuing to alternate.
description_en: Push to toe-touch is a compound bodyweight exercise that combines a push-up with a rotational toe-touch reach. It targets the chest, triceps, and core, while the toe-touch component activates the obliques and hamstrings in a flowing sequence.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手与肩同宽。
胸部下放至地面，完成一次俯卧撑。
推起时抬高髋部，过渡到下犬式。
抬起一只手伸向对侧脚，触碰或接近脚趾。
回到俯卧撑姿势，换另一侧重复，持续交替。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and body forming a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows at a 45-degree angle from your body.
Stop just before your chest touches the ground.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The push-up is a foundational bodyweight exercise targeting the pectoral muscles. It simultaneously engages the triceps, shoulders, and core, making it one of the most versatile and widely used upper body exercises.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板姿势开始，双手略宽于肩，身体成一条直线。
肘部与身体呈45度弯曲，将胸部下放至地面。
在胸部触地前停住。
手掌发力推起，伸直手臂回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start in a standard push-up position with hands below your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Keeping your core engaged and body stable, shift your weight to your left hand.
Lift your right arm off the floor, bending your elbow and pulling your hand back alongside your torso.
Return your right hand to the starting position on the floor.
Shift your weight to your right hand and repeat the movement, lifting your left arm.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The push up arm lift combines a standard push-up with an alternating forward arm raise, targeting the triceps and pectorals while adding a balance challenge. The single-arm lift phase engages the core and shoulders for anti-rotation stability.
instructions_zh: 从标准俯卧撑姿势开始，双手位于肩下，身体成一条直线。
保持核心收紧、身体稳定，将重心移到左手。
抬起右臂离地，屈肘将手拉回体侧。
将右手放回起始位置的地面。
将重心移到右手，重复动作抬起左臂。
按目标次数持续交替两侧。

instructions_en: Begin in a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your body slowly until your chest makes full contact with the floor.
Pause briefly with your chest on the ground, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Push explosively through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Push up with chest touch on floor is a bodyweight exercise that takes the push-up through its complete range of motion by touching the chest to the floor at the bottom. The full range of motion maximizes chest muscle engagement and builds greater pectoral strength.
instructions_zh: 从标准俯卧撑姿势开始，双手略宽于肩。
缓慢下放身体，直到胸部完全接触地面。
胸部贴地稍作停顿，肘部保持贴近身体。
手掌爆发发力推起，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels with your core engaged.
Lower your chest toward the ground by bending your elbows at approximately 45 degrees.
Pause when your chest is just above the floor, then push through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Push-ups are a foundational bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals, triceps, and anterior deltoids. They require no equipment and can be performed anywhere, making them one of the most versatile upper body pressing exercises.
instructions_zh: 从高位平板姿势开始，双手略宽于肩。
核心收紧，身体从头到脚跟成一条直线。
肘部约呈45度弯曲，将胸部下放至地面。
胸部接近地面时停顿，然后手掌发力推起回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, then step your right foot back about 3-4 feet.
Square your hips toward the front of your mat and keep your right foot turned in at about 45 degrees.
Place your hands on your hips or bring your palms together behind your back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and hinge forward at the hips over your left leg.
Hold the stretch for 30-60 seconds, then inhale to lift your torso and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Pyramid pose is a standing forward fold yoga posture that deeply targets the hamstrings of the front leg. It involves a staggered stance with a deep forward hinge over the front leg, promoting posterior chain flexibility and hip alignment.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，然后右脚后撤约3-4英尺。
髋部朝向垫子前方摆正，右脚内转约45度。
双手放在髋部，或在背后合掌。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气在左腿上方从髋部向前折叠。
保持拉伸30-60秒，然后吸气抬起上身，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright on one leg, using a wall or surface for balance if needed.
Bend the opposite knee and grasp the ankle with your hand behind you.
Pull the heel toward your glutes until you feel a stretch along the front of the thigh.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The quadriceps hold stretch is a bodyweight standing stretch targeting the quads and hip flexors. Pulling the heel toward the glutes elongates the rectus femoris and other quad muscles, improving front-of-thigh flexibility.
instructions_zh: 单腿直立，必要时扶墙或支撑物保持平衡。
弯曲另一侧膝盖，手在身后握住脚踝。
将脚跟拉向臀部，直到大腿前侧有拉伸感。
放松后换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright and hold onto a wall or stable surface for balance.
Bend one knee and grasp the top of your foot with the same-side hand.
Draw your heel toward your glute, feeling the stretch through the front of the thigh.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, keeping your knees together and your torso upright.
Release and repeat on the other leg.
description_en: The quadriceps stretch is a standing bodyweight exercise targeting the quad muscles through a heel-to-glute pull. It elongates the rectus femoris and hip flexors, making it a standard post-exercise or mobility stretch for the front of the thigh.
instructions_zh: 直立，扶墙或稳定支撑物保持平衡。
弯曲一侧膝盖，同侧手握住脚背。
将脚跟拉向臀部，感受大腿前侧拉伸。
保持20-30秒，双膝并拢，躯干直立。
放松后换另一腿重复。
xunji_candidate: 单腿跪姿股四头肌拉伸

instructions_en: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a half-kneeling position.
Reach back with your hand and grasp the ankle of the kneeling leg.
Pull the foot gently toward your glutes, stretching the quad of the kneeling leg.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds while keeping your torso upright.
Release and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Quadriceps stretch version 1 is a bodyweight kneeling quad stretch targeting the quads and hip flexors. The half-kneeling position provides stability while allowing a deep stretch in the front of the thigh.
instructions_zh: 单膝跪地，另一脚在前，呈半跪姿。
手向后伸，握住跪地腿的脚踝。
将脚轻轻拉向臀部，拉伸跪地腿的股四头肌。
保持拉伸20-30秒，躯干保持直立。
放松后换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Brace your core and lift one knee slightly off the floor while maintaining a flat back.
Hold the position for a moment, then lower that knee and lift the other.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
Avoid allowing your hips to rotate or shift during the movement.
description_en: Quadruped knee lifts are a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes and core stabilizers. Hovering the knees off the floor while on all fours builds core endurance and hip stability, and is commonly used in rehabilitation and activation routines.
instructions_zh: 四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩下，膝盖位于髋下。
收紧核心，将一侧膝盖稍微抬离地面，保持背部平直。
短暂保持，然后放下该膝，抬起另一膝。
继续交替进行至目标次数。
避免髋部旋转或偏移。

instructions_en: Stand in mountain pose with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Inhale and sweep both arms out to the sides and overhead, palms facing each other.
Reach your fingertips actively toward the ceiling and gently tilt your head back to gaze at your thumbs.
Keep your shoulders relaxed away from your ears and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then exhale and lower your arms back to your sides.
description_en: Raised hands pose is a foundational standing yoga posture that targets the deltoids and stretches the side body and triceps. It involves standing tall with arms extended overhead, promoting shoulder mobility and upright postural alignment.
instructions_zh: 山式站立，双脚并拢，双臂垂于体侧。
吸气，双臂向两侧展开并举过头顶，掌心相对。
指尖主动向上延伸，头部轻后仰，目光看向拇指。
肩膀放松远离耳朵，核心收紧。
保持20-30秒，呼气，双臂放回体侧。

instructions_en: Begin in a tabletop position on your hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head with your elbow pointing outward.
Rotate your torso to bring that elbow toward the floor between your arm and knee.
Then rotate in the opposite direction, opening your chest and reaching that elbow toward the ceiling.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions and switch sides.
description_en: The reach back thoracic bridge is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the lats, with secondary engagement of the chest, lower back, and shoulders. It involves rotating through the thoracic spine from a quadruped position to improve upper back mobility and shoulder health.
instructions_zh: 从手膝支撑的桌面姿势开始。
一只手放在头后，肘部朝外。
旋转躯干，将该肘部朝手臂与膝盖之间的地面靠近。
然后向反方向旋转，打开胸腔，将该肘部朝天花板延伸。
重复至目标次数后换侧。

instructions_en: Stand with feet wide apart and hinge from the hips over your front leg, keeping your back flat.
Reach one hand toward the floor or shin, extending the other arm to the ceiling.
Rotate your torso to open your chest and gaze up toward your raised hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your hamstrings and the opening in your chest.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Reach hinge triangle pose detail is a bodyweight yoga exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes, lower back, and obliques. It involves a lateral hinge over one leg with a thoracic rotation component to stretch the hamstrings and improve spinal mobility.
instructions_zh: 双脚宽站，从髋部向前腿方向折叠，保持背部平直。
一只手伸向地面或小腿，另一臂向天花板延伸。
旋转躯干打开胸腔，目光看向举起的手。
保持20-30秒，感受腘绳肌拉伸和胸腔打开。
回到站立，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor with your torso upright and bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, reaching forward and allowing your upper back to slightly round.
Pull your hands back to the starting position at your chest.
Open your arms out to the sides, bending your elbows to form a 'W' shape while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Bring your hands back together in front of your chest.
Continue alternating between the forward reach and the 'W' opener for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reach to W is a bodyweight exercise targeting the rhomboids and lower traps. Alternating between an overhead reach and a W position effectively activates the mid-back muscles and promotes healthy scapular movement and posture.
instructions_zh: 跪在地上，躯干直立，双手在胸前合拢。
双臂向前伸直，向前延伸，上背部略微弓起。
将双手拉回胸前起始位置。
双臂向两侧打开，弯曲肘部形成“W”形，同时夹紧肩胛骨。
双手回到胸前合拢。
继续交替进行前伸和“W”打开至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand between two cable pulleys set at shoulder height.
Grasp the opposite cable handle with each hand and step back until there is tension on the cables.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows and keep your chest up throughout the movement.
Pull your arms outward and backward in a wide arc until they are in line with your shoulders.
Squeeze your rear delts and upper back at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position under control and repeat.
description_en: The rear delt cable fly is an isolation exercise that targets the posterior deltoids while maintaining constant tension throughout the movement. Using cables provides a greater range of motion than machines and helps improve shoulder balance, posture, and upper back strength.
instructions_zh: 站在两个与肩同高的滑轮之间。
每只手握住对侧的把手，后退直到绳索有张力。
保持肘部微屈，整个动作中挺胸。
以宽弧线向外向后拉动手臂，直到与肩成一直线。
在动作末端挤压后束三角肌和上背。
有控制地缓慢回到起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang below your chest with palms facing each other.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder height.
Pause at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The rear delt dumbbell fly is a back and shoulder exercise targeting the rhomboids and posterior deltoids through a wide pulling motion. Performed in the bent-over position, it improves upper back posture and shoulder health.
instructions_zh: 每只手握一只哑铃，屈髋前倾直到躯干几乎与地面平行。
让哑铃垂在胸部下方，掌心相对。
肘部微屈，双臂向两侧抬起直到与肩同高。
在顶端停顿，挤压肩胛骨。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let the dumbbells hang straight down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they are parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your rear delts and rhomboids at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The rear delt fly is a dumbbell isolation exercise targeting the posterior head of the deltoids and upper back. Performed in a hinged position, the fly motion develops shoulder balance and postural integrity.
instructions_zh: 每只手握一只哑铃，屈髋前倾直到躯干几乎与地面平行。
让哑铃垂直下垂，肘部微屈。
双臂以宽弧线向两侧抬起直到与地面平行。
在顶端挤压后束三角肌和菱形肌。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit at the rear delt fly machine facing the pad with arms extended and hands gripping the handles.
Set the handles at shoulder height.
Pull the handles outward and backward in a wide arc, squeezing your rear delts.
Pause at the end of the range of motion.
Slowly return the handles to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The rear delt fly machine targets the posterior deltoids through a horizontal abduction movement. The machine provides a guided path for consistent muscle activation and is ideal for isolating the rear delts to improve shoulder balance and posture.
instructions_zh: 坐在后束飞鸟机上，面向靠垫，双臂伸展握住把手。
将把手调至肩高。
以宽弧线向外向后拉动把手，挤压后束三角肌。
在动作幅度末端停顿。
缓慢将把手回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit facing the pec deck machine and adjust the seat so your arms are parallel to the floor.
Grip the handles with a neutral grip and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the handles outward and backward in a wide arcing motion by squeezing your rear delts and shoulder blades together.
Pause at the peak of the contraction.
Slowly return the handles to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse pec deck fly is a machine exercise targeting the posterior deltoid. By reversing the pec deck movement, it isolates the rear shoulder and upper back retractors, improving posture and building balanced shoulder development.
instructions_zh: 面向蝴蝶机坐下，调整座椅使手臂与地面平行。
以中立握法握住把手，保持肘部微屈。
通过挤压后束三角肌和肩胛骨，以宽弧线向外向后拉动把手。
在收缩顶峰停顿。
缓慢将把手回到起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a bench and hinge forward at the hips with your chest near your thighs.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip, allowing them to hang below your knees.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arcing motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top when your arms are parallel to the floor.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The rear delt dumbbell fly is an exercise targeting the trapezius and rhomboids, with emphasis on the posterior deltoid. Performed bent over, it trains the muscles responsible for scapular retraction and rear shoulder development.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳边缘，屈髋前倾，胸部靠近大腿。
每只手以中立握法握一只哑铃，让其垂在膝盖下方。
以宽弧线向两侧抬起哑铃，挤压肩胛骨。
当手臂与地面平行时在顶端停顿。
缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of you with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise both arms out to the sides simultaneously, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Rear flyes are a dumbbell exercise targeting the rhomboids and posterior deltoids. Performed in a hinged position, the outward arc of the arms effectively activates the upper back and rear shoulder muscles, improving posture and shoulder health.
instructions_zh: 每只手握一只哑铃，屈髋前倾直到躯干几乎与地面平行。
让哑铃垂在身前，肘部微屈。
双臂同时向两侧抬起，在顶端挤压肩胛骨。
在动作顶端停顿，然后缓慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with a dumbbell in each hand, hands under your shoulders.
Keep your feet wider than hip-width for stability and engage your core.
Row the right dumbbell toward your right hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell and repeat the row on the left side.
Continue alternating rows while maintaining a stable plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The renegade row is a challenging plank-position dumbbell exercise that targets the lats while simultaneously demanding core anti-rotation stability. It combines upper back strength with full-body tension, making it an efficient compound movement.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，每只手握一只哑铃，双手位于肩下。
双脚间距宽于髋部以保持稳定，收紧核心。
将右侧哑铃划向右髋，肘部贴近身体。
放下哑铃，在左侧重复划船。
保持平板支撑稳定，继续交替划船。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding an end in each hand.
Keep your arms straight and raise them in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold briefly, then slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band arms raise is a shoulder isolation exercise that targets the front and lateral deltoids using band resistance. It builds shoulder strength and endurance while providing a joint-friendly alternative to dumbbell raises.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽踩住弹力带中间，双手各握一端。
保持手臂伸直，向前抬起至与地面平行。
稍作停顿，然后缓慢将手臂放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end in each hand.
Start with arms fully extended at your sides and palms facing forward.
Curl both handles upward toward your shoulders by flexing your elbows.
Pause at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band biceps curl is a portable and joint-friendly biceps exercise using an elastic band for resistance. The increasing band tension as the arm curls creates a unique strength curve that effectively builds bicep strength and endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽踩住弹力带中间，双手各握一端。
起始时双臂在体侧完全伸直，掌心朝前。
屈肘将两端向上弯举至肩部。
在顶部停顿，挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢将手臂放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height and hold one end in each hand.
Step forward to create tension and stand in a staggered stance.
Press both hands forward until your arms are fully extended in front of your chest.
Pause at the extended position, squeezing your pectorals.
Slowly bring your hands back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band chest press targets the pectorals through a horizontal pressing motion using elastic band resistance. It is a portable and accessible alternative to machine or barbell pressing, providing increasing resistance throughout the range of motion.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带固定在身后胸部高度，双手各握一端。
向前迈步制造张力，呈前后站姿。
双手向前推至手臂在胸前完全伸直。
在伸直位置停顿，挤压胸肌。
缓慢将双手带回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart.
Grip the band at your sides with palms facing inward and hinge forward at the hips.
Keep your back flat and chest tall throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips to stand upright.
Pause at the top with hips fully extended.
Slowly hinge back down to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: The resistance band deadlift replicates the hip hinge pattern of a conventional deadlift using band resistance. It targets the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings while being accessible for home workouts or warm-up activation work.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽踩住弹力带中间。
双手在体侧握住弹力带，掌心相对，屈髋前倾。
整个动作中保持背部平直、胸部挺起。
脚跟发力，伸展髋部站直。
在顶部停顿，髋部完全伸展。
缓慢屈髋回到起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band and place the looped ends over your shoulders.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips and lower your torso toward parallel while keeping your back flat.
Pause at the bottom, feeling the stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band good morning is a hip hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings using band resistance. It teaches proper posterior chain loading mechanics and is a gentler alternative to barbell good mornings for building hamstring and lower back strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚踩住弹力带中间，将环状端置于肩上。
双脚与髋同宽站立，膝盖微屈。
屈髋将躯干下放至接近平行，保持背部平直。
在底部停顿，感受腘绳肌拉伸。
髋部向前发力回到直立位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keep your core engaged and pull the band apart by driving your elbows down and out to the sides.
Bring the band down behind your neck until it reaches your upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly control the resistance as you raise your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band high side pull targets the deltoids and upper back through a diagonal pulling motion. The upward and lateral pulling path simultaneously engages the medial and posterior deltoids, improving shoulder strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽直立站立。
双手略宽于肩握住弹力带，双臂向上完全伸直过头。
保持核心收紧，肘部向下向外发力将弹力带拉开。
将弹力带拉至颈后上背部，挤压肩胛骨。
缓慢控制阻力，将手臂回到起始过头位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a resistance band to a kettlebell and anchor the other end behind you.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at the hips to grasp the kettlebell.
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell to shoulder height.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down and hinge at the hips to absorb the load.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band kettlebell swing adds accommodating resistance to the traditional kettlebell swing, increasing peak load at the top of the movement. It targets the glutes and hamstrings through the hip hinge pattern while also engaging the shoulders, lower back, and core.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带一端连接壶铃，另一端固定在身后。
双脚与肩同宽站立，屈髋握住壶铃。
爆发性向前伸髋，将壶铃摆至肩部高度。
让壶铃摆回下方，屈髋缓冲负荷。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band overhead and kneel on a mat facing the anchor point.
Grasp the band with both hands behind your head.
Crunch your torso downward by flexing your spine, bringing your elbows toward your knees.
Hold for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band kneeling crunch uses overhead band resistance to load the abdominals throughout the crunch motion. It targets the abs by requiring the core to flex against the constant tension of the band, making it more effective than a standard bodyweight crunch.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带固定在上方，面向固定点跪在垫子上。
双手在头后握住弹力带。
屈曲脊柱向下卷腹，将肘部拉向膝盖。
在底部稍作停顿，然后缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Keep your core engaged and pull the band apart by driving your elbows down and out to the sides.
Bring the band down behind your neck until it reaches your upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly control the resistance as you raise your arms back to the starting overhead position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band lat pulldown replicates the cable lat pulldown using an overhead-anchored band. It targets the lats and biceps through a vertical pulling motion and is effective for building back width at home or as a warm-up exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽直立。
双手握住弹力带，握距略宽于肩，双臂伸直举过头顶。
收紧核心，肘部向下向外发力将弹力带拉开。
将弹力带拉至颈后，直至到达上背部，同时挤压肩胛骨。
缓慢控制阻力，将双臂回到头顶起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place a resistance band around your ankles and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Slightly bend your knees and get into an athletic quarter-squat position.
Take a large step forward and to the right, maintaining tension in the band.
Follow with your left foot, keeping feet apart against the band resistance.
Continue walking forward for the desired distance, then reverse direction.
Repeat for the desired number of steps or duration.
description_en: The resistance band monster walk is a glute activation exercise that targets the glute medius through lateral and forward stepping against band resistance. It improves hip abductor strength, knee stability, and is commonly used as a warm-up or corrective exercise.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带套在脚踝处，双脚与肩同宽站立。
膝盖微屈，进入运动型四分之一蹲姿势。
向前向右迈一大步，保持弹力带张力。
左脚跟上，双脚保持分开对抗弹力带阻力。
继续向前行走目标距离，然后反向行走。
按目标步数或时间重复。

instructions_en: Assume a half-kneeling position with one knee on the floor, and anchor one end of the resistance band under that kneeling leg.
Grasp the other end of the band with both hands and extend your arms fully overhead.
Keeping your upper arms stationary and close to your head, bend your elbows to slowly lower the hands behind your head.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
Extend your arms back up to the starting position by straightening your elbows and squeezing your triceps.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band overhead triceps extension targets the long head of the triceps through an overhead extension movement. The band provides progressive resistance, making it an accessible and effective option for triceps development.
instructions_zh: 呈半跪姿，一侧膝盖着地，将弹力带一端固定在该跪地腿下方。
双手握住弹力带另一端，双臂完全伸直举过头顶。
保持上臂固定并贴近头部，弯曲肘部将双手缓慢下放至头后。
在动作底部稍作停顿。
伸直肘部将双臂回到起始位置，同时挤压肱三头肌。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Loop a resistance band across your upper back and hold one end under each hand.
Assume a standard push-up position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up against the added resistance of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band push-up is a progressive bodyweight exercise that adds external resistance to a standard push-up. The band increases the difficulty at the top of the movement, demanding greater force from the pectorals and triceps to complete the extension.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带绕过上背部，两端分别压在双手下方。
呈标准俯卧撑姿势，双手略宽于肩。
弯曲肘部将胸部向地面下放。
对抗弹力带的额外阻力撑起回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Anchor a resistance band at chest height and stand facing the anchor.
Grasp the band with both hands and step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your torso in a rowing motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms back into a triceps kickback at the end of the row.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band row to triceps is a compound pulling exercise that targets the lats through a rowing motion and adds a triceps extension at the end. It develops back width and arm strength while also engaging the rear delts and rhomboids.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带固定在胸部高度，面向固定点站立。
双手握住弹力带，后退一步制造张力。
以划船动作将弹力带拉向躯干，挤压肩胛骨。
在划船末端将双臂向后伸展做肱三头肌后踢。
有控制地回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hold a resistance band with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms at your sides.
Roll your shoulders forward in a circular motion while maintaining gentle tension on the band.
Complete several forward circles, then reverse the direction.
Keep the movements slow and controlled.
Repeat for the desired duration or repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band shoulder roll is a mobility and warm-up exercise targeting the deltoids and rotator cuff through circular shoulder rotation. The band adds light tension to increase activation and improve blood flow to the shoulder joint.
instructions_zh: 双手握住弹力带，握距略宽于肩，双臂置于身体两侧。
保持弹力带轻微张力，以圆周动作向前转动肩膀。
完成数次向前绕环后，反方向转动。
保持动作缓慢且有控制。
按目标时间或次数重复。

instructions_en: Place a resistance band just above your knees and stand on one leg near a wall for balance.
Hinge slightly at the hips and kick the banded leg back and outward against the resistance.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching legs.
description_en: The resistance band single leg glute exercise isolates the glutes and hip abductors through a single-leg kickback pattern with band resistance. It targets the glutes while improving hip extension strength, balance, and stability of the standing leg.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带置于膝盖上方，单腿站立，靠近墙壁保持平衡。
髋部稍作铰链前倾，将有弹力带的腿向后向外踢出对抗阻力。
在动作顶端挤压臀肌。
缓慢将腿回到起始位置。
一侧完成所有次数后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handles at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band squat is a beginner-friendly squat variation using elastic band resistance. With handles held at shoulder height, it combines an overhead stability demand with the squat movement, providing a full-body strengthening effect.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站在弹力带中央。
双手握住弹力带手柄置于肩部高度，掌心朝前。
髋部后推、弯曲膝盖下蹲。
保持胸部挺直，膝盖对准脚尖方向。
通过脚跟发力回到站立姿势。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: resistance band squat with lateral raise
instructions_en: Stand on the center of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the ends in each hand.
Lower into a squat as you hold the band handles at your sides.
As you press back up to standing, raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height against the band.
Lower your arms as you descend into the next squat.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band squat with lateral raise combines a lower body squat with an upper body lateral raise into a single movement. It simultaneously targets the quads and shoulders, making it a time-efficient full-body exercise.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽踩在弹力带中央，双手各握弹力带一端。
双手握住弹力带手柄置于身体两侧，下蹲。
起身站立时，双臂向两侧抬起至肩高，对抗弹力带阻力。
下蹲时放下双臂。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: resistance band stepper in out jump
instructions_en: Place a resistance band just above your knees and stand on a low stepper or platform.
Jump both feet out to the sides of the stepper and back in, moving against the band tension.
Maintain a slight squat position throughout the movement.
Continue jumping in and out at a consistent tempo for the desired duration.
description_en: The resistance band stepper in out jump uses a resistance band above the knees to add hip abductor loading to an in-and-out jump drill on a stepper. It targets the quads and glutes while improving lateral hip strength and cardiovascular conditioning.
instructions_zh: 将弹力带置于膝盖上方，站在低踏板或平台上。
双脚同时向踏板两侧跳出再跳回，对抗弹力带张力。
整个动作过程中保持微蹲姿势。
以稳定节奏持续跳进跳出至目标时长。

name_zh: 弹力带仰卧腿后侧拉伸
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back on the floor.
Loop a resistance band or long strap around the arch of one foot, holding the ends of the band with your hands.
Keep your opposite leg resting flat on the floor.
Keeping the banded leg straight, use the band to help pull your leg upward toward the ceiling.
Raise the leg until you feel a stretch in your hamstring and hold briefly.
Slowly lower the leg back to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The resistance band supine hamstring stretch is a flexibility and mobility exercise targeting the hamstrings. By using a band, you can safely guide the leg into a deeper stretch while keeping the back flat and supported on the floor, improving posterior chain flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 弹力带仰卧腿后侧拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺在地面上。
将弹力带或长带套在一只脚的足弓处，双手握住弹力带两端。
另一条腿平放在地面上。
保持套弹力带的腿伸直，用弹力带帮助将腿向上拉向天花板。
抬腿至腘绳肌有拉伸感，短暂保持。
控制弹力带缓慢将腿放回地面。
按目标次数重复后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends of a resistance band with both hands.
Raise your arms in front of you at shoulder height with elbows slightly bent.
Pull the band apart and back, bending your elbows to form a W shape with your arms.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The resistance band w-raise is an upper back and shoulder health exercise targeting the rhomboids and rear deltoids. The W arm position maximizes scapular retraction and external rotation, improving posture and rotator cuff stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手握住弹力带两端。
双臂在身前抬至肩高，肘部微屈。
将弹力带向两侧拉开并向后拉，屈肘使双臂形成W形。
动作末端夹紧肩胛骨。
缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: reverse bridge hold with one leg lift
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips into a reverse tabletop position.
Hold the bridge, then lift one leg straight up toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips level throughout the single-leg hold.
Lower the leg, then switch sides and repeat.
description_en: The reverse bridge hold with one leg lift is a bodyweight exercise that holds a reverse bridge position while raising one leg to increase the glute and core challenge. The single-leg variation demands greater hip stability and glute strength to maintain level hips.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双手放在臀部后方，手指朝前。
用手和脚发力将臀部抬至反向桌面姿势。
保持桥式，然后将一条腿伸直向上抬向天花板。
单腿保持过程中臀部保持水平。
放下腿，换侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hands placed on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing away.
Press into your palms and heels to lift your hips off the ground as high as possible.
Squeeze your glutes and let your head drop back gently.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly lower your hips back to the floor and repeat.
description_en: Reverse bridge pose II is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back and glutes. By lifting the hips from a seated reverse position, it opens the chest, stretches the front of the body, and strengthens the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿伸直，双手放在臀部后方地面上，手指朝后。
用手掌和脚跟发力将臀部尽可能抬高离开地面。
夹紧臀肌，头部轻轻后仰。
保持该姿势20-30秒。
缓慢将臀部放回地面并重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended at your sides, palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Continue to curl your hips upward off the floor using your lower abs.
Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower your hips and legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the lower abs. By lifting the hips off the floor rather than the shoulders, it shifts emphasis to the inferior portion of the rectus abdominis.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂伸直放在身体两侧，掌心朝下。
屈膝并将双脚抬离地面，膝盖拉向胸部。
用下腹肌继续将臀部向上卷离地面。
在顶端短暂保持，然后缓慢将臀部和双腿放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides and legs raised to 90 degrees.
Explosively curl your hips upward, extending your legs toward the ceiling at the peak.
Hold the fully extended position for a moment, balancing on your upper back.
Slowly lower your hips and bent knees back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions with full control.
description_en: Reverse crunch advanced is an intense bodyweight core exercise targeting the lower abs. The extended leg variation at the top of the movement increases the difficulty and maximizes lower abdominal contraction.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂放在身体两侧，双腿抬至90度。
爆发性地将臀部向上卷起，在顶点将双腿伸向天花板。
在上背部支撑下保持完全伸展姿势片刻。
缓慢将臀部和屈膝放回起始位置。
全程控制，按目标次数重复。

name_en: reverse crunch advanced with straight leg
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with arms at your sides and legs straight, raised slightly off the floor.
Without bending your knees, curl your hips off the floor and raise your straight legs toward the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your legs are perpendicular to the floor or beyond.
Hold briefly, then slowly lower your straight legs back to the starting position without touching the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Reverse crunch advanced with straight leg is a demanding bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs. Keeping the legs straight throughout the movement significantly increases the lever arm, intensifying the challenge on the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂置于身体两侧，双腿伸直并略微抬离地面。
膝盖保持伸直，将髋部卷离地面，把伸直的腿向天花板方向抬起。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面垂直或超过垂直位置。
短暂保持，然后缓慢将伸直的腿放回起始位置，不要触地。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your hands pressing flat on the floor at your sides.
Bring your knees toward your chest with your legs bent.
Curl your hips off the ground toward your ribcage in a controlled motion.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch I is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the lower abs through a hip curl movement. It is a beginner variation with a standard bent-knee position and controlled hip lift, focusing on developing lower abdominal strength and body awareness.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双手平放在身体两侧的地面上。
屈膝将膝盖拉向胸部。
控制动作，将髋部卷离地面，朝肋骨方向卷起。
缓慢将髋部放回地面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides and palms flat on the floor.
Lift your legs to a 90-degree tabletop position.
Engage your lower abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower your hips back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch II is a bodyweight lower abdominal exercise performed by curling the hips off the floor from a tabletop leg position. It targets the lower portion of the rectus abdominis and hip flexors while the arms and palms provide stability on the floor.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂置于身体两侧，手掌平放在地面上。
将双腿抬至90度桌面位置。
收紧下腹，将髋部卷离地面，把膝盖拉向胸部。
在顶部短暂保持，然后缓慢将髋部放回地面。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Press through your feet to lift your hips into a glute bridge.
From the bridge position, draw your knees toward your chest to perform a reverse crunch.
Return your feet to the floor and lower your hips to complete one repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch with glute bridge is a compound bodyweight exercise that combines a glute bridge with a reverse crunch. It targets the abs and glutes simultaneously, providing a comprehensive core and posterior chain workout within a single flowing movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
通过双脚发力，将髋部抬起进入臀桥姿势。
从臀桥位置将膝盖拉向胸部，完成反向卷腹。
将双脚放回地面并放下髋部，完成一次重复。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: reverse crunch with glute bridge beginners
instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Gently press your feet into the floor and lift your hips a few inches into a beginner glute bridge.
From this position, slowly draw your knees toward your chest in a small reverse crunch.
Lower your feet back down and release the bridge.
Repeat at a controlled pace for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch with glute bridge beginners is a modified combination of the glute bridge and reverse crunch suited for those new to core training. The reduced range of motion makes the exercise accessible while still engaging the glutes and lower abdominals.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
轻轻用双脚压地，将髋部抬起几英寸，进入初级臀桥。
从这个位置缓慢将膝盖拉向胸部，做小幅反向卷腹。
将双脚放回下方并解除臀桥。
以受控节奏按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides and legs extended straight toward the ceiling.
Engage your lower abs and curl your hips off the floor, pressing your legs upward.
Hold at the top briefly, then slowly lower your hips back to the floor.
Keep your legs straight throughout the entire movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse crunch with straight leg is an advanced bodyweight core exercise that performs the reverse crunch with legs fully extended. The straight-leg position increases the lever arm, significantly raising the demand on the lower abs and hip flexors compared to the bent-knee variation.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂置于身体两侧，双腿伸直朝向天花板。
收紧下腹，将髋部卷离地面，同时将双腿向上推。
在顶部短暂保持，然后缓慢将髋部放回地面。
整个动作过程中保持双腿伸直。
按目标次数重复。
xunji_candidate: 腹斜肌仰卧卷腹_直腿版

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your hands placed behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips off the ground.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a tabletop shape with your body.
Lower your hips back to the floor and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The reverse glute bridge is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes from a seated position using hand support behind the body. It develops glute and hamstring strength through hip extension, making it accessible for beginners or those working on foundational posterior chain strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双手放在髋部后方，手指朝前。
屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
通过双手和双脚发力，将髋部抬离地面。
在顶部收紧臀部，使身体形成桌面形状。
将髋部放回地面，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the barbell with an underhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width.
Hold the barbell in front of your thighs with arms extended.
Pull the barbell upward toward your chin by leading with your elbows.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout the movement.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse grip barbell upright row uses an underhand grip to target the deltoids and biceps while reducing shoulder impingement risk compared to the standard overhand variation. The grip change shifts more load onto the biceps and front deltoids.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以略窄于肩宽的反握握住杠铃。
双臂伸直，将杠铃握在大腿前方。
以肘部引领，将杠铃向上拉向下巴。
整个动作过程中保持杠铃贴近身体。
在顶部停顿，然后缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing the hack squat machine and place your chest against the back pad, with your shoulders under the pads.
Position your feet low on the platform, hip-width apart.
Release the safety and lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Descend until your thighs are below parallel, feeling a stretch in your glutes and hamstrings.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse hack squat is a machine-based exercise that places emphasis on the glutes and hamstrings by reversing the body orientation on the hack squat machine. The forward lean of the torso shifts load to the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 面向倒蹬机站立，胸部贴紧靠背垫，双肩置于肩垫下方。
双脚踩在踏板较低位置，与髋同宽。
解除安全锁，屈膝并向后推髋，降低身体。
下蹲至大腿低于平行位置，感受臀部和腘绳肌的拉伸。
脚跟发力蹬起，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a bench or elevated surface with your hips at the edge and legs hanging down.
Grip the sides of the bench for stability.
Keeping your legs together and slightly bent, raise them upward by squeezing your glutes.
Lift until your body forms a straight line or slightly above parallel.
Slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Reverse hyperextension is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings by lifting the legs in a prone hanging position. It develops posterior chain strength and spinal decompression simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在长凳或抬高平面上，髋部位于边缘，双腿自然下垂。
双手握住长凳两侧以保持稳定。
双腿并拢并微屈，收紧臀部将双腿向上抬起。
抬至身体成一条直线或略高于平行位置。
缓慢将双腿放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or extended in front for balance.
Step one foot directly back and lower your hips until both knees reach approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee aligned over your front ankle and your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to the standing position.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Reverse lunges are a bodyweight unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Stepping backward reduces anterior knee stress and develops balance, stability, and strength in each leg independently.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手叉腰或向前伸展以保持平衡。
一只脚直接向后迈步，降低髋部直至双膝约呈90度。
前膝保持对准前脚踝，躯干保持直立。
前脚发力推回站立位置。
换另一侧交替进行，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet together and both arms raised straight overhead.
Step one foot backward into a reverse lunge.
Lower your hips until both knees are at approximately 90 degrees.
Keep your arms raised throughout the movement.
Push back to standing and alternate legs for the desired repetitions.
description_en: Reverse lunges hands up is a bodyweight lunge variation performed with both arms raised overhead throughout. The raised arm position increases the challenge to core stability and thoracic extension, while the reverse step targets the quads and glutes of the front leg.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢直立，双臂伸直举过头顶。
一只脚向后迈步做后弓步。
降低髋部直至双膝约呈90度。
整个动作过程中保持双臂上举。
推回站立位置，交替双腿按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet together.
Step one foot backward into a reverse lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor.
Push off the back foot to return to standing and continue the motion to kick that leg behind you.
Squeeze the glute at the top of the kickback.
Return to standing and repeat on the same side for the desired reps before switching.
description_en: The reverse lunge kickback combines a reverse lunge with a rear leg kickback to create a compound glute and leg exercise. The kickback following the lunge maximizes glute activation at the top of the movement, building strength and muscle tone in the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢直立。
一只脚向后迈步做后弓步，后膝向地面降低。
后脚发力推回站立，并顺势将该腿向后踢出。
踢腿顶端收紧臀部。
回到站立，同侧按目标次数重复后换边。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand, with sliders under your feet if available.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, lowering your back knee toward the ground.
As you lower into the lunge, raise both arms laterally to shoulder height.
Lower the arms as you drive back to standing.
Repeat on the other leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The reverse lunges slider lateral raise pairs a reverse lunge with simultaneous lateral dumbbell raises to challenge the lower body and shoulders together. It targets the quads and glutes through the lunge while building shoulder strength and requiring core stability.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手各持哑铃，脚下可放置滑盘。
一只脚向后迈步做后弓步，后膝向地面降低。
下蹲的同时双臂向两侧侧平举至肩高。
推回站立时放下双臂。
换另一腿交替进行，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and place your hands flat on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line.
Engage your glutes and core to maintain the position.
Hold for the desired duration.
Lower back down and repeat.
description_en: Reverse Plank is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the glutes and lower back. Holding the body in a supine bridge position builds posterior chain strength, shoulder stability, and core endurance.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直，双手平放在髋部后方地面，手指朝前。
手掌和脚跟发力，将髋部抬离地面直至身体成一条直线。
收紧臀部和核心以保持姿势。
保持目标时长。
放下身体并重复。

name_zh: 反向平板支撑收腹内收
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and your hands placed behind you, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips into a reverse plank position.
Engage your core and squeeze your inner thighs together in an adduction motion.
Hold the adduction briefly, then release slightly and repeat the squeeze.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining the reverse plank.
description_en: The reverse plank abs and adduction is a bodyweight exercise that combines core stabilization with hip adductor engagement. Performing inner thigh squeezes from a reverse plank position challenges the abs, glutes, and inner thighs simultaneously.
name_zh_llm: 反向平板支撑收腹内收
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿伸直，双手放在身后，手指朝向双脚。
手掌和脚跟发力，将髋部抬起进入反向平板姿势。
收紧核心，大腿内侧向内夹紧做内收动作。
短暂保持内收，稍微放松后再次夹紧。
保持反向平板姿势，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand or sit tall and bring your hands behind your back, pressing the backs of your hands together.
Rotate your fingers upward and attempt to press your palms together behind your back.
Hold the stretch when you feel tension in your forearms, wrists, and chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat as desired.
description_en: Reverse Prayer is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the forearms and wrists. Pressing the palms together behind the back in a reverse prayer position deeply stretches the wrist extensors and opens the chest and shoulders.
instructions_zh: 站直或坐直，双手放到背后，手背相贴。
手指向上旋转，尝试在背后将手掌合拢。
当前臂、手腕和胸部感到拉伸时保持。
放松并根据需要重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and bring your hands into a reverse prayer position behind your back.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat and neck neutral.
Lower your torso toward the ground, deepening the stretch in your back and wrists.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Slowly rise back to standing and repeat.
description_en: Reverse Prayer Forward Fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lats and lower back. Combining the reverse prayer arm position with a forward fold simultaneously stretches the wrist extensors, posterior shoulder, and entire posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双手在背后做反祈祷姿势。
从髋部向前折叠，保持背部平直、颈部中立。
将躯干向地面下压，加深背部和手腕的拉伸。
保持20-30秒，均匀呼吸。
缓慢起身回到站立，重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, placing your hands flat on the floor behind your hips with fingers pointing forward.
Press through your palms to lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips toward the floor in a controlled dip motion.
Press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Reverse Push-Ups is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the triceps. Performed in a reverse tabletop position, the dipping motion loads the triceps and posterior shoulder in the opposite pressing plane from standard push-ups.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，屈膝、双脚踩地，双手平放在髋部后方的地面上，手指朝前。
手掌发力将髋部抬离地面。
