屈肘，以受控的下沉动作将髋部向地面降低。
发力回到起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing a wall or chair for light support, with feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto one leg and engage your glutes.
Hinge slightly forward at the hip and lift the opposite leg behind you.
Hold for a moment, then lower the leg with control.
Repeat on the other side, alternating in a marching rhythm.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The reverse single leg march is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the gluteal muscles and hamstrings. It involves a controlled single-leg hip extension from a standing position, developing posterior chain strength, balance, and pelvic stability.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁或椅子站立以获得轻微支撑，双脚与髋同宽。
将重心移到一条腿上并收紧臀肌。
从髋部略微前倾，将另一条腿向后抬起。
保持片刻，然后受控放下腿。
换另一侧重复，以行进节奏交替进行。
每侧按所需次数继续。

instructions_en: Begin in warrior II with your right knee bent and arms extended parallel to the floor.
Flip your right palm to face the ceiling and inhale as you arc your right arm up and back.
Lower your left hand to rest lightly on your left thigh or shin.
Keep your right knee bent at 90 degrees and your hips open to the side.
Hold the pose for 20-30 seconds, then return to warrior II and switch sides.
description_en: Reverse warrior is a standing yoga posture that targets the hip flexors and stretches the side body and obliques. It involves a warrior II base with a lateral backbend arc of the front arm, opening the chest and promoting lateral spinal flexibility.
instructions_zh: 从战士二式开始，右膝弯曲，双臂与地面平行伸展。
翻转右掌朝向天花板，吸气时将右臂向上向后划弧。
放下左手，轻放在左大腿或小腿上。
保持右膝弯曲90度，髋部向侧方打开。
保持20-30秒，然后回到战士二式并换侧。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet about 3-4 feet apart and extend your arms to the sides.
Turn your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in 45-60 degrees.
Exhale and rotate your torso to the right, placing your left hand on the floor outside your right foot or on a block.
Extend your right arm toward the ceiling and open your chest, stacking your shoulders vertically.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Revolved triangle is a standing twist yoga posture that targets the obliques and challenges hamstring flexibility. It involves rotating the torso over a straight front leg while reaching the opposite hand to the floor, promoting spinal rotation and lateral body strength.
instructions_zh: 双脚分开约3-4英尺站立，双臂向两侧伸展。
右脚向外转90度，左脚向内转45-60度。
呼气，将躯干向右旋转，左手放在右脚外侧的地面上或瑜伽砖上。
右臂向天花板伸展，打开胸腔，双肩上下对齐。
保持20-30秒，然后回到站立并换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the mat with your knees bent and feet lifted off the floor.
Hold your ankles and straighten your legs out into a V-shape, balancing on your sit bones.
Engage your core and round your lower back slightly.
Inhale and rock backward, rolling onto your upper back while maintaining the V-shape.
Exhale and rock back up to the balanced position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Rocker with open legs is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back and abdominal muscles. It involves rocking along the spine while holding the legs in a wide V-shape, developing spinal massage, core control, and hamstring flexibility.
instructions_zh: 坐在垫子上，屈膝，双脚抬离地面。
抓住脚踝，将双腿伸直成V形，以坐骨保持平衡。
收紧核心，下背部略微拱起。
吸气向后摇，滚到上背部，同时保持V形。
呼气摇回平衡位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on the mat with your knees bent and feet raised toward your glutes.
Reach back and grasp your ankles with both hands.
Engage your core and lift your chest and thighs off the mat simultaneously.
Rock forward onto your chest, then rock back onto your thighs in a controlled arc.
Continue rocking back and forth for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Rocking Pilate is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back and glutes. Performed prone while holding the ankles, it involves a rocking motion along the front of the body, strengthening the spinal extensors and improving spinal flexibility and body awareness.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫子上，屈膝，双脚向臀肌方向抬起。
向后伸手，用双手抓住脚踝。
收紧核心，同时将胸部和大腿抬离垫子。
以受控的弧线向前摇到胸部，再向后摇到大腿。
按所需次数继续前后摇动。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms by your sides, palms pressing into the mat.
Raise both legs to a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and use your abdominals to roll your hips off the mat.
Continue rolling until your legs are parallel to the floor overhead.
Open your legs slightly and slowly roll your spine back down to the mat, lowering your legs to 90 degrees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The roll over is an advanced Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and lower back. It involves rolling the legs overhead from a supine position, providing a deep spinal stretch and building significant core and abdominal strength.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂置于身体两侧，手掌压向垫子。
双腿抬起至90度角。
收紧核心，用腹肌将髋部卷离垫子。
继续滚动，直到双腿在头顶上方与地面平行。
双腿微微分开，缓慢将脊柱卷回垫子，双腿降至90度。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Hold one end of a battle rope in each hand and stand in a half-squat position.
Brace your core and keep your feet shoulder-width apart.
Rapidly raise and lower one arm while the other arm descends, creating alternating waves in the rope.
Maintain a continuous, powerful wave motion for the desired interval duration.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The rope wave is a battle rope exercise targeting the shoulders and providing full-body conditioning. The alternating wave motion engages the shoulders, arms, and core simultaneously, making it an excellent cardiovascular and muscular endurance exercise.
instructions_zh: 双手各握战绳一端，呈半蹲姿势站立。
收紧核心，双脚与肩同宽。
一臂快速上下摆动，另一臂下压，使绳子形成交替波浪。
保持连续有力的波浪动作至目标时长。
休息后按目标组数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the rowing machine, secure your feet in the straps, and grip the handle with both hands.
Begin with your knees bent, leaning slightly forward, and arms extended.
Drive through your legs to extend your knees while simultaneously leaning back slightly.
As your legs reach full extension, pull the handle toward your lower chest by bending your elbows.
Reverse the sequence to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired duration.
description_en: The rowing machine is a full-body cardio exercise targeting the back. It combines a leg drive, core engagement, and upper body pull in a single fluid motion, providing excellent cardiovascular conditioning and muscular endurance training.
instructions_zh: 坐在划船机上，双脚固定在绑带中，双手握住把手。
起始时屈膝、身体略前倾、双臂伸直。
蹬腿伸膝，同时身体略微后仰。
双腿完全伸展时，屈肘将把手拉向下胸部。
反向还原至起始姿势，按目标时长重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles.
Begin by pushing off with one foot and landing on the midfoot of the opposite foot.
Drive your arms in coordination with your legs, bending your elbows at 90 degrees.
Maintain a steady breathing rhythm and relaxed shoulders.
Continue at the desired pace for the target distance or duration.
description_en: Running is a fundamental cardiovascular exercise targeting the heart and lungs while engaging the lower body muscles. It builds aerobic endurance, burns calories, and improves cardiovascular health, making it one of the most accessible forms of exercise.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，从脚踝处略微前倾。
一只脚蹬地起跑，另一只脚以中足落地。
双臂屈肘90度，与双腿协调摆动。
保持稳定呼吸节奏，肩膀放松。
按目标配速持续至目标距离或时长。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Begin running in place by alternating lifting each foot off the ground.
Bend your arms at 90 degrees and swing them in natural opposition to your legs.
Gradually increase your pace to a comfortable running speed.
Continue for the desired duration, maintaining consistent form.
description_en: Run in place is a fundamental cardio exercise that simulates outdoor running without requiring space or equipment. It elevates the heart rate efficiently and engages the legs and arms in a natural running pattern, making it ideal for warm-ups, cardio intervals, or home workouts.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双脚与髋同宽。
开始原地跑，双脚交替抬离地面。
双臂屈肘90度，与双腿自然反向摆动。
逐渐加快至舒适的跑步速度。
保持稳定动作至目标时长。

instructions_en: Step onto the treadmill and set your desired speed and incline level.
Begin walking and gradually increase the speed to your running pace.
Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean and land softly on your midfoot.
Swing your arms in coordination with your legs to maintain rhythm.
Continue running for the desired duration, then gradually decrease speed to a walking cool down.
description_en: Running on a treadmill is a cardio exercise targeting the lower body and cardiovascular system. It provides controlled running conditions with adjustable speed and incline, making it suitable for building aerobic capacity and lower body endurance.
instructions_zh: 踏上跑步机，设定目标速度和坡度。
先步行，逐渐加速至跑步配速。
保持直立姿势，略微前倾，以中足轻柔落地。
双臂与双腿协调摆动以保持节奏。
按目标时长持续跑步，然后逐渐降速步行放松。

instructions_en: Stand upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles, not the waist.
Begin by jogging at a comfortable pace, landing midfoot with each step.
Pump your arms forward and back in opposition to your legs.
Gradually increase your pace to the desired running speed.
Continue for the desired distance or duration, maintaining a steady breathing pattern.
description_en: Running is a bodyweight cardio exercise that targets cardiovascular endurance and the muscles of the lower body. It is one of the most fundamental and effective exercises for building aerobic fitness and burning calories.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，从脚踝而非腰部略微前倾。
以舒适配速开始慢跑，每步以中足落地。
双臂与双腿反向前后摆动。
逐渐加快至目标跑步速度。
保持稳定呼吸至目标距离或时长。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly off the ground.
Lean back slightly to a 45-degree angle, keeping your back straight.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right as far as comfortable, then return to center.
Rotate to the left and return to center.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The russian twist is a classic bodyweight ab exercise that targets the obliques and core through rotational trunk movement. Performed seated with feet elevated, it challenges balance and rotational strength simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，屈膝，双脚略微离地。
身体后仰约45度，保持背部挺直。
双手在胸前合握。
躯干向右旋转至舒适幅度，然后回到中间。
向左旋转，然后回到中间。
交替两侧至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet slightly elevated, and lean back to a 45-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell beside your right hip.
Return to center and rotate to the left, bringing the dumbbell beside your left hip.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The russian twist with a dumbbell is a weighted core exercise targeting the obliques and abs through rotational movement. Holding the dumbbell increases the resistance compared to the bodyweight version, making it effective for building rotational core strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，屈膝，双脚稍微抬起，向后倾斜至45度角。
双手在胸前握住哑铃。
躯干向右旋转，将哑铃带到右髋旁。
回到中间，向左旋转，将哑铃带到左髋旁。
继续左右交替，完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet raised slightly off the ground.
Lean back to a 45-degree angle and clasp your hands together.
Rotate your torso to one side and tap your clasped hands to the floor beside your hip.
Rotate to the other side and repeat the tap.
Continue alternating sides, keeping your feet off the ground throughout.
description_en: Russian twist version 1 is a more challenging bodyweight oblique exercise with feet elevated off the floor. Removing foot support increases the balance demand and intensifies core activation compared to the standard version.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，屈膝，双脚稍微抬离地面。
向后倾斜至45度角，双手十指相扣。
躯干向一侧旋转，双手扣紧轻触髋旁地面。
转向另一侧，重复轻触动作。
继续左右交替，全程保持双脚离地。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly elevated, holding a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands.
Lean back slightly to create tension in your core, keeping your spine straight.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the floor beside your hip.
Return to center and rotate to the left, repeating the movement on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The weighted russian twist is a core exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and obliques. Performed in a seated position with the feet raised, this movement involves rotating the torso side to side with added resistance to build rotational strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，屈膝，双脚稍微抬起，双手握住杠铃片或哑铃。
稍微向后倾斜，让核心产生张力，保持脊柱挺直。
躯干向右旋转，将重物带向髋旁地面。
回到中间，向左旋转，在对侧重复动作。
继续左右交替，完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Open your mouth wide and slowly and exaggeratedly say each vowel: A, E, I, O, U.
Exaggerate the lip and jaw movements for each sound to fully engage the facial muscles.
Pause briefly between each vowel to feel the muscle engagement.
Repeat the vowel sequence for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Say vowels is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the lip, jaw, and cheek muscles. It involves exaggerated vocalization of vowel sounds to engage and tone multiple muscle groups across the face.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
张大嘴，缓慢夸张地依次说出每个元音：A、E、I、O、U。
夸张每个发音的唇部和下颌动作，充分激活面部肌肉。
每个元音之间短暂停顿，感受肌肉发力。
重复元音序列，完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit comfortably with your spine straight.
Place all fingertips on your scalp and apply gentle but firm pressure.
Move your fingertips in small circular motions across the scalp, starting from the hairline and working toward the crown.
Continue the circular massage over the sides and back of the scalp.
Repeat the full circuit for 30–60 seconds.
description_en: The scalp massage is a bodyweight exercise targeting the scalp and frontalis muscles. It involves applying circular pressure across the scalp to improve circulation, relieve tension, and promote relaxation.
instructions_zh: 舒适坐好，脊柱挺直。
将所有指尖放在头皮上，施加轻柔但稳定的压力。
指尖在头皮上做小圆周运动，从发际线开始向头顶移动。
继续在头皮两侧和后部做圆周按摩。
重复完整一圈，持续30–60秒。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with legs extended and hands placed beneath your lower back for support.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor and engage your core.
Raise your right leg upward while lowering your left leg, then switch in a scissoring motion.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and your legs as straight as possible.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
description_en: The scissor kick is a bodyweight core exercise that targets the abs and hip flexors through continuous alternating leg movement. It builds lower abdominal endurance and hip flexor strength while challenging core stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双手放在下背部下方支撑。
双腿抬离地面几英寸，收紧核心。
抬起右腿的同时放下左腿，然后像剪刀一样交替。
保持下背部压向地面，双腿尽量伸直。
继续交替，完成目标次数或时长。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with hands at your sides and legs fully extended.
Raise both legs off the floor by a few inches, keeping them straight.
Perform a large scissoring motion, raising one leg high while the other stays low.
Alternate quickly and add a slight torso crunch on each crossover.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions without letting your legs touch the floor.
description_en: Scissor kick advanced is an intense bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. The wider range of motion and added crunch element increase the challenge and activate the obliques in addition to the lower abs.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双手放在身体两侧，双腿完全伸直。
双腿抬离地面几英寸，保持伸直。
做大幅剪刀动作，一条腿抬高，另一条腿保持低位。
快速交替，每次交叉时加入轻微卷腹。
继续完成目标次数，全程不让双腿触地。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise both legs to a 90-degree angle.
Lower one leg toward the floor while keeping the other vertical.
Switch legs before the lowered leg touches the floor.
Continue alternating in a controlled scissoring pattern.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Scissor kick II is a bodyweight core variation targeting the abs with legs starting from vertical. The vertical starting position reduces hip flexor involvement and places greater emphasis on lower abdominal contraction.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿抬至90度角。
一条腿向地面放下，另一条腿保持垂直。
在放下的腿触地前换腿。
以受控的剪刀模式继续交替。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie on your back and lift both legs to a 90-degree angle.
Lift your head and shoulders off the mat, engaging your core.
Lower one leg toward the mat while holding the other raised leg with both hands.
Pull the raised leg gently toward your face in two short pulses.
Switch legs in a scissoring motion and repeat.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The scissor, also known as the single straight leg stretch, is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings and abdominal muscles. It involves alternating straight leg pulls in a curl-up position, improving hamstring flexibility and core control simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿抬起至90度。
抬起头和肩部离开垫子，收紧核心。
一条腿向垫子放下，同时双手握住抬起的腿。
将抬起的腿向面部方向轻拉，做两次短促脉冲。
像剪刀一样交换双腿并重复。
持续交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Begin in dolphin pose with your forearms flat on the mat and hips lifted high.
Walk your feet in until your hips are stacked over your shoulders in a forearm headstand.
Once balanced, slowly bend both knees and lower your feet toward the back of your head.
Arch your lower back and lift your chest to create a deep spinal curve as your feet descend.
Hold the pose for 10-20 seconds, then carefully lower your feet back to the mat and rest in child's pose.
description_en: Scorpion pose is an advanced inverted backbend yoga posture that intensely targets the lower back and spinal extensors. It involves balancing on the forearms in an inverted position while deeply arching the spine to bring the feet toward the head, requiring exceptional spinal flexibility and shoulder strength.
instructions_zh: 从海豚式开始，前臂平放垫上，臀部抬高。
双脚向手走近，直到臀部叠于肩上方，进入前臂头倒立。
平衡后，缓慢屈双膝，将双脚向脑后下放。
下背拱起，胸腔上提，双脚下降时形成深度脊柱弯曲。
保持10-20秒，然后小心将双脚放回垫上，在婴儿式中休息。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your core and sit tall with your hands placed on the floor beside you for support.
Push both knees outward against imaginary resistance, activating the hip abductors.
Hold the abducted position for 5-10 seconds.
Release and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated abductor flex is a bodyweight isometric exercise targeting the glutes and hip abductors. Sitting with knees bent and pressing them outward against resistance builds hip abductor strength and glute activation.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
收紧核心，坐直，双手放在身旁地面支撑。
双膝向外推，对抗想象中的阻力，激活髋外展肌。
保持外展姿势5-10秒。
放松并重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright on the edge of a chair or bench with feet flat on the floor and hands on your thighs.
Lift one foot slightly off the ground and move the knee outward in a hip abduction motion.
Hold the abducted position for 2-3 seconds.
Return the foot to the floor and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Seated abductor hip lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes and hip abductors. Lifting the knee outward from a seated position isolates the abductor muscles, making it an accessible exercise for hip strengthening and rehabilitation.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子或长凳边缘，坐直，双脚平放地面，双手放在大腿上。
一只脚稍微抬离地面，膝盖向外移动做髋外展动作。
保持外展姿势2-3秒。
脚放回地面，换另一侧重复。
持续交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Point your toes forward as far as possible, holding for 2-3 seconds.
Flex your feet back toward your shins, pulling your toes up, and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Rotate your ankles in circles, completing the desired number in each direction.
Repeat the point-flex-circle sequence for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated ankle stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the calves and ankle mobility. The combination of pointing, flexing, and rotating the foot improves ankle range of motion and relieves calf tightness.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿向前伸直。
脚趾尽量向前绷，保持2-3秒。
双脚向小腿方向回勾，脚趾上拉，保持2-3秒。
脚踝画圈旋转，每个方向完成目标次数。
重复绷-勾-画圈序列至目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed or folded in front of you.
Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Begin making small circular motions with both arms, gradually increasing the size of the circles.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions, then reverse the direction.
Keep your back straight and core gently engaged throughout.
description_en: Seated Arm Circles Leg Folded is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids. Performing arm circles from a seated position isolates shoulder mobility and reduces lower body involvement, making it ideal for warm-up or cool-down routines.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿交叉或折叠在身前。
双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
双臂开始做小圆圈运动，逐渐增大圆圈。
持续至目标次数，然后反方向。
全程保持背部挺直，核心轻微收紧。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Raise one arm overhead and place the hand behind your head.
Use the opposite hand to grasp the raised elbow and gently pull it toward your head.
Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, feeling a deep stretch in the tricep.
Release and repeat on the other arm.
description_en: The seated arm stretch chair is a seated overhead tricep stretch performed while sitting in a chair for stability. It targets the tricep and posterior shoulder, promoting upper arm flexibility and reducing tightness in the overhead position.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，坐直，双脚平放地面。
一只手臂举过头顶，手放在脑后。
用另一只手抓住抬起手臂的肘部，轻轻向头部方向拉。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受三头肌深度拉伸。
放松，换另一只手臂重复。

name_zh: 坐姿椅上手臂胸部拉伸
instructions_en: Sit tall in a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Clasp your hands behind your back with fingers interlaced.
Straighten your arms and lift them slightly, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Open your chest upward and hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds.
Release and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The seated arms and chest stretch chair is a seated posture and flexibility exercise that opens the chest and stretches the pectoral muscles. By clasping the hands behind the back and lifting the arms, the chest and anterior shoulder muscles are gently elongated.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿椅上手臂胸部拉伸
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，坐直，双脚平放地面。
双手在背后扣握，手指交叉。
伸直手臂并稍微抬起，肩胛骨向内收拢。
胸腔向上打开，保持拉伸20-30秒。
放松并重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Raise both arms overhead and bend your elbows, lowering your hands behind your head.
Use one hand to gently press the opposite elbow downward and backward, deepening the triceps stretch.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, keeping your spine tall and your head neutral.
Switch arms and repeat on the other side. Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated arms stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated in a chair. It involves raising the arms overhead and bending the elbows to stretch the back of the upper arms, promoting flexibility in the triceps and shoulder region.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放于地面。
双臂举过头顶，屈肘，双手置于脑后。
用一只手轻压对侧肘部向下向后，加深肱三头肌拉伸。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒，脊柱挺直，头部中立。
换臂，另一侧重复。按所需次数继续。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your core engaged.
Raise both arms straight overhead, reaching as high as possible and feeling a full stretch along the sides of your body.
Hold the raised position briefly, then slowly lower your arms back down to your sides.
At the lowered position, gently press your arms down and slightly behind your hips to feel a stretch through your anterior shoulder.
Repeat the upward and downward movement in a fluid, controlled motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated arms up down stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids, performed while seated. It involves raising both arms overhead and lowering them back down in a controlled motion to stretch and mobilize the shoulder girdle, trapezius, and triceps.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放于地面，核心收紧。
双臂伸直举过头顶，尽量向上伸展，感受身体两侧充分拉伸。
短暂保持上举姿势，然后缓慢将双臂放回体侧。
在放下位置，双臂向下并稍向后髋方向轻压，感受肩前侧拉伸。
以流畅可控的动作重复上下运动，完成所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with back support and position a barbell across your upper traps behind your neck.
Grip the bar wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Slowly lower the bar back behind your neck to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated behind-the-neck press is an advanced barbell shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids through a vertical pressing motion with the bar behind the head. It places significant stress on the shoulder joint and requires adequate flexibility and mobility to perform safely.
instructions_zh: 坐在有靠背的训练凳上，将杠铃置于颈后上斜方肌处。
以正握方式，宽于肩宽握住杠铃。
向上推举杠铃，直至双臂完全伸直过头。
缓慢将杠铃放回颈后起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

name_en: seated bent knee forward fold glutes
name_zh: 坐姿屈膝前屈臀部拉伸
instructions_en: Sit on the floor and cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-four position.
Flex the foot of the crossed leg to protect the knee.
Lean forward gently from the hips until you feel a deep stretch in the outer glute of the crossed leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
Repeat on each side for the desired number of holds.
description_en: Seated bent knee forward fold glutes is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the glutes. The figure-four leg position during the forward fold isolates the piriformis and gluteal muscles for a deep hip and glute release.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿屈膝前屈臀部拉伸
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，将一侧脚踝交叉放在对侧膝盖上，呈四字姿势。
勾起交叉腿的脚踝以保护膝盖。
从髋部轻柔前倾，直至交叉腿外侧臀部感到深度拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后换侧。
每侧按所需保持次数重复。

name_en: seated bent knee forward fold (head to floor)
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Lean forward from the hips, reaching your torso toward your thighs.
Continue folding forward until your head reaches toward the floor in front of your feet.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Slowly roll up to the starting position and repeat.
description_en: Seated bent knee forward fold (head to floor) is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings and lower back. The deep forward fold with bent knees allows the spine to decompress and the posterior chain to relax into a deep stretch.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，屈膝，双脚平放于地面。
从髋部前倾，躯干向大腿方向靠近。
继续前屈，直至头部朝向双脚前方的地面。
保持姿势20-30秒，深呼吸。
缓慢起身回到起始位置并重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your hands placed flat on the ground behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor and begin pedaling your legs in a smooth cycling motion.
Alternate extending and bending each leg in a continuous bicycle pattern.
Keep your core engaged and your torso from collapsing backward.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated bike hand on floor is a bodyweight core exercise that simulates a bicycle motion from a seated floor position with hand support. It targets the hip flexors and abs through the continuous pedaling action, offering an accessible floor-based cardio and core drill.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双手平放于身后地面支撑。
双脚抬离地面，开始以流畅的骑行动作蹬腿。
双腿交替伸展和弯曲，呈连续自行车动作。
保持核心收紧，躯干不要向后塌陷。
按所需时长继续。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together, letting your knees fall outward.
Hold your feet with both hands and sit as tall as possible.
Gently press your knees downward toward the floor using your elbows.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the pressure and repeat.
description_en: The seated butterfly open stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hip flexors and inner thighs. Pressing the knees toward the floor from a butterfly position improves hip external rotation and groin flexibility.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双脚脚掌相对，膝盖向外打开。
双手握住双脚，尽量坐直。
用肘部将膝盖轻柔向下压向地面。
保持拉伸20-30秒。
释放压力并重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the seated cable row bench with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the v-bar or cable handles and sit upright with a neutral spine.
Pull the handles toward your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the fully contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated cable row is a foundational back exercise targeting the lats and mid-back through a horizontal pulling motion. The cable provides constant tension, making it effective for building back thickness and improving posture.
instructions_zh: 坐在坐姿划船器上，双脚踩在踏板上，膝盖微屈。
握住V形把手或缆绳把手，坐直，脊柱中立。
将把手拉向下腹部，肘部向后驱动。
在完全收缩位置将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
缓慢伸直双臂回到起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit at a seated calf raise machine with the knee pads positioned over your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform, allowing your heels to hang.
Lower your heels as far as comfortable to get a full stretch in the calves.
Press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated calf raise is a machine-based isolation exercise targeting the calves, with particular emphasis on the soleus. The seated position bends the knee and places greater stress on the soleus compared to standing variations.
instructions_zh: 坐在提踵机上，膝垫置于大腿上方。
前脚掌踩在踏板上，脚跟悬空。
脚跟尽量下放，充分拉伸小腿。
前脚掌发力，将脚跟抬至最高。
顶端稍停，然后缓慢下放。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a leg press machine and place the balls of your feet at the lower edge of the footplate.
Extend your legs slightly and unlock the machine.
Lower your heels below the footplate to get a full stretch in the calves.
Press your toes upward by plantarflexing your ankles as high as possible.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower your heels back to the stretched position and repeat.
description_en: The seated calf raise on a leg press machine targets the calves with the knees bent, which shifts the emphasis to the soleus muscle. It is an effective machine-based calf exercise for building lower leg size and strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，前脚掌踩在踏板下缘。
双腿微伸，解锁器械。
脚跟下放至踏板下方，充分拉伸小腿。
踝关节跖屈，将脚尖向上推至最高。
顶端停顿，然后缓慢下放脚跟至拉伸位并重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your knees.
Inhale deeply and arch your lower back, pushing your chest forward and lifting your head slightly to enter the cow position.
Exhale and round your spine, tucking your chin toward your chest and drawing your navel toward your spine to enter the cat position.
Continue flowing between the two positions in sync with your breathing, moving slowly and with control.
Repeat for 8-10 cycles or the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated cat cow stretch is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the lower back, performed while seated in a chair. It involves alternating between arching and rounding the spine in coordination with the breath, promoting spinal flexibility, core engagement, and tension relief in the back and neck.
instructions_zh: 端坐椅上，双脚平放地面，双手放在膝上。
深吸气，下背拱起，胸部前推，头部微抬，进入牛式。
呼气，脊柱拱圆，下巴收向胸部，肚脐收向脊柱，进入猫式。
配合呼吸在两姿势间缓慢有控制地流动。
重复8-10个循环或目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit near the edge of your chair with your feet flat on the floor, slightly wider than hip-width apart.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly hinge forward from your hips, lowering your torso toward your thighs.
Let your hands hang down toward the floor or rest them lightly on your shins.
Relax your head and neck, allowing your upper body to drape forward and feeling a deep stretch through your lower back.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply, then slowly roll back up to seated. Repeat as desired.
description_en: The seated chair forward fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the lower back, performed while seated. It involves hinging forward from the hips to drape the torso over the thighs, releasing tension in the lower back, hamstrings, and glutes.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子前缘，双脚平放地面，略宽于髋。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气从髋部缓慢前屈，躯干向大腿下放。
双手垂向地面或轻放小腿上。
放松头颈，上身自然下垂，感受下背深度拉伸。
保持20-30秒，深呼吸，然后缓慢卷起回到坐姿。按需重复。

name_en: seated chair forward fold leg touch hips up
name_zh: 坐姿椅上体前屈触腿抬髋
instructions_en: Sit at the front edge of a chair with your legs extended and feet together on the floor.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach your hands toward your feet or the floor.
Press through your heels and engage your glutes as you fold forward.
Hold the lowest point briefly, then press your hips slightly upward to deepen the stretch.
Return to an upright position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The seated chair forward fold leg touch hips up is a seated hamstring and lower back stretch that combines a forward fold with a mild hip lift to intensify the stretch. It targets the hamstrings while also engaging the glutes and decompressing the lower spine.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿椅上体前屈触腿抬髋
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子前缘，双腿伸直，双脚并拢踩地。
从髋部前屈，双手伸向双脚或地面。
脚跟发力，收紧臀肌，加深前屈。
最低点稍停，然后臀部微向上推以加深拉伸。
回到直立位，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Lift one foot off the ground and bend the knee, bringing it toward your chest.
Hold the shin or knee with both hands to assist in raising the leg.
Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch in the hip flexor and glute.
Lower the leg and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The seated chair leg bent hold is a seated exercise targeting the hip flexors and quads through a sustained hold of one raised bent leg. It can be used for gentle hip mobilization and stretching or as an accessible core stability drill.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，双脚平放地面。
抬起一只脚，屈膝拉向胸部。
双手抱住小腿或膝盖辅助抬腿。
保持20-30秒，感受髋屈肌和臀肌拉伸。
放下腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs.
Begin lifting one knee at a time in a marching motion.
Drive each knee up to hip height alternately, pumping your arms in sync.
Maintain a brisk, consistent pace throughout.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated chair march is a low-impact cardio exercise performed while seated. It mimics marching by alternately lifting the knees, raising the heart rate, and engaging the hip flexors and core without placing load on the joints, making it ideal for seniors or those with limited mobility.
instructions_zh: 端坐椅上，双脚平放地面，双手放在大腿上。
开始交替抬膝，做踏步动作。
双膝交替抬至髋部高度，手臂同步摆动。
保持轻快一致的节奏。
持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your core engaged and feet flat on the floor.
Make fists with both hands and hold them at chest height.
Extend one arm forward in a controlled punching motion.
Retract that arm and immediately extend the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms at a brisk pace for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated chair punch is a seated cardio and strength exercise that alternates forward punching motions while seated. It targets the shoulders and triceps while engaging the core for stability, providing an upper body cardio stimulus suitable for chair-based or low-impact workouts.
instructions_zh: 端坐椅上，核心收紧，双脚平放地面。
双手握拳，置于胸部高度。
一侧手臂有控制地向前出拳。
收回该臂，立即伸出另一侧手臂。
双臂交替快速出拳，持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your arms crossed over your chest.
Keeping your hips facing forward and stationary, rotate your upper body to one side.
Hold the rotated position for a moment, feeling the stretch across your upper back.
Return to center and rotate to the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated chair twist upper back is a seated rotational mobility exercise targeting the thoracic spine and upper back muscles. By rotating the torso while keeping the hips still, the traps and lats are stretched while spinal rotation and flexibility are improved.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放地面，双臂交叉于胸前。
保持髋部朝前不动，将上半身向一侧旋转。
保持旋转姿势片刻，感受上背部的拉伸。
回到中间位置，再向另一侧旋转。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright at the edge of your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall.
Clasp your hands behind your back or interlace your fingers at your lower back.
Gently draw your shoulder blades together and lift your chest upward, feeling an opening sensation across the front of your chest.
Hold this position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply into your chest.
Release your hands and return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated chest opener is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, performed while seated in a chair. It involves clasping the hands behind the back and drawing the shoulder blades together to open the chest, counteracting the effects of prolonged sitting and forward posture.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双脚平放地面，脊柱向上延伸。
双手在背后相扣，或在腰后十指交叉。
轻轻将肩胛骨向中间收拢，胸口向上提起，感受胸前打开的感觉。
保持此姿势20-30秒，深呼吸扩张胸腔。
松开双手回到起始姿势，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height.
Rapidly draw your arms in front of you, crossing them at the wrists, then open them back out to the sides.
Continue the opening and closing motion at a brisk pace.
Perform for the desired duration to elevate the heart rate.
description_en: The seated chest opener is a chair-based cardio exercise that dynamically opens and closes the arms to engage the chest and shoulders. The rapid arm movement increases heart rate while stretching the pectoral muscles, making it an effective seated cardio and mobility drill.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放地面。
双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
快速将双臂收至身前，在手腕处交叉，再向两侧打开。
以较快节奏持续做开合动作。
持续至目标时间，以提高心率。

name_zh: 坐姿胸部支撑器械划船
instructions_en: Sit facing a chest-supported row machine and press your chest firmly against the pad.
Grip the handles with both hands using a neutral or overhand grip.
Pull the handles back towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades and driving your elbows back.
Pause at the peak of the contraction, squeezing your lats and rhomboids.
Slowly release the handles back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated chest-supported row machine is a machine exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi. The chest pad eliminates lower back involvement, allowing full focus on the back muscles and making it an effective isolation option for upper back development.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿胸部支撑器械划船
instructions_zh: 面向胸部支撑划船机坐下，将胸部紧贴靠垫。
双手以对握或正握握住把手。
肩胛骨后缩，肘部向后拉，将把手拉向身体。
在收缩顶点停顿，挤压背阔肌和菱形肌。
缓慢将把手放回起始位置，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit comfortably in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs.
Close your eyes and bring your attention to your natural breathing rhythm.
Inhale slowly through your nose for a count of four, allowing your belly to expand fully outward.
Hold the breath briefly at the top, then exhale slowly through your mouth for a count of six, releasing all tension from your body.
Continue this deep breathing pattern for 5-10 repetitions, allowing your body to relax progressively with each exhale.
description_en: The seated deep breath relax is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the abdominal breathing muscles, performed while seated. It involves slow, deliberate diaphragmatic breathing to reduce stress, lower muscular tension, and promote mental and physical relaxation.
instructions_zh: 舒适地坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，双手放在大腿上。
闭上眼睛，将注意力集中在自然的呼吸节奏上。
用鼻子缓慢吸气，数四下，让腹部充分向外扩张。
吸气顶端稍作停顿，再用嘴缓慢呼气，数六下，释放全身紧张。
继续此深呼吸模式5-10次，每次呼气时让身体逐渐放松。

instructions_en: Sit on an upright bench with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Keep your back flat against the bench and feet planted firmly on the floor.
Press both dumbbells overhead simultaneously until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated dumbbell press is a compound shoulder exercise targeting the deltoids and triceps. The seated position stabilizes the torso and eliminates leg drive, placing the full load on the shoulders and making it effective for building overhead pressing strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在直立靠背椅上，双手各持哑铃置于肩高，掌心朝前。
背部平贴椅背，双脚稳稳踩地。
同时将两个哑铃向上推举，直至手臂完全伸直。
在顶端停顿，然后缓慢将哑铃放回肩高。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your core engaged.
Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Sweep your arms forward and cross them in front of your chest in a hugging motion.
Sweep them back to the starting position, squeezing your shoulder blades together as you open your chest.
Continue the dynamic sweeping motion in a controlled manner for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining an upright posture throughout.
description_en: The seated dynamic chest stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, performed while seated. It involves sweeping the arms forward and back in a dynamic motion to open the chest, improve shoulder mobility, and reduce upper body tension.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放地面，核心收紧。
双臂向两侧伸展至肩高，掌心朝前。
双臂向前扫过，在胸前交叉做拥抱动作。
再扫回起始位置，打开胸腔时挤压肩胛骨。
以可控方式持续做动态扫臂动作至目标次数，全程保持背部挺直。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your knees.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, sitting as tall as possible.
Exhale and slowly round your back, drawing your shoulders forward and pulling your navel toward your spine.
Inhale again and return to the tall seated position, extending through the crown of your head.
Continue this dynamic movement in coordination with your breath for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated dynamic stretch is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the lower back, performed while seated in a chair. It involves rhythmically rounding and extending the spine in sync with the breath to improve spinal mobility, release tension, and gently engage the core.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，背部挺直，双脚平放地面，双手放在膝盖上。
吸气，拉长脊柱，尽量坐高。
呼气，缓慢弓背，肩膀向前收，肚脐向脊柱方向收。
再次吸气，回到坐高的姿势，头顶向上延伸。
配合呼吸继续此动态动作至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit comfortably in your chair with your back supported and your feet flat on the floor.
Gently close your eyes and place your hands on your abdomen to feel the movement of your breath.
Inhale slowly through your nose, expanding your belly outward against your hands for a count of four.
Exhale gently through your nose or mouth for a count of six, allowing your abdomen to fall inward and release all tension.
Continue breathing in this manner for 5-10 cycles, focusing your attention fully on the sensation of each breath.
description_en: The seated eyes close deep breath is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the diaphragm and abdominal muscles, performed with eyes closed while seated. It involves deliberate nasal breathing with focused attention on the belly to encourage relaxation, improve breath awareness, and reduce stress.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上，背部有支撑，双脚平放地面，保持舒适。
轻轻闭上眼睛，双手放在腹部，感受呼吸的起伏。
用鼻子缓慢吸气，让腹部向外扩张顶住双手，数四下。
用鼻子或嘴巴轻柔呼气，数六下，让腹部内收，释放所有紧张。
持续以这种方式呼吸5-10个循环，将注意力完全集中在每次呼吸的感觉上。

instructions_en: Sit near the edge of your chair with your back straight and your core lightly engaged.
Place both hands on the sides of the chair seat for stability.
Swing one leg forward and backward in a controlled but brisk motion, keeping the knee soft.
Allow the hip joint to move freely through its range of motion, increasing the pace slightly while maintaining control.
Continue for the desired number of swings, then switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The seated fast leg swing is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while seated. It involves swinging one leg forward and backward at a brisk pace to dynamically warm up the hip joint, improve range of motion, and engage the upper leg muscles.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，核心轻微收紧。
双手放在椅子座面两侧以保持稳定。
一条腿以受控但轻快的动作前后摆动，膝盖保持放松。
让髋关节在其活动范围内自由运动，稍微加快速度同时保持控制。
持续所需次数后，换另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Begin rapidly tapping your toes on the floor, alternating left and right.
Keep the movement quick and light, staying on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet if desired.
Continue for the desired duration at maximum speed.
description_en: The seated fast toe taps chair is a seated cardio drill that targets the calves and improves foot speed while seated. Rapidly alternating toe taps elevates the heart rate and engages the lower leg muscles, providing an accessible cardiovascular stimulus with minimal joint load.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面。
开始快速用脚尖交替点地，左右交替。
保持动作快速轻巧，用前脚掌发力。
如需要，手臂可与双脚节奏同步摆动。
以最大速度持续所需时间。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor and lean back slightly, placing your hands behind you for support.
Lift both feet off the floor with your legs extended.
Begin rapidly alternating small up and down kicks with each leg.
Keep the kicks controlled and the legs relatively straight.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated flutter kick 1 is a bodyweight core and hip flexor exercise performed from a seated position with hand support. Rapidly alternating leg kicks while seated targets the lower abs and hip flexors, serving as an accessible variation of the lying flutter kick.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，身体稍微后倾，双手放在身后支撑。
双腿伸直，将双脚抬离地面。
开始快速交替做小幅上下踢腿动作。
保持踢腿受控，双腿相对伸直。
持续所需时间。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a chair and grip the sides of the seat for support.
Lean back slightly and lift both feet off the floor.
Begin rapidly alternating small kicks up and down with your legs, keeping them relatively straight.
Keep your core engaged and your lower back from arching excessively.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated flutter kicks chair version is a seated core and hip flexor exercise that replicates the lying flutter kick in an upright position. By alternating rapid leg kicks while seated, the hip flexors and lower abs are engaged, making it suitable for chair-based workouts.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，双手抓住座面两侧支撑。
身体稍微后倾，将双脚抬离地面。
开始快速交替做小幅上下踢腿，双腿保持相对伸直。
保持核心收紧，避免下背部过度弓起。
持续所需时间。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and spine tall.
Flex your feet and engage your quadriceps, pressing the backs of your legs into the mat.
Inhale and lengthen your spine, then exhale and hinge forward from the hips over your legs.
Reach your hands toward your feet, holding your ankles, shins, or feet.
Hold the stretch for 30-60 seconds, maintaining length in your spine, then inhale and slowly return to seated.
description_en: Seated forward bend is a foundational yoga posture that deeply targets the hamstrings and lower back. It involves folding the torso over extended legs from a seated position, promoting posterior chain flexibility and calming the nervous system.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直，脊柱挺直。
勾脚，收紧股四头肌，将腿后侧压向垫面。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气从髋部向前折叠越过双腿。
双手伸向双脚，抓住脚踝、小腿或脚。
保持拉伸30-60秒，维持脊柱延展，然后吸气缓慢回到坐姿。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both legs extended straight in front of you.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward toward your feet.
Hinge from the hips and fold your torso forward as far as comfortable.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Slowly return to the upright seated position and repeat.
description_en: Seated forward fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings. Folding the torso over straight legs from a seated position provides a deep stretch along the entire posterior chain, from hamstrings to calves.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
坐直，双臂向前伸向双脚。
从髋部折叠，将躯干向前弯至舒适范围。
保持姿势20-30秒，深呼吸。
缓慢回到直立坐姿并重复。

instructions_en: Sit at the edge of your chair with your feet flat on the floor and slightly wider than hip-width apart.
Hinge forward from your hips, lowering your torso toward your thighs with your hands reaching toward the floor.
From the folded position, engage your glutes and press through your feet to lift your hips slightly upward off the seat.
Hold the lifted position for a moment, feeling the stretch in your lower back and hamstrings.
Lower your hips back to the seat, sit up slowly, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated forward fold hips lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back, performed while seated. It combines a forward fold with a hip lift to simultaneously stretch and activate the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings, providing effective relief from spinal tension.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，双脚平放地面，间距略宽于髋部。
从髋部向前折叠，躯干向大腿方向下压，双手伸向地面。
从折叠位置收紧臀肌，通过双脚发力将髋部稍微抬离座面。
保持抬起位置片刻，感受下背部和腘绳肌的拉伸。
将髋部放回座面，缓慢坐直，重复所需次数。

name_en: seated forward fold with bent knees
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with both legs slightly bent in front of you.
Reach your arms forward and fold your torso toward your thighs.
Allow your back to round gently and your head to drop.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the release in the lower back.
Slowly return upright and repeat.
description_en: Seated forward fold with bent knees is a bodyweight stretch targeting the lower back. Bending the knees reduces hamstring tension and allows a greater focus on releasing the lumbar spine and glutes in the folded position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿微屈置于身前。
双臂前伸，躯干向大腿方向折叠。
让背部自然弯曲，头部自然下垂。
保持20-30秒，感受下背部的放松。
缓慢起身回到直立位并重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed comfortably in front of you.
Sit tall, lengthening your spine, and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
Slowly walk your hands forward, hinging at the hips and folding your torso over your crossed legs.
Lower your chest as close to the floor as comfortable, feeling a deep stretch in your glutes and outer hips.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, then slowly walk your hands back and return to an upright seated position.
Repeat with the opposite leg crossed on top.
description_en: The seated forward over crossed legs is a bodyweight stretch targeting the glutes and outer hip area. By folding the torso forward over crossed legs, it provides a deep stretch to the glutes and hip rotators while also engaging the lower back and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双腿舒适交叉置于身前。
坐直并延展脊柱，双手放在身前地板上。
以髋部为轴缓慢向前爬手，躯干向交叉的双腿方向折叠。
在舒适范围内将胸部尽量贴近地板，感受臀部和外侧髋部的深度拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后缓慢收回双手回到直立坐姿。
换另一条腿交叉在上方重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Place your hands lightly on your thighs and engage your core.
Squeeze both glute muscles as tightly as possible, holding the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Release the squeeze completely and rest briefly before initiating the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, focusing on a strong contraction with each squeeze.
description_en: The seated glute squeeze is an isometric bodyweight strength exercise targeting the gluteal muscles, performed while seated in a chair. It involves contracting the glutes as firmly as possible and holding the contraction to strengthen and activate the glute muscles without any external movement.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子上保持直立，双脚平放地面，背部挺直。
双手轻放大腿上，收紧核心。
尽可能用力挤压两侧臀部肌肉，保持收缩5-10秒。
完全放松挤压并短暂休息，再进行下一次重复。
按目标次数重复，每次挤压注重强力收缩。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a chair with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your hips toward the chair, bending your knees and hinging at the hips.
Stop when your hips are just above the chair seat, hovering without fully sitting.
Hold the position for a moment, then push through your heels to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated half squat is a beginner-friendly squat variation that uses a chair as a depth guide. By stopping the descent just above the seat, the quads, glutes, and hamstrings are engaged through a partial range of motion, making it ideal for those building squat strength or mobility.
instructions_zh: 站在椅子前方，双脚与肩同宽。
屈膝并以髋部为轴，将臀部向椅子方向下放。
当臀部刚好高于椅面时停住，悬停但不要完全坐下。
保持片刻，然后通过脚跟发力回到站立位。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with one leg extended straight out in front of you and the other leg bent with the sole of the foot against the inner thigh.
Sit tall and place your hands on either side of the extended leg.
Hinging at the hips, slowly lean your torso forward over the extended leg, reaching toward your foot.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling tension in the back of the thigh.
Return to the upright position and switch legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The seated hamstring stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings. Performed in a single-leg extended seated position, it involves a forward hip hinge to stretch the back of the thigh and calf, and is widely used to improve posterior chain flexibility.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，一条腿向前伸直，另一条腿弯曲，脚底贴住伸直腿的大腿内侧。
坐直，双手放在伸直腿两侧。
以髋部为轴，躯干缓慢向伸直腿方向前倾，向脚的方向伸展。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受大腿后侧的张力。
回到直立位并换腿。
每侧按目标次数重复。

name_en: seated hamstring stretch (one leg bent inward)
instructions_en: Sit on the floor and extend one leg straight while bending the other so the foot rests against the inner thigh of the extended leg.
Sit tall and reach both hands toward the foot of the extended leg.
Fold forward gently from the hips until you feel the stretch in the hamstring of the extended leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
Repeat on each side for the desired number of holds.
description_en: The seated hamstring stretch (one leg bent inward) is a bodyweight flexibility exercise targeting the hamstrings. The single-leg focus allows a deeper and more targeted stretch on one hamstring at a time.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿单腿内收腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，一条腿伸直，另一条腿弯曲，脚贴住伸直腿的大腿内侧。
坐直，双手向伸直腿的脚方向伸展。
从髋部轻柔前折，直到感受伸直腿腘绳肌的拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后换腿。
每侧按目标保持次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Begin lifting one knee toward your chest as high as comfortable.
Lower that leg and immediately lift the opposite knee in an alternating fashion.
Pump your arms in coordination with your legs to increase intensity.
Continue at a brisk pace for the desired duration.
description_en: Seated high knees is a chair-based cardio exercise that mimics the standing high knee drill from a seated position. It raises the heart rate and engages the hip flexors and abs while remaining accessible to those with lower extremity limitations or those performing chair-based workouts.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘保持直立，双脚平放地面。
开始将一侧膝盖向胸部方向尽量抬高。
放下该腿并立即交替抬起对侧膝盖。
双臂配合腿部摆动以增加强度。
以较快节奏持续目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor with knees bent toward your chest.
Extend your legs straight out in front of you, then draw them back in.
Continue the in-and-out motion for the desired repetitions.
Keep your core engaged and maintain control throughout.
description_en: The seated in-and-outs hand support hold is a bodyweight core exercise performed from a seated position with hand support behind the hips. The alternate drawing in and extending of the legs targets the abs and hip flexors through a dynamic range of motion.
instructions_zh: 坐在地板上，双手放在臀部后方支撑。
身体稍后倾，双脚离地，膝盖弯曲收向胸部。
双腿向前伸直，然后收回。
按目标次数持续进行收伸动作。
保持核心收紧并全程控制动作。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your hands placed beside your hips for support.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the ground, extending your legs straight out in front of you.
Hold this extended position with your core fully engaged and your spine neutral.
Keep your legs elevated and together throughout the hold duration.
Maintain steady breathing and sustain the position for the desired time.
description_en: The seated in-and-outs hold is a bodyweight isometric core exercise performed from a seated position. It involves holding the legs extended while leaning back, placing sustained demand on the abs and hip flexors. The movement builds core endurance and lower abdominal strength.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双手放在臀部两侧支撑。
身体稍向后倾，双脚抬离地面，双腿向前伸直。
保持伸展姿势，核心收紧，脊柱保持中立。
整个保持过程中双腿抬起并并拢。
保持稳定呼吸，维持姿势至目标时间。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Interlace your fingers and extend both arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palms facing outward.
Round your upper back and push your palms forward, separating your shoulder blades and feeling a stretch through the middle of your back.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Release and return to the upright starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated interlaced back is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the rhomboids, performed while seated in a chair. It involves interlacing the fingers and pressing the arms forward while rounding the upper back to stretch the muscles between the shoulder blades, promoting upper back mobility and tension relief.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，背部挺直。
双手手指交叉，双臂向前伸直与肩同高，掌心朝外。
上背部拱起，掌根向前推，肩胛骨分开，感受背部中段的拉伸。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒，深呼吸。
放松回到直立起始姿势。按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Reach both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers together with your palms facing inward.
Gently pull your clasped hands downward and slightly away from your back, lifting your chest and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily and feeling the stretch across your chest and upper back.
Release your hands and return to the starting position. Repeat as desired.
description_en: The seated interlaced fingers behind back 1 is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the rhomboids. It involves clasping the hands behind the back and drawing them downward to open the chest and engage the upper back muscles, counteracting the forward posture common with desk work.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面。
双臂伸向背后，手指交叉，掌心朝内。
双手轻轻向下拉并稍远离背部，挺胸，肩胛骨向内收紧。
保持姿势20-30秒，平稳呼吸，感受胸部和上背部的拉伸。
松开双手回到起始姿势。按需重复。

name_en: seated interlaced fingers behind back stretch
name_zh: 坐姿背后十指交叉拉伸
instructions_en: Sit tall in your chair with your core engaged and your feet flat on the floor.
Bring both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers with your palms facing inward.
Straighten your arms fully and gently pull them downward while drawing your shoulder blades firmly together and lifting your chest upward.
Hold this stretch for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply into your chest.
Release the hands and relax back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated interlaced fingers behind back stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the rhomboids, performed while seated. It involves interlacing the hands behind the body and extending the arms to open the chest and stretch the pectoral and upper back muscles simultaneously.
name_zh_llm: 坐姿背后十指交叉拉伸
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，核心收紧，双脚平放地面。
双臂放到背后，手指交叉，掌心朝内。
双臂完全伸直，轻轻向下拉，同时肩胛骨用力向内收紧，胸部向上提起。
保持拉伸20-30秒，深呼吸至胸腔。
松开双手放松回到起始姿势。按目标次数重复。

name_en: seated interlaced fingers behind back version 1
instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your spine tall and your feet flat on the ground.
Clasp both hands behind your lower back with fingers interlaced and palms facing each other.
Extend your arms fully, gently pressing your knuckles toward the floor while lifting your sternum toward the ceiling.
Tilt your head slightly back to deepen the chest opening and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower your chin, release your hands, and return to the starting position. Repeat as needed.
description_en: The seated interlaced fingers behind back version 1 is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the rhomboids and chest, performed while seated. It involves clasping the hands behind the back and fully extending the arms with a slight head tilt to achieve a deeper chest and upper back opening.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，脊柱挺直，双脚平放地面。
双手在腰后相扣，手指交叉，掌心相对。
双臂完全伸直，指节轻轻向下压，同时胸骨向上提起。
头部稍向后仰以加深胸腔打开，保持20-30秒。
下巴收回，松开双手回到起始姿势。按需重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright on the floor with your legs extended straight out in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right foot over your left leg, placing it flat on the floor outside your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently press to rotate your torso to the right.
Extend your right arm behind you for support and look over your right shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then slowly release and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The seated iron cross stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back through spinal rotation. Performed seated with one knee bent and crossed over, it uses the elbow as a lever to deepen the twist, releasing tension in the lower back, obliques, and glutes.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲右膝，右脚跨过左腿，平放在左膝外侧的地面上。
左肘放在右膝外侧，轻轻施压使躯干向右旋转。
右臂向后伸展支撑，目光越过右肩。
保持拉伸20-30秒，然后缓慢放松，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright on the floor with both legs extended straight out in front of you.
Cross your right ankle over your left thigh just above the knee, keeping your right foot flexed.
Place both hands on the floor beside your hips for support and sit tall.
Gently rotate your torso toward the bent knee, using your hands to maintain balance.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the rotation through your lower back and hips, then switch sides.
description_en: The seated iron cross stretch version1 is a bodyweight variation of the seated iron cross stretch targeting the lower back. With the ankle crossed over the opposite thigh, the torso rotates gently toward the bent leg, creating a combined hip and spinal mobility stretch.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直。
右脚踝交叉放在左大腿膝盖上方，右脚保持勾脚。
双手放在臀部两侧地面支撑，坐直。
躯干轻轻向弯曲的膝盖方向旋转，用手保持平衡。
保持20-30秒，感受下背部和髋部的旋转，然后换侧。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Engage your core and slowly lift one foot off the ground, extending your leg out straight in front of you.
Hold the extended position for 2-3 seconds, squeezing your quadriceps firmly at the top.
Slowly lower your foot back toward the floor without fully resting it between repetitions.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The seated knee extension is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed while seated. It involves extending one leg to a straight position and holding briefly to strengthen the quads and improve knee joint stability, making it ideal for rehabilitation and office-based conditioning.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，背部挺直。
核心收紧，缓慢抬起一只脚离开地面，腿向前伸直。
保持伸展姿势2-3秒，在顶端用力收紧股四头肌。
缓慢放下脚靠近地面，组间不要完全落地。
按目标次数重复，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a chair with your hands gripping the sides of the seat for support.
Lean back slightly and extend one leg out in front of you.
Draw your knee toward your chest, contracting your abs at the top.
Extend the leg back out and repeat on the same side for the desired reps before switching.
Keep your core engaged throughout the movement.
description_en: The seated knee-to-chest crunch is a chair-based core exercise that targets the abs through a knee drive from a seated position. It engages the hip flexors and lower abdominals, making it an accessible crunch variation for those seeking a seated core workout.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，双手抓住座椅两侧支撑。
身体稍向后倾，向前伸直一条腿。
将膝盖拉向胸口，在顶端收紧腹肌。
将腿伸回，按目标次数重复同侧后再换边。
整个动作过程中保持核心收紧。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a chair and grip the sides of the seat for support.
Lean back slightly and lift both feet off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Hold the knees-to-chest position for the desired duration.
Keep your core fully contracted and your lower back from rounding excessively.
Lower your feet and return to the starting position before repeating.
description_en: The seated knee-to-chest crunch V hold is an isometric chair-based core exercise that holds the knees toward the chest from a seated position. The sustained contraction intensifies the demand on the abs and hip flexors compared to the standard knee-to-chest crunch variation.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，双手抓住座椅两侧支撑。
身体稍向后倾，双脚离地，将双膝拉向胸口。
保持膝盖贴胸姿势至目标时长。
保持核心完全收紧，下背部不要过度弯曲。
放下双脚回到起始位置后重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the sides for support and legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet off the floor.
Bring your knees toward your chest by contracting your abs.
Pause at the top, then extend your legs back out without letting your feet touch the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Seated knee tucks are a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles from a bench-seated position. Drawing the knees to the chest while keeping the feet elevated challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳边缘，双手抓住两侧支撑，双腿向前伸直。
身体稍向后倾，双脚离地。
收紧腹肌，将双膝拉向胸口。
在顶端停顿，然后伸回双腿，双脚不要触地。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs, palms facing inward.
Engage your core and maintain an upright torso.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they are at shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated lateral raise is a shoulder isolation exercise targeting the lateral deltoids while seated to reduce the temptation to use momentum. It develops shoulder width and is a key movement for well-rounded shoulder development.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳上，双手各持哑铃置于大腿上，掌心相对。
收紧核心，保持躯干直立。
双臂向两侧抬起至与肩同高。
在顶端短暂停顿，然后缓慢将哑铃放回大腿。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor and lean slightly back with hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet and bend your knees to 90 degrees.
Begin alternating kicks by extending one leg out straight while keeping the other bent.
Return and switch legs in a flutter kick pattern.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The seated leg bent flutter kick is a seated core exercise that performs the flutter kick with a bent-knee starting position. The knee bend reduces the lever arm compared to a straight-leg variation, making it more accessible while still targeting the hip flexors and lower abs.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，身体稍向后倾，双手在身后支撑。
抬起双脚，膝盖弯曲至90度。
开始交替踢腿，一条腿伸直，另一条腿保持弯曲。
收回并换腿，以交替踢腿模式进行。
持续至目标时长。

instructions_en: Sit in the seated leg curl machine with your back against the pad and the roller positioned just above your heels.
Grip the handles and align your knees with the machine's pivot point.
Curl your legs downward as far as possible, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause at the fully curled position, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated leg curl is a machine-based isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings. Performed in a seated position, the movement provides consistent resistance throughout the range of motion for hamstring development.
instructions_zh: 坐在坐姿腿弯举机上，背部贴紧靠垫，滚垫位于脚跟上方。
握住把手，使膝盖与机器转轴对齐。
尽可能向下弯举双腿，收紧腘绳肌。
在完全弯举位置停顿，然后缓慢回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the seated leg curl machine and adjust the back pad so your knees align with the pivot point.
Place your legs over the top pad and secure the lower pad just above your ankles.
Curl your legs downward by bending your knees as far as the machine allows.
Pause at the bottom and squeeze your hamstrings.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated leg curl machine is an isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings. The seated position changes the angle of hip flexion compared to the lying curl, creating a different stimulus on the hamstring muscles for complete development.
instructions_zh: 坐在坐姿腿弯举机上，调整背垫使膝盖与转轴对齐。
双腿置于上方垫上，将下方垫固定在脚踝上方。
弯曲膝盖向下弯举双腿至机器允许的最大幅度。
在底部停顿并收紧腘绳肌。
缓慢将双腿回到起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs.
Engage your core and straighten one leg, lifting it up until it is approximately parallel to the floor.
Hold the raised position for 2-3 seconds, keeping your foot flexed and your quadriceps engaged.
Slowly lower your leg back toward the floor without fully resting it.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description_en: The seated leg raise straight is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed while seated in a chair. It involves lifting one straight leg to a horizontal position and holding briefly to engage the quads, hip flexors, and core muscles.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，双手放在大腿上。
收紧核心，伸直一条腿，抬起至约与地面平行。
保持抬起姿势2-3秒，脚背勾起，股四头肌收紧。
缓慢将腿放回地面，但不要完全放下。
按目标次数重复后换另一条腿。

instructions_en: Sit at the edge of your chair with your back straight and your hands placed on the sides of the seat for support.
Allow one leg to hang freely with your knee slightly bent and your foot relaxed.
Gently swing the leg forward and backward in a pendulum motion, keeping the movement slow and controlled.
Allow the hip joint to move freely through its natural range of motion with each swing.
Continue for the desired number of swings, then switch to the other leg and repeat.
description_en: The seated leg swing is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while seated. It involves swinging one leg in a controlled pendulum motion to gently mobilize the hip joint, warm up the upper leg muscles, and improve flexibility through dynamic movement.
instructions_zh: 坐在椅子边缘，背部挺直，双手放在座位两侧支撑。
让一条腿自然下垂，膝盖微屈，脚部放松。
像钟摆一样轻轻前后摆动腿部，保持动作缓慢可控。
每次摆动时让髋关节在自然活动范围内自由运动。
持续所需次数后，换另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands gripping the sides of the seat.
Engage your core and press down through your hands for stability.
Simultaneously lift both feet off the ground, bending your knees at approximately a 90-degree angle.
Hold both legs raised for 2-5 seconds, keeping your back straight and your core tight.
Slowly lower both feet back to the floor and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated lift both legs is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while seated in a chair. It involves simultaneously lifting both legs off the ground and holding the position to engage the hip flexors, abdominal muscles, and quadriceps.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，双手抓住座位两侧。
收紧核心，双手向下按压以保持稳定。
同时抬起双脚离地，膝盖弯曲约90度。
保持双腿抬起2-5秒，背部挺直，核心收紧。
缓慢将双脚放回地面，重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Adjust the seat of the chest press machine so the handles are at chest level.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles with an overhand grip.
Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated machine chest press is a guided pressing exercise targeting the pectorals. The fixed movement path provides stability and reduces the need for stabilizer muscles, making it effective for beginners or those focused on chest isolation.
instructions_zh: 调整推胸机座椅，使把手位于胸部高度。
背部平贴靠垫坐好，正握把手。
向前推把手直至手臂完全伸展。
稍作停顿，然后缓慢将把手回到起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit at a seated row machine with your chest against the chest pad and feet on the platform.
Reach forward and grasp the handles with an overhand or neutral grip.
Pull the handles toward your torso, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the peak contraction, then slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated machine row is a machine-based pulling exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi. The chest-supported design stabilizes the torso and isolates the back muscles for consistent muscle activation.
instructions_zh: 坐在划船机上，胸部贴紧胸垫，双脚踩在踏板上。
向前伸手，正握或对握把手。
将把手拉向躯干，肘部向后驱动，肩胛骨夹紧。
在收缩顶点稍作停顿，然后缓慢将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Engage your core and begin lifting your right knee upward toward your chest in a marching motion.
Lower your right foot back to the floor and simultaneously lift your left knee to the same height.
Continue alternating legs in a brisk marching rhythm, keeping your back straight and your movements controlled.
March for the desired duration or number of repetitions on each leg.
description_en: The seated march is a bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while seated in a chair. It involves alternating knee lifts in a marching motion to elevate the heart rate, activate the hip flexors, and engage the core without leaving the seated position.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，背部挺直。
收紧核心，开始将右膝向上抬向胸部，做踏步动作。
将右脚放回地面，同时将左膝抬至相同高度。
以轻快的踏步节奏交替抬腿，保持背部挺直，动作可控。
踏步至所需时间或每条腿所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, feeling a stretch along the back of your neck.
From this position, gently round your entire upper back, deepening the combined neck and back stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply and allowing gravity to deepen the stretch with each exhale.
Slowly lift your head and return to an upright position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated neck and back stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the neck muscles, performed while seated. It combines a chin tuck with an upper back rounding motion to simultaneously release tension in the neck, trapezius, and upper back.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，双手放在大腿上。
缓慢将下巴低向胸部，感受颈后拉伸。
从这个位置轻轻弓起整个上背部，加深颈部和背部的联合拉伸。
保持20-30秒，深呼吸，每次呼气时让重力加深拉伸。
缓慢抬起头回到直立位置。重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, feeling a gentle stretch along the back of your neck.
Hold the lowered position for a brief moment, then slowly lift your head and tilt it gently backward, looking toward the ceiling.
Hold the extended position briefly, then return your head to the neutral starting position.
Repeat the upward and downward movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated neck lift up down is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the neck muscles, performed while seated. It involves slowly lowering and lifting the head in a controlled motion to stretch the anterior and posterior neck muscles and release built-up tension from prolonged screen use.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面，肩膀放松。
缓慢将下巴低向胸部，感受颈后轻柔拉伸。
保持低头位置片刻，然后缓慢抬头并轻轻后仰，看向天花板。
保持后仰位置片刻，然后将头回到中立起始位置。
重复上下运动至所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Tilt your head slowly to one side, bringing your ear toward your shoulder.
Use one hand to gently add pressure to the side of your head for a deeper stretch.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the opposite side of the neck.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The seated neck side stretch is a seated mobility exercise targeting the lateral neck muscles and upper trapezius. Tilting the head to each side while seated provides a controlled stretch to the cervical lateral flexors, relieving neck tightness and improving range of motion.
instructions_zh: 端坐在椅子上，双脚平放地面。
缓慢将头偏向一侧，使耳朵靠近肩膀。
用一只手轻轻按压头部侧面以加深拉伸。
保持20-30秒，感受颈部对侧的拉伸。
回到中间位置，换另一侧重复。

name_en: seated neck side to side rotate
instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your shoulders relaxed and your feet flat on the floor.
Slowly rotate your head to the right, bringing your chin toward your right shoulder as far as comfortably possible.
Hold for a brief moment, then slowly rotate your head to the left, bringing your chin toward your left shoulder.
Continue rotating side to side in a slow, controlled manner without forcing the range of motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The seated neck side to side rotate is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the neck muscles, performed while seated. It involves slowly rotating the head from side to side to improve cervical range of motion, reduce stiffness, and release tension in the neck and upper shoulder region.
instructions_zh: 端坐椅上，双肩放松，双脚平放地面。
缓慢向右转头，下巴尽量靠近右肩，以舒适为度。
稍作停留，再缓慢向左转头，下巴靠近左肩。
以缓慢可控的方式继续左右转动，不要强行扩大活动范围。
每侧按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright in your chair with your feet flat on the floor and your back straight.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Optionally, place your right hand gently on the left side of your head to apply light pressure and deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the pull along the left side of your neck.
Return your head to center and repeat on the left side. Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated neck stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the neck muscles, performed while seated. It involves tilting the head to one side to stretch the lateral neck and upper trapezius, effectively relieving tension associated with prolonged desk work.
instructions_zh: 端坐椅上，双脚平放地面，背部挺直。
将头向右侧倾斜，右耳靠近右肩。
可用右手轻放头部左侧施加轻压，加深拉伸。
保持拉伸20-30秒，感受颈部左侧的牵拉感。
头部回到正中，换左侧重复，按目标次数交替进行。

name_en: seated on hand support lift her hip
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and your hands placed beside your hips for support.
Lean onto one hand and press through your support hand and feet.
Lift your hips off the floor by engaging your glutes.
Hold the elevated position briefly, then lower back down.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching sides.
description_en: The seated on hand support hip lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes from a seated position. By lifting the hips off the floor while supported on one hand and both feet, the exercise develops glute and core strength with a lateral emphasis.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面，双腿伸直，双手放在髋部两侧支撑。
身体倾向一侧手，通过支撑手和双脚发力。
收紧臀肌将髋部抬离地面。
短暂保持抬高位，然后放下。
按目标次数重复后换另一侧。

instructions_en: Kneel upright on both knees with your torso tall and core engaged.
Drive one knee forward and upward in a controlled high knee motion.
Return the knee to the ground and repeat on the opposite side.
Alternate continuously at a steady pace.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated on knee high dive is a kneeling bodyweight exercise targeting the hip flexors and quads through an alternating knee drive. The kneeling base eliminates lower body momentum and isolates the hip drive, making it an effective drill for hip flexor activation.
instructions_zh: 双膝跪立，躯干挺直，核心收紧。
一侧膝盖受控向前上方抬起，做高抬膝动作。
膝盖回到地面，换另一侧重复。
以稳定节奏连续交替。
按目标次数继续。

name_en: seated on knee high dive advanced
instructions_en: Kneel upright on both knees with your core engaged and torso tall.
Drive one knee upward in a high knee motion while rising onto the opposite knee.
Return to the starting kneeling position and immediately repeat on the other side.
Increase the speed and height of the knee drive for the advanced variation.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The seated on knee high dive advanced is a kneeling cardio and strength exercise that drives the knee upward explosively from a kneeling base. The movement targets the hip flexors and quads while challenging balance and coordination, with the advanced version performed at a higher speed.
instructions_zh: 双膝跪立，核心收紧，躯干挺直。
一侧膝盖向上做高抬膝，同时对侧膝盖起身。
回到起始跪姿，立即换另一侧重复。
进阶版加快抬膝速度并提高高度。
按目标次数继续交替。

instructions_en: Begin in a kneeling position on both knees.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling lunge position.
Lower your hips toward the floor until the front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Return the front foot back to the kneeling position.
Repeat on the other side for the desired repetitions.
description_en: Seated on knee lunges are performed from a kneeling starting position, transitioning into a half-kneeling lunge by stepping one foot forward. This variation reduces the balance demand of standing lunges and focuses more deeply on the hip flexor and quad of the front leg.
instructions_zh: 从双膝跪姿开始。
