Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The standing shoulder shrug is a bodyweight exercise targeting the trapezius muscles. Performed standing with arms at the sides, it isolates the upper traps through a simple upward shrugging motion and is commonly used to build neck and shoulder stability or release upper body tension.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。
保持手臂伸直，将双肩尽可能向耳朵方向耸起。
保持耸肩姿势1-2秒，收紧斜方肌。
控制动作，缓慢将双肩放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: Standing Shoulder Stretch Hold (Hands Over Head)
name_zh: 站姿肩部拉伸保持（双手过头）
instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and raise both arms overhead.
Interlace your fingers and press your palms toward the ceiling.
Lean slightly to one side to deepen the stretch through the shoulder and lat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lean to the other side.
Return to center and repeat.
description_en: Standing Shoulder Stretch Hold Hands Over Head is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the deltoids and lats. Pressing both hands overhead and leaning side to side provides a deep stretch through the shoulder and lateral trunk.
name_zh_llm: 站姿肩部拉伸保持（双手过头）
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，双臂举过头顶。
十指交叉，掌心向天花板方向推。
向一侧略微倾斜，加深肩部和背阔肌的拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后向另一侧倾斜。
回到中间并重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright with your feet together, holding a wall or surface for balance if needed.
Keeping your upper body still and your standing leg slightly bent, raise one leg out to the side.
Lift the leg as high as comfortable, pausing at the top.
Slowly lower the leg back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: Standing side leg lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes and hip abductors. Lifting the leg laterally in a standing position isolates the gluteus medius and improves hip stability and balance.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢直立，必要时扶墙或支撑物保持平衡。
保持上身不动，支撑腿微屈，将一条腿向侧方抬起。
将腿抬至舒适的最高位置，在顶端稍作停顿。
缓慢将腿放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复后换边。

name_zh: 站姿单臂绳索肱三头肌伸展
instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead, then bend your elbow to lower it behind your head.
Keep your upper arm stationary and close to your head.
Extend your arm back to the starting overhead position.
Pause at the top and squeeze your tricep.
Complete the desired repetitions before switching arms.
description_en: The standing single arm overhead extension is a unilateral triceps exercise that isolates each arm individually using a dumbbell. The overhead position stretches the long head of the triceps, making it effective for developing arm length and size.
name_zh_llm: 站姿单臂哑铃颈后臂屈伸
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，一手持哑铃。
将哑铃推举过头顶，然后屈肘将其降至头后。
保持上臂固定并靠近头部。
伸直手臂回到头顶起始位置。
在顶端停顿并收紧肱三头肌。
完成目标次数后换臂。
xunji_candidate: 站姿单臂绳索肱三头肌伸展

instructions_en: Stand on one foot with your arms at your sides.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach your hands toward the floor.
Keep the standing leg straight or slightly bent.
Lower your torso as far as your flexibility allows.
Hold briefly, then return to standing and switch legs.
description_en: The standing single-leg forward fold is a bodyweight hamstring stretch performed while balancing on one leg. It develops hamstring flexibility, hip hinge mechanics, and single-leg balance simultaneously, serving both as a stretch and a balance challenge.
instructions_zh: 单脚站立，双臂垂于身体两侧。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，双手伸向地面。
支撑腿保持伸直或微屈。
在柔韧性允许范围内尽量下放躯干。
短暂保持，然后回到站立并换腿。

name_en: standing single-leg forward fold(leg up bent)
name_zh: 站姿单腿体前屈（抬腿弯曲）
instructions_en: Stand on one leg and bend the opposite knee, holding it up in front of you.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach your hands toward the floor.
Keep the bent knee raised throughout the fold.
Hold at the bottom briefly, then return to standing.
Repeat for the desired reps before switching sides.
description_en: The standing single-leg forward fold with the opposite leg bent is a modified hamstring stretch that holds the raised knee bent rather than extended. The bent leg position reduces the hamstring stretch demand on the raised leg while still engaging the hip flexors and stretching the standing leg.
name_zh_llm: 站姿单腿体前屈（抬腿弯曲）
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，弯曲对侧膝盖并将其抬至身前。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，双手伸向地面。
整个俯身过程中保持屈膝抬起。
在底部短暂保持，然后回到站立。
按目标次数重复后换边。

name_en: standing single-leg forward fold (one leg up)
name_zh: 站姿单腿体前屈（单腿抬起）
instructions_en: Stand on one leg and raise the other leg in front of you.
Hinge forward at the hips and reach your hands toward the raised foot.
Keep the standing leg firm and your core engaged.
Hold briefly at the lowest point.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The standing single-leg forward fold with one leg up combines a forward fold with an elevated leg, increasing the hamstring stretch on the raised leg. The position also challenges hip flexor strength and balance in the standing leg.
name_zh_llm: 站姿单腿体前屈（单腿抬起）
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，将另一条腿抬至身前。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，双手伸向抬起的脚。
支撑腿保持稳固，核心收紧。
在最低点短暂保持。
回到站立并在另一侧重复。

name_en: standing single leg upper body bent hold
name_zh: 站姿单腿上身体前屈保持
instructions_en: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the supporting knee.
Hinge forward at the hips and lower your torso until it is angled toward the floor.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Hold the position for the desired duration without allowing your torso to rotate.
Return to standing and repeat on the other leg.
description_en: The standing single leg upper body bent hold is a balance and hamstring exercise performed by holding a hinged forward torso position on one leg. It challenges posterior chain endurance, single-leg balance, and hip hinge stability through an isometric hold.
name_zh_llm: 站姿单腿上身体前屈保持
instructions_zh: 单腿站立，支撑膝微屈。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，将躯干下放至朝向地面的角度。
双臂前伸以保持平衡。
保持该姿势至目标时长，躯干不要旋转。
回到站立并在另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a standing forward fold with both hands on the floor.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and begin to lift your right leg straight up behind you.
Keep your hips as square as possible and raise your right leg as high as your flexibility allows.
Walk your hands toward your left foot or grip the ankle for a deeper stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower your right leg and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Standing split is an advanced standing balance yoga posture that targets the hamstrings through an active and gravity-assisted vertical stretch. It involves standing on one leg and lifting the other leg as high as possible while folding the torso toward the standing leg.
instructions_zh: 从站立前屈开始，双手放在地面上。
将重心移到左脚上，开始将右腿笔直向上抬起。
尽量保持髋部正对前方，在柔韧性允许的范围内将右腿抬到最高。
双手向左脚方向移动，或抓住脚踝以加深拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后放下右腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with a fully supinated grip, palms facing upward.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your hips.
Curl the barbell upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The standing supinated bicep curl uses a fully supinated grip to maximize biceps brachii activation. This grip position places the biceps in the strongest mechanical position throughout the curl, making it one of the most effective bicep strengthening exercises.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，以完全旋后的握法握住杠铃，掌心朝上。
让杠铃在手臂伸直的状态下悬于髋部前方。
将杠铃向上弯举至肩部方向，保持肘部贴近身体两侧。
在顶部停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
以受控的方式将杠铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and swing your right leg forward in a controlled front kick motion.
Lower your right foot and immediately shift your weight to swing the left leg forward.
Continue alternating legs in a rhythmic, fluid switching motion.
Keep your core engaged and your torso upright throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or time.
description_en: The standing switch kick front is a bodyweight exercise targeting the quadriceps and hip flexors. Alternating front kicks performed in a rhythmic switching pattern elevate the heart rate while activating the quads, glutes, and hip flexors, making it effective as a dynamic warm-up or cardio drill.
instructions_zh: 站直，双脚并拢，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。
将重心移到左脚上，以受控的前踢动作将右腿向前摆动。
放下右脚，立即转移重心将左腿向前摆动。
以有节奏、流畅的交替动作持续换腿。
整个动作过程中保持核心收紧、躯干直立。
按目标次数或时间重复。

instructions_en: Stand tall and loop a towel or resistance band around the sole of one foot.
Hold both ends of the towel and lift the foot forward, extending the leg as straight as possible.
Gently pull the towel toward you to increase the stretch along the back of the thigh.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, keeping your standing leg slightly bent for balance.
Lower the leg and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
description_en: The standing towel hamstring stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings. Using a towel as an assist, one leg is raised and extended forward while the towel provides gentle traction to deepen the stretch, improving hamstring flexibility and posterior chain mobility.
instructions_zh: 站直，将毛巾或阻力带套在一只脚的脚底。
双手握住毛巾两端，将脚向前抬起，尽量将腿伸直。
轻轻将毛巾拉向自己，以加深大腿后侧的拉伸。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒，支撑腿微屈以保持平衡。
放下腿，换另一侧重复。
每侧按目标次数持续进行。

instructions_en: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing upward.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers downward and back toward your body.
Hold the stretch when you feel tension along the inside of your forearm and wrist.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch hands and repeat.
description_en: Standing Wrist Flexor Stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the forearm flexors. Extending and bending the wrist backward gently lengthens the muscles and tendons of the inner forearm, commonly used to prevent or relieve repetitive strain injuries.
instructions_zh: 将一只手臂向前伸直，掌心朝上。
用另一只手轻轻将手指向下、向身体方向拉。
当前臂内侧和手腕感到紧张时保持拉伸。
换手重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hinge forward slightly at the hips.
Raise both arms overhead in a Y position, squeezing the shoulder blades upward and inward.
Move your arms out to the sides at shoulder height to form a T, squeezing the mid-back.
Bend your elbows and pull them back into a W position, drawing the shoulder blades together.
Flow slowly between each position for 20-30 seconds while maintaining controlled breathing.
description_en: Standing Y-T-W Stretch Series is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the trapezius and upper back muscles. Moving through the Y, T, and W arm positions improves shoulder mobility, posture, and scapular stability while stretching the shoulders and lats.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，髋部微微前屈。
双臂举过头顶呈Y形，向上向内挤压肩胛骨。
将双臂向两侧展开至肩高呈T形，挤压中背部。
弯曲肘部向后拉成W形，将肩胛骨向中间收拢。
在每个姿势之间缓慢流动20-30秒，保持呼吸受控。

instructions_en: Begin in a side plank position with your supporting hand or forearm on the mat and your body in a straight line.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the mat.
Raise your top arm toward the ceiling and lift your top leg, forming a star shape.
Hold this position, engaging your core and obliques to maintain balance.
Lower your arm and leg with control and return to the side plank position.
Switch sides and repeat.
description_en: The star balance is an advanced Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and obliques. Performed as an elevated side plank with the top arm and leg raised, it challenges lateral core stability, balance, and full-body coordination.
instructions_zh: 从侧板式开始，支撑手或前臂放在垫子上，身体呈一条直线。
双脚叠放，将髋部抬离垫子。
将上方手臂举向天花板，抬起上方腿，形成星形。
保持这个姿势，收紧核心和腹斜肌以维持平衡。
有控制地放下手臂和腿，回到侧板式。
换侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms and legs extended outward in an X shape.
Simultaneously lift your right arm and left leg, crunching your torso to bring them toward each other.
Touch or reach toward your foot at the top of the movement.
Lower back to the starting X position.
Repeat on the opposite side, lifting your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The starfish crunch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles through a diagonal cross-body crunch from an X-shaped lying position. The movement develops full abdominal and oblique engagement with a wide range of motion.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂和双腿向外伸展呈X形。
同时抬起右臂和左腿，卷腹使躯干将两者相互靠近。
在动作顶部触碰或伸向脚部。
放回起始X形位置。
换另一侧重复，抬起左臂和右腿。
按目标次数持续交替进行。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a bench or box and place one foot flat on the surface.
Drive through the heel of your raised foot to step up onto the box, bringing your trailing foot up beside it.
Step back down with the trailing foot first, returning to the starting position.
Repeat on the same leg for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The step-up is a bodyweight unilateral exercise targeting the quadriceps. Stepping up onto an elevated surface develops single-leg strength, balance, and coordination, while also engaging the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 站在长凳或跳箱前，将一只脚平放在上面。
通过抬起脚的脚跟发力踏上箱子，将后脚带到旁边。
后脚先退下，回到起始位置。
在同一腿上重复所需次数，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot up onto the surface and drive through that heel to lift your body up.
Bring your back foot up to stand fully on the box.
Step the leading foot back down to the floor followed by the trailing foot.
Alternate the leading leg or complete all repetitions on one side before switching.
description_en: Weighted step-ups are a unilateral compound exercise targeting the quadriceps and glutes. Stepping up onto an elevated surface with added dumbbell resistance builds single-leg strength, stability, and functional lower body power.
instructions_zh: 站在箱子或长凳前，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚踩上表面，通过该脚跟发力将身体抬起。
后脚跟上，完全站在箱子上。
前脚先退下到地面，后脚跟随。
交替领先腿，或在一侧完成所有次数后换边。

instructions_en: Mount the stepmill and set your target speed and duration.
Step onto the rotating staircase and begin climbing at a steady pace.
Keep your torso upright and engage your core throughout the exercise.
Drive through each step using your full foot to activate the glutes and quads.
Complete the session for the desired duration, then slow down to cool off before dismounting.
description_en: The stepmill machine is a cardio and lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps. Simulating continuous stair climbing, it challenges the cardiovascular system and lower body muscles simultaneously for an efficient conditioning workout.
instructions_zh: 登上踏步机，设置目标速度和时长。
踏上旋转楼梯，以稳定节奏开始攀爬。
保持躯干直立，全程收紧核心。
每一步用全脚掌发力，激活臀肌和股四头肌。
完成所需时长，然后减速冷却后下机。

instructions_en: Step onto the stepmill machine and grip the handrails lightly for balance.
Set your desired speed on the control panel.
Begin stepping at a comfortable pace, placing your full foot on each step.
Drive through your heel with each step to engage your glutes and quads.
Continue for the desired duration, maintaining an upright posture and minimizing reliance on the handrails.
description_en: The stepmill machine version 1 is a cardio exercise targeting the quadriceps and glutes. Continuously stepping on a rotating staircase provides sustained lower body conditioning and cardiovascular challenge, making it effective for fat loss and endurance.
instructions_zh: 踏上踏步机，轻握扶手保持平衡。
在控制面板上设置所需速度。
以舒适节奏开始踏步，每步全脚掌踩实。
每一步通过脚跟发力，激活臀肌和股四头肌。
保持直立姿势，尽量减少依赖扶手，持续所需时长。

instructions_en: Stand on a stepper or elevated platform holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back off the platform and lower your rear knee toward the floor.
Descend until your rear knee nearly touches the floor and your front thigh is parallel to the platform.
Drive through your front foot to step back up onto the platform.
Repeat on the same leg for the desired number of repetitions, then switch.
description_en: The stepper dumbbell reverse is a dumbbell unilateral exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings. Stepping down and back from an elevated platform increases the range of motion compared to a floor reverse lunge, placing greater stretch and demand on the posterior chain.
instructions_zh: 站在踏步器或高台上，双手各持哑铃垂于体侧。
一只脚向后退出平台，后膝朝地面下降。
下降至后膝接近地面，前大腿与平台平行。
通过前脚发力踏回平台。
在同一腿上重复所需次数，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand to one side of a stepper or low platform in an athletic stance.
Shuffle laterally, stepping up onto the stepper with the lead foot and then bringing the trailing foot up.
Immediately step down on the opposite side and continue shuffling in the same direction.
Reverse direction and shuffle back across the stepper.
Continue for the desired duration.
description_en: The stepper lateral shuffle is a cardio and agility drill that involves shuffling laterally over a stepper to improve lateral quickness and lower body conditioning. It targets the quadriceps and glutes while also developing hip abductor strength and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_zh: 以运动姿势站在踏步器或低平台一侧。
横向滑步，领先脚先踏上踏步器，后脚跟上。
立即从另一侧下步，继续同方向滑步。
反向滑步回到踏步器另一侧。
持续所需时长。

instructions_en: Stand on the platform of a deadlift machine with feet hip-width apart and grip the handles.
Keep your legs nearly straight with a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handles along your legs until you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to return to the upright starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The stiff-legged deadlift machine is an exercise targeting the hamstrings and lower back. Using the machine provides a guided path and additional safety, while the straight-leg position maximizes hamstring stretch and tension throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 站在硬拉机平台上，双脚与髋同宽，握住把手。
双腿几乎伸直，膝盖微屈。
以髋为轴俯身，沿腿部下放把手，直到感到腘绳肌深度拉伸。
髋部前推回到直立起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand holding a straight barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder-width.
Allow the bar to hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your chest, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top of the movement and squeeze your biceps.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The straight barbell curl is a classic mass-building biceps exercise that allows for heavy loading through a standard curl pattern. The straight bar provides a challenging wrist supination position that maximizes bicep engagement.
instructions_zh: 站立，以肩宽反握直杆杠铃。
让杠铃在手臂伸直状态下垂于大腿前方。
将杠铃向上弯举至胸前，保持肘部固定。
在动作顶端停顿并挤压肱二头肌。
缓慢下放杠铃至起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended straight in front of you and hands on the floor beside your hips.
Raise one leg off the ground to hip height, keeping it straight.
Hold the raised position for 2-3 seconds.
Lower the leg back to the floor and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Straight sitting with leg raise is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abs and hip flexors. Raising a straight leg from a tall-seated position creates abdominal tension and challenges hip flexor strength and upright posture.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直，双手放在臀部两侧的地面上。
将一条腿抬离地面至臀部高度，保持伸直。
保持抬起姿势2-3秒。
将腿放回地面，换另一侧重复。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Hold a heavy dumbbell in one hand at your side, arm fully extended.
Brace your core firmly to resist lateral tilting toward the weighted side.
Walk forward in a controlled manner, keeping your torso upright and shoulders level.
Maintain your grip and resist the urge to lean away from the weight.
Complete the desired distance or duration, then switch hands.
description_en: The suitcase carry is a dumbbell loaded carry exercise targeting the forearms and grip strength. Carrying the weight on one side creates an anti-lateral flexion demand on the obliques and core, making it an effective stability and strength exercise.
instructions_zh: 一只手握住重哑铃垂于体侧，手臂完全伸直。
收紧核心，抵抗向负重侧倾斜。
控制步伐向前行走，保持躯干直立、双肩水平。
保持握力，避免向远离负重方向倾斜。
完成目标距离或时间后换手。

name_en: sumo kettlebell single arm upright row
name_zh: 相扑壶铃单臂直立划船
instructions_en: Stand in a wide sumo stance with toes pointed outward, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Lower into a slight sumo squat, allowing the kettlebell to hang in front of you.
Drive through your hips to stand while simultaneously pulling the kettlebell upward along your body to chin height.
Keep your elbow higher than your wrist throughout the row.
Lower the kettlebell and return to the sumo squat starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching hands.
description_en: The sumo kettlebell single arm upright row combines a sumo stance hip extension with a single-arm upright row, linking lower body drive with upper body pulling power. It targets the deltoids and traps while also engaging the quads and glutes through the wide-stance hip hinge.
name_zh_llm: 相扑壶铃单臂直立划船
instructions_zh: 双脚宽距相扑站姿，脚尖外展，一只手握住壶铃。
下蹲至轻微相扑深蹲位，让壶铃垂于身前。
髋部发力站起，同时将壶铃沿身体向上拉至下巴高度。
整个上拉过程中保持肘部高于手腕。
放下壶铃，回到相扑深蹲起始位置。
一侧完成全部次数后换手。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed out at approximately 45 degrees.
Place your hands together in front of your chest or on your hips.
Engage your core and push your hips back and down, lowering into a squat while keeping your chest upright and knees tracking over your toes.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor or lower.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The sumo squat is a bodyweight exercise targeting the quadriceps with increased emphasis on the inner thighs and glutes. The wide stance and externally rotated feet shift the workload to the adductors and glute muscles, distinguishing it from a standard squat.
instructions_zh: 双脚站距宽于肩，脚尖外展约45度。
双手合拢放于胸前或放在髋部。
收紧核心，髋部向后向下推，下蹲时保持胸部挺直、膝盖对准脚尖方向。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行或更低。
脚跟发力回到起始位置，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes turned outward.
Lower into a sumo squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
From the squat, reach one hand across to tap the opposite foot or the floor beside it.
Return to the squat and repeat on the other side in an alternating tapping motion.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The sumo tap is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hip adductors in a wide-stance squat position. Alternating reaches add a lateral core challenge and improve hip mobility and dynamic balance.
instructions_zh: 双脚站距宽于肩，脚尖外展。
屈膝、髋部后推，下蹲至相扑深蹲位。
从深蹲位伸出一只手交叉触碰对侧脚或脚旁地面。
回到深蹲位，换另一侧交替触碰。
继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lower back at the top of the movement.
Hold the position for 2 to 3 seconds.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The superman hold is a bodyweight posterior chain exercise targeting the lower back erectors through a prone hyperextension hold. Lifting both arms and legs simultaneously engages the entire back and glutes, building spinal extension endurance.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫子上，双臂向前伸直过头，双腿伸直。
同时将双臂、胸部和双腿抬离地面。
在动作顶端收紧臀部和下背部。
保持该姿势2至3秒。
缓慢回到起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Attach a single handle to a high cable pulley and face away from the machine.
Grasp the handle with one hand with a supinated grip, palm facing upward.
Step away from the machine and raise your elbow overhead.
Extend your forearm downward and forward until your arm is fully extended.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions before switching arms.
description_en: The supinated triceps extension with one arm is a cable isolation exercise that targets the triceps using a reverse grip. The supinated wrist position shifts the emphasis to the long head of the triceps, promoting full triceps development.
instructions_zh: 将单把手连接到高位滑轮，背对器械站立。
一只手以反握（掌心向上）握住把手。
远离器械站立，将肘部举过头顶。
向下向前伸直前臂，直至手臂完全伸展。
缓慢回到起始位置，重复至目标次数后换臂。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with both legs raised to a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Reach your hands up toward your toes, lifting as high as comfortable.
Slowly lower your torso back down with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Supine legs lift toe touch is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. It involves lifting the torso to reach toward the raised legs, combining core flexion with hip flexor engagement for a challenging abdominal strengthening movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿抬起至90度。
双臂向天花板方向伸展。
收紧核心，将头和肩卷离垫子。
双手向上伸向脚趾，抬至舒适的最高点。
控制身体缓慢回到地面。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, or with your legs elevated on a surface.
Place one hand on your chest and the other on your belly.
Inhale slowly through your nose, focusing on expanding your belly rather than your chest.
Exhale fully through your mouth, letting your abdomen fall and releasing all tension.
Continue for the desired duration, maintaining a slow and deliberate breathing rhythm.
description_en: Supine recovery breathing is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the abs through diaphragmatic activation, with secondary engagement of the lower back. It involves practicing deep belly breathing in a supine position to promote nervous system recovery, reduce tension, and restore core function after training.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲，双脚平放地面，或将双腿抬高放在平面上。
一只手放在胸部，另一只手放在腹部。
用鼻子缓慢吸气，专注于腹部扩张而非胸部。
用嘴完全呼气，让腹部下沉，释放所有紧张。
保持缓慢刻意的呼吸节奏，持续所需时长。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat on the floor.
Have a partner lift your opposite straight leg toward the ceiling until you feel a mild hamstring stretch.
Press your raised leg against your partner's hands with moderate force for 5-8 seconds while they resist.
Relax your leg completely.
Have your partner gently push the leg further into the stretch and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg slowly and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Supine setup PNF hamstring stretch is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the glutes and lower back. It uses proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation from a lying position to progressively increase hamstring flexibility through alternating contraction and passive stretching.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，一侧膝盖弯曲，脚掌平放地面。
让同伴将你另一条伸直的腿向天花板方向抬起，直到感到轻微的腘绳肌拉伸。
用中等力度将抬起的腿压向同伴的手，持续5-8秒，同伴给予阻力。
完全放松腿部。
让同伴轻轻将腿进一步推入拉伸位置，保持20-30秒。
缓慢放下腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides in a T-shape.
Bend your right knee and draw it toward your chest.
Exhale and guide your right knee across your body to the left side, lowering it toward the floor.
Turn your gaze to the right and keep both shoulders flat on the mat.
Hold the twist for 30-60 seconds, then return your knee to center and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Supine spinal stretch is a restorative yoga posture that targets the lower back through a lying spinal rotation. It involves crossing one knee to the opposite side while keeping the shoulders grounded, releasing tension in the lumbar spine, glutes, and obliques.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂向两侧伸展成T形。
弯曲右膝，将其拉向胸部。
呼气，引导右膝越过身体向左侧下放至地面。
目光转向右侧，双肩保持平贴垫面。
保持扭转30-60秒，然后将膝盖回到中间，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees and shins parallel to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head and engage your core.
Slowly lower one foot toward the mat and tap your toes lightly on the ground.
Return your foot to the starting position with control.
Repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Supine toe tap is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves alternately tapping each foot to the floor from a tabletop position, challenging the deep core stabilizers to maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双膝弯曲90度，小腿与地面平行。
双手放在头后，收紧核心。
缓慢将一只脚向垫面下放，脚尖轻触地面。
有控制地将脚回到起始位置。
换对侧重复。
交替进行至所需次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your arms flat by your sides with palms pressing into the mat.
Engage your core and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold the position, keeping your knees aligned with your feet.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then slowly lower your hips back to the floor and repeat.
description_en: Supported glute bridge is a yoga and rehabilitation posture that targets the glutes and hamstrings in a supine hip-lifting position. It involves pressing the feet into the floor to raise the hips while maintaining core engagement, building posterior chain strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双膝弯曲，双脚平放地面，与髋同宽。
双臂平放于身体两侧，手掌按压垫面。
收紧核心，通过脚跟发力将臀部抬向天花板。
在顶部收紧臀肌并保持姿势，膝盖与双脚对齐。
保持20-30秒，然后缓慢将臀部放回地面，重复。

instructions_en: Stand behind your desk or chair and hold onto it with both hands for support.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and engage your core.
Keeping your right knee slightly bent, swing your right leg backward and upward, squeezing your glute firmly at the top of the movement.
Hold the raised position briefly, then slowly return your right foot to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on the right leg, then switch to the left.
description_en: The supported glute kickback is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the gluteal muscles, performed while holding a desk or chair for support. It involves extending one leg backward and upward in a controlled motion to isolate and strengthen the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子后方，双手扶住以支撑。
将重心移到左腿，收紧核心。
保持右膝微屈，将右腿向后上方摆动，在动作顶部用力收紧臀肌。
在抬起位置短暂保持，然后缓慢将右脚放回地面。
右腿重复所需次数，然后换左腿。

instructions_en: Stand behind your desk or chair and hold onto it lightly with both hands for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left leg, keeping it slightly bent at the knee.
Bend your right knee and curl your right heel upward toward your glutes as far as comfortably possible.
Hold the curled position for 1-2 seconds, squeezing your hamstring at the top.
Slowly lower your right foot back to the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The supported hamstring curl is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed while holding a desk or chair for balance. It involves curling one heel upward toward the glutes in a standing position to isolate and strengthen the hamstring muscles.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子后方，双手轻扶以保持平衡。
将重心移到左腿，膝盖保持微屈。
弯曲右膝，将右脚跟向上卷向臀部，尽可能舒适地抬高。
在卷曲位置保持1-2秒，在顶部收紧腘绳肌。
缓慢将右脚放回地面。重复所需次数，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet hip-width apart in front of your desk, holding lightly onto the surface for balance.
Engage your core and slightly soften your knees.
Hinge forward at your hips, pushing them backward while keeping your back flat and your spine neutral.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, feeling a stretch through your hamstrings and glutes.
Drive through your hips to return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The supported hip hinge is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the lower back, performed with light support from a desk or chair. It involves hinging forward at the hips with a neutral spine to stretch the hamstrings and glutes, reinforce proper hip mechanics, and decompress the lumbar spine.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站在桌前，轻扶桌面以保持平衡。
收紧核心，膝盖微微放松。
以髋部为轴向前俯身，臀部向后推，保持背部平直、脊柱中立。
下放躯干直至接近与地面平行，感受腘绳肌和臀肌的拉伸。
通过髋部发力回到站立位，在顶部收紧臀肌。重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing your desk or chair with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold lightly onto the surface for support.
Engage your core and keep your chest lifted and your back straight.
Slowly bend your knees and lower your hips as if sitting into a shallow squat, going no deeper than a 45-degree knee bend.
Pause briefly at the bottom, then press through your heels to return to the standing position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The supported mini squat is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed while holding a desk or chair for support. It involves performing a shallow squat movement to strengthen the quads, glutes, and hamstrings, making it ideal for beginners and those with limited mobility.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子或椅子站立，双脚与肩同宽，轻扶支撑面。
收紧核心，挺胸直背。
缓慢屈膝下蹲，臀部后坐，膝盖弯曲不超过45度。
在底部稍作停顿，然后脚跟发力回到站立位。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand behind your desk or chair and hold onto it lightly with both hands for support.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees alternately as if running, at a comfortable pace.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with each step, keeping the movement light and controlled.
Gradually increase your pace while maintaining proper form and keeping your core engaged.
Continue for the desired duration, then slow down gradually and come to a full stop.
description_en: The supported place jog running is a bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while holding a desk or chair for balance. It involves jogging in place with support to elevate the heart rate, engage the lower body muscles, and improve cardiovascular fitness in a confined space.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子后方，双手轻扶支撑。
开始原地慢跑，交替抬膝，保持舒适节奏。
前脚掌轻柔落地，动作轻快可控。
逐渐加快节奏，保持正确姿势并收紧核心。
持续目标时间，然后逐渐减速直至完全停下。

instructions_en: Stand beside your desk or chair and hold onto it with one hand for balance.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing your right heel toward your right glute.
Grasp your right ankle with your right hand and gently pull your heel closer to your body.
Keep your knees together, your standing leg slightly bent, and your torso upright.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs and repeat on the other side.
description_en: The supported quad stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed while holding a desk or chair for balance. It involves pulling one heel toward the glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh and hip flexors, improving lower body flexibility.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子旁，单手扶住保持平衡。
重心移至左脚，屈右膝，将右脚跟拉向右侧臀部。
右手握住右脚踝，轻轻将脚跟拉近身体。
双膝并拢，支撑腿微屈，躯干保持直立。
保持拉伸20-30秒，然后换腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand beside your desk or chair and hold onto it with one hand for support.
Shift your weight onto your inner leg and engage your core.
Keeping your outer leg straight, slowly raise it out to the side as high as comfortably possible while maintaining an upright posture.
Hold the raised position for 1-2 seconds, then slowly lower your leg back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description_en: The supported side leg raise is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the hip abductors, performed while holding a desk or chair for balance. It involves raising one leg out to the side in a controlled motion to strengthen the outer thigh, glutes, and hip stabilizers.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子旁，单手扶住支撑。
重心移至内侧腿，收紧核心。
外侧腿伸直，缓慢向侧方抬起至舒适高度，保持身体直立。
在抬起位置保持1-2秒，然后缓慢放下回到起始位。
按目标次数重复，然后换边。

instructions_en: Stand beside your desk or chair and hold onto it with one hand for support.
Cross your outer leg in front of the standing leg, resting it lightly on the ground.
Shift your hips away from the desk, leaning into the supported side to feel a stretch along the outer hip and thigh.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The supported side leg stretch is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hip abductors, performed while holding a desk or chair for support. It involves shifting the hips laterally to stretch the outer thigh and hip region, improving abductor flexibility and relieving tension from prolonged sitting or standing.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子旁，单手扶住支撑。
外侧腿交叉放在支撑腿前方，轻触地面。
髋部向远离桌子方向偏移，向支撑侧倾斜，感受外侧髋部和大腿的拉伸。
保持拉伸20-30秒，深呼吸。
回到起始位，换另一侧按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand behind your desk or chair and hold onto it lightly with both hands for initial stability.
Shift your weight onto one foot and slowly lift the other foot off the floor, bending the knee slightly.
Gradually reduce your grip on the support until you are balancing primarily on the standing leg.
Hold the single-leg balance for 20-30 seconds, focusing your gaze on a fixed point ahead to maintain stability.
Return both feet to the floor, rest briefly, then switch legs and repeat.
description_en: The supported single-leg balance is a bodyweight balance exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed with light support from a desk or chair. It involves standing on one leg to challenge the stabilizing muscles of the lower leg, engage the glutes and core, and develop proprioception and balance.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子后方，双手轻扶以获得初始稳定。
重心移至一只脚，缓慢将另一只脚抬离地面，膝盖微屈。
逐渐减少对支撑的依赖，直至主要依靠支撑腿保持平衡。
单腿保持平衡20-30秒，注视前方固定点以维持稳定。
双脚回到地面，稍作休息，然后换腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing your desk or chair with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding lightly onto the surface for support.
Engage your core and lower into a shallow squat by bending your knees to approximately 45 degrees.
From the squat position, push explosively through your feet and perform a small, controlled jump upward.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, absorbing the impact by bending your knees back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining control and using the support as needed.
description_en: The supported slightly jump squat is a bodyweight plyometric exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed with light support from a desk or chair. It involves performing a small explosive jump from a shallow squat position to develop lower body power, engage the glutes and calves, and elevate the heart rate.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子或椅子站立，双脚与肩同宽，轻扶支撑面。
收紧核心，屈膝下蹲至约45度的浅蹲位。
从蹲位双脚爆发发力，做一个小幅可控的向上跳跃。
前脚掌轻柔落地，屈膝缓冲回到蹲位。
按目标次数重复，保持控制，必要时使用支撑。

instructions_en: Stand behind your desk or chair with your feet together and hold onto the surface with both hands for support.
Engage your core and stand tall with your weight evenly distributed.
Lift your right knee upward toward hip height in a controlled marching motion.
Lower your right foot and immediately lift your left knee to the same height.
Continue alternating legs in a steady marching rhythm for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description_en: The supported standing march is a bodyweight cardio exercise targeting the hip flexors, performed while holding a desk or chair for balance. It involves alternating knee lifts in a marching motion to improve cardiovascular fitness, activate the hip flexors, quads, and core while maintaining an upright, stable posture.
instructions_zh: 站在桌子或椅子后方，双脚并拢，双手扶住支撑面。
收紧核心，站直，重心均匀分布。
以可控的踏步动作将右膝抬至髋部高度。
放下右脚，立即将左膝抬至相同高度。
以稳定的踏步节奏交替双腿，持续目标时间或次数。

instructions_en: Stand facing your desk or chair with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed slightly outward.
Hold lightly onto the surface for support and engage your core.
Slowly lower your hips toward the floor by bending both knees outward over your toes, going no deeper than a 45-degree knee bend.
Pause at the bottom of the movement, then press through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The supported wide leg mini squat is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the quadriceps, performed with support from a desk or chair. The wide stance places additional emphasis on the inner thighs and glutes alongside the quads, promoting hip mobility and inner thigh activation.
instructions_zh: 面向桌子或椅子站立，双脚间距宽于肩，脚尖略微朝外。
轻扶支撑面，收紧核心。
双膝向外沿脚尖方向弯曲，缓慢下蹲至膝盖弯曲不超过45度。
在最低点稍作停顿，然后脚跟发力回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face in a neutral, relaxed expression.
Open your eyes as wide as possible while simultaneously raising your eyebrows.
Hold the wide-eyed expression for 5 seconds without wrinkling your forehead.
Slowly relax your eyes and eyebrows back to the neutral position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The surprise look (wide eyes lift) is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the frontalis and orbicularis oculi muscles. It involves opening the eyes as wide as possible to strengthen and tone the muscles of the upper face.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部保持自然放松。
尽量睁大眼睛，同时抬高眉毛。
保持睁大眼睛的表情5秒，不要皱额头。
缓慢放松眼睛和眉毛回到自然位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand upright and hold a pair of weight plates pressed together at chest level with both palms.
Press the plates outward from your chest until your arms are nearly fully extended.
Squeeze the plates together throughout the entire movement to engage the inner chest.
Slowly pull the plates back towards your chest in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The svend press is a chest exercise using weight plates to create medial force on the pectoral muscles. By pressing the plates together while extending and retracting the arms, it effectively isolates the inner chest and improves mind-muscle connection.
instructions_zh: 直立站立，双掌在胸前将一对杠铃片压在一起。
将杠铃片从胸前向外推，直到手臂接近完全伸直。
整个动作过程中持续将杠铃片相互挤压以激活内侧胸肌。
以可控的方式缓慢将杠铃片拉回胸前。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Engage your core and lift your arms, chest, and legs off the mat.
Simultaneously sweep your arms out to the sides and back toward your hips, like a diving motion.
Return your arms overhead and repeat.
Keep your gaze downward and your neck in a neutral position throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Swim dive is a Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back and posterior shoulder muscles. Performed prone, it involves sweeping the arms from an overhead to a hip position while the chest and legs are lifted, strengthening the spinal extensors and improving shoulder mobility.
instructions_zh: 俯卧，双臂过头伸直，双腿伸直。
收紧核心，将手臂、胸部和双腿抬离垫面。
同时将双臂向两侧并向后扫向髋部，如跳水动作。
双臂回到过头位置并重复。
全程保持视线向下，颈部中立。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie face down on the mat with your arms extended overhead and your legs straight.
Engage your core and lift your arms, chest, and legs slightly off the mat.
Alternately lift your right arm and left leg higher while lowering the opposite limbs.
Continue in a fluttering swimming motion, inhaling for 5 counts and exhaling for 5 counts.
Keep your gaze down to maintain a neutral neck position throughout.
Repeat for the desired number of breath cycles.
description_en: Swimming Pilate is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lower back and glutes. Performed lying face down, it involves alternating arm and leg lifts in a flutter motion, strengthening the posterior chain and improving spinal extension and coordination.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在垫上，双臂过头伸直，双腿伸直。
收紧核心，将手臂、胸部和双腿略微抬离垫面。
交替将右臂和左腿抬得更高，同时降低对侧肢体。
持续做上下打水的游泳动作，吸气5拍，呼气5拍。
全程保持视线向下以维持颈部中立。
按目标呼吸循环次数重复。

instructions_en: Load a T-bar row machine and stand over the bar with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grasp the handles, keeping your back flat.
Perform a deadlift by driving through your heels to stand upright.
At the top, row the bar toward your chest by driving your elbows back.
Lower the bar back toward your hips, then return to the deadlift starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The T-bar deadlift to row is a compound back exercise that combines a T-bar deadlift with a row to target the lats, rhomboids, and posterior chain. It efficiently develops back thickness and strength by pairing two pulling movements in a single fluid exercise.
instructions_zh: 在T杠划船机上加载重量，双脚与髋同宽站在杠上。
屈髋俯身握住把手，保持背部平直。
脚跟发力站直完成硬拉。
在顶部将杠铃向胸部划起，肘部向后拉。
将杠铃放回髋部方向，然后回到硬拉起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment and straddle the bar.
Grip the bar end with both hands using a neutral grip handle or cupping the plates.
Hinge at the hips to lean your torso forward at approximately 45 degrees, keeping your back flat.
Row the bar upward towards your chest by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The t-bar row is a compound back exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi. Straddling the bar provides a stable base for heavy rowing, making it one of the most effective exercises for building mid-back thickness and strength.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃一端装入地雷管附件，跨站在杠铃两侧。
用双手握住杠铃末端，可使用中立握把手或托住杠铃片。
屈髋使躯干前倾约45度，保持背部平直。
肘部向后拉，将杠铃向胸部划起并挤压肩胛骨。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Start in a quadruped position with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Place one hand behind your head with your elbow pointing outward.
Rotate your upper body, opening your elbow toward the ceiling as far as comfortable.
Hold briefly at the end range, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description_en: T-spine rotation is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the thoracic spine and lower back. The controlled rotation improves thoracic mobility, reduces stiffness, and is commonly used in warm-up routines and injury prevention protocols.
instructions_zh: 从四点跪姿开始，双手位于肩下，膝盖位于髋下。
将一只手放在头后，肘部朝外。
旋转上身，将肘部尽量朝天花板打开至舒适范围。
在末端稍作停顿，然后回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复，然后换边。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, and place your hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your body.
Press through your hands and feet to lift your hips until your body forms a flat tabletop position, parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes, drop your head back slightly, and open your chest upward.
Hold the tabletop position for 2-3 seconds, then slowly lower your hips back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Tabletop start thoracic bridge is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats and thoracic spine, with secondary engagement of the lower back, shoulders, and chest. It involves lifting the hips into a reverse tabletop to open the chest and extend the spine, serving as a foundational movement for deeper backbend progressions.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，屈膝，双脚平放，双手放在身后，手指朝向身体。
通过双手和双脚发力，抬起臀部，直到身体形成与地面平行的桌面姿势。
收紧臀肌，头部微微后仰，胸部向上打开。
保持桌面姿势2-3秒，然后慢慢将臀部放回地面。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your feet flexed.
Sit up as tall as possible, lengthening your spine and pulling your shoulders back.
Inhale to lengthen, then exhale and hinge forward from the hips with a flat back, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Maintain a long spine throughout the stretch rather than rounding the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then slowly return to a tall seated position.
description_en: Tall spine seated forward fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary engagement of the lower back and glutes. It emphasizes maintaining a long, flat spine throughout the forward fold to maximize hamstring lengthening while protecting the lumbar spine.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向前伸直，双脚勾脚。
尽量坐高，拉长脊柱，肩膀向后收。
吸气拉长，然后呼气，从髋部向前折叠，保持背部平直，双手伸向双脚。
在整个拉伸过程中保持脊柱拉长，不要弓下背部。
保持20-30秒，然后慢慢回到坐高的姿势。

instructions_en: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms extended above your chest.
Point your elbows out to the sides and lower the dumbbells toward your chest by bending your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells until they touch your chest with elbows flared wide.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tate press is a triceps isolation exercise performed lying on a bench with dumbbells. The wide elbow position distinguishes it from standard presses, placing a unique demand on the lateral and medial heads of the triceps.
instructions_zh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各持一个哑铃，手臂在胸前伸直。
肘部向两侧打开，屈肘将哑铃下放至胸前。
下放哑铃直到触及胸部，肘部大幅外展。
伸肘将哑铃推回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and arms overhead.
Engage your core and simultaneously lift your legs to a 45-degree angle and roll your torso up.
Reach your arms forward, parallel to your legs, balancing on your sit bones.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your torso and legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The Pilates teaser is a fundamental bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves simultaneously rolling the torso up and lifting the legs into a V-sit position, requiring significant core strength and body control.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直，双臂举过头顶。
收紧核心，同时将双腿抬至45度角，并卷起躯干。
双臂向前伸，与双腿平行，以坐骨保持平衡。
在顶端稍作停留，然后有控制地慢慢将躯干和双腿放回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly and lift both legs to a 45-degree angle, creating a V-shape with your torso.
Extend your arms forward, parallel to your legs.
Hold this position, maintaining a stable spine and engaged core.
While holding, gently pulse your arms up and down or reach forward to deepen the challenge.
Hold for the desired duration, then slowly lower and return to the starting position.
description_en: The Pilates teaser advanced hold is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves balancing in a V-sit position for an extended hold, demanding exceptional core strength, stability, and spinal control.
instructions_zh: 坐在垫子上，屈膝，双脚平放在地面上。
身体微微后倾，抬起双腿至45度角，使躯干形成V形。
双臂向前伸，与双腿平行。
保持此姿势，维持脊柱稳定并收紧核心。
保持时，双臂轻轻上下摆动或向前伸以增加难度。
保持所需时间，然后慢慢放下并回到起始位置。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the mat.
Extend your arms overhead and engage your core.
Slowly roll up through your spine, reaching your arms forward as you lift your torso.
Stop when your torso is upright and your hands reach toward your knees.
Slowly roll back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The Pilates teaser beginner is an introductory bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. It involves a controlled spinal roll-up from a bent-knee position, helping to build the core strength and spinal articulation needed for more advanced teaser variations.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝，双脚平放在垫子上。
双臂举过头顶，收紧核心。
慢慢逐节卷起脊柱，抬起躯干时双臂向前伸。
当躯干直立、双手伸向膝盖时停止。
有控制地慢慢卷回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed.
Place the fingertips of both hands on your temples, applying gentle pressure.
Slowly clench your back teeth together to engage the temporalis muscles beneath your fingertips.
Hold the clenched position for 5 seconds.
Slowly release the clench and relax the muscles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The temple press is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the temporalis muscle. It involves placing fingers at the temples and clenching the teeth to feel and strengthen the muscles along the side of the head.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松。
将双手指尖放在太阳穴上，轻轻施压。
慢慢咬紧后牙，激活指尖下的颞肌。
保持咬紧状态5秒。
慢慢松开咬合，放松肌肉。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your feet lifted off the mat.
Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, extending your arms long by your sides.
Pump your arms up and down in small, controlled pulses.
Inhale for 5 pumps and exhale for 5 pumps, completing 10 full breath cycles for a total of 100 pumps.
Keep your core engaged and your lower back pressed to the mat throughout.
description_en: The hundred is a foundational Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. It involves a rhythmic arm-pumping motion while holding a curl-up position, combining core strengthening with breath control for 100 total pulses.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，屈膝呈90度角，双脚抬离垫子。
将头、颈和肩膀抬离垫子，双臂向身体两侧伸直。
双臂以小幅、可控的动作上下摆动。
吸气摆臂5次，呼气摆臂5次，完成10个完整呼吸循环，共100次摆臂。
全程保持核心收紧，下背部压向垫子。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your legs extended wide and arms stretched out to the sides at shoulder height.
Engage your core and sit tall through your spine.
Inhale and rotate your torso to the right.
Exhale and reach your left hand toward your right little toe in a sawing motion, pulsing three times.
Inhale and return to the center upright position.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The saw is a fundamental Pilates bodyweight exercise targeting the obliques and abdominal muscles. It combines spinal rotation with a forward reach, stretching the hamstrings and outer hips while building rotational core strength and spinal mobility.
instructions_zh: 坐直，双腿大幅分开伸直，双臂向两侧伸展至肩高。
收紧核心，脊柱向上延展坐直。
吸气，躯干向右旋转。
呼气，左手向右脚小趾方向伸展，做锯式动作，弹动三次。
吸气，回到中间直立位置。
换另一侧重复，继续交替进行至目标次数。

instructions_en: Loop a resistance band just above your knees and lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels to perform a glute bridge, thrusting your hips toward the ceiling.
At the top of the bridge, push your knees apart against the band in an abduction motion.
Bring your knees back together and lower your hips to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Thrust to abduction is a resistance band exercise that combines a glute bridge with a hip abduction movement. This compound glute exercise targets the gluteus maximus through the thrust and the gluteus medius through the outward knee press.
instructions_zh: 将阻力带套在膝盖上方，仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面。
脚跟发力做臀桥，将髋部向天花板方向顶起。
在臀桥顶端，双膝对抗阻力带向外分开做外展动作。
双膝并拢，髋部放下回到起始位置。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Kneel on the mat with your knees together and sit back so your glutes rest on your heels.
Place your hands on your thighs with palms facing down.
Sit tall, lengthen your spine, and relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your gaze forward or gently close your eyes and breathe naturally.
Hold the position for 1-5 minutes, then place your hands on the floor beside you and gently extend your legs to release.
description_en: Thunderbolt pose is a kneeling yoga posture that targets the quadriceps and provides a gentle stretch to the ankles and lower legs. It is commonly used for pranayama, meditation, and post-meal relaxation, promoting upright spinal alignment and mindful stillness.
instructions_zh: 跪在垫子上，双膝并拢，臀部坐于脚跟上。
双手放在大腿上，掌心朝下。
坐直，脊柱向上延展，肩膀放松下沉远离耳朵。
目视前方或轻轻闭眼，自然呼吸。
保持1-5分钟，然后将双手放在身旁地面上，轻轻伸直双腿退出体式。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your legs raised vertically, forming a 90-degree angle at the hips.
Extend your arms straight up toward your feet.
Curl your upper body off the ground and reach your fingertips toward your toes.
Lightly tap your toes at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The toe tap is a bodyweight abdominal exercise performed lying on the back with legs raised vertically. Reaching upward to tap the toes creates a strong contraction of the rectus abdominis and engages the hip flexors throughout.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双腿垂直抬起，髋部呈90度角。
双臂向双脚方向伸直上举。
卷起上半身离开地面，指尖向脚趾方向伸展。
在动作顶端轻触脚趾。
缓慢放下回到起始位置，重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms straight up toward your toes.
Engage your core and lift your head, neck, and shoulder blades off the floor, reaching for your toes.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your abdominal muscles.
Slowly lower your upper body back down to the floor while keeping your legs elevated.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Supine toe touches are an effective core isolation exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. By keeping the legs elevated and reaching for the toes, it heavily engages the upper abs to lift the torso while the lower abs work to stabilize the legs.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直向天花板方向抬起。
双臂向脚趾方向伸直上举。
收紧核心，将头、颈和肩胛骨抬离地面，向脚趾方向伸展。
在顶端短暂停顿，挤压腹肌。
缓慢将上半身放回地面，保持双腿抬起。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs straight up perpendicular to the floor.
Extend your arms toward the ceiling.
Engage your core and reach your hands toward your feet by lifting your shoulders off the ground.
Pause at the top of the movement, contracting your abs.
Slowly lower your upper body back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The toe touch crunch is a bodyweight ab exercise performed with legs vertical. Reaching toward the feet from this elevated position increases the range of motion and demands greater abdominal contraction than a standard crunch.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双腿伸直垂直于地面抬起。
双臂向天花板方向伸展。
收紧核心，肩膀抬离地面，双手向双脚方向伸展。
在动作顶端停顿，收缩腹肌。
缓慢将上半身放回地面。
重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your mouth closed.
Press your tongue against the inside of your cheek and move it in a slow, circular motion.
Complete a full circle along the inside of your upper lip, then across the upper teeth, down the inside of the opposite cheek, and back.
Perform 5 circles in one direction, then reverse.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tongue circle is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the tongue and surrounding facial muscles. It involves rotating the tongue in circular motions inside the mouth to tone and strengthen the muscles of the jaw and cheeks.
instructions_zh: 坐直，嘴巴闭合。
舌头抵住内侧脸颊，缓慢做圆周运动。
沿上唇内侧、上排牙齿、对侧脸颊内侧完成一整圈后返回。
一个方向做5圈，然后反向。
重复至目标次数。

name_en: tongue rotate side to side stretch
instructions_en: Sit upright with your mouth slightly open.
Extend your tongue outward from your mouth.
Slowly move your tongue to the right corner of your lips, then across to the left corner.
Keep the movement controlled and deliberate, feeling the stretch in the tongue and cheek muscles.
Continue alternating side to side for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tongue rotate side to side stretch is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the tongue and cheek muscles. It involves moving the extended tongue from side to side to stretch and strengthen the muscles of the mouth.
instructions_zh: 坐直，嘴巴微张。
将舌头伸出嘴外。
缓慢将舌头移向右侧嘴角，再横向移至左侧嘴角。
保持动作受控且有意识，感受舌头和面颊肌肉的拉伸。
继续左右交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your spine straight.
Open your mouth wide and extend your tongue outward as far as possible toward your chin.
Hold the fully extended position for 5 seconds.
Slowly retract your tongue and close your mouth.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tongue stretch forward is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the tongue and jaw muscles. It involves extending the tongue downward as far as possible to stretch and tone the muscles of the mouth and lower face.
instructions_zh: 坐直，保持脊柱挺直。
张大嘴，将舌头尽可能向外下方伸向下巴。
保持完全伸展姿势5秒。
慢慢收回舌头并闭上嘴。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your mouth gently closed.
Press the tip of your tongue firmly against the roof of your mouth just behind the upper front teeth.
Apply as much upward pressure as possible with your tongue.
Hold the position for 5–10 seconds.
Release and relax the tongue.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tongue to roof is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the tongue and jaw muscles. It involves pressing the tongue firmly against the palate to strengthen the tongue and promote jaw alignment.
instructions_zh: 坐直，轻轻闭口。
将舌尖紧贴上颚，位于上前牙后方。
用舌头尽可能向上施压。
放松舌头。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your back straight and mouth gently closed.
Open your mouth slightly and press the tongue flat against the hard palate at the roof of your mouth.
Apply firm, even pressure with the full surface of the tongue.
Hold the position for 5 seconds.
Release the tongue and relax.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tongue touch to hard palate is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the tongue and palate muscles. It involves pressing the tongue flat against the hard palate to improve muscle control and tone the oral region.
instructions_zh: 坐直，背部挺直，轻轻闭口。
微微张嘴，将舌头平贴在上颚硬腭处。
用整个舌面均匀用力按压。
保持5秒。
放松舌头。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on a sturdy chair and place a rolled towel under one thigh.
Grip both ends of the towel with the hand of the same side.
Curl your hand upward against the resistance of the towel, engaging your bicep.
Slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
description_en: Towel Biceps Curl is a bodyweight strength exercise targeting the biceps. Using a towel looped under the thigh creates resistance for curling, allowing bicep training without equipment and making it accessible for home or travel workouts.
instructions_zh: 坐在稳固的椅子上，将卷起的毛巾放在一侧大腿下方。
用同侧手握住毛巾两端。
对抗毛巾阻力向上弯举，收紧肱二头肌。
缓慢回到起始位置。
按所需次数重复后换侧。

instructions_en: Stand or sit upright and hold both ends of a towel, placing the middle of the towel behind your head at neck level.
Gently pull forward on the towel ends to create a mild traction force on the neck.
Simultaneously allow your chin to tilt slightly downward.
Hold for 20–30 seconds.
Release the tension and repeat as desired.
description_en: The towel neck stretch uses a towel as a prop to provide gentle cervical traction and a posterior neck stretch. The controlled forward pull of the towel elongates the posterior neck muscles and can help relieve neck stiffness and suboccipital tension.
instructions_zh: 站立或坐直，双手握住毛巾两端，将毛巾中部置于脑后颈部位置。
轻轻向前拉毛巾两端，对颈部形成轻度牵引。
同时让下巴略微向下倾斜。
放松张力，按需重复。

instructions_en: Stand inside a trap bar with feet hip-width apart, centered between the handles.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip both handles at your sides.
Brace your core, flatten your back, and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Drive through your heels to stand upright, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Lower the bar back to the floor with a controlled hip hinge and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The trap bar deadlift is a compound pulling exercise performed with a hexagonal trap bar that allows the lifter to stand inside the implement. The neutral grip and centered load reduce spinal shear forces compared to a straight bar deadlift while effectively targeting the glutes, quads, and hamstrings.
instructions_zh: 站在六角杠内，双脚与髋同宽，位于把手之间居中。
屈髋屈膝，双手握住身体两侧把手。
收紧核心，背部放平，肩胛骨向下向后收。
脚跟发力站起，同时伸展髋和膝。
控制屈髋将杠铃放回地面，按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Set the treadmill to a jogging speed appropriate for your fitness level.
Begin walking and gradually increase the speed to a comfortable jog.
Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean and relaxed arm swing.
Land with a midfoot strike and keep your breathing controlled throughout.
Continue for the desired duration or distance.
description_en: The treadmill jog is a moderate-intensity cardio exercise that targets the lower body while improving cardiovascular endurance. The controlled treadmill environment allows for consistent pacing and easy adjustment of speed and incline.
instructions_zh: 将跑步机调到适合自身体能水平的慢跑速度。
先步行，逐渐加速到舒适的慢跑。
保持身体直立、略微前倾，手臂放松摆动。
以前脚掌中部落地，全程控制呼吸。
持续所需时间或距离。

instructions_en: Set the treadmill to a running speed appropriate for your fitness level.
Warm up by walking or jogging before increasing to a run.
Maintain a tall posture with a slight forward lean and actively drive your arms.
Land with a midfoot strike beneath your hips and maintain an even breathing rhythm.
Continue for the desired duration or distance.
description_en: The treadmill run is a high-intensity cardio exercise targeting the lower body and cardiovascular system. Running on a treadmill provides a controlled environment for speed training, interval work, and endurance development.
instructions_zh: 将跑步机调到适合自身体能水平的跑步速度。
先步行或慢跑热身，再提高到跑步速度。
保持身体高挺、略微前倾，主动摆臂。
脚落在髋部下方以前脚掌中部着地，保持均匀呼吸节奏。
持续所需时间或距离。

instructions_en: Set the treadmill to a comfortable walking speed.
Step onto the belt and begin walking at a steady pace.
Maintain an upright posture with relaxed shoulders and a natural arm swing.
Breathe steadily and keep your gaze forward.
Continue for the desired duration or distance.
description_en: The treadmill walk is a low-impact cardio exercise suitable for all fitness levels. It targets the lower body while improving cardiovascular health, and can be adjusted in speed and incline to match varying fitness goals.
instructions_zh: 将跑步机设置为舒适的步行速度。
踏上跑带，以稳定步伐开始行走。
保持身体直立，双肩放松，手臂自然摆动。
保持平稳呼吸，目视前方。
持续所需时长或距离。

instructions_en: Stand in mountain pose with your weight evenly on both feet.
Shift your weight to your left foot and bend your right knee, lifting your right foot off the floor.
Place the sole of your right foot against your left inner calf or thigh, avoiding the knee joint.
Bring your palms together at your chest or extend your arms overhead.
Hold the balance for 30-60 seconds, gazing at a fixed point, then lower your foot and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Tree pose is a foundational standing balance yoga posture that targets the quadriceps and engages the glutes and core. It involves balancing on one leg with the opposite foot placed on the inner thigh or calf, cultivating focus, stability, and lower body strength.
instructions_zh: 以山式站立，重心均匀分布于双脚。
将重心移至左脚，弯曲右膝，抬起右脚离开地面。
将右脚脚掌贴于左小腿内侧或大腿内侧，避开膝关节。
双掌合十于胸前，或双臂上举过头。
保持平衡30-60秒，注视固定一点，然后放下右脚，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your right foot out 90 degrees, your left foot in slightly.
Extend your arms out to the sides parallel to the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and extend your torso to the right, lowering your right hand to your shin, ankle, or the floor.
Extend your left arm toward the ceiling and open your chest, stacking your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then inhale to come back up and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Triangle pose is a standing yoga posture that targets the hip flexors and inner thighs while stretching the hamstrings and obliques. It involves a wide-legged stance with a lateral bend, creating length through the entire side body and promoting hip opening.
instructions_zh: 双脚大幅分开站立，右脚外转90度，左脚稍内扣。
双臂侧平举，与地面平行。
吸气延展脊柱，呼气时躯干向右侧延伸，右手下放至小腿、脚踝或地面。
左臂向上伸展，打开胸腔，双肩上下对齐。
保持20-30秒，吸气回正，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a bench and place your hands beside your hips with fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the bench and extend your legs in front of you.
Lower your body by bending your elbows to roughly 90 degrees.
Pause at the bottom, then press back up by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The triceps bench dip is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps through a vertical dipping motion with hands on a bench. It is an accessible exercise that builds triceps strength and muscle endurance for beginners and can be progressed by elevating the feet.
instructions_zh: 坐在长凳边缘，双手置于髋部两侧，手指朝前。
将臀部滑离长凳，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲肘部至约90度，降低身体。
在底部稍作停顿，然后伸直肘部撑起身体。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a rope to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing it.
Grasp the rope with both hands and position your elbows at your sides at 90 degrees.
Push the rope downward by extending your elbows, spreading the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Pause with your arms fully extended and triceps contracted.
Slowly return to the starting position allowing your elbows to flex.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The triceps cable pushdown with a rope attachment targets all three heads of the triceps through a downward pressing motion. Spreading the rope ends at the bottom increases the range of contraction and develops triceps thickness and definition.
instructions_zh: 将绳索连接至绳索器械的高位滑轮，面朝器械站立。
双手握住绳索，肘部置于身体两侧呈90度。
伸直肘部将绳索向下推，在底部将绳端向两侧分开。
手臂完全伸直、肱三头肌收紧时稍作停顿。
缓慢返回起始位置，允许肘部弯曲。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grip the bar with an overhand grip, elbows tucked to your sides.
Push the bar downward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The triceps cable pushdown with a straight bar attachment is a classic triceps exercise providing consistent resistance through the full range of motion. The pronated grip emphasizes the medial and lateral tricep heads, contributing to arm definition.
instructions_zh: 将直杆连接至绳索器械的高位滑轮。
面朝器械站立，正握直杆，肘部收紧于身体两侧。
向下推杆直至手臂完全伸直。
在底部稍作停顿，收紧肱三头肌。
缓慢让杆回升至起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair or mat with your hands gripping the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your hips off the edge and extend your legs out in front of you.
Bend your elbows and slowly lower your body toward the floor, keeping your back close to the chair.
Stop when your elbows are at approximately 90 degrees.
Press through your palms and straighten your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Triceps dips are a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps. Performed using a chair or elevated surface, they involve lowering and raising the body using arm strength, effectively isolating the back of the upper arm while also engaging the shoulders and chest.
instructions_zh: 坐在稳固椅子或垫子边缘，双手抓住髋部两侧边缘，手指朝前。
将臀部滑离边缘，双腿向前伸直。
弯曲肘部，身体缓慢向地面下降，背部贴近椅子。
肘部约呈90度时停止。
手掌发力，伸直手臂返回起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a straight bar or rope to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine and grasp the attachment with an overhand grip, elbows at your sides.
Push the bar or rope downward by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight.
Pause at the bottom and squeeze your triceps.
Slowly allow the weight to rise back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The triceps pushdown is a cable isolation exercise targeting the triceps. Extending the elbow against resistance from the high pulley effectively develops tricep size and strength through the full range of motion.
instructions_zh: 将直杆或绳索连接至绳索器械的高位滑轮。
面朝器械站立，正握把手，肘部置于身体两侧。
伸直肘部向下推杆或绳索，直至手臂完全伸直。
在底部稍作停顿，收紧肱三头肌。
缓慢让重量回升至起始位置。
按所需次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a rope handle to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with both hands using a neutral grip and tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Push the rope downward by extending your arms until they are fully straight.
At the bottom, spread the rope ends apart slightly to maximize tricep contraction.
Slowly allow the rope to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The cable triceps pushdown with a rope is a cable exercise targeting the triceps. The rope attachment allows the wrists to rotate into a neutral position and the ends to splay at the bottom, maximizing tricep contraction and development.
instructions_zh: 将绳索手柄连接到绳索器械的高滑轮上，面向器械站立。
双手采用中立握法握住绳索，肘部贴近身体两侧。
伸直手臂将绳索向下推，直到手臂完全伸直。
在底部将绳索两端稍微分开，以最大化三头肌收缩。
缓慢让绳索回到起始位置，重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Push the bar downward by extending your arms until they are fully straight.
Pause at the bottom and squeeze your triceps.
Slowly allow the bar to rise back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The cable triceps pushdown with a straight bar is a cable machine exercise targeting the triceps. The straight bar allows both arms to work simultaneously, providing constant tension throughout the range of motion for effective tricep development.
instructions_zh: 将直杆连接到绳索器械的高滑轮上，面向器械站立。
双手采用正握法握住直杆，与肩同宽，肘部贴近身体两侧。
伸直手臂将直杆向下推，直到手臂完全伸直。
在底部停顿并挤压三头肌。
缓慢让直杆回到起始位置，重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Kneel on the floor and place the crown of your head on the mat, positioning your hands shoulder-width apart to form a triangular base.
Press firmly through your hands and lift your knees off the floor, walking your feet in toward your head.
Engage your core and tuck your knees into your chest, lifting your feet off the floor to find a balanced tucked headstand.
Gradually extend your legs toward the ceiling when ready, pressing through the balls of your feet.
Hold for the desired duration, then tuck and lower with control.
description_en: The tripod base headstand is an advanced bodyweight balance exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary engagement of the abs, traps, and upper arms. It involves balancing in an inverted position using the head and both hands as a three-point base, building shoulder strength, core stability, and body awareness.
instructions_zh: 跪在地板上，将头顶放在垫子上，双手与肩同宽形成三角形支撑。
双手用力按压地面，抬起膝盖离开地板，双脚向头部方向走近。
收紧核心，将膝盖收向胸部，双脚离地进入平衡的团身头倒立。
准备好后逐渐将双腿向天花板方向伸展，通过前脚掌发力。
保持所需时间，然后收腿并有控制地放下。

instructions_en: Begin standing in mountain pose and shift your weight to your left foot.
Lift your right leg and grasp your right foot or ankle with your right hand.
Slowly raise your right leg upward alongside your torso, extending it as high as possible.
Keep your standing leg straight and hold your right foot above your head if flexibility allows.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower the leg with control and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Trivikaramasana is an advanced standing split variation that deeply targets the hamstrings and hip flexors. It involves standing on one leg and raising the other leg alongside the torso toward a vertical position while grasping the lifted foot, demanding extreme hamstring and hip flexibility.
instructions_zh: 从山式站立开始，将重心移到左脚。
抬起右腿，用右手抓住右脚或脚踝。
缓慢将右腿沿身体向上抬起，尽可能抬高伸展。
保持站立腿伸直，柔韧性允许时将右脚举过头顶。
保持10-20秒，然后有控制地放下腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Hold a TRX band with both hands and stand on one leg, extending the other leg in front of you.
Lower your body into a single-leg squat by bending the standing knee.
Use the TRX for balance assistance, keeping your torso upright as you descend.
Drive through the standing heel to return to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one side before switching legs.
description_en: The TRX band pistol squat uses suspension straps for balance assistance to help athletes build toward the unassisted pistol squat. It targets the quadriceps and glutes while developing single-leg strength, stability, and mobility.
instructions_zh: 双手握住TRX带，单腿站立，另一条腿向前伸展。
弯曲站立腿的膝盖，将身体下降成单腿深蹲。
利用TRX辅助平衡，下降时保持躯干直立。
通过站立脚跟发力回到起始位置。
在一侧完成所有次数后再换腿。

instructions_en: Sit facing the TRX anchor with your hands in the handles and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the ground and extend your legs outward, leaning back further.
Pull your knees toward your chest while bringing your torso upright.
Hold for a moment, then extend back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The TRX band seated in and out is a core exercise that uses suspension straps to add instability and resistance to the in-and-out abdominal movement. It targets the abs and hip flexors while also requiring shoulder engagement to maintain a controlled position on the straps.
instructions_zh: 面向TRX固定点坐下，双手握住手柄，身体稍微后倾。
双脚离地，双腿向外伸展，身体进一步后倾。
将膝盖拉向胸部，同时将躯干直立起来。
保持片刻，然后向后伸展回到起始位置。
重复所需次数。

name_en: trx band with glute raise curl
instructions_en: Lie on your back and place both heels in TRX straps with your legs extended.
Drive your hips upward into a glute bridge by pressing through your heels.
From the elevated position, curl both heels toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Extend your legs back to the straight position while keeping your hips elevated.
Lower your hips to the ground to complete the repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The TRX band with glute raise curl combines a glute bridge with a hamstring curl using suspension straps to challenge both muscle groups in a single movement. It targets the glutes through the bridge and the hamstrings through the curl, while the unstable straps increase core activation.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，将双脚跟放入TRX带中，双腿伸展。
通过脚跟发力将臀部向上推成臀桥。
在抬高的位置，弯曲膝盖将双脚跟卷向臀部。
保持臀部抬高，将双腿伸回伸直位置。
将臀部放回地面完成一次动作。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Hold TRX handles for balance and stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Hinge at the hips and grasp the kettlebell with both hands.
Drive through your heels to stand upright, performing a deadlift.
At the top, curl the kettlebell toward your chest by bending your elbows.
Lower the kettlebell and return to the starting deadlift position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The TRX kettlebell deadlift to curl uses TRX straps for balance assistance while performing a deadlift-to-curl combination with a kettlebell. It targets the hamstrings and glutes through the deadlift and adds a biceps challenge through the curl.
instructions_zh: 握住TRX手柄保持平衡，双脚之间地板上放一个壶铃。
髋部铰链前倾，双手抓住壶铃。
通过脚跟发力站直，完成硬拉。
在顶部弯曲肘部将壶铃弯举向胸部。
放下壶铃，回到硬拉起始位置。
重复所需次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and bend slightly at the knees.
Explosively jump upward as high as possible.
At the peak of the jump, tuck your knees toward your chest.
Release your knees and land softly with a slight bend in the knees.
Immediately perform the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tuck jump is a plyometric exercise targeting the quads and developing explosive lower body power. The knee tuck at the peak of the jump challenges hip flexor strength and cardiovascular conditioning simultaneously.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，膝盖微屈。
爆发性向上跳至最高。
在跳跃最高点，双膝向胸部收起。
松开双膝，膝盖微屈轻柔落地。
立即进行下一次重复。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down quickly and then explosively jump up into the air.
At the peak of the jump, tuck both knees up toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees bent to absorb the impact.
Repeat continuously for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The tunk jump is a bodyweight plyometric cardio exercise that combines a squat with an explosive tuck jump. Bringing both knees toward the chest at the peak of the jump develops lower body power, core strength, and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立。
快速下蹲，然后爆发性向上跳起。
在跳跃最高点，双膝向上收向胸部。
前脚掌轻柔落地，屈膝缓冲冲击。
连续重复至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees deeply and swing your arms back to load the jump.
Jump as high as possible, driving both knees up toward your chest forcefully.
At the peak, compress tightly into the tuck position.
Land softly, absorb through your legs, and immediately jump again.
description_en: Tunk jump high is an advanced bodyweight plyometric exercise targeting cardio and explosive power. The maximum height jump combined with a deep knee tuck demands greater lower body power and neuromuscular coordination than the standard tunk jump.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立。
深屈膝，双臂后摆蓄力。
尽可能跳高，有力地将双膝向上收向胸部。
在最高点，紧密收成团身姿势。
轻柔落地，通过双腿缓冲，并立即再次起跳。

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, or stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a relaxed breath in, allowing your abdomen to expand naturally.
As you exhale, slowly draw your navel inward toward your spine without holding your breath.
Hold the contraction gently for 5-10 seconds while breathing normally.
Release and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: TVA activation, also known as the drawing in maneuver, is a bodyweight rehabilitation exercise targeting the transverse abdominis. The gentle inward draw of the navel activates the deepest core stabilizing muscle and is a foundational movement in core rehabilitation and posture correction programs.
instructions_zh: 仰卧，屈膝，双脚平放地面；或双脚与肩同宽站立。
放松吸气，让腹部自然扩张。
呼气时，缓慢将肚脐向内收向脊柱，不要憋气。
