description_en: The wall standing cat pose stretch is a bodyweight mobility exercise adapted from the yoga cat pose to a standing position against the wall. It targets the lower and upper back through spinal flexion and extension, improving mobility and relieving tension along the spine.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，双手平放于墙面与肩同高处。
双脚向后走，直到手臂完全伸直、躯干与地面呈45度角。
收紧核心，像猫式一样将上背部向上拱起，下巴收向胸口。
保持拱起姿势片刻，然后轻轻向反方向弓背。
交替重复拱背和弓背动作至目标次数。

name_en: wall standing glute bride hold hand folded
name_zh: 靠墙站姿臀桥保持双手交叉
instructions_en: Lie on your back with feet flat against the wall and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Fold your hands across your chest and drive your hips upward by pressing through both feet.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold the bridge position for the desired duration.
Maintain core engagement and keep your arms folded throughout.
Lower your hips back to the floor to complete the hold.
description_en: The wall standing glute bridge hold hand folded is a bodyweight isometric exercise where the glute bridge position is held with hands folded across the chest. The wall supports the feet, and the absence of arm floor contact increases core engagement throughout the sustained hold.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿臀桥保持双手交叉
instructions_zh: 仰卧，双脚平贴墙面，膝盖弯曲90度。
双手交叉放于胸前，双脚蹬墙将髋部向上顶起。
在最高点收紧臀部，保持臀桥姿势至目标时长。
全程保持核心收紧、双臂交叉。
将髋部放回地面，完成该保持动作。

instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, forming a figure-four shape.
Slowly bend the standing knee and slide your back down the wall until you feel a stretch in the raised glute.
Place your hands on the raised knee for a gentle press to deepen the stretch if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing glute stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise performed in a partial wall sit with a figure-four leg position. The wall provides back support, allowing a controlled and progressive stretch of the glutes and external hip rotators.
instructions_zh: 背靠墙壁站立，双脚与肩同宽。
一侧脚踝交叉搭在对侧膝盖上，形成四字形。
缓慢弯曲支撑腿膝盖，背部沿墙面下滑，直到抬起一侧臀部有拉伸感。
如需加深拉伸，可将双手放在抬起的膝盖上轻轻下压。
保持20-30秒，然后换侧。

name_zh: 靠墙站姿臀肌拉伸进阶
instructions_en: Stand with your back flat against the wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure-four position.
Slide your back fully down the wall into a deep squat position, maximizing the glute stretch.
Press the raised knee gently outward to intensify the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds at the deepest comfortable position, then switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing glute stretch advanced is a deeper variation of the wall glute stretch, performed with a full wall sit descent in the figure-four position. The increased depth provides a more intense stretch through the glutes and hip external rotators for flexible individuals.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿臀肌拉伸进阶
instructions_zh: 背靠墙站立，双脚与髋同宽。
将一侧脚踝交叉放在对侧膝盖上，呈四字姿势。
背部沿墙完全下滑至深蹲位置，最大化臀部拉伸。
将抬起的膝盖轻轻向外压以加强拉伸。
在最舒适的最深位置保持20-30秒，然后换边。

instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward toward the wall and place the heel on the ground with toes raised and resting on the wall.
Keep the front leg straight and lean your torso slightly forward until you feel a stretch in the hamstring.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.
description_en: The wall standing hamstring stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise where one heel is elevated against the wall to create a targeted hamstring stretch in a standing position. The wall supports the foot and provides leverage to deepen the stretch safely.
instructions_zh: 面向墙站立，双手与肩同高放在墙上。
一只脚向墙方向迈出，脚跟踩地，脚趾抬起靠在墙上。
保持前腿伸直，躯干微微前倾，直到感到大腿后侧拉伸。
保持拉伸20-30秒。
换腿重复。

name_en: wall standing hamstring stretch single leg hand
name_zh: 靠墙站姿单腿手扶腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and raise one foot, placing the heel against the wall at a comfortable height.
Place one hand on the wall for support and the other on the raised leg for gentle guidance.
Keep the raised leg straight and lean gently forward from the hips to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing hamstring stretch single leg hand is a bodyweight unilateral hamstring stretch using the wall for foot support and one hand for balance. Leaning forward with the raised leg extended targets the hamstring with greater precision and control.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿单腿手扶腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 面向墙站立，抬起一只脚，将脚跟靠在墙上舒适的高度。
一只手放在墙上支撑，另一只手放在抬起的腿上轻轻引导。
保持抬起的腿伸直，从髋部轻轻前倾以加深拉伸。
保持拉伸20-30秒，平稳呼吸。
放下腿并换边。

name_zh: 靠墙站姿腿部绕环拉伸
instructions_en: Stand sideways next to the wall and place one hand against it for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor and begin making slow, controlled circular motions with the leg.
Circle the leg forward, out, back, and around in a smooth arc, engaging the hip throughout.
Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Switch sides and repeat with the other leg.
description_en: The wall standing leg circle stretch is a bodyweight hip mobility exercise using the wall for balance support during controlled leg circles. It targets the hip flexors and surrounding muscles through a full circular range of motion, improving hip joint mobility and flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿腿部绕环拉伸
instructions_zh: 侧身站在墙旁，一只手扶墙保持平衡。
将外侧腿稍微抬离地面，开始用腿做缓慢、受控的圆周运动。
腿向前、向外、向后、环绕画圆，全程保持髋部发力。
完成所需圈数后反向。
换边用另一条腿重复。

instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place both hands lightly against it at shoulder height.
Stand tall and shift your weight onto one leg.
Lift the opposite leg straight up in front of you as high as comfortable, keeping the knee extended.
Hold briefly at the top, then slowly lower the leg back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description_en: The wall standing leg lift up is a bodyweight exercise using the wall for balance while performing a straight-leg front raise. It targets the hip flexors and engages the quads and core, suitable for hip flexor strengthening and lower body activation.
instructions_zh: 面向墙站立，双手与肩同高轻放在墙上。
站直，将重心移到一条腿上。
将另一条腿伸直向前抬起至舒适的高度，保持膝盖伸展。
在顶部短暂保持，然后慢慢将腿放回地面。
重复所需次数，然后换腿。

instructions_en: Stand with your side to the wall and place one hand on it for balance.
Stand tall and engage your core.
Lift the outer leg straight up in front of you as high as comfortable.
Slowly lower the leg back to the floor with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then turn and switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing leg raise is a bodyweight lower body exercise using the wall for lateral balance support during a front leg raise. It strengthens the hip flexors and quads while engaging the core for stabilization throughout the movement.
instructions_zh: 侧对墙站立，一只手扶墙保持平衡。
站直并收紧核心。
将外侧腿伸直向前抬起至舒适的高度。
有控制地慢慢将腿放回地面。
重复所需次数，然后转身换边。

instructions_en: Stand facing the wall with your feet hip-width apart and hands placed against it for support.
Bend one knee and lift your heel toward your glute, grasping the ankle with the hand on the same side.
Stand tall and keep your knees together as you hold the quad stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch through the front of the thigh.
Lower the foot and switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing lower body stretch is a comprehensive bodyweight stretching routine targeting the quadriceps, hip flexors, and calves in a standing position. The wall provides balance support, making it easier to maintain an upright posture during the full lower body stretch.
instructions_zh: 面向墙站立，双脚与髋同宽，双手扶墙支撑。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将脚跟抬向臀部，同侧手抓住脚踝。
站直并保持双膝并拢，保持股四头肌拉伸。
保持20-30秒，感受大腿前侧的拉伸。
放下脚并换边。

name_en: wall standing neck and back stretch hold
name_zh: 靠墙站姿颈背拉伸保持
instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and your feet a few inches from the base.
Press your entire back and head against the wall and relax your arms at your sides.
Slowly tuck your chin toward your chest, feeling the stretch along the back of the neck.
Hold the tucked position for 20-30 seconds.
Return your head to neutral and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The wall standing neck and back stretch hold is a bodyweight flexibility exercise performed with the back against the wall. The wall supports proper spinal alignment while the chin tuck creates a targeted stretch along the cervical spine and upper back.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿颈背拉伸保持
instructions_zh: 背靠墙站立，双脚距墙根几英寸。
将整个背部和头部贴紧墙，双臂放松垂于体侧。
慢慢将下巴收向胸部，感受颈后部的拉伸。
保持收下巴姿势20-30秒。
头部回到中立位，重复所需组数。

name_en: wall standing shoulder and hips stretch
instructions_en: Stand sideways next to the wall and place the near hand on it at shoulder height.
Step the inside foot slightly forward and rotate your body away from the wall.
Simultaneously open your hips and reach the free arm overhead or back to stretch the shoulder and hip.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch across the shoulder and hip.
Turn around and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The wall standing shoulder and hips stretch is a bodyweight combined flexibility exercise targeting the shoulders and hip flexors simultaneously. Using the wall for one arm's support, the body rotates to open both the shoulder and hip in a single integrated stretch.
instructions_zh: 侧身站在墙边，将靠近墙的手放在与肩同高的墙面上。
内侧脚稍微向前迈出，身体向远离墙的方向旋转。
同时打开髋部，自由手臂向上或向后伸展，拉伸肩部和髋部。
保持姿势20-30秒，感受肩部和髋部的拉伸。
转身，换另一侧重复。

name_en: wall standing single leg twist hamstring stretch
name_zh: 靠墙站姿单腿扭转腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place one foot slightly forward with the heel on the floor and toes raised.
Place both hands on the wall for support and keep the front leg straight.
Slowly rotate your torso away from the raised-toe leg, adding a twisting component to the stretch.
Hold the twisted position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in the hamstring and through the lower back.
Return to neutral and switch sides.
description_en: The wall standing single leg twist hamstring stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise that adds a spinal rotation component to a traditional hamstring stretch. The wall supports balance while the twisting motion targets both the hamstring and the lower back and obliques.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿单腿扭转腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，一只脚稍微向前，脚跟踩地，脚尖抬起。
双手扶墙支撑，前腿保持伸直。
慢慢将躯干向远离抬脚尖腿的方向旋转，增加扭转拉伸。
保持扭转姿势20-30秒，感受腘绳肌和下背部的拉伸。
回到中立位，换另一侧。

instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and your feet shoulder-width apart, a step away from the base.
Place your arms at your sides or extended in front of you for balance.
Slowly bend your knees and slide your back down the wall into a squat position.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the floor, then press through your heels to slide back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wall standing squat is a bodyweight lower body exercise where the back slides along the wall during the squat movement. This variation promotes proper squat mechanics and reduces spinal load, targeting the quadriceps, glutes, and hamstrings effectively.
instructions_zh: 背靠墙壁站立，双脚与肩同宽，距墙根一步远。
双臂放在身体两侧或向前伸展以保持平衡。
慢慢屈膝，背部沿墙下滑进入深蹲姿势。
下蹲至大腿与地面平行，然后脚跟发力沿墙滑回站起。
按目标次数重复。

name_en: wall standing upper back stretch version 1
name_zh: 靠墙站姿上背拉伸式一
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place both hands flat against it at shoulder height.
Walk your feet back until your arms are fully extended and your torso is bent at approximately 45 degrees.
Press your hands into the wall and allow your chest to sink toward the floor, rounding your upper back.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your feet back toward the wall and return to standing.
description_en: Wall standing upper back stretch version 1 is a bodyweight flexibility exercise targeting the upper back and shoulders. With hands pressed into the wall and the torso hinged forward, the stretch lengthens the muscles along the thoracic spine and shoulder girdle.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿上背拉伸式一
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，双手平放在与肩同高的墙面上。
双脚向后走，直到双臂完全伸展，躯干弯曲约45度。
双手推墙，让胸部向地面下沉，上背部拱起。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒。
双脚向墙走回，恢复站立。

name_en: wall standing upper body bent stretch
name_zh: 靠墙站姿上半身前屈拉伸
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands flat on it at waist height.
Walk your feet back until your torso is bent parallel to the floor with your arms fully extended.
Press your hands into the wall and lengthen your spine by pulling your hips away from the wall.
Hold the elongated position for 20-30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Walk your feet back in to return to standing.
description_en: The wall standing upper body bent stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise where the torso is bent forward with both hands on the wall. This position creates a decompressive stretch along the lower back and spine while engaging the upper back and hamstrings.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙站姿上半身前屈拉伸
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，双脚与髋同宽，双手平放在与腰同高的墙面上。
双脚向后走，直到躯干弯曲至与地面平行，双臂完全伸展。
双手推墙，将髋部拉离墙壁以拉长脊柱。
保持拉长姿势20-30秒，深呼吸。
双脚走回，恢复站立。

name_en: wall support plank leg on wall
name_zh: 靠墙支撑平板撑腿搭墙
instructions_en: Position yourself near a wall and place both hands on the floor in a standard plank position.
Lift one leg and place the sole of the foot flat against the wall behind you for support.
Engage your core, keep your hips level, and maintain a straight line from head to the elevated foot.
Hold the position for the desired amount of time, breathing steadily.
Lower the foot, switch legs, and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The wall support plank leg on wall is a bodyweight core exercise targeting the abdominals. With one foot braced against the wall, the plank position gains additional stability, allowing for deeper core and glute engagement and making it an effective progression tool for building plank endurance and unilateral stability.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙支撑平板撑腿搭墙
instructions_zh: 在墙边就位，双手撑地呈标准平板支撑姿势。
抬起一条腿，将脚掌平贴在身后墙面上作为支撑。
收紧核心，保持髋部水平，从头到抬起的脚保持一条直线。
保持姿势目标时间，平稳呼吸。
放下脚，换腿，另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and slide into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Once in the squat position, raise both arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Hold the squat and arms raised position for the desired duration.
Lower your arms and slide back up the wall to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The wall support squat hand raise is a bodyweight isometric exercise combining a wall squat hold with arms raised forward. The absence of arm support increases core activation and postural demand, while the wall-supported squat position targets the quadriceps and glutes.
instructions_zh: 背靠墙壁站立，沿墙下滑进入深蹲，直到大腿与地面平行。
进入深蹲姿势后，双臂向前伸直抬至与肩同高。
保持深蹲和双臂抬起姿势目标时长。
放下双臂，沿墙滑回站起。
按目标组数重复。

name_en: wall upper back and hips stretch
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place both hands on it at shoulder height, arms extended.
Walk your feet back until your torso is hinged forward and your arms are fully extended.
Simultaneously push your hips back and press your chest toward the floor to create a stretch through the upper back and hips.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your feet forward and return to standing.
description_en: The wall upper back and hips stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise that targets the upper back and hip flexors simultaneously. With hands against the wall and the torso bent forward, this combined stretch decompresses the spine and opens the hip flexors in one position.
instructions_zh: 面向墙壁站立，双手放在与肩同高的墙面上，双臂伸展。
双脚向后走，直到躯干前倾弯曲，双臂完全伸展。
同时将髋部向后推，胸部向地面压，拉伸上背部和髋部。
保持姿势20-30秒。
双脚向前走，恢复站立。

name_en: wall upper back reverse bent squat
instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide your back down the wall into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Round your upper back slightly against the wall and reach your arms forward.
Hold the position while engaging your upper back and core.
Slide back up to standing and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wall upper back reverse bent squat is a bodyweight exercise that combines a wall squat with an upper back rounded position. It targets the upper back musculature during the squat hold while the legs perform the primary strengthening work.
instructions_zh: 背靠墙站立，双脚与肩同宽。
背部沿墙下滑至蹲姿，直到大腿与地面平行。
上背部微微贴墙拱起，双臂向前伸展。
保持姿势，收紧上背部和核心。
沿墙滑回站立，按目标次数重复。

name_en: wall upper body bent back stretch
name_zh: 靠墙上半身前屈后伸拉伸
instructions_en: Stand with your back against the wall and your feet about a foot from the base.
Slowly bend your upper body forward and away from the wall while keeping your lower back lightly in contact.
Reach your arms down toward the floor and feel the stretch through your upper and lower back.
Hold the stretched position for 20-30 seconds.
Return to an upright position against the wall.
description_en: The wall upper body bent back stretch is a bodyweight flexibility movement targeting the lower and upper back. Bending forward from the wall while maintaining slight contact with the lower back creates a progressive decompressive stretch along the entire spine.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙上半身前屈后伸拉伸
instructions_zh: 背靠墙站立，双脚距墙约一英尺。
上身前屈，缓慢离开墙面，下背部轻贴墙。
双臂向下伸向地面，感受上下背部拉伸。
保持拉伸姿势20-30秒。
回到直立贴墙姿势。

name_en: wall upper body bent hamstrings stretch
name_zh: 靠墙上半身前屈腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_en: Stand facing the wall and place both hands on it slightly below shoulder height.
Walk your feet back and hinge at the hips until your torso is at approximately 45-90 degrees.
Keep your legs straight and press your heels into the floor to feel the hamstring stretch.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your feet back in and return to standing.
description_en: The wall upper body bent hamstrings stretch is a bodyweight standing hamstring stretch using the wall for arm support while the torso is bent forward. The straight-leg forward hinge creates effective lengthening of the hamstrings and lower back.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙上半身前屈腘绳肌拉伸
instructions_zh: 面向墙站立，双手放在略低于肩高处。
双脚后移，髋部折叠，直到躯干约呈45-90度。
双腿伸直，脚跟压地，感受腘绳肌拉伸。
保持姿势20-30秒。
双脚走回，恢复站立。

name_en: wall upper body side bent hand overhead
name_zh: 靠墙上半身侧屈手上举
instructions_en: Stand sideways next to the wall with your feet together and your near hand placed on the wall for support.
Raise the outer arm overhead and lean your body toward the wall in a lateral side bend.
Feel the stretch along the obliques and side of the torso.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Return to upright and repeat on the opposite side.
description_en: The wall upper body side bent hand overhead is a bodyweight side-bending stretch targeting the obliques and lateral torso. The wall provides support for the lower arm while the overhead arm and lateral lean create a focused stretch through the waist and shoulders.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙上半身侧屈手上举
instructions_zh: 侧身靠墙站立，双脚并拢，近侧手扶墙支撑。
外侧手臂举过头顶，身体向墙侧屈。
感受腹斜肌和躯干侧面的拉伸。
保持姿势20-30秒，平稳呼吸。
回到直立，换另一侧重复。

name_en: wall wide leg open bent stretch
name_zh: 靠墙宽腿开立前屈拉伸
instructions_en: Lie on your back and position your hips at the base of the wall with your legs extended straight up against it.
Slowly allow your legs to slide apart into a wide V position, bending your knees slightly as comfortable.
Let gravity pull your legs wider as you relax your inner thighs.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds at the comfortable maximum width.
Bring your legs back together and repeat for the desired number of sets.
description_en: The wall wide leg open bent stretch is a bodyweight flexibility exercise where the legs are spread wide against the wall in a supine position with a slight knee bend. It provides a progressive inner thigh and groin stretch using gravity and the wall for guided positioning.
name_zh_llm: 靠墙宽腿开立前屈拉伸
instructions_zh: 仰卧，臀部靠墙根，双腿伸直贴墙向上。
双腿缓慢分开成宽V形，舒适地微屈膝。
放松大腿内侧，让重力将双腿拉得更开。
在舒适的最大宽度保持拉伸20-30秒。
双腿并拢，按目标组数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet together and hands on your hips.
Take a wide step to the right and shift your body weight over your right leg, bending the right knee.
Keep your left leg straight as you sink into the lateral lunge.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the left side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Warm up lateral lunges are a bodyweight exercise targeting the hip adductors and inner thighs. The lateral stepping pattern dynamically stretches and activates the groin and hips, making it effective as a lower body warm-up movement.
instructions_zh: 双脚并拢站立，双手叉腰。
向右大步迈出，重心移到右腿，屈右膝。
左腿伸直，下沉进入侧弓步。
右脚蹬地回到起始姿势。
左侧重复，继续交替至目标次数。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped behind your head.
Perform a bodyweight squat by bending your knees and lowering your hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Rise back to standing, then immediately hinge forward at the hips into a good morning, lowering your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor.
Return to standing and repeat the squat to begin the next cycle.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The warm up squat and good morning is a bodyweight combination exercise targeting the quadriceps and hamstrings. Alternating between a squat and a hip hinge pattern activates the entire lower body and prepares the posterior chain for training.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，双手抱头。
做徒手深蹲，屈膝下蹲至大腿与地面平行。
起身站立，随即髋部折叠做早安式，躯干下放至接近平行地面。
回到站立，重复深蹲开始下一循环。
按目标次数继续。

instructions_en: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides for stability.
Bend your knees and bring them together above your hips at a 90-degree angle.
Rotate your knees slowly to one side, lowering them toward the floor.
Bring your knees back to center and rotate to the other side.
Continue alternating sides in a windshield wiper motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The warm up wiper is a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the obliques and spinal rotators. The side-to-side leg rotation from the lying position loosens the lower back and activates the core before training.
instructions_zh: 仰卧平躺，双臂向两侧伸展以稳定身体。
屈膝，双膝并拢置于髋部上方呈90度。
双膝缓慢向一侧旋转，下放靠近地面。
双膝回到中间，再转向另一侧。
像雨刷器一样交替两侧，按目标次数继续。

instructions_en: Step one foot forward into a wide lunge, keeping your front knee bent at approximately 90 degrees directly over your ankle.
Turn your back foot out at a 45-degree angle and press through the outer edge of that foot.
Square your hips toward the front of the mat as much as possible.
Raise both arms overhead with palms facing each other and draw your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily, then switch sides.
description_en: Warrior 1 alignment is a bodyweight yoga exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary engagement of the glutes, hamstrings, and shoulders. It involves holding a deep lunge position with arms raised overhead to simultaneously strengthen the lower body, open the hip flexors, and develop postural awareness.
instructions_zh: 一只脚向前迈出成宽弓步，前膝弯曲约90度，正对脚踝上方。
后脚向外转45度，用脚外侧边缘压地。
尽可能将髋部朝向垫子前方摆正。
双臂举过头顶，掌心相对，肩膀向下远离耳朵。
保持20-30秒，均匀呼吸，然后换边。

instructions_en: Stand in mountain pose, then step your right foot back about 4 feet, turning it out to about 45 degrees.
Bend your left knee to 90 degrees, keeping it directly over your ankle.
Square your hips toward the front of your mat as much as possible.
Inhale and raise both arms overhead, palms facing each other, and lift your chest.
Hold the pose for 20-30 seconds, then step forward and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Warrior I is a foundational standing yoga posture that targets the quadriceps and hip flexors. It involves a lunge-based stance with arms raised overhead, combining lower body strengthening with an opening of the chest and hip flexors.
instructions_zh: 站立于山式，右脚向后迈约4英尺，向外转约45度。
左膝弯曲90度，保持正对脚踝上方。
尽可能将髋部朝向垫子前方摆正。
吸气，双臂举过头顶，掌心相对，提起胸腔。
保持20-30秒，然后向前迈步，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your right foot out 90 degrees, left foot in slightly.
Bend your right knee to 90 degrees, keeping it aligned over your right ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides parallel to the floor, palms facing down.
Gaze out over your right hand and keep your torso upright over your hips.
Hold the pose for 20-30 seconds, then straighten your right leg and repeat on the other side.
description_en: Warrior II is a foundational standing yoga posture that targets the quadriceps and hip flexors while opening the hips and chest. It involves a wide-legged stance with the front knee bent and arms extended to the sides, building lower body strength and endurance.
instructions_zh: 双脚大幅分开站立，右脚向外转90度，左脚稍向内扣。
右膝弯曲90度，保持对齐右脚踝上方。
双臂向两侧平举与地面平行，掌心向下。
目光越过右手方向，躯干保持在髋部正上方。
保持20-30秒，然后伸直右腿，换另一侧重复。

instructions_en: Place a weight plate on your upper back and assume a standard push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels and engage your core.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them at approximately 45 degrees from your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The weighted push-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps and chest, with added resistance from a weight plate. This progression of the standard push-up increases demand on the pressing muscles, promoting strength and muscle development.
instructions_zh: 将杠片放在上背部，呈标准俯卧撑姿势，双手略宽于肩。
身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线，收紧核心。
弯曲肘部将胸部降向地面，肘部与身体约呈45度。
通过掌心发力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet slightly off the ground, leaning back at a 45-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell toward the floor beside your hip.
Return to center and rotate to the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The weighted russian twist is a dumbbell rotational exercise targeting the obliques. Adding a dumbbell to the twisting motion increases resistance, developing rotational core strength and stability.
instructions_zh: 坐在地上，屈膝，双脚稍离地，身体后倾45度。
双手在胸前握住哑铃。
躯干向右旋转，将哑铃带向髋部旁的地面。
回到中间，再向左侧旋转。
继续左右交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand in front of a sturdy box or bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step your right foot onto the surface and press through your right heel to lift your body up.
Bring your left foot up to stand fully on the box.
Step your right foot back down, followed by your left.
Continue leading with the same leg or alternate sides for the desired repetitions.
description_en: The weighted step-up is a unilateral lower body exercise targeting the quads and glutes through a stepping and single-leg press movement. Adding dumbbells increases the loading for progressive strength development and functional leg training.
instructions_zh: 站在稳固的箱子或长凳前，双手各持一只哑铃。
右脚踩上台面，通过右脚跟发力将身体撑起。
左脚跟上，完全站上箱子。
右脚先退下，然后左脚退下。
继续以同一腿领先或左右交替，按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Place two dumbbells on the floor wider than shoulder-width apart and grip each handle.
Assume a push-up position with your arms fully extended, hands gripping the dumbbells.
Lower your chest towards the floor between the dumbbells by bending your elbows.
Push through the dumbbells to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a straight body line throughout.
description_en: The wide dumbbell push-up is an exercise targeting the chest, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. Gripping dumbbells in a wide position increases the range of motion and recruits the outer chest fibers more effectively than a standard push-up.
instructions_zh: 将两只哑铃放在地上，间距宽于肩，握住每个把手。
呈俯卧撑姿势，双臂完全伸直，双手握住哑铃。
弯曲肘部将胸部降向哑铃之间的地面。
通过哑铃发力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复，全程保持身体呈一条直线。

instructions_en: Sit upright with your face relaxed and eyes in a neutral position.
Without raising your eyebrows, open your eyes as wide as possible using only the muscles around the eyes.
Hold the wide-open position for 5 seconds.
Slowly relax the eye muscles back to a normal position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide eye opener is a bodyweight facial exercise targeting the orbicularis oculi and surrounding eye muscles. It involves opening the eyes as wide as possible without engaging the forehead to isolate and strengthen the muscles around the eyes.
instructions_zh: 坐直，面部放松，眼睛处于中立位置。
不要抬眉，仅用眼周肌肉将眼睛尽量睁大。
保持睁大状态5秒。
慢慢放松眼部肌肉回到正常位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand holding a barbell with a supinated grip wider than shoulder-width.
Let the bar hang at arm's length in front of your thighs.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause at the top and contract your biceps fully.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide grip barbell curl targets the short head of the biceps by using a wider-than-shoulder-width grip. This inner bicep emphasis contributes to overall bicep width and is an effective complement to close-grip curl variations.
instructions_zh: 双手正握杠铃，握距宽于肩宽，站立持铃。
让杠铃自然下垂于大腿前方，手臂伸直。
保持肘部固定，将杠铃向上弯举至肩部方向。
在顶端稍作停顿，充分收缩肱二头肌。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Hang with arms fully extended and engage your core.
Pull your body upward by driving your elbows down toward your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin rises above the bar.
Pause at the top, squeezing your lats.
Slowly lower yourself back to the dead hang position and repeat.
description_en: The wide grip pull-up is an advanced bodyweight exercise targeting the lats through a vertical pulling motion with a wide overhand grip. The wider grip increases lat activation and reduces biceps contribution, making it highly effective for developing back width.
instructions_zh: 正握引体向上杆，握距宽于肩宽。
双臂完全伸展悬垂，收紧核心。
将肘部向下拉向髋部，带动身体向上。
继续上拉直到下巴超过横杆。
在顶端稍作停顿，挤压背阔肌。
缓慢下放回到完全悬垂位置并重复。

instructions_en: Begin in a push-up position with your hands placed significantly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your fingers pointing forward or slightly outward and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows outward.
Pause briefly when your chest is just above the floor, then press back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide grip push up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the chest with increased emphasis on the outer pectoral muscles. The wider hand position reduces triceps involvement and places greater stress on the chest, making it an effective variation for developing chest width and strength.
instructions_zh: 从俯卧撑姿势开始，双手间距明显宽于肩宽。
手指朝前或略微向外，身体从头到脚跟保持一条直线。
屈肘向外，将胸部向地面下放。
胸部接近地面时稍作停顿，然后推回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley cable and sit with feet on the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Sit upright and pull the bar toward your lower chest, driving your elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the contracted position.
Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide grip seated cable row uses a straight bar with a wide overhand grip to emphasize the upper lats and rear deltoids. The wide grip changes the pulling angle compared to a narrow grip row, targeting the outer back for improved width.
instructions_zh: 将直杆连接到低位滑轮，坐在踏板上，膝盖微屈。
正握直杆，握距宽于肩宽。
坐直，将杆拉向下胸部，肘部向外展开。
在收缩位置将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
缓慢伸直手臂回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Position yourself on a hack squat machine with a wide foot stance and toes pointed outward.
Place your shoulders under the pads and disengage the safety locks.
Lower the sled by bending your knees, tracking them in line with your toes until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to extend your legs back to the starting position without locking your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide hack squat is a machine squat variation performed with a wide stance and externally rotated feet. This positioning shifts emphasis to the inner quads and hip adductors while still heavily recruiting the glutes, making it effective for overall lower body development.
instructions_zh: 在哈克深蹲机上就位，采用宽站距，脚尖朝外。
将肩膀置于垫下，解除安全锁。
屈膝下放滑板，膝盖与脚尖方向一致，直到大腿与地面平行。
通过脚跟发力伸直双腿回到起始位置，不要锁死膝盖。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet spread wide apart, approximately two to three times shoulder-width.
Turn your toes slightly outward and place your hands on your hips.
Hinge forward at the hips, bending your knees slightly as you lower your torso toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor between your feet and allow your head to relax downward.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, feeling the stretch in the inner thighs and hamstrings.
Slowly return to standing and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-leg bent forward fold is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hamstrings and inner thighs. Performed with a wide stance and a forward hip hinge with slightly bent knees, it provides a deep stretch to the posterior and inner legs while reducing strain on the lower back.
instructions_zh: 站立，双脚大幅分开，约为肩宽的兩到三倍。
脚尖略微朝外，双手放在髋部。
以髋部为轴向前屈体，膝盖微屈，将躯干向地面下放。
双手放在双脚之间的地面上，让头部自然向下放松。
保持姿势20-30秒，感受大腿内侧和腘绳肌的拉伸。
缓慢回到站立姿势，按目标次数重复。

name_en: wide-leg forward fold with hand slide
instructions_en: Stand with your feet spread wide apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Place both hands on your thighs and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat.
Slowly slide your hands down your legs toward your feet as you deepen the forward fold.
Allow your hands to reach as far down as comfortable, feeling the stretch in the inner thighs and hamstrings.
Hold the bottom position for 20-30 seconds, then slide your hands back up your legs to return to standing.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-leg forward fold with hand slide is a bodyweight stretch targeting the hamstrings and adductors. The hands sliding progressively down the legs guide a controlled forward fold, deepening the posterior and inner thigh stretch while cuing a flat-back hip hinge pattern.
instructions_zh: 站立，双脚大幅分开，脚尖略微朝外。
双手放在大腿上，以髋部为轴向前屈体，保持背部平直。
双手沿腿部缓慢向下滑向双脚，加深前屈幅度。
让双手在舒适范围内尽量向下伸，感受大腿内侧和腘绳肌的拉伸。
在最低位置保持20-30秒，然后双手沿腿部向上滑回站立姿势。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet spread wide apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hinge forward at the hips until your torso is parallel to the floor, maintaining a flat back.
Place your hands on your shins or on the floor directly beneath your shoulders for support.
Hold this half-fold position for 20-30 seconds, focusing on keeping the spine long.
Slowly return to standing and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-leg half forward fold is a bodyweight stretch targeting the hamstrings. By hinging to a torso-parallel position with a wide stance, it stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs while placing particular emphasis on maintaining a neutral, elongated spine.
instructions_zh: 站立，双脚大幅分开，脚尖略微朝外。
以髋部为轴向前屈体，直到躯干与地面平行，保持背部平直。
双手放在小腿上或肩膀正下方的地面上作为支撑。
保持半前屈姿势20-30秒，注意保持脊柱延展。
缓慢回到站立姿势，按目标次数重复。

name_en: wide-leg lateral stretch with floor support
instructions_en: Sit on the floor and spread your legs as wide as comfortable.
Place both hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Lean your torso toward one leg, reaching your hands along the floor.
Hold the lateral stretch for 20-30 seconds, feeling the pull in the inner thigh and hip.
Return to center and repeat toward the other leg.
description_en: Wide-leg lateral stretch with floor support is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the hip flexors and inner thighs. Leaning toward each leg from a wide-seated position provides a deep unilateral hip and groin stretch.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿尽量向两侧打开至舒适宽度。
双手放在身前地面上支撑。
躯干向一侧腿倾斜，双手沿地面向前伸展。
保持侧向拉伸20-30秒，感受大腿内侧和髋部的牵拉感。
回到中间，换另一侧重复。

name_en: wide-leg seated hamstring hip lift stretch
name_zh: 宽距坐姿腘绳肌抬髋拉伸
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended wide apart and your hands placed on the floor behind your hips.
Press your hands into the floor and lift your hips slightly off the ground.
Hold the lifted position briefly, then slowly lower your hips back down.
Hinge your torso forward over one leg, reaching toward the foot to stretch the hamstring.
Hold the forward fold for 20-30 seconds, then return upright and repeat on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-leg seated hamstring hip lift stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings. Combining a hip lift with a forward fold in a wide-leg seated position, it dynamically engages the glutes and adductors while deepening the hamstring stretch for improved posterior chain flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 宽距坐姿腘绳肌抬髋拉伸
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向两侧大幅伸展，双手放在髋部后方的地面上。
双手压地，将髋部稍微抬离地面。
短暂保持抬髋位置，然后缓慢将髋部放回地面。
躯干向一侧腿前倾，伸手够向脚部以拉伸腘绳肌。
保持前屈20-30秒，然后回到直立位，换另一侧重复。
继续交替两侧，完成目标次数。

name_en: wide-leg seated hamstring hip lift stretch 1
name_zh: 宽距坐姿腘绳肌抬髋拉伸1
instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your legs extended wide and your back straight.
Place both hands on the floor in front of you between your legs.
Walk your hands forward to fold your torso toward the floor, keeping the spine long.
At the deepest point of the fold, press your hands into the floor and gently lift your hips off the ground.
Hold the lifted position for 5-10 seconds, then lower and return to upright.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide-leg seated hamstring hip lift stretch 1 is a bodyweight variation targeting the hamstrings and lower back. By adding a forward torso fold before the hip lift, it creates a deeper hamstring and adductor stretch and introduces a progressive challenge to hip extensor flexibility.
name_zh_llm: 宽距坐姿腘绳肌抬髋拉伸1
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双腿向两侧大幅伸展，背部挺直。
双手放在身前双腿之间的地面上。
双手向前爬行，使躯干向地面折叠，保持脊柱延展。
在折叠最深的位置，双手压地，轻轻将髋部抬离地面。
保持抬髋位置5-10秒，然后放下并回到直立位。
重复完成目标次数。

name_en: wide-leg sit on bent leg hand on floor
instructions_en: Begin in a wide-leg seated position on the floor with both legs extended out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring that foot in close to your groin, lowering your hips toward the bent-leg side.
Place both hands on the floor in front of you for support.
Gently shift your weight to deepen the stretch in the inner thigh of the straight leg.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
description_en: The wide-leg sit on bent leg hand on floor is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the adductors. Transitioning from a wide-leg seat to one bent knee, it creates an asymmetrical hip and inner thigh stretch, improving adductor flexibility and hip mobility.
instructions_zh: 以宽腿坐姿开始，双腿向两侧伸展。
弯曲一侧膝盖，将该脚拉近腹股沟，髋部向屈膝侧下沉。
双手放在身前地面上支撑。
轻轻转移重心，加深伸直腿大腿内侧的拉伸。
保持20-30秒，然后换侧重复。

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the mat.
Lean back slightly and lift both feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Open your legs wide apart, extending them toward a V-shape while keeping them as straight as possible.
Extend your arms forward between your legs, parallel to the floor.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, engaging your core, then slowly bring your legs together and lower your feet.
description_en: Wide-legged boat pose is a yoga balance posture that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It involves balancing on the sit bones with legs extended wide in a V-shape, intensifying the core challenge of standard boat pose through the wider leg position.
instructions_zh: 坐在地面上，双膝弯曲，双脚平放在垫子上。
身体稍向后倾，双脚抬离地面，以坐骨平衡。
双腿向两侧打开呈V形，尽量保持伸直。
双臂在双腿之间向前伸展，与地面平行。
收紧核心，保持20-30秒，然后缓慢并拢双腿并放下双脚。

instructions_en: Stand with your feet wide apart, about 4-5 feet, with toes pointed slightly inward.
Place your hands on your hips and inhale to lengthen your spine.
Exhale and hinge forward from the hips, lowering your torso between your legs.
Place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart and allow the crown of your head to reach toward the mat.
Hold the stretch for 30-60 seconds, then place your hands on your hips and inhale to rise back up.
description_en: Wide-legged forward bend is a standing yoga posture that targets the hamstrings and inner thighs through a wide-stance forward fold. It involves hinging forward between widely spaced legs with the torso hanging toward the floor, promoting deep posterior chain flexibility and shoulder opening.
instructions_zh: 双脚大幅分开站立，约4-5英尺，脚趾略微内扣。
双手放在髋部，吸气延展脊柱。
呼气，从髋部向前折叠，将躯干降至双腿之间。
双手与肩同宽平放在地面上，头顶向垫子方向延伸。
保持拉伸30-60秒，然后双手放回髋部，吸气起身。

instructions_en: Sit in the leg press machine with your feet placed wide apart on the platform and toes turned outward.
Release the safety and lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Descend until your knees are at roughly 90 degrees, keeping your lower back pressed to the pad.
Drive through your heels to press the platform away and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The wide stance leg press is a machine-based lower body exercise that shifts emphasis to the glutes and inner thighs compared to a standard leg press. The wider foot placement and outward toe angle recruit the adductors and gluteal muscles more effectively.
instructions_zh: 坐在腿举机上，双脚宽距放在踏板上，脚趾朝外。
解除安全锁，弯曲膝盖将踏板向胸部方向下放。
下放至膝盖约90度，保持下背部贴紧靠垫。
通过脚跟发力将踏板推离，回到起始位置。
重复完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Step your right foot forward to the outside of your right hand, lowering into a deep lunge.
Drop your right elbow toward the floor inside your right foot, holding briefly.
Rotate your torso and reach your right arm straight up toward the ceiling, following it with your gaze.
Return your hand to the floor, push your hips back to stretch the hamstring of the front leg, then step back to plank.
Repeat on the opposite side and continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The world's greatest stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hip flexors and providing a comprehensive full-body mobility sequence. Combining a deep lunge, thoracic rotation, and hamstring stretch in one fluid movement, it improves flexibility, mobility, and movement quality throughout the entire kinetic chain.
instructions_zh: 从高平板支撑开始，双手位于肩膀正下方。
右脚向前迈到右手外侧，下压进入深弓步。
右肘向右脚内侧地面下沉，短暂保持。
旋转躯干，右臂向上伸直指向天花板，目光跟随右手。
右手放回地面，髋部后推拉伸前腿腘绳肌，然后退回平板支撑。
换另一侧重复，继续交替完成目标次数。

instructions_en: Extend your arms in front of you at shoulder height.
Make fists with both hands and begin rotating your wrists in slow, full circles.
Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
description_en: Wrist circles are a bodyweight mobility exercise targeting the forearms and wrist joint. The circular motion improves wrist flexibility, reduces stiffness, and is used as a warm-up before exercises involving grip and pressing.
instructions_zh: 双臂向前伸直，与肩同高。
双手握拳，开始缓慢地做完整的绕腕动作。
向一个方向绕指定次数，然后反方向绕。
保持动作流畅可控。

name_zh: 手腕伸展拉伸（手指向下）
instructions_en: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing downward.
Use your other hand to gently press your fingers downward and toward your body.
Hold when you feel tension along the top of your forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch hands and repeat.
description_en: Wrist Extension Stretch Fingers Down is a bodyweight stretching exercise targeting the forearm extensors. Pressing the fingers downward gently lengthens the extensor muscles along the top of the forearm, helping to relieve tension and prevent injuries such as tennis elbow.
name_zh_llm: 手腕伸展拉伸（手指向下）
instructions_zh: 一只手臂向前伸直，掌心朝下。
用另一只手轻轻将手指向下、朝身体方向按压。
当前臂上侧感到拉伸时保持。
换手重复。

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge forward slightly at the hips.
Extend your arms in a Y shape overhead, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Lower and extend your arms into a T position at shoulder height.
Lower and bring your arms into a W position by bending the elbows.
Return to the starting position and repeat the Y-T-W sequence for the desired repetitions.
description_en: Y-T-W beginners is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back in a standing position. The beginner variation uses a slight forward hinge instead of lying prone, making it accessible while still activating the scapular stabilizers and rear deltoids.
instructions_zh: 双脚与肩同宽站立，髋部微微前倾。
双臂向上呈Y形伸展，肩胛骨向内收紧。
放下双臂，在肩高处呈T形伸展。
放下双臂，屈肘呈W形。
回到起始位置，按目标次数重复Y-T-W序列。

name_en: y t w hand leg raise
instructions_en: Lie face down on the floor with your arms and legs extended.
Simultaneously raise your arms into a Y shape and your opposite leg off the floor.
Transition to a T shape by extending your arms straight out to the sides, then a W shape by bending your elbows.
Lower back to the starting position and repeat the sequence.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Y T W hand leg raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back and rear deltoids. Combining the Y, T, and W arm positions with opposite leg raises challenges posterior chain stability, scapular control, and overall back endurance.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在地面上，双臂和双腿伸展。
同时将双臂抬成Y形，并将对侧腿抬离地面。
双臂向两侧伸直转为T形，再屈肘转为W形。
放回起始位置，重复该序列。
按目标次数继续。

instructions_en: Lie face down on the floor with your forehead resting on the ground and arms extended overhead.
Raise your arms into a Y shape, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower your arms and raise them into a T shape, then into a W shape by bending your elbows.
Lower your arms after each position before moving to the next.
Complete all three positions for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: Y T W hand raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back and traps. The sequential arm positions activate different portions of the scapular stabilizers and posterior deltoids, improving posture and shoulder health.
instructions_zh: 俯卧在地面上，额头贴地，双臂过头伸展。
将双臂抬成Y形，肩胛骨向内收紧。
放下双臂，再抬成T形，然后屈肘呈W形。
每个姿势后放下双臂再进入下一个姿势。
按目标次数完成全部三个姿势。

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip a barbell with an underhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Hinge forward at the hips to approximately a 70-degree upright angle, more upright than a standard bent over row.
Pull the barbell toward your lower abdomen, driving your elbows back.
Pause at the contracted position, squeezing your lats.
Slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The yates row is a bent-over row variation using an underhand grip performed at a more upright torso angle than a standard row. The underhand grip and angle shift emphasis to the lower lats and biceps, making it effective for overall back thickness.
instructions_zh: 双脚与髋同宽站立，以略宽于肩的反握握住杠铃。
髋部前倾至约70度的较直立角度，比标准俯身划船更直立。
将杠铃拉向下腹部，肘部向后驱动。
在收缩位置停顿，收紧背阔肌。
缓慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Rest the barbell in the crook of your elbows, forearms crossed or hands clasped in front of your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Descend by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your elbows in.
Lower until your elbows touch or nearly touch your thighs at the bottom.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The zercher squat is a barbell squat variation in which the bar is held in the crooks of the elbows. This front-loaded position challenges the upper back, core, and quads while promoting an upright torso throughout the full range of motion.
instructions_zh: 将杠铃置于肘窝处，前臂交叉或双手在胸前相扣。
双脚与肩同宽站立，脚尖略微外展。
屈膝并向后推髋下蹲，肘部保持内收。
下蹲至底部时肘部触碰或接近触碰大腿。
通过脚跟发力回到起始位置。
按目标次数重复。

instructions_en: Mark out a zig zag path on the floor or visualize a series of cones.
Begin walking briskly in a zig zag pattern, stepping side to side with each change of direction.
Keep your steps controlled and your core engaged.
Increase your pace to a brisk walk or light jog as your coordination improves.
Continue through the zig zag pattern for the desired number of passes.
description_en: The zig zag walk is a low-impact agility exercise that involves walking or jogging in a zig zag pattern. It improves directional change mechanics, foot coordination, and provides a gentle cardiovascular stimulus, making it suitable for warm-ups or rehabilitation.
instructions_zh: 在地面上标出之字形路线，或想象一系列锥桶。
以之字形快步行走，每次变向时左右跨步。
保持步伐可控，核心收紧。
随着协调性提高，加快到快走或轻慢跑。
按目标趟数继续之字形路线。

instructions_en: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders as in a standard curl.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so your palms face downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells in this pronated position.
At the bottom, rotate your wrists back to the supinated starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description_en: The zottman curl is a dumbbell exercise that targets the biceps on the way up and the forearm extensors and brachialis on the way down by rotating the wrist at the top. It is one of the most efficient exercises for developing complete arm thickness.
instructions_zh: 站立，双手持哑铃于体侧，掌心朝前。
像标准弯举一样，将哑铃向上弯举至肩部。
在动作顶端，旋转手腕使掌心朝下。
保持掌心朝下的姿势，缓慢下放哑铃。
在底部，将手腕旋转回掌心朝上的起始位置。
按目标次数重复。
